jobs.title: AI Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About Illumbria** Illumbria exists to discover what AI makes possible and build what comes next. We are drawn to ideas that once seemed out of reach, and to possibilities that people have not yet imagined. Through product design, applied AI, and engineering, we create AI\-native applications that expand how organizations work and what they can offer their customers. We are building a company where curious, ambitious people can help shape both the ideas and their implementation. Our work crosses industries and disciplines, often taking us into problems with no established approach. That calls for independent thinking, experimentation, and the judgment to turn new possibilities into software people can depend on. We care deeply about what we build and how well we build it. We want people who question assumptions, contribute their own ideas, and take responsibility for seeing them through. The opportunity is to help define what these applications can become—and do the work that brings them into existence. **The Role** We are looking for an AI Systems Engineer to design and build applications with AI at their core. You will help turn ambitious ideas into working software, making decisions about architecture, developing the systems behind the application, and refining how they perform in real use. The work spans AI agents, data, integrations, and the application itself. You will explore approaches where established patterns may not exist, evaluate what works, and carry your decisions through implementation. This is a hands\-on engineering position with meaningful ownership of both how the systems are built and how well they work. **Responsibilities** * Work with clients to understand their needs, assess technical feasibility, and explain proposed approaches and tradeoffs. * Evaluate emerging models and techniques through focused experiments, and apply them where they improve the systems we build. * Build the application around AI workflows, including user interfaces, APIs, data models, integrations, and background processing. * Build AI agents and workflows that use tools, manage context, verify results, and recover from interruptions or failures. * Develop data\-processing and retrieval systems that give applications accurate, relevant information with traceable sources. * Develop reusable components and internal tooling that improve how we build and maintain applications. * Build evaluations and regression tests that measure changes to models, prompts, and application behavior before they reach production. * Improve response times and operating costs while maintaining quality, and make system performance measurable. * Review and test code, including work produced by AI coding agents, and document decisions so others can maintain and extend the systems. **How We Work** AI coding agents are part of our everyday engineering workflow. You will direct their work, evaluate what they produce, and take responsibility for the software you ship. We value knowing when to delegate, when to investigate further, and when to work through a problem yourself. You will have clear priorities and the autonomy to decide how to approach them. Bring ideas, question assumptions, and communicate the reasoning behind your decisions. **Requirements** * A record of shipping production software you can point to and explain in detail. * Experience building applications on top of modern LLM APIs: structured outputs, tool calling, multi\-step agent runs and the failure modes that come with them. * Strong backend engineering: data modeling, APIs, async and long\-running work, and integration with external services. * Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and work through technical problems independently. * Judgment about when AI is the right tool, when deterministic code is, and how to put guardrails around the boundary. * Experience using AI coding agents, or the ability and willingness to adopt them while independently verifying their output. * Clear written communication. **Helpful Experience** Useful, but not required: * TypeScript and a modern web framework, or an equivalent stack you could carry over. * Word and PDF internals (OOXML, PDF text extraction, OCR). * AI evaluation: benchmark datasets, regression testing, human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Financial services, legal or other compliance\-sensitive software, including SOC 2\-aligned practices. * Cloud deployment and operations on AWS, Cloudflare or similar. **What We Offer** * Flexible hours and competitive pay. * Responsibility for technical decisions, with room to propose approaches and carry them through implementation. * Work across different applications and industries as projects develop. **Apply from your terminal.** ssh ingress.illumbria.com Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule Work Location: Hybrid remote in Grapevine, TX 76051

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: As a Backend Engineer at Zeromatter, you'll architect the high\-performance backend systems that power our revolutionary simulation platform. You'll design and implement scalable APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems that handle the massive computational demands of photorealistic simulations across thousands of concurrent instances. This role offers the unique opportunity to build the technical foundation that enables next\-generation autonomous systems to train and validate at unprecedented scale, combining deep backend expertise with cutting\-edge distributed systems architecture. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design and implement high\-throughput backend systems serving simulation data to internal and external systems. * Build and scale data pipelines for processing petabyte\-scale volumes of simulation output. * Architect and optimize database systems for high\-concurrency workloads. * Implement sophisticated caching strategies to minimize latency and maximize throughput. * Design fault\-tolerant systems with strong observability and monitoring. * Develop authentication and authorization systems for a multi\-tenant platform. * Collaborate with customer teams to ensure backend APIs meet integration requirements. * Design load balancing and resource allocation strategies for efficient scheduling. * Architect and operate distributed systems across multiple deployments and cloud environments. * Identify and address performance bottlenecks under heavy load. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g. computer science) or equivalent working experience. * Strong experience with compiled languages, with Rust strongly preferred (C\+\+, Go, C also acceptable). * Proven expertise in database design and optimization (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB). * Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and microservices patterns. * Experience building and scaling backend APIs handling millions of requests. * Experience with backend observability tools and performance profiling. * 1\+ years of Kubernetes experience in production environments. * Bonus: Background in high\-performance computing or scientific computing. * Bonus: Experience with multi\-cloud backend architectures. Compensation Range: $100K \- $300K

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

You’ll work across public cloud and virtualized environments, strengthen security, and partner with software and IT teams to keep systems scalable and dependable. **Duties** * Design and manage cloud infrastructure, cloud services, and cloud architecture across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and other environments. * Automate deployment processes and infrastructure management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Terraform, Ansible, scripting, and DevOps automation. * Operate Linux, UNIX, and Windows systems; manage virtualization, Virtual Private Clouds, VPNs, storage such as S3, and identity and access management (IAM) solutions. * Support containers and distributed systems, including Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and service\-oriented architecture; troubleshoot APIs, RESTful APIs, and web services. * Apply system hardening and improve scalability, reliability, and cloud management practices. Your impact: dependable infrastructure helps development teams deliver services and gives users more consistent access. **Requirements** * Experience managing IT infrastructure, cloud computing, cloud development, or software deployment; familiarity with Agile and the software development life cycle (SDLC). * Hands\-on knowledge of cloud platforms and services, such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Rackspace, VMware, OpenStack, Citrix, SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS. * Scripting or programming experience with Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, Ruby, PowerShell, Bash, or Shell Scripting; Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins are useful. * Familiarity with databases and data technologies, including SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, T\-SQL, PL/SQL, or NoSQL. * Related experience with Chef, Puppet, Meraki,.NET, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, Internet of Things, computer science, operating systems, computer management, application development, software development, or IT is a plus. jobs.title: Cybersecurity & QA Engineer

We serve enterprise clients across healthcare, fitness, hospitality and senior care. It runs on Node.js, Express and MongoDB Atlas, with integrations for payments, email, SMS and notifications. **About the Role** This is a build role. You will establish LeanSite’s structured quality assurance practice, moving us beyond release\-stage acceptance testing to planned, repeatable and increasingly automated testing. At the same time, you will own application security across the platform, from access control and vulnerability management to secure release practices. We know this combination is uncommon. We expect most candidates to be stronger on one side, and we are looking for real depth in one area and solid working competence in the other. **Key ResponsibilitiesQUALITY ASSURANCE \& TESTING** * Build and own the test strategy across all four product surfaces: FM Portal, Workforce Portal, LeanSite Agent mobile app and Admin Portal. * Write test plans and test cases from user stories and acceptance criteria, working with Product from refinement through to release. * Build and maintain regression suites, and run regression ahead of every release. * Introduce automated testing (end\-to\-end, API and mobile) and integrate it into the CI/CD pipeline so it runs on every build. * Test complex workflows end to end, including recurring and bulk work orders, offline mode, multi\-channel notifications, vendor check\-in/check\-out and payments. * Test AI features, including Vera, for accuracy, consistency and safe behavior. * Log, triage and track defects in Jira, and verify fixes before they ship. * Define release quality gates with the Head of Engineering and the Release Owner, and sign off on release readiness. * Support user acceptance testing with internal teams and clients ahead of major rollouts. **SECURITY** * Own application security across the platform: run vulnerability assessments, coordinate penetration tests and drive remediation with the engineering team. * Review authentication, authorization and role\-based access control, including data isolation between client organizations. * Embed security into the development lifecycle through secure code review support, dependency and secrets scanning, and automated security checks in CI/CD. * Review the security of third\-party integrations and infrastructure, including payment processors, email and SMS providers, cloud hosting, database and DNS. * Assess AI\-specific risks in Vera, such as prompt injection and unintended data exposure. * Lead security incident response: triage, containment, root cause analysis and post\-incident review. * Maintain security policies and documentation, and respond to enterprise client security questionnaires and reviews. * Lay the groundwork for compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 as our enterprise customer base grows. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of experience in QA engineering, application security, or a combination of both, ideally in a SaaS environment. * Hands\-on experience testing web applications and APIs, including writing structured test plans and test cases. * Experience with at least one test automation framework (e.g. Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and API testing tools (e.g. Postman). * Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and common web and API vulnerabilities. * Experience with security testing tools such as Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP. * Understanding of authentication and authorization patterns, including OAuth, JWT, OTP sign\-in and role\-based access control. * Working familiarity with JavaScript and Node.js: enough to read code, write test scripts and review changes. * Experience integrating automated checks into CI/CD pipelines. * Clear written communication: bug reports, test documentation and security findings that both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders can act on. * Experience working in Jira or a similar issue tracker within an agile team. **Nice to Have** * Mobile testing experience, particularly React Native apps on iOS and Android (e.g. Detox or Appium). * Experience with MongoDB, including NoSQL injection risks and database access controls. * Certifications such as CompTIA Security\+, CEH, OSCP or ISTQB. * Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar compliance programs. * Experience testing AI or LLM\-powered features. * Exposure to payments integrations and PCI DSS. * Load and performance testing experience (e.g. k6 or JMeter). * Background in facilities management, property technology or field service software. **What We Offer** * The chance to build quality and security from the ground up at a growing AI\-native SaaS company. * Direct impact on a product used daily by enterprise facilities teams and field technicians. * Close collaboration with Product, Engineering and leadership, with real ownership over how we ship. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $115,000\.00 per year Application Question(s): * A few things about you \* * A brief explanation of a complex technical problem you've solved — distributed systems, performance, AI integration, IOT or anything that required genuine engineering thinking \* * A link to your GitHub or a live portfolio of personal projects. * LinkedIn Profile URL (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Your best work shouldn't be hidden behind your last employer's name.** Some of the strongest engineers we've worked with wouldn't stand out in a resume stack. They didn't all come from FAANG. They didn't all have CS degrees from the usual schools. Some did, some didn't, and it made less difference than you'd think. What made them stand out: hand them an ambiguous problem and an unfamiliar codebase, and they shipped something real. Quickly. They read the code before asking for help. They picked up new tools without being told to. They weren't thrown by systems they didn't understand on day one. And they built things that held up in production. **That's who we're looking for.** **The opportunity** Peri is recruiting Software Engineers, including founding and early backend roles, for some of New York's most compelling AI startups, from Seed to Series D\+, backed by investors including a16z, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, Notable Capital, and Thrive. We've worked closely with the founders, studied the engineers who thrive on their teams, and learned what really sets them apart. The short version: **Ownership, speed, technical judgment, and the ability to learn fast often count for more than the name at the top of your last offer letter.** You don't need to have worked on AI products already. If you have, great. If you haven't, keep reading. **What you'll actually do** Imagine joining a team where the product is still taking shape. There's no thick onboarding doc. The architecture has decisions you'd make differently. The roadmap changes when a customer says something surprising. Your job is to make it work. Understand what users actually need. Make the tradeoffs. Design the system, write the code, ship it, and fix it when real traffic finds what tests didn't. You're part builder, part architect, part problem\-solver. You'll work directly with founders. You'll own features and systems end to end, not just tickets. And you'll see your work in front of customers within days, not quarters. These roles are for engineers who like having the whole problem. **Who we're looking for** Maybe you're an engineer at a big company who keeps wanting to touch more of the stack than your team allows. Maybe you taught yourself, switched careers, or grew into responsibilities long before anyone gave you the title for them. **We take all of that seriously.** But here's the thing. **We need you to show us.** A resume won't tell us how you debug something you've never seen, how you make decisions with incomplete information, or what you do when the obvious approach falls over. So walk us through it. Tell us about a system you designed. A bug that took you days to track down. A technology you had to master in a week. Something you built that nobody asked you to build. It doesn't need to be impressive\-sounding. It needs to be real. **Why aren't the companies listed?** Because this isn't one opening. We work with several teams looking for similar engineers, each building something different. Rather than you running six interview loops in parallel, we'd like to understand how you think and what you're great at, then point you toward the teams where you'd fit best. We only work with companies we'd be excited to join ourselves. **Who is Peri?** Most technical recruiting is keyword matching: languages, frameworks, years of experience, last employer. We think that leaves a lot of great engineers on the table. So we start from the other end. We learn from founders what actually makes an engineer succeed on their team, then look for those qualities in people whose resumes may undersell them. We're most interested in engineers who are better than their credentials suggest. **How to apply** * Apply here or DM me on LinkedIn. * We do want one answer: **What's the hardest or most interesting thing you've built, and what about it makes you think you're capable of more than your resume shows?** + A few sentences is enough. A link to code or a project is even better. Specifics beat buzzwords. + If there's a fit, we'll talk, share what we know about each team, and help you figure out which roles make sense. When there's a strong match, we'll connect you directly with the founders. **And if you've ever thought, "I'm a much better engineer than my resume makes me look," we especially want to hear from you.** **One last thing** Looking past credentials doesn't mean looking past ability. If you're mass\-applying without reading the post, can't show real engineering work, have a fabricated or misleading LinkedIn profile, or aren't authorized to work in the United States, please don't apply. **It's not a good use of anyone's time.** We'll overlook a pedigree. We won't overlook a lack of effort, skill, or honesty. **Show us what you've shipped, not what you say you can ship.** Compensation Range: $150K \- $350K

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life\-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— **we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 3\.6 million patients!** We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round. **About The Role** ------------------ As **Head of Engineering**, you will lead the teams building the technology and workflows that enable us to solve the prior authorization bottleneck challenging prescribers, pharmacies, and pharma \- and most importantly, the patients who need medication. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role: you will run day\-to\-day engineering execution, grow and develop engineers and tech leads, and stay close enough to the code to make the hard architectural calls. You’ll also be regularly involved, alongside our tech leads, in sales calls with customers, wearing a product and solutions\-engineering hat that keeps the voice of the customer close to our build. Our platform and agents work in healthcare delivery, meaning our workflows must be accurate and highly reliable, and with documentation digestible to our non\-technical customers: pharmaceutical companies, pharmacists, and doctors prescribing medication. In this field we must ship fast without compromising the accuracy, security, and reliability that healthcare delivery demands. You will report to the co\-founder and CTO, and sit on and partner closely with our extended leadership team. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Own delivery:** Run engineering execution across multiple pods, with weekly ship cycles, clear ownership, and a culture where velocity and high reliability go hand\-in\-hand. * **Build and lead the team:** Hire, onboard, and develop senior engineers to recent grads, growing your tech lead and engineering manager layer as we scale. (Current team is 2 leads and 7 engineers) You will be highly involved in growing the team your first six months, and as we scale, we expect you’ll interview each person at onsite to keep the bar high. * **Ship enterprise\-grade technology:** Our customers are used to and expect enterprise\-grade quality that seamlessly works with existing systems and EHRs, within their existing workflows. You’ll guide the architecture of our platform and systems so they are accurate, explainable, and extensible as we scale and move into new workflows, integrations, and verticals. * **Raise quality and reliability:** Establish practical standards for code review, testing, agent and AI evaluations, observability, on\-call, and incident response. * **Compliance and Security:** Partner with our infrastructure lead and fractional CISO to meet the security, privacy, and deployment requirements of our customers. * **Connect engineering to the customer:** Work with product and our GTM leaders to turn customer feedback and requirements into roadmaps and built features. **About You** ------------- * **You are a hands\-on leader:** You are a strong engineer who can read a PR, spot an architectural mistake, and fix it yourself when that’s expedient. You also know the team scale with the company, and know how to coach and teach earlier\-in\-career engineers how to develop their craft as engineers, including their instincts, judgement and taste that can’t be developed by AI, and often are eroded by it. * **You have become AI\-native:** You have shipped LLM, agentic, or ML systems to production and understand evaluation, context management, and the difference between a demo and a production system. You manage AI with judgement and taste, and hold a high technical bar for elegance, quality, and extensibility. * **You bring scaling experience:** You have grown engineering teams as a company scales, and developed engineers into tech leads and managers over time. * **You operate with velocity, and discernment:** References say you move fast, but you know when to slow down 10% to check your thinking, the requirements, and what problem we’re trying to solve. You reduce work\-about\-work, but insert good\-friction when needed to maintain quality and reliability. * **You value reliability and compliance:** You have built in a domain where getting it right matters, such as security, compliance, fintech, or health. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 4\+ years managing engineers and 2\+ years growing managers or tech leads. * Hands\-on experience shipping enterprise\-grade systems in an AI\-native way. * Demonstrated experience hiring and scaling engineering teams at a high\-growth company. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent engineering with customers and fellow leaders alike. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive base salary plus meaningful early\-stage equity. * A direct line to the CEO and real ownership of a business outcome. * Work that directly accelerates access to medication for hundreds of thousands of patients, with room to grow as the function scales.

infrastructure and tooling behind our machine learning workflows. * Own our data infrastructure end to end at scale: cataloguing, batch pipelines, freshness, quality assurance, and analytics. * Design the metadata, lineage, and search systems that let any engineer find, trust, and understand any dataset. * Maintain high\-quality, balanced, and representative datasets by supporting data science and analytics. * Work hands\-on with multi\-modal data — text, images, video, point clouds, and geometry — with a strong emphasis on 3D contexts and real\-world data. * Take new data systems from zero to ====================================== * Demonstrated experience in developing optimal experimental design strategies with strong background in selecting experiments to maximize information, identify parameters, distinguish hypotheses, or improve model predictions. * Demonstrated experience in developing active learning and sequential design methods for iteratively selecting new data points based on what has already been learned. * Demonstrated experience in Bayesian optimization, including development of acquisition functions, surrogate models, and sequential optimization, ideally beyond standard black\-box optimization. * Demonstrated experience with multi\-fidelity, multi\-modal, multi\-source sampling including making optimal decisions on where to sample, what conditions to test, anticipated closing window for application submission is up to 30 days and may be extended as needed. **Annual Salary Range (based on full\-time 40 hours per week)** =============================================================== Job Profile: Postdoctoral Researcher / Annual Salary Range: $76,600 \- $126,400 NLR takes into consideration a candidate’s education, training, and experience, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value, including seniority and merit systems, and internal pay alignment when determining the salary level for potential new employees. Applications are not kept on file for future positions. Please include a cover letter and resume with each position application. . **Equal Opportunity Employer** ============================== All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, domestic partner status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws. **Reasonable Accommodations** **E** **\-Verify** **www.dhs.gov/E\-Verify** For information about right to work E\-Verify is a registered trademark of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security. jobs.description: **Posting Title** ================= Postdoctoral Researcher in uncertainty quantification and prediction reliability . **Location** ============ CO \- Golden . **Position Type** ================= Postdoc (Fixed Term) . **Hours Per Week** ================== 40 . **Working at NLR** ================== NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development. Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world\-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost\-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth. At NLR, you'll find a mission\-driven environment supported by state\-of\-the\-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well\-being. **Job Description** =================== The Artificial Learning and Intelligent Systems group in NLR’s Computational Science Center has an immediate opening for a Postdoctoral Researcher to pursue a cross\-disciplinary research project in uncertainty quantification, with particular emphasis on evaluating prediction reliability across scales (lab\-scale to pilot\-scale) in applications relevant to the DOE Office of Critical Minerals and Energy Innovation. We are looking for an individual who can reason about uncertainty arising from sparse data, extrapolation, and potentially incorrect model structure. The successful applicant will develop methods to quantify uncertainty in cross\-scale prediction models and identify when a model is operating beyond the conditions where its predictions are reliable. The deeper problem is that a model trained at one scale may be systematically wrong at another because the underlying relationships have changed, important mechanisms are missing, or the available evidence does not adequately constrain the prediction. The successful applicant will conduct original methods research to address this challenge. We are looking for individuals with background in applied statistics, uncertainty quantification for scientific computing, statistical learning theory, reliable or trustworthy machine learning, out\-of\-distribution detection and distributionally robust methods, and/or model validation and discrepancy modeling. . **Basic Qualifications** ======================== Must be a recent PhD graduate within the last three years. **\* Must meet educational requirements prior to employment start date.** **Additional Required Qualifications** ====================================== * Demonstrated experience with statistical modeling including strong grounding in statistical inference, Bayesian methods, probabilistic modeling, and uncertainty propagation. * Demonstrated experience with uncertainty quantification including experience distinguishing and estimating aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty, and model\-form or structural uncertainty. * Demonstrated understanding of methods for assessing whether predicted uncertainty corresponds to actual prediction errors, especially with limited validation data. * Demonstrated understanding of distribution shift and out\-of\-distribution detection for identifying when new conditions or data differ meaningfully from the training domain. * Demonstrated experience with model discrepancy and structural uncertainty to enable understanding how missing physics, incorrect assumptions, or changing mechanisms affect model reliability. * Demonstrated experience evaluating predictions outside the training domain, including methods that can recognize when extrapolation is unsafe or unsupported. * Excellent communication skills * Demonstrated experience working in multi\-disciplinary teams and collaborative jobs.title: Product ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** Today, AI is something you rent. Alpaca is building the full stack of hardware, software, models, and applications together to make it something you own. We are developing a new computer architecture that breaks the economics keeping frontier models trapped in datacenters. On top of that, we’re building a platform of models, applications, and services that give that hardware meaning. Personal AI is moving from the datacenter to the desk, and we are driving that change. Our team is based in Cambridge, MA. **About the role** We want to make local AI models capable of doing far more than answering questions. Our goal is to build intelligent systems that can understand their users, remember information over time, use tools, and reliably accomplish complex tasks on their behalf. We are looking for an ML engineer to help bridge the gap between what a model can do on its own and what it can accomplish as part of a complete system. You'll work across model optimization, post\-training, agent architectures, memory systems, and evaluation to make our AI more capable, efficient, and reliable. This is a role for someone who enjoys both ML research and building real systems. You should be comfortable fine\-tuning models, experimenting with inference\-time techniques, designing agent harnesses, and developing new approaches to managing context and memory. You'll have the opportunity to experiment with ideas, measure what works, and bring improvements directly into products used by real people. **What you’ll do** **Improve our models:** Fine\-tune, distill, and optimize language models for tool use, instruction following, and complex agentic tasks. **Build agent systems:** Develop harnesses, tool\-use architectures, planning and execution loops, and other techniques that make models more capable and reliable. **Engineer memory and context:** Build retrieval, persistent memory, context compression, and management systems that allow agents to work effectively across long tasks and conversations. **Optimize inference:** Experiment with quantization, speculative decoding, and inference\-time techniques to improve model quality, speed, and efficiency on local hardware. **Evaluate and iterate:** Develop benchmarks and evaluations for agent capabilities, long\-horizon reliability, memory, and real\-world task performance. **Research and implement:** Explore new papers, algorithms, and techniques, rapidly prototype promising ideas, and integrate successful approaches into production. **Who we’re looking for** **Strong ML fundamentals:** Experience with modern language models, transformers, PyTorch, and the training and inference techniques behind them. **Agentic systems experience:** You've built or experimented with LLM agents, tool calling, planning, retrieval, or multi\-step reasoning systems. **Memory and context engineering:** Understanding of long\-context processing, memory architectures, and techniques for working within limited context windows. **Model optimization:** Familiarity with quantization, efficient inference, and the tradeoffs between model quality, latency, and compute. **Experience with post\-training:** Familiarity with supervised fine\-tuning, reinforcement learning, distillation, or other techniques for improving model behavior. **Research\-minded engineering:** You enjoy reading papers, implementing new ideas, and turning research into working software. **Independence:** You take ownership of ambiguous problems, move quickly, and thrive in an experimental environment. **How to apply** Send us your resume, Github, and some projects you have worked on, along with a short note about why Alpaca interests you. More than credentials, we want to see what you've made, researched, designed, or shipped. If the role sounds like you but your background is unconventional, apply anyways. Compensation Range: $160K \- $180K

This is a greenfield opportunity to shape our backend architecture, data model, database design, and the services that make recordings accessible and useful. You'll have real influence over technology choices and how the platform grows. Leading candidates include Supabase and PostgreSQL, with S3\-compatible object storage and Zarr v3 for scientific arrays. We favor focused services and managed infrastructure that give a small team room to build ambitious capabilities. **You will** ------------ * Shape the backend architecture and select technologies around the needs of our product, researchers, and engineering team. * Design the data model and relational database schema, including recording identity, configuration, provenance, relationships, indexing, and schema migrations. * Build APIs and services for ingesting, storing, discovering, and retrieving recordings and their metadata. * Design authentication, authorization, and credential flows that make access secure and straightforward. * Collaborate with desktop engineers on robust upload and synchronization workflows that preserve recording integrity. * Develop scientific data storage around useful access patterns, balancing performance, scalability, and cost. * Establish automated testing, continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), and observability that keep the platform reliable and easy to evolve. **You are** ----------- * An engineer with a degree in computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field, and at least five years SQL, APIs, and cloud object storage. * Familiar with authentication, authorization, and credential management across application boundaries. * Able to design robust data flows and reason about consistency between services, stored data, and metadata. * Interested in shaping a greenfield system, making tradeoffs explicit, and choosing designs a small team can build and evolve. * Someone who enjoys collaborating with the people producing and consuming the data. **You might also** ------------------ * Have experience with Supabase or PostgreSQL row\-level security (RLS), or bring related database and managed\-backend experience with MySQL, Firebase, or Appwrite. * Have built REST or GraphQL APIs, serverless functions, event\-driven services, or data ingestion pipelines on AWS, Google By combining real\-world healthcare data with AI\-powered insights, AcuityMD enables companies from pre\-commercial to enterprise to understand where and how to sell faster to accelerate the adoption of medical technology. As a Senior Data Product Manager, you will build and refine AcuityMD’s data assets, products, model and platform. You’ll play a critical role in identifying market opportunities, crafting compelling product offerings, and bringing agentic AI solutions to life. You will build empathy for our users, solve complex problems and drive business success for our customers and for AcuityMD. You will work cross\-functionally with engineering and customer\-facing teams. ### **Team Mission** We are building a world\-class data products team to meticulously craft and deliver data assets and algorithms that enable new workflows and power AcuityAI to solve customer problems. Our team is the critical link between what our engineers build and what our customers need. We are looking for product leaders to develop deep empathy for our users, apply data and AI to prioritize user needs, and bring new capabilities to life by aligning and coordinating across technical and customer\-facing teams. ### **Responsibilities** * Own a product area end\-to\-end: deeply understand customer problems, define the product vision, clearly articulate desired outcomes and acceptance criteria, prioritize ruthlessly, and ship thoughtfully. * Prototype, test and deliver new data products and algorithms with engineering and small, nimble cross\-functional teams * Drive discovery by partnering with customers, product marketing, and data teams to uncover unmet needs and turn them into compelling, scalable software * Integrate AI effectively, both in how you work (e.g., research, analysis, content generation) and in what we build, leveraging LLMs and automation where they create user value and differentiation. * Collaborate with data, machine learning, and analytics engineers to operationalize and harden our data products and tooling, and to ensure the success of solutions that build on our data * Communicate clearly and regularly \- both in meetings and in writing. You’ll drive a compelling roadmap to ensure everyone is working toward clear goals and outcomes. * Balance short\- and long\-term bets. Keep the team focused on measurable outcomes today while building toward a compelling long\-term product vision. * Own key metrics to measure and improve product and business outcomes * Uphold high standards of integrity, curiosity, and ambition—championing what’s right for our users, our team, and the business. ### **Your Profile** * Motivated by building exceptional products and building a winning AI company. * 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally in vertical B2B. You’ll have a successful record of managing and shipping great software products. * 1\+ years leading and building AI solutions. * You have built complex data products as part of a cross\-functional team. * You have practical hands\-on technical experience and use it extensively. You’re not afraid to get your hands dirty digging into data, building code with AI tools and tracking metrics. * Strong grasp of product fundamentals: discovery, prioritization, metrics, user feedback loops, and go\-to\-market alignment. You know what good product management looks like. * Adept at using AI tools in your daily work and experience delivering AI powered features. You have a realistic understanding of LLM capabilities and limits. * Proven ability to make smart tradeoffs in ambiguous environments—handling technical constraints, business priorities and strong personalities. * You pay strong attention to detail and you write things down. You communicate clearly and concisely, and tell stories using data. * You are curious and seek to understand, question, and improve our products. You build empathy for customer problems and have a bias towards action to solve them. * You seek hard problems to solve and are comfortable with ambiguity. You drive prioritization and make tradeoff decisions ### **Nice to Haves** * You have built healthcare\-specific data products as part of a cross\-functional team * Prior product management experience in vertical growth stage AI solutions * Experience with LLM integration, data\-driven so before using it * Demonstrated mentorship or leadership in previous PM roles AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided. Base salary range: $175,000\-$215,000 *You must have an eligible work permit in the USA to be considered for this position* ### **We Offer:** * **Ground floor opportunity**: Join a high\-growth startup, backed by world\-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health). * **Learning Budget:** Reimbursements for relevant learning and up\-skilling opportunities. * **Remote work**: AcuityMD is committed to supporting full\-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work\-from\-home stipend for all employees. * **Flexible PTO**: Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work. * **Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans:** We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees' dependents. * **Home Office Stipend:** $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement. * **Optional Team Retreats:** We meet in\-person multiple times per year for co\-working and social gatherings. * **Parental Leave:** 8\-16 weeks of fully\-paid, flexible parental leave. ### **Who We Are:** **The Company:** We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting\-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values. We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, ICONIQ Growth and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we've brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth\-stage companies and regional medical device distributors. **The Product:** AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients. ### **How We Work:** AcuityMD is a remote\-first company. We believe the best talent isn't confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S. We also believe some of our best work happens face\-to\-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we're in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company\-wide and team on\-sites built around that work. In practice: expect 4\-5 in\-person opportunities a year through company/team on\-sites and in\-person collaboration for critical projects. If you're based near our Boston hub, there's no set requirement for how often you come into the office, that's your call, based on what works best for you and your team. We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employees and contractors of AcuityMD are responsible for maintaining a work culture free from discrimination and harassment by treating others with kindness and respect.

You'll own the software that ties our system together, from embedded firmware to real\-time services to the interfaces physicians use at the table, working alongside our perception, hardware, and clinical teams in the lab and, increasingly, in animal labs and cath suites. One day, you might be tracking down a timing issue between a sensor stream and the motion controller. Next, you might be designing how a new perception module integrates into our controls and software architecture, or shipping a fix for something that broke in a preclinical study. **Your job is to build software that physicians can trust, and to make sure we can keep improving it quickly.** This is a tech lead role reporting to our VP of Engineering, with the opportunity to grow into leading a larger software engineering function as we scale. **What You'll Build** --------------------- * **Software platform:** + **Hands\-on development:** Write production code across firmware, real\-time services, and clinician\-facing apps, taking on the hardest and highest\-risk parts yourself. + **System architecture:** Architect software that scales with Mosaic's ambitions, bringing perception and machine learning models into a real\-time, safety\-critical robotic system. + **Lab\-to\-fix loop:** Debug issues from the bench and preclinical studies through root cause to verified fix, so each study improves the next. * **Engineering practice:** + **AI\-native development:** Define how we use agentic development in a regulated industry to improve both quality and speed. + **Engineering standards:** Own branching, CI/CD, automated testing, and releases. Review code daily and hold a high bar for readability, test coverage, and defensive design. + **Team building:** Help hire and mentor the engineers who join after you. * **Safety, security, and compliance:** + **Regulated development:** Run development under IEC 62304 and our ISO 13485 quality system, producing design history and traceability as part of the work, and support submissions and audits with clear documentation. + **Risk management:** Contribute to ISO 14971 hazard analysis and software risk controls. + **Cybersecurity:** Build security into the design, including threat modeling, SBOM, and vulnerability management, in line with FDA premarket cybersecurity guidance. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **Strong engineering foundations:** A background in computer science, computer or electrical engineering, robotics, or a related field, with experience building software that runs on or controls real hardware. * **Relevant experience:** 8\+ years building production software, including time as a technical lead or architect who still shipped code. * **Fluency across the stack:** Strong C\+\+ and Python, experience with real\-time or embedded systems, and the judgment to pick the right tool for each layer. * **Quality as a habit:** You write tests as you write code, design for failure, and treat traceability as part of good engineering rather than a tax on it. * **A low\-ego builder:** You'd rather fix a problem than describe it, care more about the right solution than whose idea it was, and build trust across disciplines. * **Comfort with ambiguity:** You thrive in an early\-stage environment where the product, processes, and your own role will evolve. **Ways to Stand Out** --------------------- * **Robotics software:** ROS/ROS2, real\-time control, hardware bring\-up, and sensor integration. * **AI\-native engineering:** You've changed how a team builds software with agentic coding tools and know where they need guardrails. * **Medical device product development:** Design controls, risk management, verification and validation, cybersecurity, and regulatory submissions, with an eagerness to find lighter\-weight ways to meet the intent of design controls. * **Regulated software experience:** Shipping IEC 62304 Class B or C software, or software in another safety\-critical field such as aerospace or automotive. * **Surgical or interventional robotics:** Developing or clinically deploying robotic systems used in procedural medicine. * **Endovascular experience:** Exposure to catheter\-based interventions in cardiology, radiology, or neurovascular procedures. You don't need to check every box. We're most interested in strong engineering judgment, a deep sense of ownership, and a willingness to build. **About Our Team** ------------------ We're a small, technically deep team building a new category of intelligent surgical systems. Our work brings together robotics, medical imaging, mechanical engineering, machine learning, and clinical medicine. We believe in testing on physical systems early, learning directly from clinical collaborators, and iterating quickly. As our Software Lead, you'll shape not only our product but how software engineering works at Mosaic, working alongside our founders, physicians, and engineers from day one.

From executive roadmapping to production\-ready systems and workforce upskilling, Ajaia embeds intelligent tools directly into the workflows that matter most. You will own features from start to finish: take loosely defined requirements, clarify the real problem, and ship robust solutions across web interfaces, backend services, LLM integrations, and AI\-driven workflows. You will also set up the infrastructure, deployments, and security those features need to run safely in production. This is an individual contributor role for someone who builds with autonomy while working closely with product, delivery, and client\-facing teams, and who helps newer engineers along the way. Every role at Ajaia is AI\-forward. We expect engineers to use AI tools in daily workflows across research, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation. AI usage is a core execution capability, not optional tooling. **Primary Responsibilities** * Own AI\-enabled features end to end for client delivery systems, internal platforms, and products. * Work across frontend implementation, backend logic, API design, and database operations. * Build and integrate AI capabilities into production systems: LLM APIs, prompt workflows, retrieval (RAG), agents, and automation. * Set up and maintain the infrastructure your features run on: cloud services, environments, and configuration. * Own deployments for your features: CI/CD pipelines, releases, rollbacks, and environment management. * Apply security best practices in daily work: secure authentication, secrets management, access control, and protection against common vulnerabilities (such as the OWASP Top 10\). * Use AI tools regularly for coding support, debugging, technical research, test generation, and documentation. * Turn ambiguous requests into clear technical tasks, estimates, and delivery plans. * Identify risks early and unblock execution through pragmatic decisions. * Review code from peers and help junior engineers with patterns and practices. * Keep systems maintainable, secure, observable, and ready for continuous iteration. **Requirements** * 2–5 years of hands\-on experience building and shipping software in professional environments. * Solid experience with a modern frontend framework (such as React or Next.js) and a backend stack (such as Python/FastAPI or Node.js). * Experience with APIs, relational databases (such as PostgreSQL or MySQL), and authentication. * Experience building features on top of large language models (prompting, tool use, retrieval, or agent workflows). * **Infrastructure:** hands\-on knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS or Google Cloud Platform), containers (Docker), and core services such as compute, storage, networking, and managed databases. * **Deployments:** experience building and running CI/CD pipelines (such as GitHub Actions), deploying to production, and handling releases and rollbacks safely. * **Security:** working knowledge of secure coding, authentication and authorization (OAuth, JWT), secrets management, encryption, and common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10\). * Ownership mindset and ability to deliver without highly detailed requirements. * Comfort managing multiple priorities or workstreams in a fast\-moving consultancy or product environment. * Proficiency with GitHub and modern developer tooling. * Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Active daily use of AI tools for planning, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation. * Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated output and hold a high standard for correctness and reliability. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience shipping AI features to production users. * Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, vector databases, or LLM evaluation. * Experience working in startup, consultancy, or fast\-iteration environments. **Schedule and Location** * This is a fully remote role within approved hiring locations, subject to Ajaia hiring and compliance requirements. * Working schedule follows Eastern Time hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET, including holidays. **Technical Requirements** * Reliable wired internet connection with at least 100 Mbps speed. * Computer or laptop with Intel Core i5 or Ryzen 5 processor or higher. * Minimum 8 GB RAM and at least 128 GB available storage. * Dual\-monitor setup preferred. * Windows 10 or macOS (latest version). * 1080p webcam and working microphone. * Backup solutions for power and internet interruptions. **Benefits** * Compensation: USD 12,500 per year base salary \+ Performance Bonus * Remote work with earned flexibility. * Professional development opportunities. * Paid time off. **Why Join Ajaia** This role gives you exposure to a wide range of applied AI and software delivery challenges while keeping you close to real implementation work. You will build across client and internal initiatives, work directly with operators and technical leaders, and grow toward senior ownership. The environment rewards ownership, speed, and clarity rather than bureaucracy. *Experience the Ajaia difference. Let's build what's next.*

integration, and performance testing. * Manage moderately complex projects and initiatives, typically within one platform or business organization, applying project leadership skills in planning, managers and cross\-functional teams on user requirements, factory acceptance tests, validation planning, site acceptance tests, pre\-installation planning, initial installation, setup, maintenance, ability to follow procedures, maintain detailed records, and manage time effectively across competing priorities. * Highly motivated, able to work both independently and as part of a team. * Adaptable and open to change; able to work in ambiguous situations and respond to new information and unexpected circumstances. * Creativity and latitude, including the ability to multi\-task and work productively in a demanding environment with changing priorities. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field; **or** an Associate’s degree in Engineering, procedures. * Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship. * Demonstrated ability to perform the essential duties of the position, with or without accommodation. **Preferred production environment. * Advanced knowledge of databases, laboratory information management systems, and other file management applications. **Physical Requirements \& Work Conditions** * Work seated Accuray develops, manufactures and sells radiotherapy systems for alternative cancer treatments. Our radiation therapy for cancer makes treatment shorter, safer, personalized and more effective, ultimately enabling patients to live longer, better lives. **Job Description** **SUMMARY:** The Software Engineer participates in requirements, design, development, integration, and testing of software systems used to create, store, optimize, and manage patient treatment plans. The Software engineer collaborates in a complex environment integrating software with other software and hardware subsystems for an advanced medical device. Our work has a daily impact on patients worldwide, and we hold a high bar for quality and rigor. **REPORTING TO/DEPARTMENT:** Reports to the Manager, Software Engineering in the Software Engineering team **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** **Software Development (Build, Extend, Maintain)** * Develop and maintain software that supports the lifecycle of a complex radiation therapy medical device. * Write high\-quality, reliable code that fulfills product and subsystem requirements in a complex clinical domain. * Implement automated tests (unit/integration as appropriate) to validate functionality and reduce regressions. * Contribute to sustaining engineering by troubleshooting, participating in root\-cause analysis, and resolving issues found in new or existing functionality. **Software Design \& Architecture (Make the System Better)** * Directly impact the development and architecture of software that creates, stores, optimizes and delivers patient treatments. * Drive critical design and implementation decisions and participate in design discussions for complex systems. * Present concise designs through written and oral reviews; jobs.title: Director of Data Science & Engineering
jobs.description: ### **ABOUT ADACTION** Founded in 2013, AdAction is a leader in performance\-based mobile app marketing, partnering globally to deliver premium users at scale. Our collaborative team prioritizes innovation and strategic decision\-making, fostering a dynamic and inclusive culture. AdAction is looking for individuals who thrive in an autonomous work environment, seek out ways to meaningfully contribute to our shared success, and embrace growth both personally and professionally. Our fully remote workforce is centered in the US, LATAM, UK, and Taiwan. This is a fully remote role open to candidates located in Illinois, Texas, or Colorado. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE** AdAction is seeking a hands\-on Director of Data Science \& Engineering to lead our Data function across Machine Learning, Data Science, Analytics, and Data Engineering. You will set the technical direction, develop our people, and strengthen how we use data and scientific thinking to improve products and business outcomes. Reporting to our VP of Engineering, you will serve as a peer to our Director of Engineering and a member of the Technology leadership team. You will directly manage a small group of Data professionals (ML Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Engineers). Our Data professionals remain embedded in cross\-functional Mission Aligned Teams (MATs), working alongside Product Managers and Engineers. You will own people leadership, technical standards, and capability development while partnering with MAT leaders on priorities and delivery, rather than creating a separate centralized delivery team. This is a hands\-on leadership role, not solely a strategy or advisory position. You will regularly write code, build and evaluate models, and contribute to production implementations. Your deepest expertise should be in applied ML and Data Science, supported by the Analytics and Data Engineering experience needed to lead the broader function credibly. We make extensive use of AI in our day\-to\-day work and are looking for an AI\-forward leader who actively uses these tools and helps the team adopt them effectively. Success means a stronger, more independent Data function, more trustworthy analysis and data foundations, and ML initiatives that deliver measurable value. ### **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Directly manage, coach, and develop ML Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Engineers through clear expectations, actionable feedback, performance management, and discipline\-specific growth plans. Shape hiring, develop technical leaders and qualified reviewers, and delegate decisions so quality doesn't depend on your approval of every change. * Set a practical ML and data strategy with Technology leadership, Product, and business stakeholders, tied to business outcomes and the capabilities we need to build. Evaluate opportunities such as conversion quality, fraud detection, personalization, forecasting, and campaign optimization, establish baselines and success measures, and recognize when better instrumentation, a simple rule, or an analysis beats a model. Track the impact of what we ship and adjust. * Regularly contribute Python, SQL, models, analytical workflows, and production implementations, using AI\-assisted coding and analysis and helping the team adopt these tools without compromising rigor, security, or data privacy. Pair on difficult problems and leave behind tested, documented work others can maintain. * Raise the standard for scientific thinking through problem framing, testable hypotheses, experiment design, statistical reasoning, model evaluation, and metric design. Coach analysts and Product Managers on measurement plans, communicating uncertainty, distinguishing correlation from causation, and translating evidence into decisions. * Establish practical standards for data quality, reproducibility, testing, documentation, model deployment, and ongoing evaluation. Ensure important models and datasets have clear monitoring, maintenance, and operational ownership. * Lead Data Engineering practices across data architecture, modeling, pipelines, and shared datasets, improving data quality, reliability, and accessibility. Partner with our Director of Engineering, Platform team, and MAT Tech Leads on infrastructure, production integration, security, and cost. * Coordinate cross\-team data investments and capacity with MAT leaders, involving Data professionals early in discovery rather than after a solution is chosen. Build reusable capabilities and shared practices that make teams more effective while preserving local ownership. ### **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS** * Typically 8\+ years of relevant professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or related engineering roles, including substantial hands\-on experience delivering applied ML or Data Science solutions and progressively broader technical or team leadership responsibilities. * Deep applied Machine Learning and Data Science experience, including framing business problems, de iciency in Python and SQL, with the ability and desire to regularly contribute maintainable, tested code, models, and analytical workflows. * Demonstrated use of AI\-assisted tools in day\-to\-day technical work, with the ability to evaluate their outputs, recognize limitations, protect sensitive data, and coach others in their effective use. * Strong statistical reasoning and analytics experience, including metric design, hypothesis testing, experiment design, and responsible interpretation of results. Ability to explain what the evidence supports and where it remains inconclusive. * Credible Data Engineering knowledge across data modeling, pipelines, warehouses, and data quality. Ability to coach Data Engineers and evaluate architectural tradeoffs without needing to be the deepest specialist in every technology. * Experience with the operational lifecycle of data and ML systems, including reproducibility, version control, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintaining solutions after launch. * Product\-oriented judgment and experience prioritizing technical investments against customer and business outcomes. Ability to align multiple teams, navigate dependencies, and balance direct implementation with people and functional leadership. * Proven ability to teach complex concepts, communicate tradeoffs, and collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical colleagues in a distributed environment. We value demonstrated capability, sound judgment, and meaningful results over a particular degree or previous job title. We welcome established Directors, experienced Data Science or Engineering Managers, and Staff\- or Principal\-level practitioners ready to lead a function. A previous Director title is not required. ### **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** * Experience in advertising technology, performance marketing, or other transaction\- and event\-driven products, particularly fraud detection, recommendations, personalization, forecasting, or optimization. * Experience with data and ML technologies such as Amazon Redshift, dbt, Airflow, MLflow, and Amazon SageMaker, or comparable tools for data transformation, orchestration, experiment tracking, and model deployment and monitoring. * Experience leading multiple data disciplines in a smaller organization or supporting specialists embedded in cross\-functional product teams. * Experience with real\-time or streaming analytics and event\-driven data pipelines, including tradeoffs around latency, data freshness, correctness, and operational complexity. * Experience designing or evolving data architectures that support analytics and ML, including storage and processing patterns, data modeling, and shared data foundations. * Prior direct people\-management experience, including career development, performance reviews, hiring, and addressing performance challenges. ### **CULTURE FIT** * Curious and evidence\-driven: ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and change your mind when the evidence changes. * AI\-forward mindset: actively explore and adopt AI tools, share what works, and continually improve how you and your team work while retaining accountability for quality and outcomes. * Hands\-on ownership: enjoy building useful solutions and developing the people who build them, rather than leading only through reviews and presentations. * Pragmatic scientific rigor: choose methods appropriate to the decision, favor simple solutions when they work, and balance learning with timely delivery. * Collaborative leadership: work comfortably within a Mission Aligned Team framework, build alignment across disciplines, and strengthen others without taking over their work. * Continuous improvement: value pairing, small increments of delivery, automation, testing, observability, and shared operational ownership. * Teaching and direct feedback: explain your reasoning clearly, invite different perspectives, and help the team become increasingly capable and independent.

jobs.title: IT Support Manager
jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Agilify builds custom applications, cloud platforms and AI solutions for clients, then supports them in production. We are hiring a Support Manager to own that support: the person accountable for every ticket that reaches us, for the engineers who resolve it, and for what we tell the client. The applications you will support include web and workflow applications, their integrations to enterprise platforms, data and reporting platforms, and AI services that produce recommendations for human review. You may hold more than one client engagement at a time. This is a coordination role with a technical center of gravity: you will not write the fix, but you need to understand it well enough to judge whether the estimate is reasonable and whether what you are telling the client is accurate. **Responsibilities** *Service Delivery and Scope* * Single point of accountability for every ticket: acknowledge within the agreed response time, confirm ownership, assign severity, and drive to resolution against the agreed service levels. * Operate a tiered support model, where the client typically handles first\-line intake and Agilify picks up at second line, escalating to engineering when needed. * Determine whether a root cause sits in the application, a platform service or a client\-owned system, and manage third\-party cases to closure. * Track contracted hours or allowances against consumption, notify the client before limits are reached, and hold work until it is authorized. * Classify requests between defect resolution, routine maintenance, minor change and work requiring a change request. This governs what is billable and is the most common source of dispute. *Coordination and Client Relationship* * Assign and sequence work across application, data, cloud, machine learning and test engineering, with architects available on escalation. * Run the working cadence: stand\-ups, backlog grooming, sprint planning and retrospectives for enhancement work, and triage for reactive work. * Manage dependencies with client resolver groups, and escalate early rather than after a target has been missed. * Produce weekly and monthly service reporting, lead the periodic business review, and surface work falling outside the agreement as a scoping conversation rather than absorbing it quietly. * Hold the day\-to\-day client relationship, translate between business and engineering in both directions, and make sure the client hears about a problem from us first. **Required skills** * Five or more years coordinating technical delivery or production support teams, with direct accountability for service levels against a formal agreement. * A technical background in software delivery. You should have shipped software, not only managed people who did. * Agile delivery experience including backlog management, sprint planning and estimation, with judgment about where Agile ceremonies help a support function and where they get in the way. * Working understanding of modern application architecture, enough cloud literacy to tell an application defect from a platform fault, enough data literacy to reason about pipelines, and comfort with version control, CI/CD and environment promotion. * Hands\-on use of a ticketing and change management platform, and experience explaining a missed commitment and the recovery plan with the client in the room. * Precise written communication, composure under escalation, and willingness to report a problem before being asked. **Preferred experience** Managed the development or implementation of the following solution platforms. * **.NET development —** C\# and the .NET stack. Part of our supported estate is built this way. * **AI and machine learning —** agentic systems, decision records and audit, guardrails, and tracing a recommendation back through its evidence. Enough modeling literacy to follow a discussion about versioning and drift. * **Cloud and data platforms —** AWS or Azure, infrastructure as code, and a modern business intelligence platform. * **Regulated environments and certification —** experience where formal quality assurance and change control apply. Certified Scrum Master, PMI\-ACP, PMP, ITIL or a cloud associate certification. Pay: From $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Experience: * managing technical teams with SLA accountability: 5 years (Required) * developing and shipping software to production: 2 years (Required) * managing Agile backlogs, sprints, and estimates: 3 years (Required) * cloud platforms, application architecture, and CI/CD: 3 years (Required) * using ticketing and change management systems: 2 years (Required) * managing client escalations and service recovery plans: 3 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: **Alloy is where you belong!** ------------------------------ Alloy is the AI\-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth. Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we've been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine's Best Workplaces, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers, Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker, year after year. Check out our investors and read more about us here. **About the team** ------------------ The Data Platform team sits within Alloy's Intelligence vertical and owns the infrastructure that powers how data is modeled, governed, and delivered — both internally and to customers. We work at the intersection of data engineering and analytical depth, with a stack built around dbt, Snowflake, and Artie, and a growing investment in our semantic layer. This is an early but high\-leverage moment for Analytics Engineering at Alloy. We have the tooling, the data, and the leadership experience to build this function the right way — and this role is central to that effort. The person who joins will help establish the patterns, standards, and culture of Analytics Engineering here. The strategic stakes are real: native warehouse data delivery is becoming a core part of how we serve customers, agentic workflows depend on a well\-maintained semantic layer, and OLAP infrastructure is increasingly woven into our product stack. Analytics Engineering sits at the center of all three. Alloy operates in a hybrid\-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week. **What you'll do** ------------------ You'll manage the Data Platform team: hire for it, grow the people on it and set its direction. This is a player\-coach role. Roughly half your time goes to hands\-on work on the platform, and the other half to leading the team. * Lead a team of two engineers. Set clear direction, run one\-on\-ones and performance reviews, give direct feedback and coach each person toward work that stretches them * Hire as the team grows. Define the roles, run the interview loops and decide who joins * Own the data platform end to end: ingestion and change data capture, the Snowflake warehouse, dbt and the semantic layer, and the tooling that internal and customer\-facing analytics run on * Ship native warehouse data sharing into customers' own environments, including the schema contracts customers will build on for years * Design how sensitive customer data is handled across analytics and BI, so teams get the answers they need and customer data stays protected * Set the team's technical standard for modeling, testing, documentation and code review, and meet it in your own code * Work with Product, Compliance and other engineering teams to decide what data we expose, to whom and under what constraints. Make the platform good enough that teams choose it over building their own **What we're looking for** -------------------------- You want both halves of this job. You'd be unhappy in a role that took you away from building, and just as unhappy in one where nobody grew because of you. * Deep analytics engineering and data systems experience. Strong SQL, dbt and a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred), with real depth in data modeling: grain, slowly changing dimensions and what makes a model trustworthy * Experience owning architecture from ingestion through the warehouse to delivery, including ingestion and change data capture tools (Artie or similar) and how they fail: late\-arriving data, schema drift, out\-of\-order events * A record of leading people. You've set direction others followed, grown someone on purpose, given feedback that was hard to give and raised a team's standard. Formal management experience is not required. We care about what you did, not the title you held * Good judgment about sequencing. Given more good ideas than quarters, you pick what comes first and can explain why the rest wait * Experience getting other teams to adopt something you built, or agreeing a constraint with a function that had reasons to resist, with the relationship intact afterwards * Based in the New York City area and able to work from our Union Square office Tuesday through Thursday **Nice\-to\-haves:** * Experience with native warehouse data delivery, such as Snowflake Data Sharing or Marketplace * Background in fintech, financial services or another regulated industry, especially handling PII in analytics * Experience building a semantic or metrics layer and connecting it to BI tools * Exposure to agentic or LLM\-based workflows and the data infrastructure behind them We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately, and opportunities will grow as the company scales up. Are you excited by the challenge of writing systems software that runs on millions custom networking cards across millions of hosts? Our code is what makes Virtual Private Clouds (VPC) work, what enforces customer security policies, and what enables workloads to scale from a single instance to clusters of tens of thousands. We're looking for a resourceful engineer with real robotics experience who is as comfortable reading schematics and torquing fasteners as they are reading logs, running debuggers, and writing scripts to isolate faults. verify actuator, sensor, and control\-loop function; perform sensor calibration; and run acceptance testing and performance characterization using standard and custom test equipment. * Use git and the Linux command line to install, configure, and run test, calibration, and diagnostic software on robot platforms;
