jobs.title: Pricing Optimization Scientist, Pricing Science
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Take hard sequential decision problems, like delayed rewards, shifting demand and strict business constraints, and turn them into pricing policies that run at Amazon scale. Few places let you test RL ideas on a problem this large. Key job responsibilities Every day, Amazon makes hundreds of millions of pricing decisions. Each one is a choice made with incomplete information: demand shifts, competitors move, inventory runs low, and every price we set changes the data we learn from next. The P2 Optimization Science (P2OS) team builds the science behind these decisions. Our work includes demand response models, the optimization systems that turn them into prices, and the experiments that prove those prices help customers and the business. We're hiring an Applied Scientist to build sequential decision\-making methods for pricing. Most pricing systems estimate demand first and optimize second. We want systems that learn while they decide. That means deciding when to explore and when to exploit, how to trade short\-term revenue against long\-term customer trust, and how to set safe prices in categories where we have little history. You'll work on contextual bandits, reinforcement learning and online optimization problems that most research setups ignore: delayed and noisy rewards, hard business constraints, non\-stationary demand, and a catalog too big for a separate model per product. This is an applied role. You'll take methods from offline simulation through online experiments and into production. Your success will be measured by what changes for customers and the business, not by benchmark scores. You'll partner closely with senior scientists, economists, software engineers and product managers. You'll also help shape the team's long\-term direction on how Amazon prices adaptively. If you like hard optimization problems with real stakes, and you'd rather ship a method that works than publish one that doesn't, we'd like to talk to you. A day in the life As a Pricing Applied Scientist, you'll shape the prices customers see on a very large share of Amazon's catalog. In a typical week, you might: * Prototype a contextual bandit policy for a product segment with sparse sales history, then stress\-test it in simulation against the current production approach. * Dig into why a policy is exploring more than expected and trace it to a reward signal that arrives days late. * Work through a reward design with an economist: how to credit a price change that lifts conversion today but may affect repeat purchases next month. * Review an online experiment readout with your product manager and decide whether the policy is ready to scale or needs another iteration. * Write a short science proposal on a new constraint, like limiting how often a price can change, and estimate its cost to the objective. * Pair with an engineer to make a policy fast enough to update prices in near real time. * Present your findings at the team's science review, or develop them into a paper for a venue like KDD, NeurIPS or EC. About the team The Pricing and Promotions Optimization Science (P2OS) team is the Optimization ‘Application Layer’ within Pricing Sciences. Our team is a small unit of specialized science resources equipped to solve some of the organization’s most ambiguous challenges. Our charter is to develop models to set optimal prices and promotions, shared common tooling across all merchants, rule and policy setting to drive error detection and price sharpness, and innovative price guardrails and incentives to support long\-term marketplace health. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * PhD, or Master's degree and 4\+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience * Experience programming in Java, C\+\+, Python or related language * Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high\-performance computing **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience in professional software development * Experience using Unix/Linux * Knowledge of architectural concepts and algorithms, schedule tradeoffs and new opportunities with technical team members Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our team builds and operates a globally distributed DNS resolution service that enables AWS customers to securely resolve internal and external DNS names across regions, networks, and hybrid environments. You will help ensure that DNS queries are resolved securely, reliably, and within milliseconds for enterprise customers running workloads across VPCs, on\-prem, and edge locations. DynamoDB is a key\-value and document database that delivers single\-digit\-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast\-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission\-critical workloads. DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers. A day in the life As an Software Development Engineer on DynamoDB Storage, you'll own features end\-to\-end in the storage engine powering every DynamoDB read and write globally. Your days involve implementing changes in Java/Rust \- optimizing replication, reducing tail latency, or building new capabilities \- then validating through capacity tests across dozens of instance types. On on call (\~1 week/quarter), you'll diagnose production issues across 30\+ regions in real\-time. You'll review teammates' code daily, contribute to designs spanning millions of nodes, and ship through rigorous phased rollouts. The work is deeply technical, exabyte\-scale, and directly impacts DynamoDB's durability guarantees. About the team AWS values diverse experiences. jobs.description: At Amyris, we value that everyone's career journey is unique and authentic to who they are. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply and grow alongside us! You may be just the right candidate for this or other open roles. **About Amyris** Amyris is an integrated synthetic biology company applying breakthrough fermentation science to develop high\-performance, sustainable ingredients and products. Our technology platform spans cloud\-forward systems on Google Cloud Platform alongside on\-premises infrastructure that supports our labs, manufacturing, and global workforce across the United States and Brazil. Our DevOps team helps make this cutting\-edge science possible — and is looking for people who can connect the two worlds. **Position Overview** The Manager, Enterprise DevOps Architect will serve as a senior technical and team leader for Amyris's hybrid infrastructure and for the CI/CD and DevOps practices that deliver across them. This individual will bridge the gap between Amyris's cloud\-forward direction on Google Cloud Platform and its on\-premises IT estate, defining the standards, automation practices, and integration patterns that allow both environments to operate as one coherent platform. The role combines hands\-on architecture with team leadership, owning infrastructure and DevOps strategy and representing technology to Amyris's Computing teams — Data Science, Software Engineering, and Data Engineering — and to stakeholders in Business Development, R\&D, and Manufacturing. This is a technical and team lead role, split evenly between technical execution and team leadership (50\-50%). The ideal candidate is a hands\-on DevOps leader (CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, containerization, observability) with enterprise architecture experience across networking, identity, security, databases, and infrastructure. They turn ambiguous demands into well\-defined, automated, and documented solutions. The role keeps regular overlap with both US Pacific and Brazil working hours. **Location***:* Remote, US. Remote employees should be available for occasional travel to Emeryville, CA. **Key Responsibilities** **Hybrid Cloud \& On\-Prem Integration** * Architect and document hybrid infrastructure spanning jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Application Security
jobs.description: For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well. For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you. **Angi at a glance:** * Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021 * Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide * Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting **About the team:** At Angi, security is woven into everything we build, from PCI\-scoped payment flows to the AI agents now handling homeowner / pro conversations and scheduling end\-to\-end. The team is small and the surface is not: cloud infrastructure, applications, and a growing set of agentic AI products. You'll own security architecture and execution across all three. *While this is a remote position, we are a global company and are looking for applicants located in eastern or central time zones to align with our team's working hours.* **What you’ll do:** * Own security initiatives end to end across cloud infrastructure hardening and application security, including work that spans several sprints and arrives ambiguous. * Own the technical controls that InfoSec retains within compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS (e.g., ASV scanning, network security control reviews, tamper\-detection monitoring). * Deploy and tune the infrastructure protecting Angi's applications from exploitation, account takeover, and denial of service. * Drive security architecture and threat modeling for Angi's AI agent products (voice/chat agents with calendar and account access). * Review RFCs, PRDs, and MRs from a security lens, and partner directly with product/engineering teams shipping AI\-native features. You will be in the room when these are designed, not brought in after the fact. * Build the tooling and frameworks that make the secure path the easy path for Angi's engineers \- paved roads, not policy documents. * Mentor engineers within and across teams, and improve the status quo where you find it \- recurring incident patterns, tooling gaps, process debt. * Actively participate in all facets of the incident response lifecycle by participating in a 24/7 on\-call rotation. * Continuously evaluate and integrate AI\-driven tooling into InfoSec's own workflows. You're expected to use AI coding/security assistants daily, not just secure them for others. **Who you are:** * 5\+ years in security engineering, spanning at least two of: application security, cloud/infrastructure security, or enterprise security. * Hands\-on with AWS and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent); comfortable reading and contributing to product service code (Kotlin, NextJS, Python, Ruby, Scala, or Swift are preferred). * Sound build\-versus\-buy judgment with no allergy to either answer. You reach for what exists when it fits, and you're comfortable wrapping, extending, or replacing it when it doesn't. * Fluent in the OWASP Top 10 and how each is actually remediated, and in the authentication and authorization standards Angi runs on (OAuth, OIDC, SAML). * Some level of exposure to LLM/agentic system security (prompt injection, agent identity, data exfiltration via AI systems). * A daily, fluent user of AI\-assisted coding/security tools. You are able to speak concretely about how you direct and verify AI output. * Strong written communication: you'll write threat models and give written feedback on other people's design docs and merge requests regularly. * Comfort executing the technical side of a compliance framework (PCI, SOX, or similar) \- vulnerability scanning, control reviews, tamper detection is preferred. * Hands\-on experience in the tool categories this work runs through \- static analysis (Snyk, Veracode, Fortify), infrastructure vulnerability scanning (Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7\), and penetration testing tooling (BurpSuite, OWASP ZAP) is preferred. * Container and Kubernetes experience is preferred. **Compensation \& Benefits** * The base salary band for this position ranges from $150,000 \- $225,000, commensurate with experience and performance. Compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location. * This position will be eligible for a competitive year end performance bonus \& equity package. * Full medical, dental, vision package to fit your needs. * Flexible vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it. * Pet discount plans \& retirement plan with company match (401K). * The rare opportunity to work with sharp, motivated teammates solving some of the most unique challenges and changing the world. **We value diversity** We know that the best ideas come from teams where diverse points of view uncover new solutions to hard problems. We welcome and value individuals who bring diverse life experiences, educational backgrounds, cultures, and work experiences. *Our hiring process may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision\-making.* \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Safeguards Evals
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ How do we know whether a model is safe \- and how do we know whether the systems we built to catch misuse actually catch it? Anthropic answers both questions with evaluations. We measure model behavior across misuse, prompt injection, and user well\-being to inform training and deployment decisions. We also use AI to investigate potential misuse of Claude, analyzing real\-world traffic to surface bad actors and emerging threats that drive enforcement actions. Neither is worth much unless the evaluations behind them are representative, robust, and trustworthy. This role builds the methods and infrastructure that make them so. Sitting at the intersection of applied ML research and engineering, you'll design experiments to improve how we evaluate both model behavior and the agentic systems that govern it, build datasets that represent real abuse rather than clean approximations of it, and ship those methods into the pipelines that gate model training, agent changes, and launch decisions. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Evaluation research and methodology.** Design and run experiments to improve evaluation quality — developing methods to generate representative test data, simulate realistic user behavior, and validate grading accuracy. Research how different factors (multi\-turn conversations, tools, long context, user diversity) impact model safety behavior. Analyze evaluation coverage to identify measurement gaps, and evolve evals so they remain unsaturated and high\-signal as model and agent capabilities advance. **Agentic investigation evals.** Build and own the evaluation harness for an agentic investigation system — defining metrics, test cases, and grading approaches for a complex, long\-horizon agent. Measure agent performance end\-to\-end (detection precision and recall, investigation quality, robustness) and drive hill\-climbing on the hardest harm areas. Construct RL environments to improve Claude's safety investigation capabilities. **Datasets grounded in real harm.** Construct high\-quality eval datasets representing real\-world misuse across harm areas such as cyber attacks, bio weapons, and influence operations, drawing from both real traffic patterns and synthetic generation. Collaborate with Policy and Enforcement to translate observed harm patterns into measurable evaluations. **Productionization and tooling.** Ship successful research into evaluation, regression, and release pipelines that run during model training, on every agent change, prompt update, and underlying model upgrade, and beyond launch. Build tooling that enables policy experts to author, run, and iterate on evaluations without engineering support. Surface findings to research and training teams to drive upstream model improvements. **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Experience building and maintaining data pipelines * Experience working with LLMs and a working understanding of their capabilities and failure modes — especially agentic systems with tool use and multi\-step reasoning * Strong data analysis skills — you can draw reliable insights from large datasets * Ability to move fluidly between research prototyping and production\-quality code * Ability to translate ambiguous problems into concrete, testable experiments * Care deeply about AI safety and want your work to have real impact **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * 8\+ years of industry software engineering or ML engineering experience * Expertise in building or contributing to LLM or agent evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, or automated grading systems * Extensive experience in trust and safety, content moderation, or abuse detection systems * Experience in red teaming, adversarial testing, or jailbreak research on AI systems * Experience with synthetic data generation or data augmentation * Experience with distributed systems or large\-scale data processing * Experience with prompt engineering or building LLM\-powered applications The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 \- $485,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Agent Development Engineer, Customer Systems
jobs.description: Summary Customer Systems is part of IS\&T and drives the technology behind Apple's customer support experience — from contact center operations to the software powering the iconic Genius Bar. The team also builds and operates AppleCare's online support platform, which handles 6 billion visits per year, delivering seamless, high\-quality support to Apple customers around the globe. There are jobs and then there are opportunities! This is your opportunity to do the best work of your life. Join us, the team that serves as Apple’s nerve center: Apple Information Systems and Technology group! We are seeking a highly innovative and specialized Agent Development Engineer to design, build, and deploy autonomous AI systems. Unlike traditional software or chatbot developers, you will create intelligent agents that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) to reason, plan, use tools, and execute multi\-step actions independently to achieve specific goals, fundamentally transforming how Apple operates and delivers customer experiences. When you join IS\&T, you’ll help design and manage systems, frameworks, and apps that countless Apple customers and employees rely on every day. Together, we’ll explore all the ways to improve how Apple operates, freeing our employees to do what they do best, and crafting magical experiences for our customers! Description As an Agent Development Engineer, you will be at the forefront of building the next generation of intelligent automation. Your core responsibilities will include:• Design \& Architecture: Creating the foundational architecture for AI agents, including sophisticated reasoning engines that break down complex problems and robust decision\-making workflows. Agent Development: Building autonomous agents using cutting\-edge frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or CrewAI. Tool Integration \& API Usage: Connecting agents to external tools, databases, APIs, and critical business systems to enable seamless action\-taking and interaction with the broader ecosystem. Memory \& Context Management: Implementing advanced short\- and long\-term memory systems (e.g., using vector databases, RAG) so agents can remember past interactions, learn from experience, and maintain context across complex tasks. Prompt Engineering \& Optimization: Authoring complex, domain\-specific prompts and designing sophisticated chain\-of\-thought workflows to guide agent reasoning and ensure optimal performance. Testing \& Reliability: Implementing “human\-in\-the\-loop” systems, developing comprehensive evaluation frameworks (evals), and establishing safety guardrails to ensure agents behave reliably, ethically, and predictably in production environments. Deployment \& Scaling: Deploying agents into production environments, often leveraging Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms like AWS/Azure/GCP, ensuring scalability and high availability. The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of software engineering rigor and AI innovation. The role combines broad technical judgment with the ability and motivation to go deep into implementation details. **Agentic AI development is central to how we work.** We value engineers who use AI agents to expand what they can investigate and deliver, while personally understanding, reviewing, and verifying the systems they build. **Ownership and Delivery** -------------------------- * Take responsibility from problem definition through implementation, production adoption, and ongoing operation. * Show initiative: identify gaps, gather context, propose practical solutions, and move work forward with appropriate coordination. * Work through ambiguity and setbacks, surface blockers early, and follow through on commitments. * Balance speed with quality, explain tradeoffs, and verify that the result solves the intended problem. * Remain accountable after release: investigate failures, incorporate feedback, and improve reliability and maintainability. * Share knowledge and credit, seek input from component owners, and strengthen the team's ability to deliver. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Design across component boundaries.** Translate ambiguous needs into clear designs, evaluate tradeoffs, define interfaces, and consider the effects on the wider system. * **Build robust server\-side software.** Implement and improve services with appropriate correctness, performance, scalability, security, and operational visibility. * **Investigate end to end.** Follow requests, data, and failures across components; identify root causes and work with component owners to deliver lasting improvements. * **Rapid AI\-assisted prototyping.** Use AI tools to quickly build working prototypes, compare approaches, and validate technical feasibility before developing promising ideas into production\-quality software. * **Move between design and code.** Prototype approaches, write critical implementation code, review changes, and validate assumptions through tests and measurements. * **Use AI agents effectively.** Break work into clear tasks, supply relevant context and constraints, review generated changes, and verify behavior including failure scenarios. * **Learn unfamiliar systems.** Use code, documentation, experiments, AI tools, and collaboration to become effective across languages and codebases. * **Evolve software thoughtfully.** Improve maintainability and delivery speed while managing compatibility, rollout, and operational risk. * **Contribute across the stack.** Work with APIs, client integrations, and user interfaces when needed to deliver a complete outcome. * **Provide hands\-on technical leadership.** Communicate decisions, coordinate across teams, mentor peers, and help others deliver. **Required Experience** ----------------------- * Substantial hands\-on software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production systems and meaningful technical decisions. * Strong system design skills: the ability to reason about interfaces, dependencies, data flows, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability across multiple components. * Deep backend engineering skills in at least one relevant language (Go, Rust, Node.js/TypeScript, Java, etc), including effective debugging and performance investigation. * Practical understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous communication, data consistency, persistence, and failure recovery. Experience with databases, caching, cloud platforms, containers, and messaging technologies such as Kafka, NATS, or comparable systems is valuable. * Experience with automated testing, deployment, observability, and production troubleshooting. * Practical use of AI coding agents for substantial engineering work, with the ability to explain decisions, identify mistakes, and independently verify results. * Curiosity and demonstrated initiative to learn unfamiliar technologies and investigate beyond a single component or specialty. * Clear communication and effective collaboration across engineering teams. **Preferred Experience** ------------------------ * Production development in Rust or Go. * Full\-stack delivery or meaningful work with client applications, SDKs, or modern frontend frameworks. * Improving systems under demanding availability, latency, throughput, or cost constraints. * Modernizing existing software and delivering changes across multiple components or teams. * Event\-driven systems using Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ, or comparable technologies. * Contact center, telecommunications, or other real\-time enterprise applications. * AI\-enabled application development involving tool integration, orchestration, or evaluations. **Education** ------------- Bachelor degree or equivalent experience **Footer** ---------- Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: As an AI Engineer, you're responsible for designing, building, and shipping AI systems that real people use, from AI features inside products used on over 30 million websites to internal tools built on our behavioral and operational data. You will turn messy real\-world data and a user's goals into output people can trust and act on: generated campaigns and content, plain\-English recommendations, and automations that save hours of work. We hire for caliber first, then match you to the team where you will have the most impact. ***Interested in applying?*** ***Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.*** ***Attention to detail is one of our core values! This is your chance to stand out :)*** **To love this role, here's the type of person you are:** * You're a builder at heart. You don't just use AI tools, you understand how they work under the hood, and you think about how to make them useful for real people, not just technically impressive. * You care more about how good the output is than which model produced it, and you get restless when an AI feature is just fine. * You're a self\-starter who can take a loosely defined problem, figure out the right approach, and ship a working solution without needing to be told what to do next. * You think about the user and the decision first, not the pipeline and the model. When you see data, your first instinct is to ask what question it answers for the person who needs it. * You're comfortable owning the full stack of an AI project, from data exploration and model selection to the API, the interface, and deployment, and making sure it actually works in production. * You build with AI every day, and you still verify everything before it ships. "The AI did it" is never your answer. * You're an excellent communicator, fluent in both verbal and written English. You can explain complex technical decisions to non\-technical stakeholders without dumbing it down. * You take pride in the quality and craftsmanship of your work: clean code, proper error handling, thoughtful architecture, not just something that works on the happy path. * You have the curiosity and desire to learn and grow. The AI landscape moves fast and you keep up because you genuinely enjoy it, and you share what you learn so the people around you get faster too. * You're a team player who is comfortable working alongside developers, product, design, and marketing, and doesn't take critical feedback personally. **Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):** * Designing and shipping AI features that turn a user's goal, website, or data into campaigns, content, and recommendations they can act on. * Building AI\-powered internal tools and data\-driven systems used across the organization: analytics platforms, reporting automation, and workflow intelligence. * Designing and building LLM pipelines with solid prompt design, structured and validated output, RAG, guardrails, and agentic workflows. * Cleaning and analyzing messy product and behavioral data, and grounding AI output in the facts so it never makes numbers up. * Building data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve behavioral and operational data at scale. * Setting up evaluation and observability so every iteration is measurably better than the last, and failures are caught before users see them. * Owning the full path from model output to what the user sees, across backend and frontend. * Evaluating and selecting the right models, frameworks, and infrastructure for each use case, balancing quality, cost, and latency. * Watching how people actually use what you build, and turning that into the next improvement. * Writing clean, well\-tested, production\-grade code with proper error handling, logging, and observability. * Documenting your work, including how you used AI to build it, so others can learn from it and reuse it. * Keeping up with the rapidly evolving AI landscape and bringing new ideas, tools, and approaches to the team. * Communicating with the team and supporting your peers using chat, audio, and video. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of professional experience building AI/ML systems in production, with AI features that real users touch (not just POCs or hackathon projects). * Strong proficiency in Python, including production\-grade practices: proper packaging, testing, type hints, and async where appropriate. * Full\-stack experience. You can lean backend or frontend, but you work on both: Python or Node services and a modern frontend such as React. * Hands\-on LLM engineering: prompt design, structured output, tool calling, RAG, guardrails, and evaluation of output quality. * Hands\-on experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar. You should be able to build a RAG pipeline from scratch. * Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Qdrant, or similar) and embedding models. * Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, n ics, or personalization experience. * Experience with eval and observability tooling such as Langfuse, DeepEval, RAGAS, or LLM\-as\-a\-judge setups. * Experience building multi\-agent systems using CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar frameworks. * Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), function calling, or similar LLM integration patterns. * Experience with model fine\-tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA) and quantization for cost optimization. * Familiarity with MLOps practices: model versioning, drift monitoring, and experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights \& Biases, etc). * Experience with Databricks, AWS SageMaker, or similar ML platforms. * Familiarity with the WordPress ecosystem, PHP, or SaaS product development. Understanding the end user (small business owners, bloggers, ecommerce operators) is valuable context. * Experience building internal tools and data platforms that non\-technical teams rely on daily. * Published research, open\-source contributions, or technical writing that demonstrates depth of understanding. **Benefits** **Working for a fast\-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here's what we offer.** * Competitive Salary. * Term Life Insurance and Accidental Death \& Dismemberment for all full\-time team members during their employment. * Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance benefits for full\-time U.S. employees. * Health Insurance benefits for all employees in Argentina, Brazil, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Jamaica, Kenya, Mexico, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Spain, and Ukraine. * Work from your home. We're spread out all over the world – United States, Canada, Ukraine, India, Pakistan, Singapore, and more. * Flexible PTO after 90 days of employment. We encourage employees to take the time they need for a vacation, stay healthy, and spend time with friends and family. * Holidays (based on your location) * Paid Parental Leave. * We happily provide or reimburse software you'll need as well as books or courses that promote continued learning. * We cover all costs of company travel (including our annual all\-company retreat and mini\-team meetups). * Additional Perks include AM Welcome Box for new team members, Yearly Anniversary Gifts, and Technology Stipend each work anniversary. * We give you the opportunity to solve challenging and meaningful problems that make a difference. * Ability to work with some of the best people in the business through frequent, if not daily, interactions. * And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks. **Location** **This is a remote position \- our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Florida, USA, so company operating hours are 9am \- 5pm ET (UTC \-5\). While full coverage is not a requirement, you must be available during a portion of the day.** **Inclusion Statement** **At Awesome Motive, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. Awesome Motive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.** **How to apply?** **If all of this sounds interesting, then please submit your application!** *Also note, don't forget to proofread before submitting. Check spelling, capitalization, etc. This is your chance to make your application stand out :)* We won't be able to individually respond to all applications, but if we feel you're a strong match, someone will be in touch shortly. Thanks and we look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: #### **About us** Axiomatic AI is building a new class of AI systems designed to reason with the rigor of the scientific method. By combining deep learning with formal logic and physics\-based modeling, we create verifiable, interpretable AI systems that collaborate with and support human researchers in high\-stakes scientific and engineering workflows. Our mission, 30×30, is to deliver a 30× improvement in the speed, accessibility, and cost of semiconductor and photonic hardware development by 2030\. We aim to revolutionize hardware design and simulation in these industries and are building a team of highly motivated professionals to bring these innovations from research into commercial products. #### **Position overview** We are looking for an Applied AI Engineer to own the agent platform that lets AI agents run scientific and engineering workflows reliably and safely. Some of these workflows run in lab environments where reliability and safety matter as much as speed. You will join a small, cross\-functional team and be the main owner of the agent platform code. You will scope your own work and make the calls on how it is built. #### **What you will do** * Own the agent platform end to end: design, implementation, releases and support. * Design the typed, tested tools that agents use to plan, run and verify work, and decide what belongs in a tool and what belongs in a prompt. * Keep the platform portable and well documented, so it is easy to adopt and extend. * Build safety and traceability into the platform from the start. * Run evals that drive decisions: your own golden task sets, baselines for every release, and comparisons across clients and models, including local ones. * Ship changes in small, reversible steps, with upgrade paths that need no manual work from users. * Turn research experiments into production features, and work with scientists to bring their workflows into the product. * Write ADRs and review code with the rest of the team. #### **Key requirements** * 5\+ years of software engineering, mostly in companies shipping software to real customers. Research or academic experience is welcome, but it should not be your only background. Software engineers who moved into AI are a good fit. * 2\+ years building LLM features that run in production at a company, beyond prototypes. * Strong Python: packaging with uv or Poetry, type hints, async, testing and building CLIs. * Hands\-on experience building or extending MCP servers and designing tools for LLM tool calling. * Good working knowledge of current agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar): plugins, skills, hooks, subagents, MCP support, and where each one falls short. You use them every day in your own work. * A working understanding of agent architecture: how the model, the harness, tools and state fit together, and which decisions belong in code instead of a prompt. * Experience running evals on LLM systems: building test sets, catching regressions and explaining the results to others. * A safety mindset: human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, guardrails in code, audit logs and awareness of prompt injection. * Care for compatibility: versioning, smooth upgrades and installers you can run twice without breaking anything. * CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker. * Comfort in a small team with unclear requirements. You can scope your own work and ship it with little support. * Clear, confident communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including the ability to challenge or push back constructively when needed. * Professional fluency in English. #### **Nice to have** * Experience running LLMs and software in restricted or customer\-managed environments. * Pydantic AI, LangGraph or similar agent frameworks. * Lab automation, instrument control or hardware connections (VISA/SCPI, OpenTAP). * Observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Logfire, Sentry). * Exposure to photonics or semiconductors. * Open\-source contributions to agent tooling. #### **What we offer** * **Competitive Compensation:** A competitive compensation package. * **Stock Options Plan:** Empowering you to share in our success and growth. * **Cutting\-Edge Tools:** Access to state\-of\-the\-art tools and collaborative opportunities with leading experts in artificial intelligence, physics, hardware and electronic design automation. * **Work\-Life Balance:** A hybrid work arrangement with three days per week in our Boston office. * **Professional Growth:** Opportunities to attend industry conferences, present research findings, and engage with the global AI research community. * **Impact\-Driven Culture:** Join a passionate team focused on solving some of the most challenging problems at the intersection of AI and hardware. #### **Work model \& location expectations** Hybrid from our Boston office, 3 days per week. #### **Why join us?** At Axiomatic AI, you will be working on technology that drives innovation in AI for scientific and engineering applications in line with our 30×30 mission. This is your opportunity to contribute to the development of new AI architectures that can reason coherently and produce interpretable and verifiable solutions, and to see those ideas commercialized into products that will shape the future of hardware and computing, while collaborating with a global team of engineers and AI specialists. We believe in pushing the boundaries of what is possible and continuously seek to redefine the intersection of AI, with a focus on formal consistency. If you're ready to take your expertise in artificial intelligence and physics to the next level, we want to hear from you! *Worried about not meeting every qualification? Studies show that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every listed requirement. At Axiomatic AI, we are dedicated to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If this role excites you but your background doesn't perfectly match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this position or another opportunity with us.*

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** BAE Systems, a top ten prime contractor to the U.S. Department of War, enables the U.S. government to transform data into intelligence and provides engineering, integration and sustainment support for critical military platforms and systems. Intelligence \& Security provides services and products to the Department of War, the intelligence community, federal law enforcement officials, and troops deployed around the world. We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer to support the design, development, and deployment of intelligent systems that can learn from data, make predictions, classify objects, and generate insights supporting a new Enterprise lab environment across multiple classification levels. The lab supports new and emerging paradigms to support and enhance customer capabilities and tradecraft. The enterprise lab environment will encompass multi\-intelligence data infusion to enable innovative tradecraft development modeling and simulation to provide solutions for customer problems and needs. Th AI/ML Engineer will develop high\-quality analytic algorithms that drive business value and mission\-critical use cases in support of an IC customer. As the AI/ML Engineer you will: * Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models using popular libraries and frameworks. * Conduct feature engineering and feature selection to optimize model performance. * Collaborate with Data Engineers to prepare data for AI/ML model development, ensuring that the data is in a suitable format for model training. * Implement AI/ML algorithms, including design, training, testing, verification, and validation activities. * Develop and implement data pipelines to enable retrieval of data from federated data systems (e.g., cloud storage or on\-premises databases). * Develop and implement monitoring systems to ensure AI/ML model reliability and performance, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or New Relic. * Stay up to date on best practices and emerging technologies in AI/ML, including advancements in deep learning, natural language processing, and computer vision. * Assess and provide recommendations on emerging intelligence methodologies and tools * Validate work against real and simulated data – making corrections for non\-ideal data artifacts. * Brief internal stakeholders, internal subject matter experts, and potentially customers. * Build collaborative relationships with key leaders and peers, both internally and externally, across the organization. XYZ **Required Education, Experience, \& Skills** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related STEM field and 10 years work experience or equivalent experience * Understanding of the AI/ML development process, Large Language Models (LLMs), and their applications in AI. * Knowledge of AI/ML libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, Pytorch, Scikit\-learn). * Knowledge of data visualization tools (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn) and data storytelling techniques. * Familiarity with natural language processing (NLP) and computer vision libraries (e.g., NLTK, spaCy). * Experience with ETL/TS tools and frameworks (e.g., Apache Beam, AWS Glue). * Familiarity with big data technologies like Hadoop, Spark, and Kafka. * Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering disciplines * Excellent organizational and follow through skills. * Strong communication (written and verbal) skills. * Detail oriented with problem\-solving skills. * Proficient in Microsoft Office **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $149603 \- $254317 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. **About BAE Systems, Inc.** BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support. Our culture is performance\-driven and values\-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters. This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.title: Lead Network Engineer
jobs.description: **A World\-Class Team** BJ’s Wholesale Club is powered by more than 30,000 team members who make a real impact every day. Whether you're stocking shelves, solving problems or shaping strategy, your work helps families save on what matters most. We’re a team built on purpose and opportunity. Join us and be part of something meaningful. **Why You’ll Love Working at BJ’s** At BJ’s Wholesale Club, our team members are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well\-being and future – both on and off the job. When you grow, we grow. **Here’s just some of what you can look forward to:** * **Weekly Pay:** Get paid every week so that you can manage your money on your terms. * **Daily Pay:** Access your earned pay before payday, giving you more flexibility when you need it. (fee may apply.) * **Free BJ’s Memberships:** Enjoy a complimentary The Club Card Membership, plus a free Supplemental Membership for someone in your household.\* * **Generous Paid Time Off:** Take the time you need with vacation, personal, sick days, holidays, bereavement, and jury duty leave.\* * **Flexible and Affordable Health Benefits:** Choose from three medical plans, and access optional dental, vision, Health Savings Account (HSA), and flexible spending account options to fit your lifestyle.\* * **401(k) Retirement Savings Plan:** Build your financial future with a company match (available to team members 18 and older).\* * **Employee Stock Purchase Plan:** Accumulate funds through after\-tax payroll deductions that can be used to purchase shares of BJ’s common stock at a 15% discount.\* * Eligibility requirements vary by position. We are seeking an experienced Lead Network Engineer to design, deploy, and manage enterprise\-grade network infrastructure across our retail store portfolio and distribution center operations. This role is the subject matter expert for Aruba wireless solutions, providing hands\-on leadership for WiFi, LAN/WAN designs and deployments. The ideal candidate thrives in fast\-paced retail and logistics environments, balances project work with escalation support, and brings a proactive mindset to network reliability and security. **Key Responsibilities** **Wireless Network Design \& Deployment (Aruba)** * Lead end\-to\-end Aruba WiFi deployments for new and existing retail stores and distribution centers, from design through post\-deployment validation. * Conduct professional RF site surveys using Ekahau Pro and similar predictive/post\-installation tools; produce detailed heat maps, coverage reports, and capacity recommendations. * Design and maintain Aruba wireless infrastructure including APs (indoor/outdoor), Mobility Conductors/Gateways, and AOS\-8/AOS\-10 architecture. * Optimize RF environments for high\-density retail and warehouse settings, including 2\.4GHz/5GHz/6GHz band management, channel planning, and interference mitigation. * Develop and enforce wireless security standards (WPA3\-Enterprise, 802\.1X, PPSK) aligned with PCI\-DSS requirements for retail payment environments. * Administer Aruba ClearPass for network access control, guest management, and device onboarding as it relates to wireless policy enforcement. **LAN Architecture \& Operations** * Design, deploy, and maintain switching infrastructure (Aruba CX, HP ProCurve) across retail stores and distribution centers. * Manage VLAN segmentation strategies for POS systems, corporate devices, IoT/OT equipment, and guest networks. * Configure and troubleshoot spanning tree (MSTP/RSTP), link aggregation (LACP), and Layer 3 routing protocols (OSPF, BGP). * Perform capacity planning and lifecycle management for access\-layer and distribution\-layer switching infrastructure. **WAN \& Fortinet SD\-WAN** * Architect, deploy, and manage Fortinet SD\-WAN solutions across retail branch locations, replacing or augmenting traditional MPLS circuits with broadband/LTE/5G overlays. * Configure FortiGate firewall policies, IPSec VPN tunnels, and SD\-WAN application steering rules aligned to business\-critical retail applications (POS, inventory, ERP). * Monitor WAN performance and SLA adherence using Fortinet analytics and third\-party NMS tools; proactively identify and resolve connectivity degradation. * Collaborate with ISPs and telecom vendors to manage circuit provisioning, failover configurations, and SLA enforcement. * Maintain FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer for centralized policy management and log analytics across distributed locations. **Operations, Support \& Projects** * Serve as Level 3 escalation for network incidents, providing root\-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions. * Lead network workstreams for new store openings, store refreshes, and DC expansions — coordinating with construction, real estate, and IT project managers. * Maintain comprehensive network documentation including topology diagrams, IP address management (IPAM), configuration standards, and runbo deployments. * Fortinet SD\-WAN: Demonstrated experience with FortiGate SD\-WAN, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, and FortiOS policy management. * Switching / LAN: Aruba CX, VLANs, 802\.1Q trunking, LACP, STP/MSTP, Layer 3 inter\-VLAN routing. * WAN Protocols: BGP, OSPF, IPSec VPN, WAN circuit management. * Security: Firewall policy management, 802\.1X/NAC, PCI\-DSS network segmentation requirements. * Network Monitoring: Proficiency with SNMP\-based NMS tools (SolarWinds, PRTG, or equivalent), packet capture analysis (Wireshark). **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Aruba Certified Mobility Professional (ACMP) or Aruba Certified ClearPass Associate/Professional (ACCA/ACCP). * CCNP (Enterprise or Security) or equivalent vendor\-neutral certification. * Experience with Aruba Central (cloud\-managed networking) and Aruba AIOps. * Familiarity with retail\-specific systems: POS network requirements, IoT/OT device segmentation (HVAC, digital signage, self\-checkout), and loss prevention systems. * Experience with SD\-WAN migration projects from legacy MPLS to hybrid WAN architectures. * Familiarity with ITSM platforms (ServiceNow) and IPAM solutions (Infoblox, SolarWinds IPAM). * Knowledge of cloud networking concepts (AWS/Azure VPN Gateways, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute). * Experience with automation and scripting (Python, Ansible) for network configuration management. **Core Competencies** --------------------- **Technical Problem Solving** Strong analytical skills for diagnosing complex, multi\-layer network issues in production retail environments. **Project Management** Ability to manage multiple concurrent network projects (store openings, refreshes, DC expansions) from scoping through delivery. **Communication** Translates complex technical topics for non\-technical stakeholders including retail operations and store leadership. **Documentation Discipline** Maintains accurate, up\-to\-date network documentation, diagrams, and change records without prompting. **Collaboration** Works effectively across IT, security, vendor, and field operations teams; builds credibility through expertise and reliability. **Continuous Improvement** Proactively identifies network performance gaps and proposes solutions before issues escalate. **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** --------------------------------------------- * Hybrid work model — 3 days per week mandatory in\-office at Marlborough, MA headquarters; remaining days remote. * Up to 25% travel to retail stores and distribution centers for site surveys, new store openings, network installations, and infrastructure audits. * Ability to work in active retail and warehouse environments, including walking distribution center floors and working in network closets/data rooms. * Must be able to lift and carry network equipment (APs, switches, routers) up to 50 lbs and work on ladders when required for AP mounting. * Occasional after\-hours and weekend work required for maintenance windows, store openings, and critical incident response. * On\-call rotation participation for after\-hours network support escalation. This is a hybrid role. Tuesday through Thursday are in\-office days at BJ's Club Support Center in Marlborough, MA and Monday and Friday are remote days. In accordance with the Pay Transparency requirements, the following represents a good faith estimate of the compensation range for this position. At BJ’s Wholesale Club, we carefully consider a wide range of non\-discriminatory factors when determining salary. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, education, experience, and qualifications. The pay range for this position is $128,500\.00 \- $164,000\.00 We recognize the growing role of AI tools, including ChatGPT, and value familiarity with them. That said, we want to hear from your authentic self. Your application should reflect your own skills, experiences, and insights rather than AI\-generated responses.

You will work alongside our VP of Engineering, VP of AI and product leadership to define how data science and machine learning are used across the platform. You will spend most of your time exploring complex datasets, developing and evaluating models, designing experiments, and translating ambiguous business problems into robust data science solutions. Success is measured by the quality of the decisions and product outcomes your work enables, not simply model complexity or novelty. **Here is how, through this exciting role, YOU will contribute to BMC's and your own success:** * Lead the design and development of machine learning and data science solutions for complex product and customer problems. * Take data science initiatives from problem definition and experimentation through validation and production adoption. * Build machine learning models where appropriate. * Apply statistical analysis and experimentation to measure product impact. * Explore large and complex datasets to identify signals that can improve product capabilities. * Develop robust approaches to model validation and performance evaluation. * Define meaningful metrics and evaluation frameworks for both traditional ML and GenAI\-powered capabilities. * Work with product and engineering teams to translate customer and business problems into data science solutions. * Use Python and modern data science tooling to build reproducible modelling and experimentation workflows. * Evaluate emerging techniques across machine learning, LLMs and GenAI and jobs.description: Berkshire Hathaway Homestate Companies, Workers Compensation Division, is looking for a **Senior Cyber Security Engineer** to join its IT Security team! This individual will work closely with key business partners, internal technology teams, and external vendors to research, deploy, and configure technologies and processes that strengthen the defenses of the enterprise. ### **ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES** * Develop repeatable security architectures working with internal and external partners. * Contribute to the development of an Agile methodology architecture, ensuring that security practices are implemented in a repeatable fashion. * Design, implement, and maintain DevSecOps pipelines, embedding automated security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA, container/image scanning) and policy\-as\-code gates into CI/CD workflows. * Partner with development teams to advance application security practices, including secure code review, threat modeling, and remediation of vulnerabilities identified through static and dynamic testing. * Evaluate risk and protect applications and infrastructure against new and emerging threats/threat actors. * Document and diagram administrative and technical controls for systems and architectures. * Integrate security within various cloud service models (e.g., IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and identify appropriate security solutions for each implementation. * AI \& Agent Security: Develop and apply expertise in the OWASP LLM Top 10 and related AI/agent threat models. Monitor AI agent behavior for anomalous or unauthorized activity and respond to AI specific security incidents (e.g., prompt injection, data, exfiltration, model misuse). * AI Fluency \& AI Integration: Maintain working fluency with AI assistant tools as part of standard security workflows, using AI to accelerate threat report analysis, detection rule generation, and security documentation. Evaluate and responsibly apply AI tools to improve team efficiency while maintaining appropriate human review and data handling controls. * Perform as a subject matter expert and contribute to the Experience using security tools such as Security Incident and Event Management (SIEM), vulnerability scanners, Endpoint Detection ility to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public. ### **NEEDED COMPETENCIES** * ANALYTICAL THINKING: Collects, analyzes, and synthesizes data and information from diverse sources that is often complex, voluminous and technical. Spots issues and detects gaps in available information. Uses intuition and experience to enhance understanding and interpretation of data. Determines the costs and benefits of alternative courses of action. * COMMUNICATION AND COLLABORATION: Effective communicator with strong interpersonal and communication skills. Communicates clearly and appropriately using effective verbal, listening, reading and writing skills. Asks questions freely to broaden knowledge and skills. Ability to successfully build relationships and adapt communication style across various environments. Listens and requests clarification. Appropriately responds to and resolves complex situations or problems. Responds well to feedback. Demonstrates effective group presentation and facilitation skills; contributes effectively in meetings with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Balances resources and constraints. Routinely delivers results at a higher level than anticipated (e.g., efficiency, quality). Is frequently assigned to high\-profile or challenging projects to achieve results. jobs.description: **The role, at a glance:** The Senior Backend Engineer is a 3\-month contract position that develops cloud services, APIs, and infrastructure for Biamp’s audiovisual conferencing solutions used worldwide. This role centers on identity and access control, including the permission model, APIs, and workflows that determine what users can do across the platform. The initial priority is to use SpiceDB to replace fixed, organization\-wide roles with permission sets, groups, and grants that reflect customers’ organizational structures. **How you'll contribute:** * Design, build, and maintain backend microservices and APIs (REST, GraphQL, and gRPC), primarily in Go * Design and implement fine\-grained authorization (role\-, resource\-, and relationship\-based) using SpiceDB * Plan and carry out zero\-downtime, verifiably equivalent migrations of existing customer access to the new permission model * Build event\-driven services using messaging systems such as NATS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ * Design and maintain SQL database schemas, queries, and data migrations * Troubleshoot and improve the reliability, security, and performance of production services * Work with the Web, Embedded Software, Product Verification (QA), and Product Management teams to deliver features and resolve issues * Participate in code reviews and document designs and processes in Confluence * Other duties as assigned by Supervisor **A successful candidate should have:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience * Hands\-on experience with AI agentic coding tools (such as Claude Code) as a core part of daily development, including directing agents through multi\-step tasks, reviewing and validating AI\-generated code, and building reusable skills and tool integrations (MCP) * 6\+ years of commercial software development, including backend services and cloud infrastructure * Proficiency in Go (Golang) and experience building microservices * Experience designing and building APIs, with GraphQL preferred. Exposure to REST or gRPC is also valuable * Experience with SpiceDB, OpenFGA, or other Zanzibar\-style permission systems * Experience designing relationship\-based, hierarchical authorization models (ReBAC), including inherited and delegated access * Experience with SQL and relational databases * Experience working in Linux environments, including administration and shell scripting * Experience with agile development practices * Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work independently and in a team **Some nice\-to\-haves:** * Experience with Kubernetes, Docker * Experience with Zitadel, Auth0, or similar OIDC providers * Experience with SCIM provisioning and SSO identity providers (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID) * Experience with message systems such as NATS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ * Experience with Terraform for building and managing infrastructure * CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Bitbucket * Experience with Microsoft Azure **Tools \& Collaboration** Bitbucket, Jenkins, Docker, Azure Kubernetes Services, Terraform, Jira, and Confluence. **Work Environment:** This is a 3\-month, on\-site contract position. Biamp does not have a remote or hybrid work policy for this role. **Who is Biamp?** We make the world’s most extraordinary audio and video solutions. For over 50 years, Biamp has created and innovated professional audiovisual solutions that enable great communication. From the smallest of rooms to the largest of venues, we empower true human connection in every space. As we grow to meet our customers’ needs and evolve to address the challenges of tomorrow, one guiding principle remains the same: Biamp connects people through extraordinary audiovisual experiences. **About our company:** At Biamp, we believe the employment relationship should be reciprocal. We want you to love your job, and we want your expertise and knowledge to help drive our business forward. We champion a supportive and dynamic environment filled with passionate people who choose continuous improvement over perfection. We insist on clear, explicit decision making, believe in taking calculated risks, and celebrate tough decisions even when they don’t succeed. We look for people who desire the best from themselves and encourage the same from their coworkers. Our commitment to one another and to the common goal is the most consistent reliable path to recurring success for all of us.

jobs.title: Enterprise Intelligence Manager
jobs.description: **Who We Are** *We have the fundamental belief that we, as an organization, can and will improve lives. Rooted in the centuries\-old credit union philosophy of people helping people, we maintain a simple premise. Those we interact with will receive equal and just treatment, devoid of intolerance, false judgment, racism, or discrimination of any kind. We must not accept less if we are to fulfill our mission, "We Improve Lives." This mission empowers us to serve the greater good and to make a difference in our world. Our cooperative structure creates a cycle of mutual assistance towards the common goal of the financial well\-being of members.* *At Black Hills Federal Credit Union (BHFCU), we’re committed to improving the lives of our members every day, and we look for people who share that passion. Don’t have a ton of financial industry experience? No problem. Our onboarding includes an orientation program with ongoing training to help staff further their career at BHFCU by building on their existing strengths.* **General Purpose:** The Enterprise Intelligence Manager is responsible for executing the Credit Union's enterprise data, analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and automation strategies. This role serves as the bridge between strategic vision and operational delivery, ensuring that data and AI capabilities generate measurable business value, improve member experience, increase organizational efficiency, and support strategic decision\-making. The Enterprise Intelligence Manager works across business units to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, establish governance, and deliver solutions that leverage data, analytics, automation, and emerging AI technologies. This position leads enterprise intelligence initiatives from concept through implementation and adoption, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities, regulatory expectations, and member\-centric objectives. As a champion of innovation and intelligence\-driven transformation, the Enterprise Intelligence Manager enables the Credit Union to turn information into insight, insight into action, and action into member value. **Essential Duties/Responsibilities:** * Execute the Credit Union's enterprise intelligence strategy encompassing data, analytics, artificial intelligence, automation, and decision intelligence. * Translate strategic priorities into actionable initiatives, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. * Establish and manage a portfolio of intelligence initiatives aligned with organizational goals. * Monitor performance and ensure initiatives deliver expected business value and strategic impact. * Regularly communicate progress, outcomes, and recommendations to AI Center of Excellence, project teams and CU leadership. * Support the deployment and adoption of AI\-enabled solutions that improve member experiences, employee productivity, operational efficiency, and decision quality. * Lead execution of enterprise data initiatives that improve data quality, accessibility, reliability, and usability. * Advance enterprise analytics capabilities that support proactive decision\-making. * Partner with business leaders to define key performance indicators and success measures. * Ensure leaders have access to actionable intelligence through reporting, dashboards, predictive analytics, and decision\-support tools. * Partner with Technology, Information Security, Risk Management, and Compliance teams to manage organizational risk. **Other Duties/Responsibilities:** * Promote responsible AI practices through governance, oversight, and risk management. * Monitor emerging AI technologies and evaluate opportunities for organizational application. * Foster a culture of data literacy and evidence\-based decision making. * Support and advance enterprise governance programs related to data, analytics, AI, and automation. * Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, privacy requirements, security standards, and internal policies. * Participate in the evaluation of emerging technologies, vendors, and strategic partnerships. * Participate in solution selection, implementation, and value realization activities. * Manage relationships with intelligence, analytics, AI, and automation solution providers. * Maintain awareness of evolving regulatory expectations impacting AI and data usage within financial services. * Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders regarding intelligence, data, analytics, automation, and AI opportunities. **Job Knowledge:** * Strong understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, analytics, business intelligence, and intelligent automation concepts. * Knowledge of data governance, data management, and information stewardship practices. * Strong business acumen and strategic thinking skills. * Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills. **Job Qualifications (Skills):** BHFCU is committed to working with its employees to reasonabl d consensus and drive adoption across diverse stakeholder groups. * Commitment to continuous learning and innovation. **Job Qualifications (Education):** Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Technology Management, Finance, or a related field. **Job Qualifications (Experience):** Eight (8\) to ten (10\) years of progressive experience in data architecture, data management, artificial intelligence, machine learning, automation, or related disciplines, including leadership experience managing and developing teams of technologists or engineers and driving organizational results through innovation and continuous improvement. Of the above required experience, at least three (3\) years should include implementing modern cloud data architecture and supporting AI, data integration, and automation strategies. Demonstrated success leading cross\-functional and enterprise\-wide initiatives and translating complex technical concepts into practical business solutions. **Working Conditions:** **Material and Equipment Involved** * Credit Union Computer/Internet * Telephone / Mobile Devices * Printer / Copier * SalesForce * Mulesoft * Azure * Microsoft Office Suite **Work Environment/Physical Activities** Occasional travel to one of BHFCU’s branch locations or attendance at community events may be required. **Physical Requirements** Perform primarily sedentary work with limited physical exertion and occasional lifting of up to 5 lbs. Must be capable of climbing/descending stairs in emergency situation. Must be able to operate routine office equipment including telephone, copier, facsimile, and calculator. Must be able to routinely perform work on computer for an average of 6\-8 hours per day. Must be able to work extended hours whenever required or requested by management. Must be capable of regular, reliable and timely attendance. **Working Conditions** Must be able to routinely perform work indoors in climate\-controlled shared work area with moderate noise. **Mental and/or Emotional Requirements** Must be able to perform job functions with supervision and work effectively either on own or as part of a team. Must be able to read and carry out various instructions and follow oral instructions. Must be able to speak clearly and deliver information in a logical and understandable sequence. Must be able to perform basic mathematical calculations with extreme accuracy. Must be capable of dealing calmly and professionally with numerous different personalities from diverse cultures at various levels within and outside of the organization and demonstrate highest levels of customer service and discretion when dealing with the public. Must be able to perform responsibilities with composure under the stress of deadlines/requirements for extreme accuracy and quality and/or fast pace. Must be able to effectively handle multiple, simultaneous, and changing priorities. Must be capable of exercising highest level of discretion on confidential matters. **Notice:** This job description is not intended to be, nor should it be construed as, a contract or guarantee of employment. Black Hills Federal Credit Union adheres to all federal and state labor laws regarding termination and probationary periods. This position is also subject to all the personnel policies of Black Hills Federal Credit Union. Changes may be made to this job description at any time by the President.
