jobs.title: Research Engineer - Robotics AI
jobs.description: **Company Description** The Bosch Research and Technology Center North America with offices in Sunnyvale, California, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and Cambridge, Massachusetts is a part of the global Bosch Group (www.bosch.com), a company with over 70 billion euro revenue, 400,000 employees worldwide, a very diverse product portfolio, and a history spanning over 125 years. The Research and Technology Center North America (RTC\-NA) is dedicated to providing technologies and system solutions for various Bosch business fields, primarily in the field of artificial intelligence, energy technologies, internet technologies, circuit design, semiconductors and wireless, as well as advanced MEMS design. As a part of the global research, our AI research in Silicon Valley focuses on Foundation Models, Explainable AI (XAI), Agentic AI, Computer Vision, Data\-driven Robotics, Data Science, AI System Engineering, Time\-series Analysis. We develop scalable, intelligent, and trustworthy AIoT solutions for Bosch products and services in application areas such as automated driving, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), robotics, smart manufacturing, enterprise AI, health care, smart home and building solutions. Originating from the AI research in Silicon Valley, our Embodied AI group is responsible for enabling future autonomous Bosch products by pushing the boundaries of automated driving, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), robotics and automation through key innovations that encompass system architecture and AI components. These include methods for motion planning, high level task planning and decision making as well as systems for making these technologies work on real products. We work with internal partners of different Bosch business units to transfer our solutions into future products. We also actively collaborate with leading groups in academia and industry to promote research ideas and publish research findings in internationally renowned conferences and journals such as CVPR, ICRA, IROS, RSS, NeurIPS and CoRL. **Job Description** As a Research Engineer \- Robotics AI, you contribute to research projects at the forefront of the Robot Learning field. Key responsibilities include: * **Conduct engineering** in core AI and machine learning fields to enable Embodied AI (including computer vision, autonomous planning, open\-world learning, and so on) for related business domains of ADAS/AD, industrial automation, robotics etc. * **Push the boundaries** in AI based Robotics, incorporating advancements in large vision\-language\-(action) models to aid reasoning capabilities and explainability. * **Collaborate cross\-functionally** with global research and engineering teams to ensure seamless technology transfer and system integration. * **Implement research results** to solve real\-world challenges, ensuring high\-quality system integration within Bosch's existing platforms. * **Stay at the forefront of innovation** by actively engaging with academic and industry communities through conferences, workshops, and technical events. * Collaborate to document and disseminate research findings through high\-caliber publications and/or patent submissions. **Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications** * Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics or a related discipline or outstanding Master's degree. * A minimum of 2 years of R\&D experience, or an equivalent graduate research background, primarily in AI technologies including Computer Vision and Robotic or Automotive Motion and Behavioral Planning. * Proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in machine learning (e.g., Python, C\+\+, Rust). * Strong interpersonal, communication, and teamwork capabilities. * Knowledge of major machine learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch. * Hands\-on research experience in agentic robotics / real2sim2real. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with real\-world product development and deployment of autonomous systems. * Hands\-on experience in reinforcement learning for behavior or motion planning or other applicable contexts and familiarity with common RL techniques (e.g. PPO, DQN, DDPG). * Hands\-on experience building and applying multimodal transformer\-based sequence\-to\-sequence models, especially multimodal vision\-language\-action models. * Hands\-on experience in computer vision and deep learning, with work in any of the following areas: multimodal transformers, multimodal language models, diffusion models, NeRF, gaussian splatting, object detection / segmentation, 3D scene understanding, sensor calibration, SfM, voxel/BEV grid\-based feature representation * A strong portfolio of publications in premier machine learning, deep learning, robotics and computer vision journals and conferences. **Additional Information** We offer a competitive base salary for this position with a range in US\-California of \-$160,000 \- $180,000 along with an annual corporate bonus, and a long\-term incentive bonus designed to reward sustained impact and contribution over time. Within the salary range, the individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc. Your well\-being matters at Bosch! We offer a a benefits package designed to empower you in every area of your life. This includes premium health coverage, a 401(k) with generous matching, resources for financial planning and goal setting, ample paid time off, parental leave, and comprehensive life and disability protection. Your Recruiter can share more details for this position during the interview process. Learn more about our full benefits offerings by visiting: https://www.myboschbenefits.com/public/welcome. **Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.** * Bosch adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug\-testing. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date. *\#LI\-JM1*

jobs.title: Security Automation Engineer II, BU Info Security
jobs.description: Help secure a major research university's IT systems, and automate as much of that work as you can. You'll work with technologists and business units across Boston University to define, implement, and evaluate security risks and controls, and to make sure what we build matches our enterprise architecture standards and Information Security policy. You'll deploy and maintain security services, both commercial and home\-grown, and help refine the policies and standards that govern them. What makes this role different is how we expect the work to be done. Security delivered as code, with version control, automated tests, and pipelines — and automated security checks living inside the pipelines our IS\&T colleagues already use. We also want real fluency with current AI tooling: working in AI\-assisted development environments day to day, using AI to help generate and validate tests and review code, building AI\-assisted security tooling and MCP integrations, and being the engineer who can look hard at the AI systems other units want to deploy and say something useful about them. Raising everyone else's capability is a permanent part of this job, not a side project. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Crusoe Managed Data Transfer
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** Crusoe's Managed Platform Services (MAPS) organization builds the managed services that make Crusoe Cloud easy to adopt and hard to leave, including Crusoe Container Registry, Cloud Monitoring and Managed Logs. Managed Data Transfer (MDT) is its newest service. MDT moves petabyte\-scale training data from AWS S3, and later other clouds, into Crusoe storage with a single API call: the service shards the work across a fleet of transfer workers, verifies every object, and asks the customer to run nothing. For AI labs and Physical AI companies whose data lives with a hyperscaler, it removes one of the biggest obstacles to training on Crusoe GPUs. We are hiring Senior Software Engineers to build the MDT control plane: the job API, scheduler and job state that turn a customer request into a coordinated, resumable transfer. You will join a new team at the beginning, take the service from first commit to its preview launch with design\-partner customers, and shape the API that new clouds and Crusoe\-internal transfers will plug into later. You will work closely with the Storage, Network, IAM and Cloud Console teams, and report to the Engineering Manager of Managed Data Transfer. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Job API and Lifecycle:** Design and build the data\-transfer API (create, list, get, cancel) with a provider\-neutral model for sources and destinations, so new clouds and storage types can be added without breaking customers. * **Scheduling and Job State:** Build the scheduler and state machine that split a bucket listing into units of work, place them on regional worker pools, and track progress, retries and resume across failures. * **Correctness at Scale:** Make petabyte\-scale jobs safe to retry and cancel, with end\-to\-end checksum verification and clear errors when a customer's permissions or destination are wrong. * **Cross\-Cloud Identity:** Implement secure access to customer buckets with short\-lived, least\-privilege credentials (AWS role assumption first, other clouds next), integrated with Crusoe IAM and audit logging. * **Customer Surfaces:** Ship the CLI and, with partner teams, the Terraform and Console experiences for creating and monitoring transfers. * **Operational Excellence:** Instrument the service with metrics, logs and alerts, write the runbooks, and take part in the team's on\-call rotation. * **Cross\-Team Collaboration:** Agree the interfaces MDT depends on with Storage, Network, IAM and Console, and work with Product and Solutions Architects on early customer onboarding. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Backend Engineering Craft:** Experience designing and shipping production backend services and APIs, ideally in Go, with gRPC or REST, relational databases and Kubernetes. * **Professional Experience:** 5\+ years building cloud infrastructure or platform services, including taking a service from zero to general availability. * **Distributed Systems Judgment:** Comfort with long\-running, failure\-prone work: idempotency, retries with backoff, leases, checkpointing and partial failure. * **API Design:** Ability to design public APIs that customers automate against and that can grow without breaking changes. * **Security Mindset:** Working knowledge of authentication, authorization and least privilege, and care in handling customer credentials. * **Operational Ownership:** You have run services in production, been on call, and built the dashboards and alerts that keep incidents short. * **Collaboration and Writing:** You work well across teams with different priorities, and your design docs settle decisions. * **Educational Foundation:** A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. **Bonus Points** * Experience with large\-scale data movement, such as S3 multipart uploads, rclone, s5cmd, AWS DataSync or Google Storage Transfer Service. * Hands\-on experience with cross\-cloud identity: AWS IAM and STS, GCP service\-account impersonation, or Azure workload identity. * Experience with storage systems (object storage, NFS, parallel file systems) or high\-throughput networking. * Experience with job jobs.title: Associate Director, AI Engineering
jobs.description: **Entity:** CSL Behring **Job Category:** Information Technology **Job Family:** IT Multi Discipline **Job Type:** Full Time **Location****:** Waltham, Massachusetts, United States **Employer Reference:** R\-295164 **Job Description** ------------------- Deliver robust, tested and supportable systems from the team's working prototypes to R\&D scientists. The Associate Director is the team's senior full\-stack engineer and architect. The role owns the engineering standards, development and deployment patterns, and production readiness for every application the team ships, and decides how software built with agentic tools by scientists and colleagues becomes durable, validation\-ready systems. Its decisions set how quickly prototypes become products, how reliable those products are, and whether they are ready for validation. The role partners with a peer Associate Director, AI Platform \& Enablement, who turns proven team patterns into shared platform capabilities over time. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role: the Associate Director designs, builds, debugs and reviews production software, working in agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) throughout the day, alongside validated\-system work that follows its own procedures. **Responsibilities:** * Own engineering standards and production readiness for every application the team ships. Select and maintain the team's standard languages, frameworks and supported versions based on security, maintainability, enterprise compatibility and what AI\-assisted development builds most reliably. Make architecture, release and incident\-response decisions without escalation, within agreed governance, security and quality requirements. * Take prototypes built by scientists and colleagues with agentic tools to production grade: refactor, strengthen and productize them with sound architecture, tests, observability, security, documentation and operability. Assess prototypes against agreed engineering standards and work with stakeholders to recommend and implement retain, rebuild or retire decisions. * Own application\-to\-platform integration: the production concerns that recur across applications, such as authentication and single sign\-on, secrets, networking, deployment and monitoring. Solve them for the team, build them once into reusable patterns, and work with the AI Platform \& Enablement Associate Director and enterprise platform teams to move proven patterns into the platform. * Establish and maintain the team's standard development and deployment patterns: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments, starter templates, monitoring and operational runbooks for the team's applications and agents. * Own code\-review standards and the merge gate for the team's repositories, reviewing and approving changes from scientists, colleagues, contractors and embedded delivery engineers, none of whom report to the role. Run design and architecture reviews before applications enter shared environments, and set the review standard for AI\-generated code. * Design and build full\-stack, cloud\-native systems: APIs, orchestration and workflow services, data and vector stores, identity and access, and scientist\-facing front ends, favoring managed services and simple, maintainable designs. * Partner with Quality and computer system validation colleagues to define and implement risk\-based engineering and validation practices for LLM and agent\-based applications, and build the evidence case for them. Practices may include requirements traceability, model and configuration change control, regression evaluations, controlled releases and auditable records. Quality retains decision authority. * Work directly with R\&D scientists and the team's scientists to define software requirements, review their code and build engineering capability through pairing. Lead the productization of the team's flagship applications, directing embedded delivery or professional\-services engineers and coaching colleagues on engineering practice. * Gain acceptance from platform teams and Cyber for the team's deployment and access patterns. Implement application security practice in line with Cyber standards, and ensure the team's applications and delivery practice comply with the company's quality management system, security guidelines and IT policies. * Own the production\-support approach for the team's applications, including triage, escalation, incident follow\-up and engineering fixes, with support responsibilities agreed across the team and platform partners. * Bring production\-readiness and risk assessments to senior leadership, with recommendations on build versus buy and on which prototypes to harden or retire. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in a physical, life or quantitative science or in engineering, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred. * 10\+ years building and operating production software, with a substantial share as a hands\-on architect or principal\-level engineer who thinks in systems. * Experience building or operating software in regulated, validated environments (e.g., GxP, computer system validation, IQ/OQ/PQ, requirements traceability) required. * Demonstrated, sustained daily use of agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) to design, build and ship software, with full ownership of generated code, evidenced by delivered software, professional or personal. * Experience owning CI/CD, infrastructure as code and release engineering with a globally distributed team: pipelines, environments, deployment and rollback, and observability. * Track record of taking inherited or prototype code to production grade: refactoring, test coverage, security hardening, performance and operability. * Experience solving the production concerns that sit between applications and platforms (e.g., authentication and SSO, secrets, networking, access control) and turning them into reusable patterns. * Fluency in at least one production language and the judgment to direct agents across a polyglot stack (the team's is Python, TypeScript and PostgreSQL). * Deep cloud\-native experience, AWS preferred (equivalent Azure or GCP depth considered): containers and serverless, workflow orchestration, IAM and least\-privilege design, managed data stores. * Hands\-on LLM application patterns (RAG, vector search, multi\-stage pipelines) preferred. * Experience working directly with research scientists preferred. **About CSL Behring** --------------------- CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients' needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. CSL Behring operates one of the world's largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. jobs.title: Senior AI Agentic App Sec Engineer
jobs.description: **Department Overview** The Information Security organization is advancing Application Security to help the enterprise deliver products and services securely as software development practices rapidly evolve. The Application Security Engineering and Innovation team builds, integrates, operates, and matures modern security capabilities across the software development lifecycle, with a particular focus on automation, developer experience, software supply chain security, and AI\-enabled security engineering. **Job Overview** The Application Security Engineer, AI and Agentic Security is a senior individual contributor responsible for designing, prototyping, evaluating, and operationalizing generative and agentic AI capabilities within Application Security. The role combines hands\-on software engineering, Application Security expertise, and practical experience with AI\-enabled development patterns. It will help establish safe, scalable approaches for AI\-assisted vulnerability identification, code analysis, remediation, validation, and security workflow automation. This engineer will partner with Application Security, software engineering, cloud and platform teams, Security Architecture, AI Governance, and other information security functions to move promising concepts from experimentation into governed, supportable enterprise capabilities. The role is expected to balance innovation with disciplined engineering, security controls, measurable outcomes, and long\-term operational sustainability. ***Responsibilities*** * Design, build, and test prototypes and production\-ready capabilities using generative AI, large language models, AI agents, and multi\-step agentic workflows. * Develop Python\-based services, automation, integrations, evaluation harnesses, and supporting tools for Application Security use cases. * Evaluate AI\-enabled security products and frameworks for vulnerability discovery, exploitability analysis, secure code guidance, remediation, validation, and developer workflow integration. * Create controlled workflows in which AI capabilities can analyze code, use approved tools, recommend or generate changes, execute tests, and produce auditable evidence while maintaining appropriate human oversight. * Establish technical guardrails for agent identity, least privilege, data access, tool use, repository access, secrets handling, logging, traceability, change control, and safe failure or termination. * Develop test plans and benchmarks to assess accuracy, security, reliability, repeatability, cost, latency, false positives, remediation quality, and operational value. * Perform security testing of AI and agentic workflows, including prompt injection, unsafe tool use, excessive agency, data leakage, insecure output handling, dependency and supply chain risks, and authorization failures. * Integrate capabilities with source control, CI/CD pipelines, developer tools, issue management, security testing platforms, and vulnerability management workflows. * Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, technical requirements, runbooks, and operational support models for approved capabilities. * Partner with governance and architecture teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise AI, security, privacy, data protection, and technology standards. * Support pilots with application teams, capture feedback, measure outcomes, and recommend whether capabilities should be scaled, redesigned, purchased, built, or retired. * Maintain awareness of developments in generative AI, agentic systems, secure AI engineering, Application Security, and software delivery practices. * Strong hands\-on Python development experience, including API integration, automation, testing, data handling, and production\-quality engineering practices. * Experience building or integrating solutions using large language models, model APIs, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool calling, structured outputs, workflow orchestration, or agent frameworks. * Experience designing and evaluating agentic workflows that use tools, maintain state, make bounded decisions, and operate with human approval where appropriate. * Strong understanding of secure software development, common application vulnerabilities, threat modeling, secure design, authentication and authorization, secrets management, and software supply chain risk. * Experience with Application Security capabilities such as SAST, SCA, secrets detection, DAST, API security, container security, IaC security, and vulnerability remediation workflows. * Experience with Git\-based development, pull requests, CI/CD, automated testing, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native development patterns. * Ability to evaluate AI output quality using repeatable test cases, metrics, red\-team scenarios, and evidence\-based comparison rather than demonstration results alone. * Understanding of AI security risks and controls, including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, insecure tool use, mo tion development, LLM integration, agentic systems, or AI\-enabled developer tooling. * Experience with one or more additional languages or platforms such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, .NET/C\#, or Go. * Experience with cloud services, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and enterprise developer platforms. * Experience with AI evaluation, adversarial testing, red teaming, observability, or governance controls for AI\-enabled systems. * Knowledge of industry guidance such as the OWASP Top 10, OWASP guidance for LLM or agentic applications, NIST Secure Software Development Framework, and NIST AI Risk Management Framework. * Relevant security, cloud, or software credentials are beneficial but not required; examples may include CISSP, CSSLP, CCSP, GWEB, or cloud\-provider certifications. **What Is Expected of You and Others at This Level** * Applies advanced knowledge of software engineering, Application Security, and AI\-enabled development to solve complex and ambiguous problems. * Leads or materially contributes to complex projects with broad scope, significant technical impact, and long\-term operational implications. * Recommends new practices, architectures, controls, metrics, and engineering approaches for emerging capabilities. * Independently determines methods for completing new or undefined work while receiving guidance on overall objectives. * Experience in providing solutions and technical patterns that help establish precedents for organization wide adoption . * Experience in transiting emerging technology into practical, secure, and supportable capabilities that can be adopted by engineering teams. * Efficiently communicate technical findings, risks, trade\-offs, and recommendations to engineering, security, governance, in various leadership forums. * Acts as a mentor and technical resource for less experienced colleagues and cross\-functional partners. **Success in This Role** Success is demonstrated by converting emerging AI capabilities into secure, measurable, and operationally sustainable Application Security outcomes. jobs.title: Identity Resolution Engineer
jobs.description: **At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.** We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting\-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: *“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”* That question drives everything we do. But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose. **Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.** **Position Summary** Caris Life Sciences serves hundreds of thousands of molecular cases a year and continues to grow at double\-digit rates. Its molecular, imaging, and clinical\-outcomes data support software that helps ensure a cancer patient's report is right, complete, and on time. The Senior Software Engineer \- Identity Resolution \& Master Data Management designs, builds, and operates the production identity capabilities that regulated clinical workflows depend on: matching, linking, merging, and separating identity records under auditable controls, so that clinical information lands on the correct patient and provider records across complex healthcare data flows. The engineer improves resolution quality, data integrity, and operational reliability, and every change ships through controlled, testable delivery practices. The engineering environment supports advanced AI coding assistants and agentic workflows across design, implementation, and test generation. Characterization tests and golden\-master replay serve as executable evidence, and onboarding is harness\-first: the engineer builds or extends those tests to capture current behavior as repeatable validation evidence. Delivery runs on CI/CD, automated testing, application\-level observability, and risk\-based release governance aligned with current FDA Computer Software Assurance guidance. The specific technology stack is discussed during the interview process. Reporting to an Engineering Manager or Senior Engineering Manager in Clinical Software Engineering, this senior individual contributor leads technical delivery in the identity\-resolution domain, participates in architecture and design decisions, and maintains software subject to SOX financial controls and FDA regulatory requirements. Location: Irving, Texas (Dallas–Fort Worth), on\-site/hybrid, minimum three days per week on campus; co\-located with Caris's laboratory and clinical operations. **Job Responsibilities** * Design, build, test, and maintain identity\-resolution and MDM services for patient and provider data. * Develop and tune deterministic and probabilistic matching across names, addresses, dates of birth, contact information, identifiers, and other approved attributes. * Implement workflows to merge, unmerge, link, and separate records, with durable audit trails and safeguards for downstream clinical use. * Define and monitor resolution\-quality, data\-quality, performance, and reliability measures; investigate anomalies and strengthen controls. * Own the data models, APIs, and integration patterns that connect upstream and downstream clinical systems. * Partner with product management, data governance, clinical operations, compliance, and engineering to refine requirements and manage identity\-related risks. * Write and maintain the technical record: design documents, architecture decision records, data\-flow documentation, and operational runbooks. * Review code and submit work for review; contribute automated unit, integration, regression, and performance tests. * Automate recurring engineering and operational tasks: repeated manual steps become scripted, reviewed automation rather than standing process. * Instrument and support production services; participate in incident response, root\-cause analysis, and corrective\-action work. * Mentor less\-experienced engineers through code review, pair programming, and knowledge sharing. * Work AI\-first: use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as daily practice across design, implementation, and test generation, with peer and engineering review as the quality gate. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production software systems. * 3\+ of those years designing or operating entity\-resolution, record\-linkage, MDM, or comparable identity systems in production. * 2\+ of those years building system integrations through APIs, event\-driven patterns, or batch data pipelines. * A track record of implementing matching logic across multiple identity attributes and evaluating it against measurable quality controls. * Experience designing data models and remediation workflows for duplicate, conflicting, or incomplete records. * Command of full SDLC practices, automated testing, code review, and controlled production delivery. * Operating experience with high\-volume production services: observability, incident response, and root\-cause analysis. * Hands\-on fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic development workflows in real engineering work. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in healthcare, clinical laboratory, diagnostics, or life sciences software environments. * Experience with MPI or enterprise identity\-resolution platforms. * Familiarity with HL7 messaging and FHIR. * Depth in relational and document databases: SQL, indexing, and query optimization. * Experience applying graph databases, probabilistic methods, or ML to entity resolution. * Experience with CI/CD, automated regression testing, and production observability. * Experience implementing or operating controls aligned with SOX ITGCs or FDA requirements under 21 CFR. * Experience in CLIA\- or HIPAA\-governed environments. Regulated\-domain experience is preferred, not required. **Physical Demands** * Ability to sit, stand, and work at a computer for extended periods. **Training** * All job\-specific, safety, and compliance training is assigned based on the job functions associated with this employee. **Other** * This role may require periodic travel to other Caris sites or partner locations. After\-hours response to critical patient\-identity or clinical\-data issues and participation in periodic scheduled on\-call rotations may be required. **Conditions of Employment:** Individual must successfully complete pre\-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check ( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification. This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Caris Life Sciences is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises. We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to join the Cloudera Cloud Factory and play a pivotal role in shaping the architecture, engineering direction, and technical execution of our next generation of cloud and data platform capabilities. This is a senior technical leadership role for an engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong systems thinking, architectural judgment, and the ability to influence across teams. You will work on complex, high\-scale distributed systems and help translate product and platform requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions. You will operate across team boundaries, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, and other R\&D teams to define technical strategy and deliver critical capabilities. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Own and drive the technical direction for significant areas of the Cloudera Cloud Factory platform. * Design and evolve highly scalable, resilient, and secure distributed systems across cloud and hybrid\-cloud environments. * Lead architecture and technical design for complex, cross\-cutting initiatives with significant customer and business impact. * Act as a closely with Product Management to translate customer and business requirements into pragmatic technical strategies. * Drive technical alignment across multiple engineering teams and influence decisions beyond your immediate organization. * Lead technical initiatives from early\-stage exploration and design through implementation, production adoption, and continuous improvement. * Mentor and develop senior and staff\-level engineers, helping raise the technical bar across the organization. * Participate in and influence technical reviews, architecture forums, design discussions, and strategic planning. * Balance short\-term delivery requirements with long\-term platform strategy and architectural integrity. * Represent Engineering in cross\-functional and customer\-facing technical discussions when required. **What You Bring** ------------------ * Extensive experience designing and building large\-scale distributed systems and cloud platforms. * Deep expertise in software engineering, system architecture, and modern cloud\-native technologies. * Proven experience operating as a technical leader across multiple engineering teams, without relying on direct reporting relationships. * Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts including scalability, availability, fault tolerance, consistency, observability, and performance. * Experience working with public cloud platforms and/or hybrid\-cloud environments. * Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous, complex problems and turn them into clear technical strategies and executable plans. * Strong track record of delivering technically complex products or platform capabilities into production. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both deeply technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong engineering judgment and the ability to make pragmatic trade\-offs between architectural purity, delivery velocity, operational complexity, and customer value. * Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture and technical standards. **Preferred Experience** ------------------------ * Experience with cloud management, Kubernetes, container orchestration, or cloud\-native infrastructure. * Experience building data platforms, distributed data services, or large\-scale data management systems. * Experience across AWS, Azure, GCP, or other public cloud environments. * Experience with multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud architectures. * Experience contributing to or working with open\-source software. * Leadership Expectations** ------------------------------------- As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will be expected to operate beyond the boundaries of an individual team. **You will:** Think at platform Raise the technical bar — mentor engineers, challenge assumptions, establish strong engineering practices, and create reusable patterns. Connect technology to customer value — ensure architectural and technical decisions ultimately improve customer experience, product capability, reliability, and business outcomes. **Why Join Us** --------------- This is an opportunity to have significant influence over the technical direction of Cloudera Cloud Factory, working alongside highly experienced engineers and architects to build the foundation for Cloudera's next generation of cloud and data platform capabilities. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Ambient Product
jobs.description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Ambient Product Engineering team powering the entire suite of Ambient AI products across care settings and specialties. This team builds and owns the core product features used across clinician\-facing experiences: ambient capture, real\-time note generation, review \& edit flows, copilot\-style assistance, and admin tooling embedded into clinical workflows. The product engineering team is at the heart of our product vision in building innovative and intuitive product experiences under real\-world clinical conditions. Your team works closely with Ambient Frontend Engineering, Ambient Labs, and Ambient Integrations teams to build the Ambient product end\-to\-end, enhancing provider experience by creating a better in\-app experience and improving the quality of generated medical notes. Your team’s work directly impacts provider trust, documentation quality, and time saved per visit. This role is ideal for a leader who has scaled complex, data\-heavy, real\-time products and who is excited about building innovative best\-in\-class AI products that transform the future of healthcare. *Seeking an engineering leader who can join us in the office at least 3 days a week.* **What You’ll Do** ------------------ People Leadership \& Delivery * Lead and grow a team of product engineers * Set clear technical and execution standards in a high\-bar, healthcare\-grade environment * Coach engineers on scope ownership, technical decision\-making, and cross\-team influence * Own planning, execution, and delivery for product initiatives with large impact * Actively participate in hiring, performance management, and improving related processes Ambient Product Ownership * Own the core Ambient features clinicians use every visit: ambient capture, real\-time note generation, review and edit, copilot assistance, and admin tooling * Lead architecture for real\-time and async product workflows, from audio capture through note generation and review * Drive latency, reliability, and uptime for a product used during live patient encounters * Ship features that measurably improve provider trust, note quality, and time saved per visit * Establish patterns for partial data, AI failures, and confidence signaling across product workflows Developer Experience \& Scale * Build shared product layers and abstractions that let Ambient teams ship features without duplication * Adopt cutting\-edge AI workflows to improve developer velocity * Define standards for product observability, usage metrics, and user\-impact monitoring * Partner with Ambient Labs to define clean contracts between LLM pipelines and product features, and turn note\-quality gains into shipped product Cross\-Functional Leadership * Partner deeply with Product to translate clinical workflows into intuitive, scalable product experiences * Work closely with Ambient Frontend Engineering and Design to deliver a cohesive, clinician\-grade experience end to end * Collaborate with Compliance and Security to ensure product features meet healthcare requirements * Collaborate with Operations and Customer Success to improve how customer feedback is handled and turn it into key product improvements * Influence product engineering direction across the broader engineering organization Technical Leadership * Drive technical design quality for Ambient product initiatives. Ensure architecture decisions anticipate future use cases (new care settings, modalities, and products). * Identify common patterns and drive technical vision across Ambient engineering * Help teams navigate tradeoffs between speed, quality, and safety in AI\-driven UX * Drive engineering excellence initiatives including on\-call, incident management, and reliability * Stay close enough to the code and architecture to unblock complex problems when needed **What You Have** ----------------- Requirements * 10\+ years of engineering experience, including 4\+ years managing high\-performing product teams * Deep backend expertise in designing and scaling distributed systems, APIs, and data pipelines for high\-throughput, low\-latency products * Experience supporting mission\-critical user workflows * Proven ability to deliver large\-scale product initiatives on time with high quality * Strong communication skills and influence over product and technical direction Nice to Have * Experience building clinician\-facing, enterprise, or regulated products * Familiarity with AI\-driven or ML\-powered user experiences * Background in healthcare, fintech, or other high\-reliability domains ### **What Success Looks Like** * The team ships fast without trading off quality or safety * Clinicians trust Ambient to work every time, in every live encounter * Product work shows clear, measurable impact for providers * Improvements from Ambient Labs reach clinicians quickly * AI\-driven workflows feel consistent and scale to new products and care settings * Partner teams see this team as the one that turns ambitious ideas into shipped product * A high\-performing team that attracts senior talent and grows its own leaders Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization. Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis. Compensation Range: $240K \- $275K

jobs.title: Software Engineer I – C#/.NET | Hybrid – Paducah, KY
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Are you an early\-career software developer looking for an opportunity to build your technical skills while working on real\-world applications? CSI is seeking a **Software Engineer I** to join our development team in Paducah, Kentucky. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or junior developer who wants to begin or grow a career in software development while gaining hands\-on experience with **C\#, SQL, JavaScript, APIs, and banking technology**. This is a **hybrid position based in Paducah**, where many members of the team are located. Having the team nearby will provide additional opportunities for hands\-on training, mentoring, and collaboration as you get up to speed. **What You'll Do** * Spend approximately 75% of your time coding and developing application enhancements * Develop and maintain applications using C\#, SQL, and JavaScript * Write, test, debug, and maintain code under the guidance of experienced developers * Assist with enhancements and ongoing development for CSI's banking applications * Troubleshoot production issues and respond to application\-related support requests * Work with Product Management, CRC, and internal stakeholders to research questions and resolve application issues * Write and execute functional test scenarios * Identify and resolve straightforward software bugs, escalating more complex issues when appropriate * Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from experienced developers * Contribute to sprint planning, team meetings, and development discussions * Learn CSI's products, development tools, processes, and banking applications * Participate in occasional post\-release testing, currently occurring approximately six times per year **Technologies You'll Work With** **Primary technologies:** * C\# * .NET * SQL * JavaScript **Experience or exposure to the following is a plus, but not required:** * Angular * API development * Postman * Swagger * Hangfire * Telerik controls Candidates do **not** need to come in knowing every technology listed above. This is an early\-career role designed for someone who has a solid technical foundation and is excited to continue learning. **Applications You'll Support** You'll have an opportunity to work with several applications supporting CSI's banking customers, including solutions focused on: * Document storage and retrieval * Bank and executive reporting * Data processing and database integration * Telephone banking * Other internally developed banking applications One of the primary areas of focus will be Centerdoc, CSI's document storage solution. You'll provide additional development capacity and backup support while gaining deeper knowledge of the application. **What We're Looking For** * 0–3 years of hands\-on experience in software development or a related technical field * Education or training from an accredited university, college, trade school, or comparable technical program * Foundational knowledge of software development concepts * Experience or coursework involving C\#, SQL, and/or JavaScript * Ability to troubleshoot problems and work through technical issues * Willingness to ask questions, accept feedback, and learn from more experienced developers * Strong communication and collaboration skills * Interest in building a long\-term career in software development Coursework, internships, personal projects, and early professional development experience may all be relevant for this position. **Work Environment** This role is based in **Paducah, Kentucky** and will follow a **hybrid work model**, with approximately **1–2 days per week in the office**, particularly during onboarding and training. **Grow Your Career at CSI** This position is designed for someone at the beginning of their software development career. You'll have the opportunity to learn from experienced engineers, work on applications used by financial institutions, and gradually take on greater technical ownership as your skills and product knowledge grow. CSI developers also have access to AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude as supplemental resources for activities such as understanding or analyzing code. AI\-generated output is expected to be reviewed and validated rather than used as a replacement for software development knowledge and judgment. As a forward\-thinking software provider, Computer Services, Inc. (CSI) helps community and regional financial institutions solve their customers’ needs through open and flexible technologies. In addition to its award\-winning core banking platform, these include the latest in lending, digital banking, payments, financial crime prevention and cybersecurity. Building on its 60\-year track record of personalized service, CSI is shaping the future of banking and empowering its customers to rival their competition. For more information about CSI, visit www.csiweb.com CSI provides rewarding and challenging career opportunities for our employees. When determining your pay, we consider various factors such as your skills, qualifications, experience and location. Along with a competitive salary, this position includes eligibility for incentive awards based on both individual and business performance. We also offer a comprehensive range of benefits. To learn more about our benefits, visit: Benefits Summary CSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email us at recruiter@csiweb.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. jobs.description: **About Crunchyroll** --------------------- Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super\-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200\+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in\-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love. Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime! **About the Role** ------------------ The EDGE Discovery team at Crunchyroll is focused on powering content discoverability experiences across the platform. We build and evolve the backend systems that enable anime fans worldwide to seamlessly discover, browse, search, and engage with Crunchyroll’s catalog through personalized, highly scalable experiences. Our systems power critical user journeys, including home page personalization, search, recommendations, metadata delivery, content ranking, and discovery APIs across all Crunchyroll platforms and devices. We operate at the intersection of backend platform engineering, large\-scale distributed systems, and machine\-learning enablement, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, relevance, and reliability. As a Backend Senior Engineer, you will help drive the technical direction and architecture of the services that power Crunchyroll’s discovery ecosystem. You will partner closely with engineering, product, data, and machine learning teams to build highly scalable backend platforms that improve content discoverability and user engagement while enabling teams to iterate quickly and safely. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges in distributed systems, scaling high\-traffic backend services, and building systems that directly impact how millions of users discover and experience content. jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It's a big mission, and that's where you come in! You'll have limitless learning opportunities, mentorship and collaboration with world\-class minds, and a variety of projects with large scopes — while doing work that's both fun and meaningful. Join our life\-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world. **About the role** As a Staff Security Engineer, you will shape and deliver Duolingo's security strategy, safeguarding our learners, employees, systems, and services. You'll identify the highest\-impact security problems, lead complex initiatives from proposal through production, and build durable security capabilities across our applications and cloud infrastructure. Working across Engineering, Product, Legal, Finance, and IT, you'll make practical risk decisions, establish secure\-by\-default patterns, and help teams ship safely at scale. This role is based in New York City. We know great candidates bring different combinations of experience. If you meet some or most of the qualifications below, we encourage you to apply! **:brain: You will...** * Set technical direction for security across Duolingo's applications, cloud infrastructure, and engineering systems. * Lead complex, multi\-team security initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation, measurement, and ongoing ownership. * Design and build scalable security services, controls, and automation that prevent, detect, and remediate risks with minimal manual effort. * Partner with engineering teams to threat model systems, review architecture and code, prioritize risks, and deliver practical mitigations. * Strengthen security across the software\-development lifecycle, including secrets management, dependency security, vulnerability management, and CI/CD controls. * Evaluate Duolingo's security posture, use evidence to identify the highest\-impact investments, and define measurable outcomes for security programs. * Lead technical response to significant security incidents and translate lessons learned into lasting improvements. * Establish reusable secure\-by\-default patterns for cloud and application infrastructure, including infrastructure as code. * Communicate technical risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to engineering teams and company leaders. * Mentor engineers, scale security knowledge through documentation and guidance, and raise the technical bar across Engineering. **:check: You have...** * A track record of leading large, complex security engineering initiatives across multiple teams from proposal through production. * Deep experience in at least two of the following areas: application security, product security, cloud security, infrastructure security, detection and response, or security automation. * Strong software\-engineering skills in one or more programming or scripting languages and experience building reliable production systems or internal platforms. * Experience securing cloud environments and designing controls for identity, networking, data protection, secrets, logging, and workload security. * Experience applying threat modeling, architecture review, code review, and vulnerability analysis to real\-world systems. * Experience using infrastructure as code and CI/CD to deliver repeatable, testable, and secure configurations. * Sound judgment in balancing security risk, engineering effort, product needs, and business priorities. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders with different technical backgrounds. * The ability to work from or relocate to New York City. **:star: Exceptional candidates will have...** * Experience building a security program or technical capability from an early stage and scaling it across an engineering organization. * Experience securing large, multi\-account or multi\-cloud environments, particularly AWS and GCP. * Experience creating security platforms or paved\-road patterns adopted broadly by engineers. * Experience leading high\-severity incident response and driving durable improvements afterward. * Experience applying AI\-assisted tooling to security analysis, remediation, or control validation. **Benefits:** Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well\-being with our benefits here. **Job Alerts:** Sign up for job alerts jobs.description: Duquesne Light Company, headquartered in downtown Pittsburgh, is a leader in providing electric energy and has been in the forefront of the electric energy market, with a history rooted in technological innovation and superior customer service. Today, the company continues its role as a leader in the transmission and distribution of electric energy, providing a secure supply of reliable power to more than half a million customers in southwestern Pennsylvania. We want you to join our team! **Summary:** Duquesne Light Holdings (DLH) embarked on an agile transformation initiative in late\-2022 with product management as its central tenet. The goal within the Operations Product Management Team is to deliver business outcomes through improved delivery lead times and cycle times aligned with the company’s strategic imperatives. In alignment with the agile transformation initiative, our aim is to enable and execute delivery and support through a blend of lean principles and practices and fostering engagement and collaboration with our business stakeholders. jobs.title: AI Engineer I/II/III
jobs.description: **At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross\-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement.** **Join our Qrew!** EQT is building a fleet of AI agents that work alongside our people, and we need an AI Engineer to help it grow. You'll join an AI team that builds the shared tools agents rely on, configures and deploys the agents themselves, and keeps the whole fleet healthy once it's live. Our agents already run in production on Microsoft Foundry, posting into Salesforce and the enterprise systems our people use every day. The next step is scale: many more agents, built faster, with business users helping tune them. As an AI Engineer, you build and maintain the capabilities our agents run on, and you monitor and optimize the agent fleet once it's in production. You set up the configuration for each prompt agent and customize its tools. Then you hand off to AI Specialists and domain experts, who test against real cases and tune the prompts until the agent is right. When reasoning alone can't do the job reliably, you build a pro\-code hosted agent or specialized tooling. That's the exception, not the plan. **Who thrives here:** * **You think agentically.** You trust reasoning models to do most of the heavy lifting, and you reach for deterministic code where the outcome must be guaranteed, not by default. * **You build for flexibility.** You'd rather ship an agent that improves as models get better and cheaper than hardcode every scenario and fall behind. * **You favor progress over perfection.** You'd rather get many useful agents live and improve them than polish one forever. * **You make others better.** You enjoy building the tools and patterns that let business users and new builders do more on their own. * **You're excited about where AI is going.** You follow the field, try new models and tools as they land, and want to help an organization change how it works. **The AI Engineer I/II/III responsibilities include but are not limited to:** * Build and maintain shared agent tools and capabilities. * Configure Foundry prompt agents: instructions, model selection, tool assignments, permissions, and guardrails, ready for others to test and tune. * Customize and extend tools when an agent needs something the shared set doesn't yet cover. * Partner with AI Specialists and domain experts as they test against real cases, and coach them on prompt design and evaluation. * Deploy agents and monitor the fleet through the Foundry control plane: evaluations, monitoring and alerts, audit trail, and cost. * Optimize agents in production, and recognize when a deployment is drifting or needs tighter guardrails, better data, or a narrower scope. * Build pro\-code hosted agents or specialized tooling when review shows a prompt agent can't do the job reliably. * Ensure agents adhere to our security and identity standards. * Help shape the Agent Factory standards and share what you learn, so the next agent is faster to build than the last. * Stay current with models, agent frameworks, and Foundry features, and bring forward jobs.description: At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting\-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses. Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment. Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship. Overall Purpose The Software Engineering Manager leads a full\-stack engineering team that designs, builds, delivers and supports customer\-facing web applications and the backend services behind them. The role has a strong user\-interface focus, with hands\-on leadership of modern front\-end engineering, and also owns the APIs, integrations and data flows that make the experience work end to end. The Manager provides technical leadership and architecture guidance, is accountable for delivery, quality, security and production support, and leads the team's migration of applications and services to the cloud and its adoption of AI\-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code. The Manager is also responsible for the career planning, mentoring, goal setting and performance management of the team. The Manager also contributes to the continued maturity of the Agile SDLC within Software Engineering. Essential Functions Technical Leadership \& Architecture * Own the technical direction of the team's applications across the user interface, backend services, integrations and data layers. * Set front\-end engineering standards for a modern component\-based framework (e.g., React with TypeScript), including shared component libraries, performance, accessibility and testing. * Guide the design of secure, scalable backend services and APIs (REST and event\-driven) and their integration with internal systems and third\-party platforms. \- Define integration approaches for enterprise identity (single sign\-on, multi\-factor authentication, role\- and attribute\-based access) and for customer\-relationship / service\-management platforms, using standards\-based, loosely coupled designs so vendors can be replaced with limited rework. * Make and document key architecture decisions (e.g., through Architecture Decision Records), including build\-versus\-buy and build\-versus\-configure trade\-offs. * Review designs and code, and stay hands\-on enough to unblock engineers and maintain technical credibility. Cloud Migration \& Modernization * Lead the team's migration of applications, services and data from on\-premises or legacy hosting to the cloud (AWS preferred), from assessment and target architecture through cutover and decommissioning. * Define migration approach and sequencing for each workload (rehost, replatform, refactor, retire), balancing customer impact, risk, cost and delivery commitments. * Design cloud\-native, resilient and cost\-aware architectures, including infrastructure as code, containerization or serverless where appropriate, autoscaling, and multi\-AZ availability and disaster recovery. * Plan and execute data migration, integration cutover and rollback strategies with minimal customer disruption, and validate performance, security and compliance before and after each cutover. * Establish cloud operations practices for the team, including observability, cost monitoring (FinOps), and shared\-responsibility security controls. AI\-Assisted Engineering (Claude Code Adoption) * Lead adoption of AI coding assistants, including Claude Code, across the team's development lifecycle: design exploration, code and test generation, code review, refactoring, documentation, and migration/modernization work. * Define team standards and guardrails for responsible use, including human review of all AI\-generated changes, no secrets, credentials or Restricted/Confidential data in prompts or generated code, adherence to dependency and vulnerability policies, and clear attribution of AI\-assisted commits for audit. * Coach engineers on effective prompting, project context files, and agentic workflows; share working patterns across the team and the broader Software Engineering organization. * Measure and report the impact of AI\-assisted engineering on delivery speed, quality and cost, and adjust practices based on results. Delivery \& Operations * Lead the team to meet project commitments, surfacing risks, dependencies and trade\-offs early. * Translate product goals and customer outcomes into a sequenced technical plan in partnership with Product and UX. * Direct the identification, enhancement and automation of testing processes (unit, integration, end\-to\-end, performance); enforce test policies and quality control standards across the development lifecycle. * Dr ist of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow instructions and perform other related duties as assigned by their supervisor. **Physical Requirements** Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling, and reaching. Must be able to lift10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. jobs.title: Director Late Phase Process Development SMDD
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. The Synthetic Molecule Design and Development (SMDD) team is involved in key activities for the development of synthetic active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) from pre\-clinical through commercialization of drug substances and drug products. Our chemists, engineers, and scientists develop key technical and business solutions across the portfolio using their deep technical expertise to accelerate testing of the clinical hypothesis and overall drug development. SMDD delivers on these responsibilities by recognizing that diverse talent and cultures are vital to bring the next generation of life\-changing medicines to patients. **Position Summary:** Our team is looking for experienced and creative individuals to lead late\-phase synthetic molecule process development. This includes finalizing the commercial route and process, characterizing the process, and defining the control strategy to support Phase 3 clinical supply, registration stability, regulatory submissions, process validation, and commercial hand\-off. The position presents an opportunity to lead dynamic teams comprised of process chemists, analytical chemists, material scientists, and engineers. Additionally, candidates will provide oversight for external R\&D, tech transfer, and campaign execution. **Responsibilities:** * Demonstrate a deep expertise and demonstrated capability in the utilization of modern synthetic organic and process chemistry techniques to address key CMC challenges * Lead and/or supervise the finalization of commercial synthetic routes and the development of robust, scalable, and well\-characterized API manufacturing processes, including starting materials selection and justification of the commercial route * Design experimental laboratory plans in support of route and process design, definition, optimization, and technology transfer objectives * Exhibit a high learning agility with the ability to understand and exploit new scientific concepts and methods across multiple fields; be able to apply these takeaways to a dynamic portfolio of small molecule programs * Possess solid understanding in unit operation design and scale\-up methodologies; build and apply groundbreaking technology and novel platforms within a time constrained environment * Apply risk\-based process characterization, design space definition, and control strategy development to ensure readiness for process validation and commercial manufacture. * Leverage predictive modeling, simulation, and machine learning to inform design space definition, impurity fate and purge, scale\-up, and control strategy, reducing experimental burden and strengthening regulatory justification * Lead a cross\-disciplinary team to refine manufacturing routes and manufacturing technologies to advance an exciting small molecule portfolio * Deliver commercial\-ready manufacturing processes, including impurity control, process robustness, and lifecycle strategy, and enable effective handoff to internal and external commercial manufacturing sites * Collaborate in technology transfer activities to CRO/CMO organizations and internal Lilly manufacturing nodes to ensure processes are technically robust, well developed and characterized, and safe * Integrate process and property data with a fundamental understanding of the underlying physical processes; build and apply mechanistic, kinetic, and data\-driven models to predict process performance and guide development decisions * Utilize modern artificial intelligence and machine learning tools to accelerate development and deepen process understanding * Collaborate across internal CMC networks (Drug Product Delivery, Project Management, Quality, Manufacturing, and Regulatory) to implement and deliver material and information for clinical trials and regulatory submissions * Embrace diversity in thoughts, background, and experiences through supervision, mentoring, and development of a diverse scientific staff to deliver solutions. Encourage team members to take initiative and accountability to achieve goals and draw out and encourage others to share knowledge on challenging technical issues. * Actively collaborate and exhibit influence in the external scientific environment and demonstrate an ability to recognize and integrate external innovation across the Lilly synthetic portfolio **Minimum Qualifications:** product is acceptable. Experience with developing chemical processes for Phase 3 through commercialization of small molecule projects. * Experience with technical transfer of processes into manufacturing operations * Experience with authoring regulatory submissions and responding to regulatory questions * Established external reputation and strong publication record * Knowledge and experience with management of a technical project and ability to build ideas for future work plans * Experience with modern analytical techniques and process analytical technologies (PAT) * Experience applying Quality by Design (QbD) principles, design of experiments (DoE), and risk assessments to establish process understanding, proven acceptable ranges, and design space. * Plan and lead short term and long\-term development activities; develop and/or review technical agendas and timelines for project work; advise resource allocation to accomplish projects according to plans, communicate progress and propose changes in timeline, objectives, or direction. * Experience with modeling and simulation tools, data analytics, predictive analytics, and AI/ML * Ability to transform ideas into marketable products and processes * Demonstrated leadership capabilities, good communication skills and a sustained tendency for collaboration * Ability to prioritize multiple activities and handle ambiguity * Ability to influence others to promote a positive work environment **Additional Information:** * Potential exposure to chemicals, allergens, and loud noises. * Travel: 0 to 20% * Position Location: Indianapolis, IN; Lilly Technology Center\-North (LTC\-N) Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions.
