jobs.title: Principal AI/ML Engineer – Data Analytics & AI
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Do you want to engineer the platforms that take agentic AI from prototype to production? Lilly USA is scaling AI from prototype to everyday business capability, from how we bring medicines to market to how we help patients access and afford them. The Lilly USA Technology at Lilly Data Analytics \& AI team is seeking a Principal AI/ML Engineer to build the agentic AI and machine learning platforms that power this work. You will turn prototypes into reliable, scalable, well\-governed production systems. You will also build the data pipelines, partner integrations, and ML engineering foundations that teams reuse across business use cases. **What You'll Be Doing:** As a Principal AI/ML Engineer, you will design and build the engineering backbone for the AI and ML systems that serve business teams across Lilly USA: the orchestration frameworks, end\-to\-end data and model pipelines, serving infrastructure, and the evaluation and monitoring that keep them reliable in production. You will work at the intersection of enterprise data, business operations, field and customer\-facing teams, and third\-party partner integrations. You will partner closely with data scientists to productionize models and agentic workflows. You will also work with technical product managers, business and field teams, and Technology at Lilly colleagues to bring those solutions into real applications in a secure and auditable way. You will reuse infrastructure and patterns so that each new business use case is faster and cheaper to ship. **Examples of the kinds of problems you might work on:** * Agentic AI workflows that help field and commercial teams prepare for engagements, surface insights, and act faster, including multi\-agent systems that reason over complex data and recommend the best next step. * Predictive and machine\-learning models that inform decisions about market access, customer outreach, resource allocation, and revenue protection, from anomaly detection to next\-best\-action. * LLM\-powered solutions that make large volumes of unstructured information usable, using techniques like retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) to ground answers in trusted, cited sources. * Secure, analytics\-ready data pipelines that bring partner and vendor data into our platforms at scale, with the data quality, governance, and auditability a regulated environment demands. * Shared, reusable AI tooling for deployment, evaluation, and monitoring that multiple teams build on instead of rebuilding, so each new solution ships faster and more reliably than the last. **How You'll Succeed:** * Build and operationalize agentic AI platforms, including agent\-to\-agent orchestration frameworks, multi\-agent workflow engines, tool and API integration layers, and secure connectivity between agents, enterprise systems, and external partner platforms. * Build and integrate data pipelines, bringing data from enterprise systems, external vendors, and third\-party partners into secure, analytics\-ready platforms. * Deliver AI capabilities for business use cases, such as reporting, predictive analytics, process and decision optimization, and decision support for field and commercial teams. * Engineer robust, end\-to\-end AI/ML pipelines, covering data capture, feature engineering, training, fine\-tuning, inference, and feedback, at production scale and reliability. * Stand up ML engineering foundations, including model and prompt versioning, registries, experiment tracking, continuous integration and delivery for models, and automated evaluation and rollback within each pipeline. * Apply production\-grade deployment techniques, including scalable model serving, containerization, inference optimization, and deployment of small and specialized models hosted in\-house, with attention to latency, cost, scalability, and data residency. * Build observability and monitoring for AI systems, including tracing of agentic workflows, cost and latency tracking, drift detection, and integration of AI evaluation into production monitoring. * Implement governance and data\-protection controls, including privacy and regulatory compliance (e.g., HIPAA where applicable), PHI and PII handling, de\-identification, and auditability consistent with a regulated environment. * Design reusable, horizontal engineering capabilities and shared infrastructur  in healthcare or pharma is a plus. * Demonstrated ability to deliver reliable systems in complex data domains and to communicate with a geographically dispersed group of business and technical colleagues. **About the Organization:** Technology at Lilly builds and maintains capabilities with cutting\-edge technologies, as the most prominent tech companies do. Technology at Lilly is different because we use technology to advance our purpose: creating medicines that make life better for people around the world. Examples include data\-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, and AI that helps patients access and afford their medicines. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business. The Lilly USA Technology at Lilly team is at the forefront of leveraging data and technology to launch new medicines to market, raise awareness, and help appropriate patients get access to medication. We partner closely with Lilly's market access organization, which works with payers, employers, and government customers to improve affordability and broaden access. Scaling:** Synthesize enterprise market requirements to shape product and evaluation roadmaps while establishing the playbook to hire and scale our future commercial team. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * **Enterprise Closer with Strategic GTM Acumen:** Proven track record of carrying a quota and closing complex, seven\-figure technical enterprise deals, combined with experience crafting 0\-to\-1 GTM strategy. * **Value\-Led Technical Positioning:** Demonstrated ability to translate raw technical primitives and frontier model benchmarks into clear business cases and strategic value propositions for C\-level buyers. * **Model \& Infrastructure Literacy:** Deep fluency selling developer\-centric or infrastructure products (APIs, foundation models, compute and customer environments. ### **What you will do** * **Technical Support \& Maintenance:** * Provide onsite and remote technical assistance and troubleshooting for platform users. * Perform routine to senior management. * Develop project plans, reports, and roadmaps to support customer objectives and the broader platform portfolio. * **Sales Support:** * Conduct product demonstrations and deliver compelling presentations to highlight platform features and value propositions. ### **Profile and Skills** * A minimum of 4 to 5 years in a similar role managing complex technical projects. * Travel Readiness: Willingness to travel as needed for client meetings, project kick\-offs, or other project\-related activities, which may be up to a maximum of 50% of your working time. * You have extensive experience with Linux systems; proficient in Docker and/or Podman. * Strong scripting abilities in Bash, Python and Node.js. * You have knowledge of standard network communication protocols such as TCP, UDP, HTTP, WS, FTP. * You have a basic understanding of networking concepts including VPNs, subnets, DNS configurations, SSL certificates, etc. * Familiarity with automation tools, and Smartsheet. * Exceptional problem\-solving and organizational abilities, with a proactive and self\-motivated mindset. * Capable of managing multiple initiatives in a dynamic environment. * additional education and research about Artificial Intelligence. **About****Everseen** ===================== Shrink and inefficiency cost global retailers more than a hundred billion dollars each year. Its flagship product, Evercheck, is deployed in 10,000 retail stores and 150,000 checkouts globally. jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision. The AI\-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550\+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80\+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management. We are seeking a Software Engineer in Test (SET) with 4–6 years of experience to help deliver reliable, high\-quality software through test automation and strong engineering practices. This means choosing and building the right frameworks for the company while maintaining reliability for all of our software in the age of AI. In this role, you will build and maintain automated testing frameworks, develop test strategies, and integrate quality checks into our CI/CD pipelines. You will work closely with software engineers, product managers, and infrastructure teams to identify risks early, improve testability, and increase release confidence. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain automated tests for APIs, services, web applications, and end\-to\-end workflows. * Build and improve reusable test frameworks, utilities, and test data management tools. * Translate requirements and technical designs into test plans covering functional behavior, integrations, edge cases, and failure scenarios. * Test Agents, LLMs and Prompts. * Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide timely, actionable feedback. * Investigate test failures, reproduce defects, and collaborate with engineers on root cause analysis and resolution. * Improve test reliability and execution speed by reducing flaky tests and maintaining dependable test environments. * Perform exploratory and targeted manual testing where automation does not provide sufficient coverage. * Validate data integrity and application behavior using SQL, API tools, logs, and monitoring systems. * Participate in design and code reviews to improve testability and identify quality risks before implementation. * Track and communicate quality indicators, including critical workflow coverage, escaped defects, test reliability, and execution time. * Contribute to performance and resilience testing and help strengthen testing practices across the team. * Develop with AI. ### **Required Qualifications** * 4–6 years of professional experience in software testing, quality engineering, or software development, with substantial hands\-on test automation experience. * Proficiency in at least one of these programming languages (Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript). Multiple is preferred. * Experience developing and maintaining automated tests using frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, JUnit, or TestNG. * Strong experience testing REST APIs, including authentication, authorization, error handling, and response validation. * Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases. * Experience with Git, code reviews, and CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps. * Understanding of test design, regression testing, integration testing, and the appropriate use of unit, service, and end\-to\-end tests. * Strong debugging skills and the ability to distinguish application defects from test, data, and environment issues. * Ability to independently own testing for a feature or service, prioritize work based on risk, and communicate findings clearly. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience testing cloud\-hosted applications and distributed or microservices\-based systems. * Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud. * Experience with performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter, and/or Locust. * Familiarity with contract testing, event\-driven systems, and asynchronous workflows. * Understanding of accessibility testing and secure software development practices. * Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to shared testing standards. ### **What Success Looks Like** * Critical user journeys and service integrations have reliable automated coverage. * CI/CD quality checks provide fast, meaningful feedback that supports release decisions. * Test failures are investigated promptly, and flaky tests are consistently reduced. * Quality risks are identified early and communicated with clear recommendations. * Engineering teams can release changes with greater confidence and fewer production defects. \#LI\-Hybrid Innovator Award, Exiger's technology has been recognized by leading analyst evaluations and 50\+ awards. We are mission\-inspired, imagination\-driven, trust\-anchored, and compassion\-focused—committed to building technology that makes the world safer, more transparent, and more resilient. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law. *Exiger's hybrid work policy is periodically reviewed and adjusted to align with evolving business needs.*

Qualifications** * **7\+ years of experience** building highly scalable, performant and evolvable backend distributed systems; proficiency in Spring with Kotlin and/or Java is a plus. * **Demonstrated ability** to drive best practices in backend development and mentor others in effective coding and architectural strategies, such as clean code, hexagonal/layered architectures, domain driven design and other design and architectural patterns * **Knowledge of observability practices**, including logging, monitoring, and tracing in distributed systems. * **Expertise in Agile software delivery**, with a track record of modeling and driving process improvements across teams, and ability to collaborate cross\-functionally across diverse teams within large enterprise environments, driving alignment and shared success. * **Excellent communication skills**, capable of conveying complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences, including engineers, executives, and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Team\-first mentality**, with a willingness to do what it takes to get the job done and a desire to strive for better. * **Thrives in a high\-growth** environment where priorities evolve regularly and decisions are made quickly. **Preferred Qualifications** * **Strong Experience** in the sports industry, gaming and content delivery * **Highly effective** with Kotlin, Java and/or Go * **Expertise in messaging technologies** such as Kafka or Amazon SQS, with a solid understanding of event\-driven architectures. * **Comfortable working with** Cloud Native and Infrastructure as Code, like Kubernetes, Helm and Terraform * **Ability to work in diverse** codebases, both legacy and greenfield, in different languages and environments *If you possess some of these qualifications but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!* \#LI\-AC2 By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate jobs.description: **Position Overview** Follett Higher Education is a leading educational service provider and omnichannel retailer that provides students, faculty and staff, parents, and fans with the course materials, learning tools, and retail services needed to successfully support the collegiate journey. Follett Higher Education supports over 6 million students through its 1,100 physical and 1,750 eCommerce campus stores across North America. The **Software Engineering Manager** leads the team responsible for Follett's title catalog and course materials adoption systems: large, business\-critical .NET Framework applications (C\# and VB.NET) with extensive SQL Server codebases. This is a player\-coach role. The Software Engineering Manager is the primary technical representative and operational owner for these systems, stays an active contributor, and leads the engineering team. The role carries a two\-part modernization mandate: modernize how the team works, with an emphasis on AI\-assisted development, and modernize the applications, moving them to current .NET, containerized deployments on Azure, and modern CI/CD. **Responsibilities** **Team Leadership \& Development:** * Lead a team of engineers; set clear standards for quality, ownership, and delivery and hold the team accountable to them. * Mentor engineers and technical leads through pairing, code review, and design feedback; develop the next generation of technical leaders. * Conduct performance reviews for associates and manage contractor and vendor performance. * Allocate capacity across feature work, support, and modernization; provide input on staffing, hiring, and tooling. **Application Modernization \& Engineering Practices:** * Own the modernization roadmap: .NET Framework to current .NET, containerized deployments on Azure, and modern CI/CD, delivered incrementally without disrupting the business. * Bring the database tier under source control, automated deployment, and test coverage. * Drive adoption of AI\-assisted development across coding, review, testing, documentation, and legacy code comprehension. * Establish modern engineering practices, including pull\-request review, automated testing, observability, and secure coding; measure and improve delivery performance. **Delivery \& Stakeholder Partnership:** * Serve as the primary technical representative for these systems; report regularly on progress, risks, and issues. * Advise engineering, product, and business leadership on technical strategy, trade\-offs, and risk in business terms. * Partner with stakeholders on priorities and sequencing; deliver roadmap work predictably. * Own the engineering support rotation and its policies, including ticket intake, severity definitions, response expectations, and escalation paths. * Serve as the escalation point above the rotation; communicate incident impact to stakeholders and reduce recurring support volume. **Technical Leadership \& Software Development:** * Contribute production code in C\# and T\-SQL, focused on the highest\-risk changes. * Debug and performance\-tune large stored procedure codebases. * Lead response to critical production incidents through resolution and root\-cause fixes. * Lead code and design reviews on high\-impact changes, focusing on design and long\-term maintainability. * Build reference implementations that set patterns for modernization. jobs.title: Sr. Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Hybrid We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters. **Enterprise Technology** plays a critical part in shaping the future of mobility. If you’re looking for the chance to leverage advanced technology to redefine the transportation landscape, enhance the customer experience and improve people’s lives, this is the opportunity for you. Join us and challenge your IT expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are. **In this position...** As a **Sr. Full Stack Developer**, you will assume comprehensive ownership of our modeling tool ecosystem. This entails the end\-to\-end development, maintenance, and enhancement of custom MagicDraw/Cameo Systems Modeler plugins. You will also be instrumental in establishing sophisticated data retrieval mechanisms from the Teamwork Cloud Server, enabling the display of granular insights through dedicated data analytics dashboards. Moreover, you will devise and execute strategies for integrating with enterprise data platforms and explore the innovative application of AI/ML techniques to elevate our modeling intelligence and efficiency. You'll work across the entire software stack, contributing to both our back\-end services built with Java and Spring Boot, and our modern front\-end user interfaces using either React or Angular. You will also play a key part in our DevOps practices, leveraging Github Actions pipelines (and potentially Jenkins) for continuous integration and deployment, and utilizing your knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and OpenShift for deploying, managing, and monitoring our applications in the cloud. You will contribute to architectural discussions and technology choices, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance. **What you'll do...** * Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable and resilient back\-end services and APIs using Java and the Spring Boot framework. * Develop applications and scripts using Python and VS Code IDE, potentially for automation, data processing, or specific service components. * Build responsive and user\-friendly front\-end interfaces using JavaScript with frameworks like React or Angular, leveraging Node.js for development tooling and package management. * Implement and manage automated build, test, and deployment pipelines using Tekton pipelines and Jenkins (CI/CD). * Deploy, manage, and monitor applications on OpenShift, our container orchestration platform, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), understanding key GCP services (including potential storage, databases, networking, or serverless functions). * Deploy infrastructure components using Terraform, orchestrated via Github actions pipelines. * Ensure seamless integration between front\-end and back\-end components, ensuring smooth data flow and user experience. * Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define, design, and ship new features throughout the software development lifecycle. * Write clean, efficient, well\-tested, and maintainable code across the stack. * Implement and maintain automated testing (unit, integration, end\-to\-end) for both front\-end and back\-end code. * Identify and address performance bottlenecks, debug applications, and resolve technical issues. * Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and contribute to team knowledge sharing and best practices. * Troubleshoot production issues and implement fixes. * Contribute to architectural discussions and technology choices. **You'll have...** * Proven experience of 10\+ years as a Full Stack Developer or in a similar role, with a strong portfolio of delivered projects. * Deep proficiency in Java and extensive experience with the Spring Boot framework. * Hands\-on experience with building and consuming RESTful APIs, FAST APIs and Stream APIs. * Experience developing applications or scripts using Python. * Knowledge of using AI/ML and Data analytics libraries such as Pandas, NumPy and TensorFLow. * Strong practical experience deploying and managing applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This could include experience with services like Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Firestore etc. * Solid understanding of front\-end development technologies, including JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, and modern front\-end development principles. * Demonstrated experience with modern JavaScript frameworks: React and Angular. * Experience deploying and managing applications on OpenShift. * Experience with containerization concepts (Docker is highly relevant given OpenShift). * Experience with Terraform for infrastructure deployment, utilizing Github Actions for automation. * Practical experience implementing and managing CI/CD pipelines using Tekton pipelines, and ideally Jenkins. * Familiarity with compliance checking tools such as 42Crunch, FOSSA, Cycode, SonarQube. * Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent. * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills. **Even better, you may have...** * Experience with agile development methodologies and use of JIRA. * Direct experience with Kubernetes (OpenShift is built on it, so K8s knowledge is valuable). * Familiarity with database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL). * Knowledge of MagicDraw/Teamwork Cloud and Model Based systems Engineering concepts. * Experience with VIATRA or other model\-driven engineering/transformation tools. * Knowledge of automotive and systems engineering concepts and terminology. As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? jobs.title: AI & Automation Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive. We deliver automation through a Robotics\-as\-a\-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full\-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment. Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high\-performance, Made in America production. **About the team:** Formic's Business Systems team builds and manages the software, data infrastructure, and integrations that power our operations. Our work touches nearly every part of the company. We build internal applications that help teams manage robot deployments and field service, connect operational data across platforms, and develop AI\-powered tools that make information more accessible and work more efficient. We also help shape the systems behind our sales, marketing, finance, and other business processes. Some solutions are custom\-built applications. Others involve integrating existing platforms, automating workflows, or rethinking how information moves through the business. We work directly with the people using these systems and own what we deliver, including adoption, reliability, and ongoing improvement. We're a small team with significant autonomy, tackling technical challenges across a robotics company where the software we build has a direct impact on real\-world operations. **About the role:** We're looking for a technically strong, AI\-forward builder who can turn complex business problems into working software. You'll work directly with teams across Formic to identify opportunities and build solutions, whether that's developing an internal application, connecting systems that don't communicate, automating an operational process, or applying AI to make existing tools more useful. You'll have the autonomy to determine what to build and how to build it, along with responsibility for getting it into production and making sure it works. We want someone who moves quickly, makes sound technical decisions, and cares as much about adoption and reliability as development. This isn't a traditional product management role or one focused exclusively on AI. It's a hands\-on opportunity for someone who loves building software and wants to see the impact of their work. We care more about what you've built than your job title or career path. You might come from software engineering, applied AI, technical product development, business systems engineering, or a startup where you've worn several hats. What matters is that you know how to turn ideas into working software and can show us what you've shipped. **In this role you will:** * Build and maintain internal applications, AI\-powered tools, automations, and integrations that solve problems across Formic * Work directly with employees and business leaders to understand existing processes, uncover inefficiencies, and determine what should be built * Design technical solutions, including application architecture, APIs, databases, data pipelines, and integrations with existing platforms * Experiment with LLMs, AI agents, and emerging development tools, applying them where they offer a meaningful advantage * Connect information across business systems to improve data quality, visibility, and decision\-making * Take projects from initial discovery through prototyping, development, deployment, and ongoing support * Build with security, reliability, maintainability, and scalability in mind, including appropriate testing and monitoring * Gather feedback, measure adoption and results, and continuously improve the products you deliver * Collaborate with engineering and other technical teams when projects require shared infrastructure or specialized expertise * Help determine the priorities, architecture, and technical direction of our Business Systems function **What makes you a great fit:** * A strong track record of personally building and shipping software, internal products, automations, or other technical solutions that people rely on * Solid software development skills, including experience working with APIs, databases, and modern application development tools * Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Python or TypeScript, and experience working with APIs, databases, and SQL * Hands\-on experience integrating systems and working with data across multiple platforms * Practical experience using AI in software development or building AI\-powered applications, with genuine curiosity about emerging capabilities * The ability to make thoughtful technical decisions without overengineering solutions * Strong product instincts. You can understand what users need, distinguish symptoms from underlying problems, and prioritize work based on impact * Comfort working independently, navigating ambiguity, and owning projects from beginning to end * An appreciation for what happens after launch, including testing, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, and user adoption * The ability to communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical colleagues * A bias toward action, intellectual curiosity, and genuine interest in how businesses operate **Bonus points if you have:** * Experience building with LLM APIs, AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, or agentic workflows * Experience building and deploying cloud\-based applications * Familiarity with CRM, ERP, finance, or operational systems and the data that connects them * Experience with workflow orchestration, event\-driven integrations, or data engineering * Experience building applications that handle sensitive business information * A background in robotics, manufacturing, industrial automation, logistics, or field service operations. * Experience working in a startup or small technical team where you've had substantial ownership. **What we look for:** We're building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. If this sounds like you, Formic may be the right place for you! * **Fearless Optimism:** You make bold bets and default optimistic. You believe in the mission, aren't paralyzed by risk, and fear inaction more than failure. You see ambiguity as opportunity and bring energy to building what doesn't yet exist. * **Create the Magic:** You absorb complexity so customers don't have to. Whether your customer is external or internal, you focus on delivering experiences that are clear, fast, value\-added, and outcome\-driven. You don't say "not my job." You make things work. * **Today, Not Tomorrow:** You have a bias to action. You close the loop. You take extreme ownership. You understand that speed compounds, and you don't confuse activity with results. * **Seek Truth:** You think from first principles. You value data over ego and strong opinions loosely held. You're willing to challenge assumptions, including your own, in pursuit of the best answer. * **Made of Rubber:** You are resolute and adaptable. When things break or priorities shift, you rebound stronger. You treat setbacks as learning moments and move forward with grit. * **One Formic:** You operate without silos. You practice radical helpfulness, document clearly, and make clean handoffs. You assume positive intent and prioritize team success over individual credit. **Equal Opportunity Employment:** Formic is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion or religious creed, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, marital status, family or parental status, disability, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. All employment decisions are based on a person's merit, business needs, and role requirements. If you require further accommodations or have questions regarding accessibility of our roles, please reach out to accessibility@formic.co. **AI Use:** At Formic, fairness and transparency are at the heart of our hiring process. We use AI\-powered tools in some interviews to help our teams evaluate candidate responses, but all final hiring decisions are made by humans. You can learn more about how AI is used in our recruitment process by reviewing our AI Hiring Disclosure linked here.

jobs.title: Research Assistant
jobs.description: **About Generalist** ==================== At Generalist, we are on a mission to build general intelligence for the physical world and make it useful to everyone. We believe the industries and homes of the future will depend on humans and machines working together in new ways. Robots can help us build more and get more done. We build embodied foundation models, starting with a focus on dexterity. This requires advancing the frontiers of data, models, and hardware, to enable robots to intelligently interact with the physical world. The company embraces both large\-scale AI and robotics as core to its DNA. Our team of researchers, roboticists, and company builders come from OpenAI, Boston Dynamics, Google DeepMind, and other frontier labs—with a track record of shipping AI breakthroughs. Before Generalist, we pioneered large embodied multimodal models and vision\-language\-action models (PaLM\-E, RT\-2, Gemini Robotics), launched and scaled ChatGPT and GPT\-4 to hundreds of millions of users, engineered the foundations of autonomous driving, built next\-generation robots (Atlas, Spot, Stretch) and pushed the limits of what they can do (from parkour to manipulation, and testing robustness). We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. **About the Role:** ------------------- We are looking for a Research Assistant to help design, run, and analyze experiments at the intersection of machine learning and robotics. This is an entry\-level research role for individuals with less than 3 years of machine learning research experience, and is designed to be a potential career path towards eventually contributing as a Research Scientist. At Generalist, we are building foundation models for robots. These models improve through a tight feedback loop: design experiments, collect data, train or fine\-tune models, evaluate them in the real world, analyze results, and repeat. This role helps make that loop faster, more rigorous, and more reliable. You will work closely with ML researchers and robotics engineers to run robot experiments, design evaluation tasks, brainstorm ideas, collect data, interpret results, and document repeatable workflows. A major part of this role is helping ensure our evaluations are trustworthy. We care deeply about experimental design, controls, hands\-on iteration, sample sizes, variance, repeatability, and statistical rigor. **You’ll be responsible for:** ------------------------------ * Running structured experiments on robot platforms * Setting up physical tasks, materials, fixtures, and benchmarks for robot evaluations * Collecting high\-quality robot data and tracking experimental conditions * Measuring real\-world success rates across tasks, robots, and model variants * Designing evaluations with attention to controls, repeatability, statistical rigor, and sources of bias * Analyzing results to help distinguish real model improvements from noise * Synthesizing findings and communicating them clearly to ML researchers and engineers * Preparing robots, sensors, workspaces, and materials for rollouts and evaluations * Helping kick off training jobs, run evaluations, and organize results * Beta testing internal and third\-party tools for teaching robots new skills * Troubleshooting physical setups, hardware issues, and procedural bottlenecks * Writing clear documentation and playbooks so others can reproduce workflows * Improving experimental reliability, data quality, and operational throughput over time **You might thrive in this role if you:** ----------------------------------------- * Have experience running experiments, lab studies, field studies, data collection workflows, or structured evaluations * Think carefully about experimental design, confounding factors, controls, sample sizes, variance, and what conclusions the data can actually support * Are diligent and detail\-oriented, especially when tasks are repetitive but subtle differences matter * Enjoy hands\-on work with physical systems, equipment, materials, or instruments * Are comfortable following protocols while also noticing when something is wrong or could be improved * Can coordinate many moving parts: robots, materials, tasks, data, model versions, metrics, and documentation * Communicate clearly and can summarize what happened, what changed, and what the evidence suggests * Are curious about machine learning and robotics, even if you are not yet an expert in either * Have some exposure to programming, data analysis, robotics, hardware, electronics, mechanical assembly, or experimental tooling * Prefer fast iteration, careful measurement, and empirical progress over abstract theory alone

jobs.description: About Gleason With more than 2,200 employees and 13 manufacturing facilities worldwide, Gleason Corporation is a leader in gear technology. Gleason's product and service offerings include gear and transmission design software, gear manufacturing machines and related accessories, gear metrology equipment and automation systems. Gleason products are used by customers in e\-mobility, commercial vehicles, aerospace, agriculture, mining, sustainable energy, construction, power tools, marine and many other industries Working for Gleason, you will be connected to work that matters, putting your expertise to its best use while developing skills for the future. The result is a career defined by you, supported by Gleason and built on tangible accomplishments. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for the right people to join us on our mission. If you are interested in being part of our team, there are a few things you should know: We are energized by challenges and the effort needed to solve them. We like working with people who are positive, adaptable and growth\-minded. We care how work gets accomplished and are deeply invested in the success of our customers and colleagues. If this sounds like you, we invite you to read on and learn more. Why work at Gleason? * Excellent benefits package including a 6% Company 401(k) match * Flexible scheduling * Tuition Assistance Program * Employee Assistance Program * Formal and informal Development opportunities. Multi\-site enterprise network security \| Hands\-on technical leadership The opportunity We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on network and infrastructure security engineer to own the operational security, reliability, and continuous improvement of our networks across multiple company locations. This role is primarily focused on network engineering and defensive security—not a policy\-only cybersecurity position. The successful candidate will be our resident technical expert for firewalls, secure connectivity, network segmentation, switching, wireless, and protection of internet\-facing infrastructure. You will work with Corporate IT and local IT teams to identify weaknesses before they are exploited, establish consistent technical standards, and resolve complex incidents without depending on vendors for routine diagnosis. What you will own * Firewall and perimeter security: Administer, harden, monitor, and troubleshoot next\-generation firewalls and edge services; manage rule bases, NAT, IPS/IDS, remote access, VPNs, firmware, certificates, and secure management access. Experience with Palo Alto, SonicWall, Sophos, and/or Fortinet is especially relevant. * Proactive vulnerability and patch management: Maintain an accurate inventory of network/security devices; track vendor advisories, exposed services, end\-of\-life systems, configuration drift, and vulnerabilities. Prioritize and coordinate firmware/security updates, validate remediation, and document exceptions. * Segmentation and secure architecture: Design and maintain VLANs, ACLs, inter\-VLAN controls, least\-privilege access, site\-to\-site connectivity, and segmentation of user, server, guest, management, and other higher\-risk networks. Reduce lateral\-movement opportunities. * Switching, wireless, and network operations: Configure and troubleshoot managed switches, routing, DNS/DHCP dependencies, wireless controllers/APs, authentication, and network performance. Understand the security implications of each component. * Detection, response, and resilience: Review firewall/network telemetry and alerts, investigate suspicious traffic and attempted intrusions, support incident containment, validate backups of device configurations, and test recovery procedures. * Multi\-site standards and execution: Conduct regular site security reviews; maintain network diagrams, configurations, change records, runbooks, and remediation plans. Coordinate changes with local IT teams while ensuring common corporate security baselines. * Technical Leadership and Continuous Improvement: Serve as a technical escalation point for complex network and security issues. Provide technical guidance to IT personnel across locations, establish engineering standards, and lead initiatives that improve the security and reliability of enterprise infrastructure. Required experience and capabilities * 3\-5 years of hands\-on enterprise network administration/engineering, including direct responsibility for firewall security and multi\-site connectivity. * Proven ability to configure, troubleshoot, and secure at least one major next\-generation firewall platform; ability to learn and support additional platforms. * Strong TCP/IP, routing, VLAN, ACL, VPN/IPsec, switching, wireless, DNS, DHCP, and network troubleshooting skills. * Experience managing security patches, firmware upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and change control on production network devices. * Ability to investigate issues using logs, packet captures, traffic analy /Entra ID environments; endpoint detection and response integration; CrowdStrike vulnerability scanning and SIEM/log monitoring; manufacturing or operational technology (OT) segmentation; Experience with high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity design. Relevant vendor certifications (for example PCNSE, NSE/FCP/FCSS, CCNP, or equivalent) are valued, but demonstrated hands\-on ability matters more than credentials. What success looks like * Internet\-facing devices are inventoried, hardened, monitored, and patched within risk\-based targets. * Firewall rules and VPN access are reviewed regularly; unnecessary exposure and overly permissive access are reduced. * Sites follow consistent segmentation, configuration, logging, backup, and change\-control standards. * High\-risk findings have clear owners, remediation plans, and evidence of closure. * When an outage or suspicious event occurs, you can diagnose the technical cause, restore service safely, and prevent recurrence. jobs.title: Senior Software Developer (Remote)
jobs.description: Do you love working with a high caliber team that’s invested in delivering quality code? Are you a natural problem solver who’s able to create elegant solutions to address even the most challenging problems? Are you looking for a better work/life balance and a work from home atmosphere? If so, you may be the perfect fit for Grant Street Group! **We are currently offering all Senior Developer hires the option to work a 4x10 schedule (4 days per week, 10 hours per day).** As a Senior Software Developer at Grant Street Group, you could have the opportunity to expand the functionality of our existing products, customize systems to meet clients' unique needs, and create entirely new products from the ground up. The majority of your time will be spent on directing AI agents effectively on complex development tasks, critically evaluating their output, and helping the team adopt reliable agentic workflows while remaining accountable for the quality of delivered software. You’ll have the option to move across the organization, try out various projects and tasks, and continuously evolve your professional skill set. ### **We are looking for talented Software Developers who:** * Have 5\+ years of experience in full time software development roles * Can demonstrate the ability to write great code in any commonly used programming language, such as Python, Java, C\+\+, C\#, or Ruby. (If you've mastered one language, we know you'll be able to learn our tech stack quickly) * Can demonstrate the ability to design and improve relational data models in any commonly used database, such as MySQL or PostgreSQL * Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to support implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation, while applying independent judgment to the resulting work * Read, explain, and evaluate code—including AI\-generated code—and identify when a proposed solution is incomplete, incorrect, unnecessarily complex, or inconsistent with existing patterns * Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability as development practices and AI capabilities evolve; be willing to learn new tools and incorporate effective approaches into day\-to\-day work ### **Here are just some of the tools and approaches we use. Experience with any of them is helpful, but if they are new to you, don't worry. We're able to provide the training and guidance that you'll need in order to get up and running:** * Perl and Go * MySQL * Vue.js, jQuery, Ajax * Devin, and other AI\-assisted development tools * git * Linux environments (Ubuntu) * Data warehouse (Exasol) * Messaging frameworks (rabbitmq) * ETL/Scheduling frameworks (NiFi) * Agile software development process **Why consider Grant Street Group as part of your future?** Grant Street Group is an innovative and rapidly growing software company that supports a variety of clients in specialized financial transactions. Our hosted Software as a Service (SaaS) applications focus on tax collection, electronic payments, bond auctions, and more. We reward teamwork, professional excellence, and individual responsibility. Using the best collaboration tools available, we offer a technology\-rich work environment that makes it possible for us to support on\-site and telecommuting positions tailored to the needs of our employees. If you are passionate about your work, you have an entrepreneurial spirit, and you want to be on a team of exceptional professionals, then maybe Grant Street is for you! Please note that Grant Street may not consider your application if you have previously submitted an application for this role within the last 12 months. We thank you for your understanding. There is minimal travel: 1\-2 weeks per year for on\-site meetings. *Expected Salary Range: $100,000 – $200,000 base salary* *Recruitment Fraud Warning:* *It has come to our attention that various individuals have been posing as Grant Street Group employees and contacting job seekers to schedule interviews and/or complete pre\-interview screening questions.* *All legitimate Grant Street Group positions require completing an application on our website before an interview. When you are contacted by Grant Street Group, all correspondence will come from an email address ending in “@**grantstreet.com**”.* *The hiring process usually takes several weeks and begins with a phone or video interview. Grant Street Group will not ask you to use any platform other than Google Meet or Zoom to conduct an interview. We will not ask you to make payments or to provide your date of birth, social security number, or banking details during the interview process.* *If you believe you have been a victim of recruiting fraud concerning Grant Street Group, please contact us at* *jobs@grantstreet.com**.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster. **About the role** ------------------ As a Senior Program Manager, Application Security, you will lead the post\-sale journey for a portfolio of large enterprise customers, turning their investment in Harness shift\-left and runtime security products into measurable business outcomes. jobs.description: **System Engineer — Managed IT Services** ========================================= **About LocalGov** ------------------ LocalGov, a division of Harris, builds and supports the software that runs local government — eight product lines serving counties, cities and departments across North America. Remote support is delivered from anywhere in the state, and a share of the work is hands\-on at customer sites — hardware, server and network builds, and on\-premise access that remote tools cannot reach. You will use approved AI and automation tools to take the repeatable work off your plate, and spend the time that frees where it counts: with the customer. The System Engineer designs, maintains and supports the IT infrastructure of local government customers under our managed services agreements — servers, networks, endpoints and security — and acts as a trusted technical advisor to customers across Iowa. You will be expected to use approved AI and automation tools to deliver consistent, efficient service and to build repeatable solutions such as automated network assessments. Hands\-on experience using AI tools and building AI agents is a requirement. **What makes someone successful in this role** We are looking for an engineer who works alongside the customer rather than at arm's length from them — someone who is comfortable in the county office, understands how that office runs, and can resolve issues in place rather than handing back a ticket. Policy, DNS, DHCP, etc.) (required) * Experience with networking including routing, VLANs, VPNs, NAT, wireless, SSID, point to point (required) * Hands\-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) in daily technical work — research, scripting, troubleshooting and documentation (required) * Experience building and using AI agents to automate multi\-step IT tasks — monitoring, triage, reporting, device setup or customer notifications — including designing the workflow, testing it and supporting it in production (required) * Willingness to work onsite at customer locations across the assigned region (required) * Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for onsite customer visits (required) * Willingness to complete accurate records of work, time and resolutions (required) * Familiarity using a CRM or ticketing system to log work, track time and maintain knowledge base articles (required) * Comfortable being on camera for meetings with both customers and internal staff (required) * Experience with RMM tools and scripting (PowerShell or similar) * Ability to show examples of AI\-built scripts, agents or automations the candidate has created and the time or effort they saved * Use of AI to recognize recurring customer issues and recommend scalable or automated solutions that reduce future support demand * Understanding of safe and responsible AI use: protecting customer data, checking AI output before acting on it, and following company AI governance and security standards * Experience supporting local government or other public\-sector customers a plus * Proven ability to build trusted relationships with customers through active listening, professionalism and consultative support * Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize competing demands while keeping attention to detail * Experience creating and maintaining knowledge base articles and technical documentation * Commitment to continuous learning and adoption of emerging technologies and best practices Participate in on\-call rotation * **Salary** : $65,000 – $75,000, commensurate with experience and job responsibilities **Location** : Iowa — serving our managed services customers across the assigned region. Remote support delivered from anywhere in the state; onsite attendance at customer locations required. Northeast Iowa (Oelwein), Des Moines, and Spencer areas. **Benefits** : Harris offers competitive compensation and benefits packages. Paid holidays, generous vacation and personal time. jobs.title: Software AI Engineer 4
jobs.description: At **Hologic**, we are driven by a singular purpose: to enable healthier lives everywhere, every day. As a global leader in women’s health, we design innovative diagnostic and imaging solutions that help detect disease earlier and improve outcomes for patients worldwide. Join a team where your work in AI and digital diagnostics directly supports clinicians in delivering better care for women. **Job Summary** **Hologic** is seeking a Software Algorithm Engineer 4 to design, train and validate deep learning models for cytology on the Genius™ Digital Diagnostics System. This role owns the cell\-level CNN classifier, nuclear\-to\-cytoplasmic (NC) ratio segmentation pipeline, and the technical evidence needed to support FDA and other regulatory submissions. The engineer serves as the technical lead for model design and verification under design controls, working closely with cytopathologists, imaging scientists, regulatory and quality teams. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, train and tune multi\-class CNNs to classify cells and aggregate predictions into specimen\-level diagnostic categories. * Develop multi\-task models with shared encoders and feature heads for diagnostic class, cytomorphologic features and NC ratio category. * Build nucleus and cytoplasm segmentation networks to measure NC ratio and nuclear area, including overlapping cells in clusters. * Own the data pipeline, including patient\-grouped splits, color profile application, class balance and imaging metadata. * Run disciplined experiments, benchmark lightweight backbones against larger reference models and define evaluation metrics and reports. * Collaborate with pathologists on labeling protocols, inter\-observer agreement and adjudication processes. * Prepare design documentation, verification/validation protocols and technical content for regulatory submissions. * Mentor engineers and establish coding, reproducibility and MLOps standards. * Ensure model performance and interpretability, including Grad\-CAM checks and feature outputs that align with pathologist expectations. * Support regulatory strategy for AI\-enabled medical devices under design controls and PCCP guidance. **Qualifications** **Education** * MS or PhD in computer science, biomedical engineering, electrical engineering or a related field, or BS with equivalent experience. **Experience** * 7\+ years of software development, including 4\+ years building and deploying deep learning models for computer vision. * Coaching and mentorship experience a plus **Skills** * Expert Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow), including CNN fine\-tuning, transfer learning and segmentation (e.g., U\-Net, segmentation\_models\_pytorch). * Experience with imbalanced, multi\-class and multi\-task problems, and metrics such as per\-class sensitivity, F1, kappa and AUROC. * Experience with medical or microscopy imaging, including color handling, stain variation and high\-resolution tiling. * Strong discipline in data splitting, leakage prevention, experiment tracking and reproducible training. * Clear written communication for technical reports and design documentation. * Preferred: digital pathology or cytology AI experience (ideally urine cytology); experience with FDA 510(k), De Novo, PMA or EU IVDR; familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, 21 CFR Part 820 and FDA PCCP guidance. * Preferred: ICC color management, stain deconvolution and scanner color calibration; cell instance segmentation tools (StarDist, Cellpose) and annotation tools (QuPath, CVAT, napari). * Preferred: model optimization for edge or embedded inference (quantization, ONNX, TensorRT) and experience leading or technically guiding a small team. **Why join Hologic?** We are committed to making Hologic the destination for top talent. For you to succeed, we want to enable you with the tools and knowledge required and so we provide comprehensive training when you join as well as continued development and training throughout your career. The annualized base salary range for this role is $133,000 \- $190,000 and is bonus eligible. Final compensation packages will ultimately depend on factors including relevant experience, skillset, knowledge, education, business needs and market demand. **Agency and Third\-Party Recruiter Notice** Agencies that submit a resume to Hologic must have a current executed Hologic Agency Agreement executed by a member of the Human Resource Department. jobs.description: Honeywell is accelerating its transformation from industrial automation to full autonomy and the data that powers that future starts here. As a Lead Data Engineer on our Industrial AI \& Data Platforms team, you will architect and own the data foundations that enable physical AI at scale: from terabytes of IoT sensor telemetry streaming through our medallion lakehouse to production\-grade Generative AI pipelines that deliver actionable intelligence across Honeywell's global industrial operations. You will serve as a technical anchor for a team of engineers, shaping architecture decisions, building cutting edge AI solutions, raising engineering standards, and directly building the AI\-ready data products that Honeywell's autonomy mission depends on. This role sits at the intersection of modern data engineering and applied GenAI, if you are energized by building systems that have real\-world industrial impact, this is your role. You will report directly to our Director, Data Engineering and you’ll work out of our Atlanta, GA location on a Hybrid work schedule. Hybrid Work Schedule Note: For the first 90 days, New Hires must be prepared to work 100% onsite M\-F **YOU MUST HAVE** * 8\+ years of data engineering experience with at least 2 years in a lead or senior role, demonstrating progression in technical complexity and team leadership. * Hands\-on experience building and operating medallion lakehouse architectures (Bronze / Silver / Gold). * Deep expertise in Apache Spark / PySpark with production experience on Azure Databricks at scale. * Strong proficiency with streaming platforms \- Apache Kafka and/or Azure Event Hub for real\-time IoT data. * Cloud data architecture skills (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP a plus) with experience designing scalable, cost\-effective data lakes and warehouses using cloud\-native services. * Data modeling and schema design expertise for both transactional and analytical workloads, including dimensional modeling and data vault methodologies. * Proven experience building data pipelines for GenAI or ML applications: RAG systems, embedding pipelines, and document ingestion. * MLOps familiarity including model versioning, feature stores, and monitoring/observability for data and ML systems. * Demonstrated ability to lead technical design reviews, mentor engineers, and drive architectural decisions with stakeholder buy\-in. * Proficiency in CI/CD using GitHub Actions for automating data pipeline deployments. **WE VALUE** * Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or other agentic AI orchestration frameworks. * Expertise in real\-time data processing frameworks (Apache Spark Streaming, Structured Streaming) * Knowledge of MLOps practices and experience building data pipelines for AI model deployment * Experience with time\-series databases and IoT data modeling patterns * Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) for AI workloads * Strong background in data quality implementation for AI training data * Experience working with distributed teams and cross\-functional collaboration * Knowledge of data security and governance practices for AI systems * Experience working on analytics projects with Agile and Scrum Methodologies The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Job Posting Date: November 9 2026\. Relocation support may be provided **BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL** In addition to a competitive salary, leading\-edge work, and developing solutions side\-by\-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. Learn more (https://benefits.honeywell.com/) The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. **ABOUT HONEYWELL** Honeywell International Inc. (Nasdaq: HON) invents and commercializes technologies that address some of the world's most critical challenges around energy, safety, security, productivity, and global urbanization. We are a leading software\-industrial company committed to introducing state of the art technology solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, sustainability, and safety in high growth businesses in broad\-based, attractive industrial end markets. Our products and solutions enable a safer, more comfortable, and more productive world, enhancing the quality of life of people around the globe. Learn more (https://www.honeywell.com/us/en) **THE BUSINESS UNIT** Corporate (CORP) at Honeywell provides centralized services and strategic leadership that supports all business units globally. This unit focuses on driving innovation, operational excellence, and enabling technology solutions that empower Honeywell’s diverse portfolio of businesses to achieve sustainable growth and competitive advantage. *Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status.* Learn more **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** Architecture \& Technical Leadership * Architect end\-to\-end data pipelines processing terabytes of IoT telemetry on Azure Databricks (PySpark DLT, Lakeflow) using medallion Lakehouse architecture. * Design and optimize real\-time ingestion pipelines from Azure Event Hub and Apache Kafka for high\-volume industrial IoT telemetry. * Build fault\-tolerant, idempotent streaming architectures handling schema evolution, backpressure, and latency SLAs. * Lead architecture reviews, set engineering standards, and drive decisions on data modeling, pipeline design, and platform evolution. * Define technical direction for AI\-ready data products including vector stores, embedding pipelines, and RAG\-ready structured/unstructured data. * Adopt emerging LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph) to accelerate GenAI platform capabilities. GenAI \& AI Pipeline Development * Build production GenAI pipelines\- RAG workflows, document ingestion, PII anonymization and vector database infrastructure. * Collaborate with data scientists and AI engineers to deliver high\-quality, AI\-ready datasets that improve downstream model performance. DevOps, Security \& Governance * Enforce data governance, access control, and security policies; lead PII detection and anonymization strategies across the data platform. * Champion CI/CD practices using GitHub Actions, DAB, Octopus, and Bamboo for automated, reliable pipeline delivery. * Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards within the SDLC. Team Development \& Stakeholder Engagement * Mentor engineers across seniority levels through code reviews, pairing, and technical coaching. * Translate business and AI product requirements into clear technical roadmaps and execution plans. * Partner with data scientists, product owners, and architects to align data investments with Honeywell's autonomy strategy. Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

jobs.title: Advanced Systems Engineer

Honeywell continues to lead the industry with Advanced Cockpit solutions and Integrated Avionics systems Our newest and most advanced Integrated Flight Deck will herald a new age of aviation where connectivity will help enable true autonomy. NO RELOCATION OFFERED.**

In this remote role, you will write and review code while owning architectural decisions, design direction, and the technical roadmap for defined areas of the product. You will collaborate with existing technical leadership, establish technical direction within your area of ownership, and translate that direction into well\-organized implementation work. This is a technical leadership role, not a people\-management position. Active coding and code review are central to the work, alongside architectural ownership, stakeholder communication, technical planning, and coordination of engineering activities. The right candidate combines strong development skills with the judgment to set direction, make final technical recommendations within their area of ownership, and build consensus around implementation choices. **What you will be doing**: * Build and improve application code using C\# and .NET, TypeScript and React, with hands\-on development as a primary responsibility. * Review code and provide constructive technical feedback that supports maintainable implementations, consistent application of established patterns, and adoption of new patterns where the product’s architecture needs to evolve. * Own architectural decisions and design direction for defined areas of the product, ensuring that solutions align with broader product goals and established enterprise standards. Lead day\-to\-day engineering execution by translating that direction into actionable development tickets and organizing dependencies, sequencing, and implementation work. * Make technical decisions and final recommendations within the role’s area of ownership, using collaboration to build consensus while resolving disagreements when alignment cannot be reached. Ensure the engineering team shares responsibility for implementation quality and reliability, not just coordination. * Own and evolve the medium\-term technical roadmap for defined areas of the product, sequencing architectural improvements and delivery work to balance current needs with long\-term maintainability, reliability, performance, and product sustainability. * Anticipate technical dependencies and delivery risks, raise them early, and lead the development of practical responses with stakeholders and existing technical leadership. * Communicate proactively with stakeholders about engineering progress, technical needs, limitations, and implementation tradeoffs. * Own production readiness and operational health for the product’s 2027 launch and ongoing operation, including reliability, performance, observability, deployment pipelines, operational documentation, issue resolution, and long\-term support outcomes. * Define and lead the product’s agentic engineering practices, establishing technical standards and decision criteria for how AI tools support design, implementation, code review, testing, and maintainable delivery. Own work end to end, complete objectives, ask questions early, and flag when a decision or detail has been overlooked. * **What we need you to have (minimum qualifications):** * 8\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including architecture ownership, technical leadership responsibilities, and continued hands\-on contribution to a production codebase. * Demonstrated ability to build and maintain frontend application code using TypeScript and React. * Experience leading day\-to\-day engineering execution while remaining an active contributor to the codebase, including organizing implementation work, managing technical dependencies, and reviewing other engineers’ code. * Experience owning architecture, design direction, and technical strategy for a defined solution area, including making final technical recommendations and translating direction into actionable implementation plans and well\-defined development tickets. * Demonstrated experience using agentic coding tools in day\-to\-day development, including sound judgment about where they add value and where they do not, and skill in prompting and directing them toward maintainable results. Azure experience is preferred, not required. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact. With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you. **Lead Software Engineer** **Semrock Optical Filters, IDEX Life Science Optics, West Henrietta, NY** **Position Overview** IDEX Life Science Optics is seeking an experienced Lead Software Engineer to lead the development and evolution of software systems that support engineering, commercial, manufacturing, operations, and product delivery. This role combines software architecture, scientific computing, data systems, and hardware integration in a highly technical environment. Working closely with engineers, scientists, and manufacturing teams, the successful candidate will develop software that enables the design, production, testing, and delivery of advanced optical products. This position is intended for a senior technical individual contributor with the potential to grow into a Principal Engineer role responsible for long\-term software architecture and technical direction. While each developer often owns specific applications or platforms, success requires thinking beyond any single system. The ideal candidate will help evolve a cohesive software ecosystem, ensuring applications integrate effectively, leverage shared components and data, and provide a consistent experience across the organization. **Responsibilities** * Serve as the primary technical owner for several software applications or platforms while contributing to the architecture and evolution of our software ecosystem. * Lead the architecture, design, development, and support of critical engineering, manufacturing, and business software systems. * Modernize legacy applications and workflows into scalable, maintainable, and extensible software platforms. * Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate business and technical needs into effective software solutions. * Design software that integrates with shared databases, enterprise data flows, manufacturing systems, and workstation\-connected hardware. * Partner with fellow software engineers to promote common standards, reusable components, integrated data models, and a consistent user experience. * Promote software engineering best practices, including source control, testing, documentation, maintainability, and code quality. * Troubleshoot complex software, database, integration, and hardware\-interfa * ce issues. * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and solution effectiveness. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline. * 10\+ years of professional software development experience. * Demonstrated success designing and delivering complex software systems. * Strong software architecture, design, and problem\-solving skills. * Experience leading technical projects and influencing engineering direction. * Ability to effectively utilize modern AI development tools and workflows. **Technical Experience** Experience designing, developing, and supporting software systems using: * C\# and the Microsoft .NET ecosystem, including both .NET Framework and modern .NET platforms * Desktop application technologies, including WinForms * Microsoft SQL Server and relational database architectures * Python for scientific, engineering, automation, or data\-driven applications Demonstrated expertise in: * Software architecture, design patterns, and maintainable system design * Integration of software with databases, instrumentation, manufacturing systems, cameras, motion control, and other hardware * Source control, testing, documentation, and modern software engineering practices * Troubleshooting complex software, data, and system integration problems **Preferred Experience** * Manufacturing, scientific, engineering, or industrial software environments. * Software integration with instrumentation, laboratory equipment, automated production equipment, PLCs, robotics, or embedded systems. * Optical, photonics, physical science, or engineering applications for modeling or optimization. * Manufacturing automation, machine vision, robotics, FANUC systems, or related industrial technologies. * High\-performance computing (HPC), GPU\-accelerated computing (e.g., CUDA), scientific computing, computational modeling, machine learning, computer vision, custom AI/ML model development, or data\-intensive engineering applications. * Modernization of legacy software applications, databases, and spreadsheet\-driven workflows. **What We're Looking For** The ideal candidate is a strong engineer who enjoys understanding the science, engineering, and business processes behind the software systems they build. They are equally comfortable discussing software architecture, troubleshooting a hardware interface, designing a database schema, or collaborating with engineers developing new products. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award\-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge. At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact.
