With the power of our AI\-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference. If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS. **Job Description** ------------------- About the Role We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to help bring AI into real business operations. The role sits between engineering, consulting and business change. You will build and run applications for the IFS M\&A Group and deliver production AI solutions to acquired companies. You will work with their business and technical stakeholders to understand the problem, prototype quickly, connect to existing systems, and deliver implementations that work at scale. You work independently with limited guidance on assigned projects, within the group's approved architecture, security and data standards. You escalate decisions that fall outside those guidelines to your manager. Key Responsibilities * Deliver assigned AI projects and workstreams, from discovery through design, build, deployment, verification, training and support. Priorities and scope are agreed with your manager. * Support discovery with business and technical stakeholders to understand workflows, systems and desired outcomes, and help identify suitable AI use cases. * Analyse non\-routine requirements, recommend practical solution designs, and implement them as tested code. Prototype quickly to validate a use case. * Build integrations that connect AI platforms to existing applications, APIs and data sources, using service identities with the narrowest scopes and following approved security and data governance policies. * Ship AI features that are scoped to the user, name sources and models on every answer, and are tested before release. * Build agentic systems that automate processes and use enterprise tools within defined guardrails. * Take solutions from prototype to production and run them: jobs, backups, monitoring, access and incident write\-ups. * Train users and support adoption. Contribute lessons learned from acquired\-company projects to team best practices and process improvements. * Report progress, trade\-offs and outcomes clearly to stakeholders and project leads. * Provide guidance to junior colleagues where needed. **Qualifications** ------------------ Requirements * In\-depth expertise in AI/software engineering, with a solid understanding of related areas (data, cloud, security) and business context. * Experience shipping at least one system to production and measuring its operational or business impact. * Experience building an LLM application used by real users, covering tool use, retrieval and prompt or context design. * Experience with API integrations between AI platforms and enterprise systems (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite, Databricks) and the data governance that goes with them. * Python backend (FastAPI or similar), working React/TypeScript, SQL, one cloud (Azure preferred), infrastructure as code and CI/CD. * Ability to work independently on non\-routine problems, recommend practical solutions, and escalate when a decision is outside agreed guidelines. * Clear written and spoken communication with both technical and business stakeholders. * A habit of verifying results, with numbers checked before they are reported. Nice to Have * Experience in a forward\-deployed or embedded engineering role. * Familiarity with RevOps, FP\&A or sales operations. * Agent experience in production, ideally with Model Context Protocol. * Azure experience (Container Apps, Entra, Key Vault, Terraform, Azure DevOps). * Working French or Dutch. **Additional Information** -------------------------- **What We’re Offering** * Salary Range: $130,000 to $160,000 annually \+ bonus * Flexible paid time off, including sick and holiday * Medical, dental, \& vision insurance * 401K with Company contribution * Flexible spending accounts * Life insurance and disability benefits * Tuition assistance * Community involvement and volunteering events M/F/Disabled/Vet VEVRAA Federal Contractor. jobs.title: General QA Engineer (Remote, Contract)
jobs.description: **OUR HIRING PROCESS:** * We will review your application against our job requirements. We do not employ machine learning technologies during this phase as we believe every human deserves attention from another human. We do not think machines can evaluate your application quite like our seasoned recruiting professionals—every person is unique. We promise to give your candidacy a fair and detailed assessment. * We may then invite you to submit a video interview for the review of the hiring manager. This video interview is often followed by a test or short project that allows us to determine whether you will be a good fit for the team. * At this point, we will invite you to interview with our hiring manager and/or the interview team. Please note: We do not conduct interviews via text message, Telegram, etc. and we never hire anyone into our organization without having met you face\-to\-face (or via Zoom). You will be invited to come to a live meeting or Zoom, where you will meet our INFUSE team. * From there on, it's decision time! If you are still excited to join INFUSE and we like you as much, we will have a conversation about your offer. We do not make offers without giving you the opportunity to speak with us live. INFUSE is committed to complying with applicable data privacy and security laws and regulations. For more information, please see our Privacy Policy We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented General QA Engineer to help ensure the quality and reliability of our product. In this role, you will combine manual and automated testing, build and maintain scalable Playwright test suites, leverage AI\-powered tools to increase efficiency and work closely with engineering and product teams to deliver a seamless user experience. ### **As part of our team, your responsibilities in this role will include:** * Automates validation across UI, APIs, dashboards * Maintains reusable test systems, flakes analytics * Development and maintenance of a suite of e2e/UI tests in Playwright (TS), covering critical user scenarios. * Use of AI in work * Practical use of LLM tools (e.g., ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot/Codeium) to optimize the execution of testing tasks. * Performing manual testing of features (planning, test design, regression, exploratory). * Integration and optimization of test runs in CI (parallelization, stabilization, flakiness metrics). * Setting up reporting and observability for automated tests (traces, video, flake analytics). * Collaboration with engineering and product: requirements clarification, help reproducing defects, and improving testability. Maintaining the quality of test data and environments. * ### **Our ideal candidate possesses the following skills:** * 3–5 years in QA, including 1\.5\+ years in automation using JavaScript/Playwright. * Strong Playwright: Test Runner, fixtures, projects, parallelization, and sharding. Auto\-wait/locators, stable selectors, working with flakes (timeouts, retries, expect.poll). BrowserContext/Page, environment isolation, test data management. Tracing, video/screenshots, network mocking (route), APIRequestContext. Page Object/Screenplay patterns, project structure, reusability. * AI \& No\-Code Integration: Building test workflows in n8n, Zapier, Gumloop. Use of no\-code tools as part of the automated test infrastructure. * AI\-Enhanced Testing: Practical use of LLMs (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot). Explore AI QA tools (Testim, Diffblue, CodiumAI, Mabl). * JavaScript/TypeScript at advanced mid\-level: Async/await, promises, modules, TS typing, interfaces, generics. NPM/Yarn, Node.js scripts, ESLint/Prettier configuration. * PI testing: REST, Postman/Swagger. * Browser DevTools: network, storage, cookies, CORS, headers, status codes. * Databases: solid SQL, basic work with test data. * CI/CD and VCS: Git (branching, PR, code review). Integration of automated tests into CI (GitHub Actions/Jenkins), artifacts, and reports. Running tests in containers/headless, dependency management, and caching. * Manual testing: Requirements analysis. Creation of all types of test documentation. Test design techniques. Types of testing. * English: reading documentation and written communication (Intermediate\+). * Ukrainian and/or Russian language proficiency is a must. ### **What we offer:** * Opportunity to shape the backbone systems of a modern, data\-driven digital company * A collaborative, innovation\-first environment that values initiative and experimentation * Reduced working hours on Fridays during the summer * Days off on US national holidays and your birthday * **Schedule: Monday–Friday, 1 PM – 9 PM EET (including 1 hour break)** ### **Why join us?** You'll be at the intersection of technology, process innovation, and business growth – building systems that empower our teams to work smarter, faster, and more collaboratively. If you're a strategic thinker who loves turning complexity into clarity and ideas into scalable solutions, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Join the IPG Team! Are you ready to elevate your career? At IPG, we are more than just a global leader in packaging and protective solutions—we are a community that values safety, people, passion, integrity, performance, and teamwork. From tapes and films to packaging and protective products, as well as engineered coated materials and advanced packaging machinery, we develop innovative solutions that protect the world. Now, we are expanding our global team and looking for talented individuals like you! Position Description **Title:** Cloud Infrastructure Engineer **Department:** MIS **Immediate Supervisor:** Director, Enterprise Infrastructure **Status:** Exempt Salaried **Location:** Remote **Position Purpose:** Administer, design, maintain, analyze, and troubleshoot IPG core systems including but not limited to: Cloud, Virtualization, Server, Storage, Network, Endpoints and Directory Services. This person is also responsible for maintaining compliancy within IPG’s security standards and Cloud providers standards. Principle Accountabilities * Design and administer IaaS, SaaS, and PaaS network infrastructure. * Deploy and support various cloud and on\-premise server\-based operating systems. * Manage and monitor physical network hardware to ensure maximum uptime. * Manage and monitor the physical equipment for the on\-premise virtual compute environment. * Educating teams on the implementation of new cloud technologies and initiatives. * Manage the migration and modernization of workloads from on\-premise data centers to Azure * Manage and monitor Endpoint management systems including Intune and SCCM. * Maintain up to date standards and process documents for relevant areas. * Assist with the build and support of cost models and risk models for new solutions to determine if the best home for them is in the cloud or on premises * Aid in the development of business continuity and disaster recovery plans, and maintain current knowledge of plan executables and opportunities for where cloud can play a role in the recovery efforts * Provide troubleshooting\\support to applications group for network and server performance. * Provide on\-call technical support. * Troubleshoot escalated issues to identify and repair cloud infrastructure issues * Actively work to maintain and develop expertise on relevant cloud technology products, services, protocols, and standards to remain abreast of developments in the cloud infrastructure industry * Primary resource for securing network \& server infrastructure. * Provide technical leadership in the design of highly complex cloud systems * Other duties as assigned Essential Skills and Experience * Strong Working knowledge of Azure architecture and migration skills and experience * Bachelor’s degree in information technology or equivalent experience * 4\-7 years’ experience in Cloud administration. * Knowledge of additional cloud technologies such as Endpoint, API Management, and Identity Management * Strong understanding across cloud and on\-premise infrastructure components (server, storage, network, data, and applications) to deliver end\-to\-end cloud infrastructure, architectures, and designs * Strong working knowledge of Azure, Microsoft Active Directory and Windows Server 2016, 2019, \& 2025 * Experience with the Azure CLI, PowerShell/Azure PowerShell and the Azure Portal * Experience with IT automation tools like Ansible. * Strong interpersonal, organizational, oral communication skills, proven analytical and problem\-solving abilities with root cause analysis * Works independently as well as within a team with close attention to details, little supervision is needed * Relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals and perform a variety of tasks * Adept at reading, writing, and interpreting technical documentation and procedure\\manuals * Highly self\-motivated and directed * Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high\-pressure environment * Strong customer service orientation * Experience working in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment * Train technical support staff in new technologies and common systems\-related problems * Experience with vulnerability scanning solutions (I.e. Nessus) and resolving vulnerabilities. * Work after\-hours, weekends and the ability to travel is required. Why Choose IPG? At IPG, you will find more than just a job—you will find a place where your success is our success. We pride ourselves on a culture built around strong relationships, where every team member plays a crucial role in our growth. Whether it is through cross\-department collaboration, continuous training, or sustainability\-driven initiatives, we create an environment where you can thrive. Our commitment to sustainability influences everything we do, from designing eco\-friendly products to minimizing waste in our production processes. We are dedicated to building a greener future while providing safe, supportive workplaces for our people. With over 40 years of industry expertise and a proven track record of growth and innovation, IPG offers a stable, secure environment where you can flourish! We offer competitive pay, extensive benefits that support you and your family, and exciting career development opportunities. Whether you are looking to enhance your skills or advance your career, we offer ongoing training and the support you need to succeed. Think big, dream bigger, and make an impact with IPG. You belong here. Join us today!

jobs.description: Posted Date 11/06/2026 Description Director, Full\-Stack Engineer \- AML (Anti Money Laundering) As a Director, Full\-stack Engineer at Capital One, you will lead high\-performing engineering teams working to define the future of banking in the cloud. You will partner closely with product managers, designers, architects and executive leaders to deliver scalable, customer\-centric solutions. Our Directors are technical people leaders who drive engineering strategy, guide complex architectural decisions and translate business goals into impactful technology platforms. At Capital One, we believe diversity of thought strengthens our ability to influence, collaborate and provide the most innovative solutions across organizational boundaries. You will foster a culture of engineering excellence and inclusivity, balancing technical depth with empowered team leadership. You will lead the way in building next\-generation talent for Capital One Tech—mentoring managers and engineers, driving workforce strategy and actively recruiting top\-tier talent. Directors are expected to lead through technical vision, operational rigor and strategic alignment. You will serve as a key owner for your domain's technical health, delivery velocity and system resilience. While shaping long\-term technology strategy and platform roadmaps, you will inspire a culture of continuous learning, innovation and high\-impact delivery across your organization. **Team Description** The Anti Money Laundering (AML) Technology Team at Capital One is responsible for providing solutions that enable the detection, investigation and reporting of suspicious activities to FinCen, the Financial Crimes Enforcement network, a bureau of the United States Department of Treasury. We are transforming the technology that drives AML investigations with Agentic AI. If you are interested in building and leading engineering teams that are at the forefront of this innovation with a high bar for engineering and operational excellence, this role is for you. **What You’ll Do:** * Lead, manage and grow multiple teams of product\-focused software engineers * Mentor and guide the professional and technical development of engineers on your team. * Work with product managers to understand desired application capabilities and testing scenarios * Continuously improve software engineering practices * Work within and across Agile teams to design, develop, test, implement and support technical solutions across a full\-stack development tools and technologies * Lead the craftsmanship, availability, resilience, and scalability of your solutions * Bring a passion to stay on top of tech trends, experiment with and learn new technologies, participate in internal \& external technology communities, and mentor other members of the engineering community * Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting\-edge technologies, inclusion, outside\-of\-the\-box thinking, teamwork, self\-organization and diversity * Work across to improve the velocity of your and other teams * Lead efforts to deploy new and existing applications into AWS environments * Oversee and guide the technical implementation of breaking existing monolithic applications into microservice architectures and build new microservices * Shape long\-term technical strategy and architecture standards for enterprise platforms * Partner with senior engineering and business leaders to align product roadmaps with scalable technology capabilities * Drive talent strategy, ensuring succession planning, skill development, and equitable opportunity across engineering teams This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on\-site presence at your designated office location. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering) * At least 5 years of people management experience * At least 7 years of experience in all of the following: + Software engineering and solution architecture + Enterprise architecture and design patterns + Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) + Data architecture **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s Degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering * Foundational knowledge in AI/ML. * Experience building and delivering Generative AI applications. * 10\+ years of experience in all of the following: + Software engineering and solution architecture + Enterprise architecture and design patterns + Web technologies (JavaScript, TypeScript and SPA frameworks) + Designing and building distributed HPC and ML systems + Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) + Data architecture * 10\+ years of professional experience coding in commonly used languages like Go, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust, C\#, Scala * 8\+ years of experience with database and database management systems * 10\+  , from conception through architecture, implementation, testing, deployment and production support * 8\+ years of experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud\-based productivity tools, or virtualization technologies * 7\+ years of experience mentoring senior engineers and driving professional development within technical teams * 2\+ years of experience leading cross\-domain architectural reviews and establishing coding and design standards * Expertise in the strategic application of agentic AI coding tools to solve systemic development challenges ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. Cambridge, MA: $269,100 \- $307,200 for Director, Full\-stack Engineer McLean, VA: $269,100 \- $307,200 for Director, Full\-stack Engineer New York, NY: $293,600 \- $335,100 for Director, Full\-stack Engineer Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Our client headquartered is a premier global provider of satellite solutions and technology services, and offers the opportunity to explore the boundaries of what’s possible in the fields of engineering and the business functions transforming this engineering into revenue. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, integrate, and support production\-quality embedded and network software for commercial and government communication systems, applications, and products. * Own significant software components from architecture and design through implementation, integration, test, deployment, and sustaining engineering. * Develop high\-performance software and services in C/C\+\+, with additional development in languages such as Python as appropriate. * Design and implement software for Linux\-based embedded and RTOS platforms, including multithreaded and event\-driven applications, system services, device interfaces, and network applications. * Develop and troubleshoot networking functionality involving IPv4/IPv6, TCP, UDP, routing, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPNs, and other IP networking technologies. * Analyze packet flows and diagnose complex system and network issues using tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, and Linux networking utilities. * Optimize applications, protocols, and algorithms for operation across wireless, cellular, satellite, and other variable or constrained network environments. * Collaborate with systems, hardware, firmware, test, and network engineers to define interfaces, architectures, and end\-to\-end solutions. * Investigate difficult field and system\-level problems, identify root causes, and drive solutions through production deployment. * Participate in architecture and design reviews and contribute to software engineering best practices, including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and configuration management. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to less\-experienced engineers while contributing directly to software development. * Communicate technical trade\-offs, status, risks, and recommendations clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders. **Basic Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with approximately 5 years of experience preferred for this role. * Strong software development experience in C and/or C\+\+. * Professional experience developing software for embedded Linux or RTOS environments. * Solid understanding of computer networking, including IP, TCP, UDP, sockets, and common networking protocols. * Experience designing, debugging, and maintaining multithreaded, concurrent, or real\-time software systems. * Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, operating systems, and software architecture. * Experience debugging complex software and system\-level issues using source\- level debuggers, logs, packet captures, and other diagnostic tools. Preferred Qualifications * Experience developing software for routers, gateways, modems, wireless devices, telecommunications equipment, or other networked embedded platforms. * Strong understanding of Linux networking, including routing, interfaces, VLANs, bridging, firewalling, and network configuration. * Experience with wireless communications technologies such as cellular, Wi\-Fi, satellite, or other RF/networking systems. * Experience with embedded Linux build environments, development toolchains, cross\-compilation, and hardware/software integration. * Familiarity with Yocto, Buildroot, OpenWrt, or similar embedded Linux environments. * Experience with networking software and technologies such as VPNs, tunneling, QoS, and advanced routing libraries. * Experience developing interfaces to hardware and peripherals using technologies such as UART, SPI, I²C, USB, Ethernet, or PCIe. * Familiarity with modern development practices and tools including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, static analysis, and issue tracking. * Experience developing software for systems requiring high availability, reliability, security, or operation in constrained network environments. * Exposure to containerized applications, cloud\-connected edge systems, telemetry, or device\-management platforms. * Experience working with communications systems for commercial, government, aerospace, or defense applications. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly. * Self\-directed, collaborative engineer who can take ownership of challenging technical problems and drive them to resolution.

jobs.title: Conversational AI Specialist (On-Site)
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** At Integra, we are a team of relentless innovators driven by a passion to push boundaries, move fast, and redefine what’s possible in consumer goods. Headquartered in Dania Beach, Florida, with key operations in Ohio, we thrive on agility\-pivoting with purpose, taking bold risks, and continuously raising the bar for modern product innovation. We engineer cutting\-edge digital platforms and scale high\-performance products across online marketplaces, mobile, social, and retail channels. As the engine behind category\-defining brands like L’ange and OFIR, Integra Beauty is actively paving the way for unlimited brand incubation. Every product we launch and every platform we build is rooted in an unwavering focus on the consumer experience and a drive for real, measurable results. We want to continue to grow our team of exceptional talent that is action\-oriented, adapts effortlessly to shifting landscapes, and are ready to shape the future of modern consumer brands! **About The Role:** You will own the performance of our AI customer service agent, built on Siena AI. Your core benchmark is resolution rate: the percentage of customer conversations the AI handles accurately and autonomously from start to finish without requiring human intervention. In this role, you will audit live customer interactions, identify failure patterns, and rapidly execute solutions\- whether that means rewriting LLM prompts, clarifying internal business policies, or refining handoff boundaries. **The Ideal Candidate:** * **Strong writing skills.** You’ve written product documentation, knowledge base articles, help articles, FAQs, or marketing copy. * **Prompt authoring experience.** You know how to write prompts for LLMs, especially declarative constraints and conditional statements. You also understand, at least roughly, how these models behave and why they fail. * **CX platform experience.** You’ve worked hands\-on in Gladly, Zendesk, Gorgias, or similar. * **DTC e\-commerce knowledge.** You’re familiar with Shopify, orders, shipping and tracking, returns, product subscriptions, and similar systems. * **Risk judgment.** You can tell a question the AI should answer from one that needs a human, and you err on the side of protecting the customer and the company. * **Collaboration.** You communicate clearly with frontline agents and leadership, and you know when an issue is beyond your scope. ### **Duties and Responsibilities** * Monitor AI conversation outcomes, find failure patterns, and prioritize fixes by impact. * Review automated conversations and change the LLM prompts to fix an issue or steer future conversations. * Write prompts for new customer intents using declarative constraints and conditional logic. * Turn loosely documented business rules into consistent written policies the AI can follow. Ask the right questions when the rules are unclear. * Decide when the AI should hand off to a human instead of answering. This matters most for product\-safety complaints, money disputes, and anything it isn’t authorized to promise. * Maintain knowledge content. Write and update the help articles, FAQs, and policy documentation the AI draws on. * Take issue reports from CX agents, keep CX leadership updated on performance and changes, and escalate technical issues to the right team. ### **Qualifications** * 1–3\+ years of experience in AI Prompt Engineering, Conversational Design, or Technical Writing within an e\-commerce environment and experience within corporate Customer Experience (CX). * Demonstrated hands\-on experience writing prompts for LLMs using conditional logic, system instructions, and negative/declarative constraints, with a clear understanding of LLM limitations and hallucination patterns. * Hands\-on experience working within enterprise CX and ticketing platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Gorgias, Gladly, or similar platforms). * Strong operational understanding of DTC e\-commerce tools, specifically Shopify Plus, order processing, shipping/tracking APIs, returns/exchanges, subscriptions, and ERP order flows (e.g., NetSuite). jobs.title: Engineering Manager – Backend
jobs.description: **Company Description** Jitterbit is a leading data, application, and process workflow automation solution. Rooted in iPaaS and fueled by an ambitious vision, we integrate critical business processes to deliver the experiences and insights needed by enterprises of all sizes to accelerate their digital journey and future proof their business. Simply put, we power people to perform their best. Jitterbit empowers business transformation by automating critical business processes for faster, more informed decision\-making. Jitterbit is the only provider to seamlessly combine and simplify the power of integration, APIM, and no\-code app creation to amplify the value of your tech stack and speed up your digital journey. Organizations worldwide rely on Jitterbit’s experience and expertise to help them save time and money, while creating exceptional experiences, now and into the future. **Job Description** Jitterbit is a recognized leader in Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) and API Management, named in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for seven consecutive years. Our mission is to simplify and accelerate digital transformation through our low\-code iPaaS, API Management (APIM), Low\-Code Application Platform (LCAP), and B2B solutions. Our platform helps businesses automate mission\-critical systems quickly and effectively. To do this, we continuously build and evolve a robust, scalable, secure, and highly reliable SaaS platform serving customers around the world. We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who combines strong people leadership, execution discipline, and technical depth. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building high\-performing distributed teams while remaining close enough to the technology to guide architecture, troubleshoot complex problems, and help the team make sound engineering decisions. About the Team At Jitterbit, engineering is at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building high\- quality, maintainable software and delivering a world\-class experience for our customers. Our engineering organization operates in a collaborative, remote\-first environment with team members across multiple countries and time zones. You will work closely with engineers, Product Management, Support, L3 Engineering, DevOps/SRE, QA, and other engineering teams to build and operate enterprise\-grade integration and API management capabilities. We value ownership, transparency, technical excellence, continuous improvement, and a willingness to solve problems collaboratively. **About the Role** As a Senior Engineering Manager – Backend, you will lead a distributed team of backend engineers responsible for designing, building, operating, and evolving critical components of Jitterbit's iPaaS and API Management platform. You will be accountable for both people leadership and engineering delivery. You will establish clear priorities, help the team execute predictably, develop engineering talent, remove obstacles, and create an environment in which engineers can do their best work. You will partner closely with Product Management and other stakeholders to translate business priorities into executable engineering plans while balancing product delivery with platform scalability, reliability, technical debt, and operational excellence. This is not a purely administrative management position. You should be technically strong enough to participate in architecture and design discussions, challenge technical assumptions, review approaches, and dive deeply into complex production or engineering problems when necessary. When critical situations arise, you are comfortable rolling up your sleeves and working alongside the team to drive them to resolution. Our technology environment includes: * Languages \& Frameworks: Java, Spring Boot, C\+\+, Lua * Infrastructure \& DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Nginx, Tomcat, Apache * Data \& Messaging: MySQL, SQL Server, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, InfluxDB * Cloud Services: AWS, including S3, CloudFront, DynamoDB, and related services What You'll Do Lead and Develop the Team * Lead, coach, and mentor a geographically distributed engineering team across multiple countries and time zones. * Build a high\-performing engineering culture based on ownership, accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous learning. * Conduct regular 1:1s, provide actionable feedback, establish development goals, and support engineers in their career growth. * Manage performance effectively, recognizing strong contributors while addressing performance gaps in a timely and constructive manner. * Participate in workforce planning, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and retaining high\- quality engineering talent. * Identify future technical and team leaders and create opportunities for them to grow. * Foster an inclusive environment where team members are comfortable sharing ideas, raising risks, and challenging assumptions. Drive Engineering Execution * Own the  years of experience directly managing and developing software engineering teams. * Demonstrated experience leading distributed engineering teams across multiple countries and time zones. * Proven ability to lead teams through planning, execution, and delivery of complex software initiatives. * Strong experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog management, estimation, execution tracking, retrospectives, and continuous improvement. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration experience working with Product Management, Support, L3 Engineering, QA, DevOps/SRE, and other engineering teams. * Strong technical foundation in backend and distributed systems, with the ability to participate deeply in architecture, design, debugging, and production troubleshooting conversations. * Experience building and operating multi\-tenant SaaS applications. * Strong understanding of cloud\-native architectures, microservices, APIs, and event\- driven systems. * Experience or strong familiarity with Java and Spring Boot. * Experience or strong familiarity with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Tomcat, and Apache. **You'll Thrive Here If You...** * Are passionate about building, coaching, and retaining high\-performing engineering teams. * Balance people leadership, delivery accountability, and technical excellence. * Stay technically engaged and are comfortable diving deeply into difficult engineering problems when the situation requires it. * Can move comfortably between a team member's career discussion, a sprint\-planning conversation, an architecture review, and a critical production issue. * Create clarity when priorities or requirements are ambiguous. * Hold yourself and your team accountable while creating an environment built on trust and transparency. * Communicate proactively and clearly in a globally distributed, remote\-first environment. * Use data and engineering metrics to identify problems and drive continuous improvement. * Think beyond individual features and consider scalability, reliability, maintainability, customer impact, and long\-term platform health. * Collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries and focus on solving problems rather than assigning blame. * Champion the best ideas regardless of where they originate. * Know when to delegate and empower your team—and when to roll up your sleeves and work alongside them. * Solid understanding of relational databases, particularly MySQL and SQL Server. * Familiarity with technologies such as Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, DynamoDB, and other distributed data technologies is a plus. * Experience supporting highly available, business\-critical production systems. * Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and operational readiness. * Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, communication, and organizational skills. * Ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical teams and business stakeholders. **Additional Information** **What You’ll Get:** * Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space * Join a mission\-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business\-critical processes. * Career development and mentorship * A flexible, remote\-friendly company with personality and heart Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: There are over 7 billion people on this planet. And by 2050, there will be 2 billion more... many moving into urban centers at an unprecedented rate. Making sure there is enough food, fiber and infrastructure for our rapidly growing world is what we're all about at John Deere. And it's why we're investing in our people and our technology like never before! Here the world's brightest minds are tackling the world's biggest challenges. If you believe one person can make the world a better place, we'll put you to work. RIGHT NOW. *John Deere is an equal opportunity employer, including disabled \& veterans.* ***Primary Location:*** *United States (US) \- Iowa \- DUBUQUE* ***Function:*** *Product Engineering (CA)* ***Title:*** *Embedded Software Engineer \- 125822* ***Onsite/Remote:****Onsite Position* **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- As an **Embedded Software Engineer** in the **Earthmoving Embedded Software** organization in **Dubuque, IA**, you will become a contributing member of a software engineering team, focused on the development of embedded software applications for earthmoving equipment. In addition, you will: * Design, develop, test, and debug software components used for electronically controlled systems on various earthmoving products, while complying with a defined development process and coding standards * Participate and guide Agile\-based software development teams and collaborate with cross\-functional product design teams developing various features, such as electro\-hydraulics, powertrain, and/or operator interfaces * Perform embedded systems engineering tasking including requirements analysis, concept development, software architecture and design reviews. * Utilize software tools and electronic instruments to troubleshoot and debug embedded systems * Provide technical support to the factory, Supply Management, and Product Support during key product development phases **VISA Sponsorship is NOT available for this position** **What Skills You Need** ------------------------ * Programming proficiency in C or C\+\+ * Experience with IDEs or code editors, such as Microsoft Visual Studio or Visual Studio Code * Experience with CI/CD tools, particularly Jenkins pipelines and GitHub. * Experience with microcontrollers/microprocessors and hardware interfaces * Strong mathematical and analytical problem\-solving skills * Effective communicator with teamwork experience **What Makes You Stand Out** ---------------------------- * Experience in embedded systems design with preemptive, multitasking real\-time operating systems, such as FreeRTOS * Proficiency in Model Based Software Design, preferably Mathworks (Simulink/Stateflow/Real\-Time Workshop) * Experience with compilers and in\-circuit\-debuggers * Technical experience with electrohydraulic or electromechanical systems * Experience developing software architecture **Education** ------------- Ideally, you will have a degree or equivalent related work experience in the following: * Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Equivalent. **What You'll Get** At John Deere, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. Here, you'll enjoy the freedom to explore new projects, the support to think outside the box and the advanced tools and technology that foster innovation and achievement. Additionally, we offer a comprehensive reward package to help you get started on your new career path, including: * Flexible work arrangements * Highly competitive base pay * Savings \& Retirement benefits (401K and Defined Contribution) * Healthcare benefits with a generous company contribution in the Health Savings Account * Adoption assistance * Employee Assistance Programs * Tuition assistance * Fitness subsidies and on\-site gyms at specific Deere locations * Charitable contribution match * Employee Purchase Plan \& numerous discount programs for personal use * Vacation and Holiday Pay $74,988\.00 \- $112,476\.00 \+ Benefits Follow this link to learn more about our Total Rewards Package https://bit.ly/3XCd8fL Must be 18 years of age or older to apply The information contained herein is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and qualifications required of individuals performing the job. The qualifications detailed in this job description are not considered the minimum requirements necessary to perform the job, but rather as guidelines. The terms of the applicable benefit plans, and all company actions administering or interpreting these plans, continue to control. Deere \& Company reserves the right to suspend, amend, modify, or terminate the Plan(s) in any manner at any time, including the right to modify or eliminate any cost\-sharing between the company and participants. Changes, which can be made at any time, are made by action of the company's board of directors, or to the extent authorized by resolution of its board of directors, or by the Deere \& Company Compensation Committee. In the event of a conflict between the language of the official Plan Documents and this document, the language of the official Plan Documents will control. jobs.title: Staff Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Are you ready to unlock intelligence?** If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box \- we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. **About the Role:** Are you ready to sit at the epicenter of the API and AI connectivity revolution? As a Staff Solutions Engineer at Kong, you won’t just be selling a platform — you’ll be a trusted technical advisor helping the world’s most innovative enterprises architect secure, scalable API ecosystems while navigating the transition into the agentic AI era. Kong sits at the intersection of API management and AI connectivity, and you’ll be the person who makes that story real for customers. **What You’ll Do:** * Support field sales in helping customers understand the value of the Kong API and AI connectivity platform. * Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer requirements and map them to Kong solutions, from initial product reviews through to production. * Support POCs throughout the entire evaluation process, owning technical validation and stakeholder alignment. * Ensure customer satisfaction across your assigned set of accounts. * Collaborate with support, product, and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs. * Create technical documentation for DevOps, implementations, and services engagements. * Lead and support API Management and AI Goverance evaluations, including scoping API/AI use cases, LLM traffic management, and governance requirements. * Deliver demonstrations of Kong’s API \& AI governance and agentic connectivity capabilities, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection. * Run API \& AI\-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to validate Kong’s fit for modern and/or AI/agentic architectures. * Own the technical strategy for complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise deals from qualification through close. * Mentor and coach junior SEs on technical skills, discovery methods, and deal strategy. * Drive thought leadership by authoring technical blogs, hosting webinars, speaking at industry events and conferences such as AWS re:Invent, Google Next, API \& AI summit, and regional events * Influence product direction by synthesizing customer feedback and market signals into actionable input for the product team. * And any additional tasks required by manager. **What You’ll Bring:** * 7\+ years of software engineering and/or solutions engineering experience at a SaaS, open source, or enterprise software company. * Proven track record owning complex, enterprise\-level deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders. * Experience mentoring or coaching other SEs or technical team members. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native platforms. * Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and API security patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS). * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tooling — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent is required. * Working knowledge of AI/LLM architectures, including model routing, rate limiting, semantic caching, and prompt governance. * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic AI patterns. * Solid understanding of cloud computing trends and open source business models. * Strong listener and communicator — you can confidently lead discussions with engineers, architects, and executives. * Enthusiasm for working in a high\-profile, fast\-paced environment at the intersection of API and AI connectivity. \#LI\-MP1 **About Kong:** Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500 and AI\-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com. Compensation Range: $220K \- $250K

jobs.title: Sr. Network & Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: At Kids2, we’re really good at what we do. And when we’re great at our jobs, we help parents be great at their jobs. Parenting is demanding, and that’s where we come in. We want to reimagine how brands can make it easier for early stage parents – not by just selling them products, but by providing holistic solutions that transcend borders, categories and aisles. No matter our title or department, at Kids2, our job is to create more tiny wins for parents, so they can create bright futures for their little ones. That’s a big task! We’re serious about what we do, AND we love to have fun. Our team is hardworking, entrepreneurial, and passionate about helping families create millions, if not billions of tiny wins. **SUMMARY** The Senior Network \& Infrastructure Engineer owns the network that connects Kids2's US offices, the Suwanee data center, Azure, Hong Kong, mainland China and Mexico. This is a senior, hands\-on role on a small Global IT team, owning network architecture and the roadmap as well as firewalls, WAN and site\-to\-site tunnels, remote access VPN, and Meraki wired and wireless networks. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** * Own the network architecture, design standards and roadmap across all sites. * Lead network projects such as China connectivity and WAN and firewall refreshes, from design through cutover. * Manage carriers and network vendors, and give input on the network budget. * Administer FortiGate and Cisco ASA/FTD (FMC) firewalls, including rules, policies, upgrades and change requests. * Review firewall rules and logs, and keep configurations backed up and documented. * Operate the IPsec tunnels and carrier\-managed WAN (DTNaaS) between the US, Azure, Hong Kong and China. * Troubleshoot tunnel, routing and circuit issues, and work with carriers on outages and changes. * Own Cisco Secure Client and Meraki client jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.description: About Leena AI Leena AI is an enterprise agentic AI platform for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Colleagues don't just answer employee questions — they run the work behind them: case handling, approvals and transactions across systems like Workday, SAP SuccessFactors and ServiceNow. We compete — and win — against ServiceNow \+ Moveworks, Workday Illuminate and vertical point solutions. We do it with vendor\-agnostic, cross\-functional orchestration, the broadest connector coverage in the category, and deployments measured in weeks, not quarters. The business is working: ARR has passed $20M and tripled in the last 12 months. Gartner has named us a Leader in agentic AI three times running, and hundreds of enterprises — including Nestlé and Coca\-Cola — run on Leena AI. We're headquartered in New York, with our product and engineering hub in Gurugram. The role We're hiring a VP of Product to own what Leena AI builds, why, and how we know it worked. You'll report to Adit Jain, our co\-founder and CEO, and lead the product org across our pods — knowledge management, AI Colleague Studio, integrations, and the HR, IT and Finance agents. We've built the platform. The next stage is harder: turning a strong agentic platform into the system of record for back\-office work, while competing against incumbents who own the underlying systems. That takes a product leader who can set a sharp strategy, decompose it into metrics, and carry senior rooms — internally and with Fortune 500 CIOs and CHROs. This is not a roadmap\-routing role. We want someone who decides, holds a line under pressure, and builds a product org that does the same. What you own * Product strategy and vision. Define where Leena AI wins over the next 24 months — which back\-office workflows we go deep on across HR, IT, Finance and Legal, and where we stay horizontal. Turn that into a multi\-quarter roadmap the company can bet on. * The metric tree. Own a clear north star (e.g., autonomous resolution rate, or work completed end\-to\-end without a human) and the decomposed tree of input metrics beneath it, with owners and quarterly movement targets for every pod. If a pod's plan is a list of features rather than a model of its metric, send it back. * The agentic platform. Set direction for AI Colleague Studio, our agent orchestration layer, voice, and the knowledge layer — so customers' builders can design, test, govern and deploy agents themselves without raising a ticket with us. * Integrations as a moat. Keep our connector breadth and depth ahead of the market — Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, Oracle, ADP, Salesforce and Microsoft 365 — and make sure agents land transactions correctly across them. * Enterprise trust. Make data residency, audit trails, explainability, permissions and agent guardrails first\-class product features, not RFP afterthoughts. * Field to product loop. Partner with Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions and our HR domain leads so what we learn in each implementation ships to the next customer by default. Cut time\-to\-value release over release. * Go\-to\-market alignment. Work with Sales, Product Marketing and Demand Gen on positioning, packaging and pricing. Be in the room for strategic deals, QBRs, customer advisory boards and analyst briefings. * Team. Lead and grow a team of product managers and designers across New York and Gurugram. Raise the bar on PRDs, metric thinking and customer presence. Hire well and fast as we scale. * Operating cadence. Run planning, roadmap reviews and launch readiness with Engineering, Design, CS and Sales on a single prioritized backlog. **Requirements** What we're looking for * 12\+ years in product, 5\+ leading product teams — including product leaders managing PMs — at high\-growth B2B SaaS companies selling to the enterprise. * You've shipped to CIO, CHRO or CFO buyers. You understand that enterprise trust means data residency, audit trails, sub\-processor transparency and the ability to explain a wrong answer — not just model quality. * Platform and AI depth. You've owned an AI, automation, workflow or integration platform. You can reason about LLM agents, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails with your engineering leaders — and you know where today's models break. * Metric decomposition and structured bets. Given a north star, you sketch the input tree, pick the two or three highest\-leverage inputs for next quarter, and propose sequenced bets with expected movement. * Stakeholder leadership. You've run a product org where decisions routed through founders, Engineering, Sales and CS — and you held the line on a contested call. You can walk us through why it held. * CIO\-level communication. You can run a QBR, a technical deep\-dive or an escalation with a Fortune 500 executive team and leave with decisions, not just sentiment. You sound like a peer, not a vendor. * AI builder, not just AI user. You prototype with LLMs and agent tools yourself, and hold your team to the same standard. * Systems thinking. jobs.title: Cyber-Physical Systems Reverse Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** **Who We Are:** Kudu Dynamics is Leidos Owned Company, forged out of a decade of experience in computer network operations and staffed with talent who have built, overseen, and enhanced capabilities throughout the entire USG arsenal. Our team of hackers and engineers have experience spanning centuries of research, development, and operations missions \- across desktop, mobile, IoT, and embedded platforms. Kudu Dynamics, a Leidos company is uniquely qualified to anticipate tomorrow’s threats and build the next generation of capabilities. We are looking for a Cyber\-Physical Systems Reverse Engineer to support a new project researching and developing novel capabilities for maritime cybersecurity. This is the kind of job where you get to poke at real systems, ask why something behaved differently than expected, and keep digging when the answer is, "Huh, that's weird." This role focuses on understanding how complex embedded and cyber\-physical systems actually behave, not just how they were intended to behave. On our team, you will work hands\-on with real embedded systems and operational technology in a lab environment, analyzing hardware, firmware, communications interfaces, and interactions between components. You will reverse engineer and emulate embedded devices, develop automated methods for exploring system behavior, and design experiments to identify unexpected or emergent behaviors, undocumented features, or even bugs and misconfigurations. This role calls for the creative application of multiple skill sets across embedded systems, firmware, software, hardware, and cybersecurity. You may find yourself building test harnesses and automated workflows, instrumenting analog and digital systems, integrating physical devices with software analysis and cyber reasoning tools, and developing code. **Responsibilities Include:** * Develop, integrate, and debug embedded firmware for real\-time and resource\-constrained systems, including RTOS\-based applications, device drivers, hardware interfaces, and low\-level system software * Design and implement simulation, emulation, and automated test environments for embedded and cyber\-physical systems, including tools for exploring system behavior, reproducing observed effects, and exercising hardware and firmware * Analyze and reverse engineer embedded devices, firmware, communications protocols, sensors, and other system components to understand both intended functionality and real\-world behavior * Develop production\-quality C/C\+\+ and Python software to automate testing, instrumentation, experimentation, and analysis, including integration with laboratory hardware and software\-based analysis tools * Conduct hands\-on laboratory testing using embedded debugging tools and analog/digital instrumentation; critically analyze, document, and communicate technical findings. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Experience developing embedded firmware in C/C\+\+, including real\-time systems, RTOS concepts, interrupts, concurrency, memory\-mapped I/O, device drivers, and hardware peripherals * Experience with embedded hardware and common communications interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, USB, Ethernet, or wireless interfaces, including debugging hardware/software interactions * Experience developing simulation, emulation, automated testing, or hardware/software test harnesses for embedded systems * Proficiency with Python or similar scripting languages for automation, testing, analysis, and development of engineering tools * Experience using embedded development and diagnostic equipment such as JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic/protocol analyzers, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, function generators, or similar instrumentation. **Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications:** * Experience reverse engineering embedded devices and firmware, including use of tools such as Ghidra, Binary Ninja, IDA Pro, or similar tools and the ability to analyze assembly for one or more processor architectures. * Experience with program analysis and vulnerability research techniques such as fuzzing, symbolic execution, static/dynamic analysis, binary exploitation, and modern exploit mitigations. * Experience with processor or full\-system emulation, hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL), software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL), or development of custom models for processors, peripherals, sensors, or other embedded components. * Experience with digital signal processing, RF systems, software\-defined radio, wireless communications, audio/signal processing, or MATLAB\-based modeling and analysis. * Understanding of digital and analog circuits, hardware reverse engineering, low\-level computer architecture, and the interaction between software, firmware, and physical system behavior. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. **About Leidos** Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16\.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025\. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com. **Pay and Benefits** Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay\-benefits. **Securing Your Data** Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, AI
jobs.description: LiteLLM is the world’s most popular AI Gateway, trusted by companies like Adobe, Netflix, and NASA. We’ve grown ARR 6x in the last year to nearly $30M with a team of 20, and developers use LiteLLM to call 100\+ LLM providers through one API. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to lead our unified API team and make sure every new model and provider works with LiteLLM on day one. **About the role** ------------------ This is a hands\-on technical lead role. You'll own how LiteLLM unifies LLM APIs across the OpenAI and Anthropic specs, lead the engineers who build it, and set the bar for what good looks like. Every week a provider ships something new: a new API, a new modality, a new feature. The promise of LiteLLM is that it works with all of them on day one. Your job is to keep that promise: new endpoints ship on day one, open source translation issues go down, and developers can count on LiteLLM to keep up. You’ll lead our open source pod, where most issues are LLM translation issues. You’ll report to the CEO, and later to our Head of Engineering. This role is in person in San Francisco. We help with relocation and support H\-1B transfers. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead the unified API team and own new model, endpoint, and provider rollouts end to end. * Design provider\-agnostic features at the gateway level, such as session management for non\-OpenAI models. * Triage open source issues and outside PRs (new providers, translation fixes) and get them merged, reviewed, or replaced with an internal fix. * Review the AI team's PRs and hold a high bar for code quality, including code written with AI. * Find the power users in your area and use what they need to decide what to build next. * Take on new unification bets with a customer who will use them and give feedback. * Own the developer experience for everyone who uses LiteLLM's Python SDK and proxy. **What is our tech stack** The tech stack includes Python, FastAPI, Redis, Postgres. We're moving the gateway to Rust. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * You've been a machine learning engineer and now build applied AI products. * 3\+ years of experience. The scope you've owned matters more than a Staff title. * Deep expertise in LLM APIs. You can speak to the differences between /chat/completions and /responses, and to each provider's nuances. * Experience building or maintaining a unified API that sits in front of many providers. * Taste in developer experience. You can tell when an API or playground is bad and explain why. * Customer empathy. You ask why a user wants something and how big the use case is before you build it. * Ready to lead a team from day one and set the technical bar yourself. * Strong software engineering fundamentals in Python. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Experience at a company built on a unified API, such as OpenRouter, Vercel AI SDK, Merge, Segment, or Fivetran. * You've built your own unified API or written about what a good one should do. * You've built evals for LLMs. * You've used LiteLLM in production. * Open source contributions, especially to LLM tooling. **Why join LiteLLM?** --------------------- * Work directly with the founders every day. * Lead the team behind the core of the product: the unified API thousands of engineering teams depend on. * Own a whole area of the product. We don't have PMs: engineers talk to customers and decide what to build. * Your work ships in open source, used by engineering teams around the world. * Move incredibly fast and see your work in production immediately. * Competitive salary, equity, health, dental, and vision benefits. **About LiteLLM** ----------------- LiteLLM is the world's most widely adopted AI Gateway. We provide a unified API for 100\+ LLM providers along with routing, authentication, budgets, observability, and governance for production AI systems. Thousands of companies rely on LiteLLM to power AI in production. If you want to lead the team that keeps LiteLLM ahead of every model launch, we'd love to meet you. Compensation Range: $250K \- $350K

jobs.title: AI-Native Cyber Security Manager
jobs.description: #### **Role Overview** We are seeking an experienced, AI\-native Cyber Security Manager with a proven track record of delivering security solutions and a passion for using AI to transform how security is done. You will join a Lumenalta team embedded with a new start\-up division within an established retail financial services group, helping assemble a brand new financial services platform from the ground up. In this role, you’ll leverage your industry knowledge to design and deliver key security solutions for the platform, using AI tools and agents to do the heavy lifting wherever possible. You will work cross\-functionally to identify, prioritize, and remediate risks, and continuously improve the vulnerability management lifecycle through AI\-assisted scanning, triage, and patch management. #### **What You'll Be Doing** * Manage ongoing cyber commitments to the business, delivering operational security controls, risk and governance frameworks, and InfoSec principles and standards that protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of systems, data, and information assets. * Identify emerging threats and vulnerabilities using AI\-driven threat intelligence and analysis, ensuring the right countermeasures and mitigations are prioritized and implemented through detection technologies and governance frameworks. * Run an AI\-powered vulnerability and patch management program, using AI agents to triage findings, assess exploitability, and draft remediation, maintaining a clear understanding of technical control measures. * Design, build, and continuously improve AI\-driven security workflows such as alert triage, automated compliance evidence collection, and third\-party risk assessment. * Provide subject matter expertise to internal stakeholders and collaborate with information security partners to stay ahead of industry technologies and evolving threats. * Deliver the InfoSec technology roadmap, ensuring regulatory obligations are met in line with industry best practices. * Shape ongoing cybersecurity strategy in an evolving digital landscape, including the secure adoption of AI across the organization. * Define and review key security performance indicators and use AI tools to automate reporting for management updates and escalations. * Build and maintain cybersecurity policies, procedures, and processes, using AI to draft them, map them against control frameworks, and keep them current. * Continuously collect, correlate, and analyze security data with AI and automation to detect external and internal threats across services. * Prepare the platform for Go Live, ensuring support processes are in place, rolled out to teams, and integrated with the wider parent group. * Remove team impediments by working collaboratively with stakeholders to proactively manage risks, issues, or delays. #### **What We're Looking For** * Experience: 5\+ years in cybersecurity, ideally with a background in technology disruption or financial services (retail credit preferred). * AI\-Native Security Practice: Demonstrable experience using AI tools and agents (such as Claude, Microsoft Security Copilot, or similar) to perform security work including threat analysis, vulnerability triage, policy drafting, and reporting. * AI Security Risk: Understanding of the security risks of AI itself, including prompt injection, data leakage, and model misuse, and familiarity with frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and ISO/IEC 42001\. * AWS Security: Strong working knowledge of AWS security services and implementations, including Security Hub, Control Tower, Organizations, SCPs, IAM entities and policies, account lockdown, Macie, and GuardDuty. * Risk and Compliance: Deep understanding of risk assessment methodologies and compliance requirements, including the Data Protection Act (DPA), GDPR, PCI DSS, SOC1, SOC2, and ISO27001\. * Threat Awareness: Current awareness of InfoSec issues such as emerging vulnerabilities and zero\-day exploits, and the ability to identify appropriate countermeasures. * Third\-Party Management: Experience managing third\-party suppliers, including the assessment of AI tools and vendors. * Communication: Ability to convey complex technical information to non\-technical stakeholders and executives through reports, policies, and security training. * Problem Solving: Strong ability to analyze complex problems, troubleshoot security incidents, and develop effective mitigations. * Start\-up Mindset: Comfortable with agile frameworks and iterative, AI\-first delivery. Curious, experimentally minded, decisive, able to ruthlessly prioritize, and a champion of radical candor. #### **Desirable Qualifications** * Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) * Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) #### **Why Lumenalta is an amazing place to work** * Be 100% dedicated to one project at a time so that you can innovate and grow. * Be a part of a team of talented and friendly senior\-level engineers and specialists. * Work on projects that allow you to use leading tech. #### **Location** This is a fully remote position; however, candidates must be based in regions that align with UK time zones to ensure effective collaboration with client and team schedules. #### **Application Deadline** Applications will be accepted until **November 22nd, 2026**. Candidates can expect feedback by **November 30th, 2026**.

jobs.title: Agentic Quality Engineering
jobs.description: At Lumenalta, we partner with forward\-thinking organizations to build technology solutions that scale, delight users, and accelerate business growth. Our global teams bring curiosity, commitment, and technical excellence to every project. We value transparency, autonomy, and impact, empowering every team member to do their best work. #### **Actively hiring** We are hiring for a current opening on an active client project. This is a specific, presently open role. We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to move qualified candidates through our process promptly. #### **About the role** We’re seeking an experienced Agentic Quality Engineer to own the quality and test strategy across a modern, AI\-augmented engineering platform. This is a hands\-on senior role: you won’t manage traditional QA, you’ll architect an AI\-driven quality model. You set the standards, judgment, and guardrails, while AI agents handle test creation, maintenance (Playwright, Cypress, Jest), and triage alongside engineers. Your goal is to make agent\-led testing reliable and consistently high quality. #### **What you will do** * **Own the agent\-led quality model**. Define how AI agents are directed, constrained, reviewed, and measured across the testing lifecycle and evolve that model as the capability matures. * **Orchestrate agents that build and maintain automation**. Direct Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent coding agents to create and maintain Playwright, Cypress, and Jest suites alongside engineers: generating coverage for new work, repairing suites as the product changes, and expanding depth where risk is highest. * **Develop the prompting, context, and workflow patterns** tthat make agent\-generated tests reliable: repo context strategies, guardrails, review gates, and escalation paths for when an agent should hand back to a human. * **Set the quality and test strategy for the platform**, ensuring quality is engineered in at every stage rather than inspected in at the end. * **Own the quality roadmap** Maintain a quarterly quality and test roadmap and a 6\-month forecast aligned to engineering delivery goals and platform evolution. * **Maintain quality standards** across teams. Define, evolve, and maintain the quality standards and practices teams work to, and adjust processes based on what reviews and audits reveal. * **Drive adoption across engineering teams.** Onboard squads onto the model, document what works, run enablement, and make the practice self\-sustaining without owning headcount. * **Own technical acceptance criteria** in partnership with Product Managers, and lead risk\-based functional testing across all stages of development. * **Plan and manage UAT cycles**, environment specifications, execution, and stakeholder reporting. * **Own performance and load testing.** Ensure critical services have load, stress, and performance testing in place and actively maintained. * **Ensure test data and environment readiness** so test cycles aren’t delayed by missing or invalid data or misconfigured environments. * **Establish the measurement framework.** Define quality KPIs that work for an agent\-led model: coverage quality (not just coverage percentage), escaped\-defect rates, agent output reliability, and human review load over time. * **Own service acceptance** for complex deliverables. * **Track where the frontier is moving.** Evaluate new agent capabilities, models, and testing technologies, and decide what earns a place in the platform. #### **What we are looking for** * Proven **leadership experience**, including managing others and working in cross\-team and cross\-organizational environments. * **Hands\-on AI agent development and orchestration.** Practical, sustained experience directing Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent coding agents on real engineering work. You’ve used coding agents to generate or maintain a production test suite and can describe a case where agent output was wrong and how you caught it. You can talk concretely about context management, prompt and workflow design, where agents fail, and how you designed around it. * **Experience supervising agents in a testing context** using them for coverage generation, defect detection, or suite maintenance, and applying real judgment to their output. * **Expert test automation proficiency with Playwright**, Cypress, and Jest (or close equivalents). You need to be able to read, judge, and fix what an agent produces. * **7\+ years in QA or test engineering,** including setting strategy across multiple teams. * **Expert\-level functional testing and UAT management.** * **Ability to define measurement frameworks and quality KPIs** from scratch, in a model where the traditional metrics do not fully apply. * **Solid engineering foundations:** microservices and API architecture, Git, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node/NPM. * **Expert familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Grafana, and Kibana.** * **Strong agile background and excellent English communication skills.** #### **Nice to have** * Anthropic Claude certification, or equivalent credentials in AI agent development or applied AI engineering * Public evidence of agent work: open\-source contributions, published prompt or workflow patterns, talks, or writing on agent\-led testing * ISTQB Advanced Level Test Manager certification * Professional certifications such as ITIL, BCS, ISACA, or ISC2 * Experience introducing a new engineering practice across an organization and getting it adopted #### **Location** This is a fully remote position; however, candidates must be based in regions that align with the UK time zone (GMT\+1\) to ensure effective collaboration with the client and team schedules. #### **Application Deadline** Applications will be accepted until **November 22nd, 2026**. Candidates can expect feedback by **November 30th, 2026**.

jobs.title: Information Security Engineer and Data Protection
jobs.description: #### **About the Role** We are seeking an experienced, highly technical Information Security Engineer with a proven track record of implementing data protection tools end to end. In this role, you will lead ePHI discovery and inventory work from deployment through day\-to\-day operation, working from a defined strategy set by security leadership. You will implement a data security posture management (DSPM) platform and related tooling, mature existing DLP and SASE controls, and build an accurate, well\-maintained inventory of where ePHI lives across cloud and SaaS environments. You will also support vulnerability remediation and back up incident response. The ideal candidate is hands\-on, communicates clearly, and uses AI to work more efficiently. #### **What You'll Be Doing** * Own ePHI discovery and inventory, finding, classifying, and inventorying ePHI across cloud storage, databases, file shares, and SaaS applications, and keeping that inventory accurate as systems change. * Implement a DSPM platform end to end, connecting data sources, tuning classifiers, identifying sensitive data that is over\-exposed, unencrypted, or broadly accessible, and partnering with system owners to right\-size access and fix misconfigurations. * Integrate supporting tooling such as asset inventory and data classification so discovery results feed the system of record, documenting configurations and runbooks along the way. * Mature DLP and SASE controls across the secure web gateway, CASB, DLP, and zero\-trust stack by tuning policies to reduce false positives and negatives, strengthening enforcement, and building repeatable response processes for PHI movement events. * Establish GenAI and shadow IT guardrails by identifying unsanctioned AI and SaaS tools and applying policies that enable safe use while blocking what should not be allowed. Support the vulnerability remediation lifecycle by monitoring critical public vulnerabilities, validating bug bounty, pen test, and scanner findings, routing them to the right teams, and confirming
