jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Forecasting & Real-Time Optimization
jobs.description: At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. Marketplace teams are at the heart of Lyft's products and decision\-making. We're looking for passionate, driven engineers to build systems that empower our users (both drivers and riders) to make the most effective use of Lyft's products and experiences by making them more predictive, personalized, and adaptive. The ideal candidate enjoys solving problems with distributed computing for ML and forecasting models, and finding patterns and insights in real\-world data while building reliable systems, and is excited about working in a fast\-paced, innovative, and collegial environment. The Forecasting and Real\-Time Optimization Platform (FORTOP) team in Lyft's Rideshare Experience \& Marketplace (REM) org provides reliable, real\-time market supply and demand signals and forecasts that power the systems making critical automated decisions for Lyft's business. These signals feed many of Lyft's most important marketplace products, including Dynamic Pricing, Real\-Time Supply Management, Fulfillment, and more. As a Senior Software Engineer on FORTOP's forecasting team, you'll lead the design and operation of the production systems that turn streaming marketplace data into accurate, reliable forecasts: real\-time feature pipelines, model training and inference infrastructure, backtesting and evaluation tooling, and the serving layer that downstream products query continuously. You'll work closely with our scientists to take models from prototype to production, and with downstream teams to define the contracts and reliability guarantees they build on. The work involves forecasting both rider demand and driver supply as they shift with traffic, holidays, and major events, and keeping systems correct and fast during the peaks when they matter most. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * **Lead projects end to end:** Drive multi\-engineer projects from proposal and technical design through launch. Break work into milestones, align dependencies with partner teams, and own estimates. * **Architect ML systems:** Design and evolve streaming feature pipelines, training and inference workflows, and signal serving, and lead design reviews with attention to latency, correctness, scalability, and cost. Reduce complexity by consolidating or sunsetting components. * **Partner with science to ship:** Partner with scientists to design/productionize ML models. Build the rollout tooling (shadow, canary, rollback) and the backtesting and experimentation infrastructure that make launches safe and fast. * **Own signal contracts:** Define and maintain the interfaces, data contracts, and SLAs between forecasting signals and downstream consumers such as Dynamic Pricing and Driver Incentives. * **Operate what you build:** Monitor system health (latency, freshness, error rates) and signal quality (accuracy, bias, drift), and prepare systems for peak events. Take part in on\-call, lead post\-incident investigations, and drive action items to completion. * **Code quality:** Write well\-tested, maintainable code and give code reviews that improve the work of others. Coach teammates on testing and engineering practices. * **Collaborate across functions:** Work with Product, Science, and partner engineering teams to frame problems, shape the roadmap, and make clear tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, and complexity. * **Grow the team:** Mentor engineers, take part in hiring and onboarding, and share knowledge through design docs, runbooks, and tech talks. **Experience:** --------------- * 5\+ years of software engineering industry experience, including building and operating backend or data systems in production * BS/MS or equivalent in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience * Experience designing and leading delivery of large\-scale distributed systems, and owning their reliability through monitoring, on\-call, and incident response * Solid distributed systems fundamentals: fault tolerance, delivery semantics, and consistency tradeoffs * Track record of leading ambiguous, multi\-engineer projects and mentoring other engineers * Clear written communication, including design docs that align stakeholders * Preferred: Experience building production ML models and infrastructure, such as model choice, feature engineering and pipelines, training and inference pipelines, model serving, or ML platforms * Preferred: Hands\-on experience with stream or large\-scale batch processing (Flink, Beam, Spark, or similar) and distributed messaging (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) * Preferred: Experience with time series forecasting systems, or familiarity with backtesting and forecast evaluation (error metrics, bias, calibration) * Preferred: Experience with online experimentation or real\-time decision systems such as pricing, dispatch, or marketplace balancing * Preferred: Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools to move faster without compromising quality **Benefits:** ------------- * Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled * Mental health benefits * Family building benefits * Child care and pet benefits * 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future * In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off * 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible * Subsidized commuter benefits * Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Lyft highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in\-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in\-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. \#Hybrid The expected base pay range for this position in the Seattle area is $136,160 \- $170,200, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI - Systems
jobs.description: **About Mercor** ================ Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real\-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents. Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast\-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in\-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices. **About the Role** ================== The Applied AI org builds the systems that turn human expertise into training data for frontier models, task pipelines, expert workflows, evaluation infrastructure, and the services that tie them together. We have synthetic pipelines and modular quality control systems that run in unison to generate highest quality tasks and at scale. All of it runs on backend systems that have to stay correct, fast, and observable while the volume behind them grows every month. As a Software Engineer on Backend Systems, you'll own services in that stack: designing the data models, building the APIs, services, data pipelines that move work through the platform. This is a build role. You'll take a problem that's roughly scoped, make the design calls, ship it to production, and own it afterward. We're hiring for depth in backend fundamentals rather than any particular domain. If you've built and operated real services, handled the schema migration that couldn't take downtime, found the query that fell over at 10x traffic, designed the retry logic that made a flaky dependency invisible to users, or build a system that recover when things break that's the experience that matters here. You'll work with a talent dense group of engineers who will review your designs and push your thinking, and you'll be expected to grow into owning larger surfaces quickly. **What you will Do** ==================== * Design, build, and operate backend services in the Applied AI stack including APIs, data models, background jobs, and the pipelines that connect them. * Own features end to end: scope the problem, write the design, ship the code, instrument it, and keep it healthy in production. * Build and tune high\-throughput data and job pipelines: queuing, batching, idempotency, retries, and backpressure. * Make the system fast and reliable by adding failure recovery in pipelines, profile hot spots, Agent token and cost attribution, caching issues, and set latency, error, cost budgets you actually hold to. * Instrument what you ship: observability, metrics, logging, tracing, and alerts that proactively catch problems. * Work on modern cutting edge tools, libraries and frameworks. * Manage and launch 10s of 1000s of containers, sandbox environments, manage resource allocation and system health. * Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform. * Participate in on\-call for the systems you own, debug production incidents, and write up what you learn in RCCA. * Write clear design docs and give useful code review, we make technical decisions in writing and expect everyone to take part. * Work directly with product, operations, and research partners to turn ambiguous requirements into systems that ship. **What we are Looking For** =========================== * 2–5 years of professional backend engineering experience building and operating production systems. * Strong fundamentals in backend engineering: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and writing code that's clear enough for the next person to change. * Hands\-on experience with **API design** \- REST, gRPC, or GraphQL, and an understanding of versioning, contracts, and backward compatibility. * Solid **database skills**: relational data modeling, indexing, query performance, transactions and isolation, and safe migrations. Familiarity with at least one NoSQL or key\-value store and when it's the right choice. * Practical experience with **distributed systems basics**: queues and event streams, caching, idempotency, rate limiting, and designing for partial failure. * Experience with Data Orchestration and workflow management systems like Airflow, Temporal, Dagster. * Be able to roll your sleeves up and dig deeper into the lower level infrastructure issues container, permissions, logs, traces and find the needle in the haystack. * Experience running services in production: containers, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting, and debugging issues under real traffic. * Comfort with ambiguity you can take a loosely defined problem, ask the right questions, and come back with a plan. * Genuine excitement for agentic development and new technology, fluency with modern AI dev tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), and a real passion for writing good code. * Clear written and verbal communication. High ownership, pragmatism, and a bias toward shipping. **Nice to Have** ================ * Experience building or integrating with LLM\-backed services in production (evaluation, orchestration, or serving). * Familiarity with AI infrastructure providers like Modal, Fireworks, Baseten, Temporal **Benefits** ------------ * Bi\-annual performance bonus structure * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Up to $15k Relocation bonus * $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0\.5 miles of our office) * $1\.5K monthly stipend for meals * Free Equinox membership * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement * Health, Dental, Vision insurance Compensation Range: $220K \- $500K

membership * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement * Health, Dental, Vision insurance Compensation Range: $220K \- $250K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: At Morgan \& Morgan, the work we do matters. For millions of Americans, we're their last line of defense against insurance companies, large corporations or defective goods. From attorneys in all 50 states, to client support staff, creative marketing to operations teams, every member of our firm has a key role to play in the winning fight for consumer rights. Our over 6,000 employees are all united by one mission: For the People. **Forward Deployed Engineer** Remote, United States **About the Role** We're hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who are passionate about building high\-quality software and putting AI to work where it makes the biggest difference. In this role, you'll work directly with our business teams, such as call center reps, case managers and attorneys, to find problems worth solving and ship solutions that move a measurable business result. You'll build AI agents and full\-stack applications on AWS and MX2, our in\-house AI platform, which more than 5,000 people across the firm use every month. This is a hands\-on engineering role on smaller teams tasked with solving one problem at a time. You'll own each solution from the first conversation to the measured result, then hand it to a permanent owner and take on the next problem. There is one title for this role, with no junior or senior levels: we care most about the business impact you deliver and how well you use AI to get there, not about years of experience alone. **Responsibilities** * **Embed with the business:** Spend time with the teams doing the work to understand how it gets done and where it gets stuck * **Pick the right problem:** Agree with business owners on one measurable problem, take a baseline before building, and define how success will be measured * **Lead by example:** Design and implement reliable systems across the backend, frontend, and cloud infrastructure on AWS * **Build with AI:** Build AI agents and workflows for areas such as our call center and client intake across chat, text and voice, the early steps of litigation, practice areas beyond personal injury, and new AI products the firm is building * **Elevate code quality:** Champion test\-driven development, code hygiene, and clean architecture * **Build for trust:** Test and evaluate AI output, design human review where it matters, and protect client data under HIPAA and firm policy * **Move fast, build right\-sized:** Ship working solutions quickly and improve them in production, with the reliability and observability the problem actually needs rather than over\-engineering up front * **Measure the result:** Report the business outcome, not just the feature shipped * **Champion documentation and handoff:** Author technical design documents and transfer what you build cleanly to a permanent product or engineering owner * **Cross\-functional alignment:** Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to keep every solution aligned with the MX2 roadmap **Requirements** * Typically 5\+ years of professional software development experience, though we weigh shipped impact and AI fluency over tenure * Strong in at least one modern programming language, and comfortable working across the full stack * Hands\-on experience with agentic development: using AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor to plan, write, test and review production code * Hands\-on experience building with large language models in production, such as Anthropic Claude or OpenAI models, including prompting, tool use, retrieval, AI agent workflows and evaluation * Production experience with AWS and modern cloud\-native architectures * Demonstrated expertise in software testing, quality assurance, and CI/CD pipelines * Comfort turning a loosely defined business problem into a scoped build without a detailed spec * Exceptional communication skills, including explaining technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders in plain language **Nice to Have** * Experience as a forward deployed, solutions or field engineer, or in another customer\-facing engineering role * Voice AI or contact center technology, such as speech\-to\-text, telephony and real\-time conversation * Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore or similar AI agent platforms * Salesforce or Litify experience * Experience in legal, healthcare or another regulated industry **Why Join Us** * Be part of a fast\-growing engineering team within a stable, established company * Build AI that people across America's largest injury law firm use every day * Opportunities for career advancement, ownership, and professional development * Get recognized for the impact you deliver, and see the difference your work makes in the business * Work with passionate engineers who value thoughtful design, high\-quality code, and continuous improvement * Work remotely from anywhere in the United States This role is remote within the United States, with occasional travel to our offices and business teams. \#LI\-MB1 **Benefits** Morgan \& Morgan is a leading personal injury law firm dedicated to protecting the people, not the powerful. This success starts with our staff. For full\-time employees, we offer an excellent benefits package including medical and dental insurance, 401(k) plan, paid time off and paid holidays. **Equal Opportunity Statement** Morgan \& Morgan provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. **E\-Verify** This employer participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E\-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. jobs.title: ML Search Engineer
jobs.description: **Search Engineer (Software Engineer III)** You must be eligible to work in the US without Visa Sponsorship. **ABOUT THE ROLE** We're building intelligent product search that understands intent, learns from behavior, and gets smarter over time. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer on the ML/AI Search team, you'll design and build both the frontend and backend systems that power product discovery for millions of industrial buyers—from scalable retrieval pipelines, APIs, and Frontend interfaces that make AI accessible. This isn't a research role. You'll own the full lifecycle: prototyping ideas, shipping production\-grade services on GCP, and iterating based on real user data. Strong Python and React engineering is the foundation—if you also bring experience in search systems, vector databases, or Elasticsearch, you'll hit the ground running from day one. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** **Build \& Ship Search and AI\-Powered Systems** * Design, develop, and deploy production Python services end\-to\-end—from retrieval and ranking pipelines through client\-facing APIs. * Build and integrate ML inference pipelines: embedding models, transformer\-based classifiers, LLM\-powered query understanding, and reranking services. * Develop event\-driven, real\-time architectures using GCP services—Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, GKE, Cloud Functions. * Write clean, well\-tested, observable Python backends; own your services through deployment, monitoring, and on\-call * Drive frontend architecture decisions, establishing development standards, and creating reusable component libraries. **Contribute to Search Infrastructure** * Work alongside the Search Architect and ML Architect to implement hybrid retrieval systems combining keyword search, dense vector similarity, and reranking. * Build and maintain Elasticsearch indexing pipelines, query services, and relevance tuning tooling. * Integrate vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS or similar) into retrieval workflows—even if this is new territory, you'll learn fast. * Instrument search pipelines with meaningful metrics: CTR, zero\-result rate, latency—feeding the team's A/B experimentation loop. * Build clean, responsive, and production\-ready interfaces from wireframes or Figma designs. **Own the Engineering Bar** * Champion CI/CD, observability, testing, and infrastructure\-as\-code as non\-negotiables, not afterthoughts. * Lead design sessions with Engineers and Architects; translate product requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions. * Participate in code reviews and knowledge\-sharing—actively raising the team's collective skill level. **WHAT YOU BRING** **Must\-Haves** * **Strong Python****and React****foundation:**6\+ years of professional backend or full\-stack engineering experience with a deep Python/React (e.g., Next.js, Vite.js, Remix.js, Gatsby.js) focus—async patterns, type annotations, testing, and production\-grade service/component design. * **Cloud\-native experience:**Proven experience designing and deploying cloud\-native applications ( GCP strongly preferred; AWS or Azure considered). * Hands\-on experience building resilient high throughput microservices and RESTful/gRPC APIs. * Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and serverless paradigms. * Strong grounding in SOLID design principles and software craftsmanship. * Good communicator who thrives in cross\-functional, agile teams alongside ML engineers, architects, and product owners. * Comfort using AI tools to accelerate development throughput. * Strong experience of using and managing Monorepos * Strong understanding of relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) and non\-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB). * **Mentorship:** Provide guidance and technical knowledge sharing to mid\-level and junior developers. **Strongly Preferred — Search \& ML** *You don't need all of these on day one—but the more you bring, the faster you'll contribute:* * **Search systems:**Experience with search platforms: Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, or Algolia—index management, query DSL, relevance tuning. * **Vector search:**Familiarity with vector search concepts and tooling: embeddings, approximate nearest neighbor (ANN), FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar. * Exposure to ML/AI patterns: RAG pipelines, LLM integration, prompt engineering, or fine\-tuning workflows. * Experience with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Google ADK. * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience (Terraform, Pulumi, OpenTofu) and mature CI/CD pipeline ownership. **WHO YOU ARE** **Fearless Builder** A working proof\-of\-concept beats a thousand slide decks. Speed and quality are both non\-negotiable. **Relentless Learner** You pick up new technologies fast and have a genuine eagerness to master whatever comes next. **Architecture\-Minded** You design scalable, fault\-tolerant services as second nature and aren't afraid to challenge the status quo. **Ownership\-Driven** Code isn't done until it's tested, documented, and monitored. Your name on a release means something. **Search\-Curious** You may not have built a search system yet—but you're excited by the challenge and ready to go deep. **Team Multiplier** You give and welcome candid feedback and actively make the people around you better. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** **LICENSES \& CERTIFICATIONS:** None required. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:** No Supervisory Responsibility **BUDGET RESPONSIBILITY:** No **COMPANY INFORMATION:** Motion Industries offers an excellent benefits package which includes options for healthcare coverage, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, vacation, sick, and holiday pay. **DISCLAIMER:** This job description illustrates the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this job classification. jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer III

We provide flight software and systems engineering for the design and implementation of spacecraft for the laboratory's key flight projects. We provide leadership and specialized expertise in developing flight software and systems engineering for spacecraft, small satellites, and instrument payloads. As a **Flight Software Engineer III**, you will be working for JPL’s **Flight Software and Systems Engineering Section**, which provides leadership and specialized expertise in developing flight software and systems engineering for spacecraft, small satellites, and instrument payloads. maintaining real\-time embedded software systems for mission\-critical, aerospace applications. + Developing application programs for the various functional domains (e.g., CDH, GNC, System Fault Protection, etc.) for execution in an embedded flight processor. + Experience with distributed computing and inter\-process communication (IPC) mechanisms. + Familiarity with communication buses and protocols: PCI/PCIe, UART, SPI, I2C, CAN bus, and SpaceWire. + Demonstrate ability to show knowledge of UDP / TCP network protocols + Familiarity or experience with real\-time or embedded operating systems such as FreeRTOS, RTEMS, Zephyr, or WindRiver VxWorks + Experience with static code analysis toolsets * Demonstrated ability in the development and delivery of reliable, embedded real\-time software applications that employs formal and structured lifecycle development process. * Familiarity with software development and testing with experience in the following languages and operating systems: C\+\+, C, Python, Linux. * Ability to work with in\-development hardware undergoing changing interface specifications. * Strong verbal and written communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with ability to work in a team environment. **Preferred Skills:** * Knowledge of Laboratory policies and procedures, NASA policies and procedures, and government regulations across a range of applications. * Experience with device driver development and software/hardware interfaces for both custom and commercial hardware, with experience debugging software/hardware interactions and possible failure modes. * Experience developing, deploying and maintaining software product lines. * Knowledge with software development processes, standards, and practices. * System engineering experience in generating, tracking and proving successful implementation of requirements. * Understand of NASA F Prime or cFS open\-source frameworks * Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) \& Testbeds: Hands\-on lab debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers. jobs.title: Senior Perception AI Engineer - Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.description: Self\-driving cars need to understand the road ahead in real time, even without a prior map. Our team builds the online mapping system that turns raw data from multiple sensors into an accurate, continuously updated 3D model of the driving environment. This model captures lanes, road boundaries, crosswalks, intersection layouts, and traffic control information to support decisions across the autonomous driving system. You’ll write the models, write the C\+\+, and ship both into vehicles on the road, running on NVIDIA DRIVE Orin and Thor. The tasks you perform will be tested at scale, on real cars, with real safety requirements. NVIDIA’s autonomous driving stack spans the full range of automation, and online mapping is a core component across it, so your work will reach L2\+\+, L3, and L4 systems. The role spans two subject areas, and we want someone who enjoys both: * Learned mapping involves training DNNs to predict map elements directly from visual sensors, laser scanning, and radar. This includes owning the GT story and collaborating with partners to provide the vital data. Geometry and C\+\+ engineering: building the post\-processing that turns network outputs into stable, consistent, production\-ready map elements. * **What you’ll be doing:** * Design, train, and improve PyTorch models that predict online map elements (lanes, road boundaries, crosswalks, road markings, topology) from camera, LiDAR, and/or radar, using BEV and vectorized\-map representations. * Solve the hardest scenes: model intersection topology (connectivity between incoming and outgoing lanes, turn paths, merges and splits) and traffic light understanding (detection, state, and association of each light to the lanes it controls). * Write production C\+\+ for geometry\-based post\-processing: curve and surface fitting, association, multi\-frame fusion and tracking, topology reasoning, and consistency checks on DNN outputs. * Apply multi\-view geometry, calibration, coordinate transforms, and sensor fusion to produce 3D maps that stay accurate and stable over time. * Optimize and deploy models alongside algorithms on NVIDIA DRIVE Orin and Thor under real\-time and safety constraints, and get them running in vehicles. * Lead the narrative around GT and the data loop by planning datasets and defining GT and labeling requirements. Work with labeling, data, and tooling partners to produce high\-quality GT. Mine data, choose metrics, and analyze failure cases to drive improvements. * Define critical metrics and build evaluation tooling to measure quality gains against large\-scale real\-world data. * Partner with perception, localization, planning, and infrastructure teams to integrate online mapping into the full AV stack, across L2\+\+, L3, and L4 programs. Contribute to technical direction and architecture decisions across the learned and geometric components of the mapping system. * **What we need to see:** * MS or PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent experience * 5\+ years of industry or research experience in autonomous driving, robotics, or computer vision. * Strong foundation in 3D geometry: camera models, projective geometry, coordinate transforms, optimization, and curve/surface fitting. * Strong C\+\+ skills, with a track record of designing and shipping production\-quality algorithm code that is fast, reliable, and maintainable. * Hands\-on experience training deep neural networks in PyTorch, including model design, training pipelines, debugging, and performance analysis. * Experience with data\-driven development: building datasets, defining labels and GT, choosing metrics, and improving models by analyzing failures. Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills, and the ability to drive technical direction across teams. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Direct experience with DNN\-based online or HD map generation, or BEV perception (e.g., vectorized map prediction, lane topology learning), or equivalent experience to BEV perception. * Experience with intersection understanding, such as lane connectivity and topology reasoning in sophisticated junctions, or traffic light detection and lane association. * Experience combining learned models with geometric post\-processing in a production AV system and publications or open\-source contributions in 3D vision, mapping, or autonomous driving. * Background in sensor fusion, multi\-object tracking, or temporal fusion for map elements. Experience deploying DNNs and algorithms on embedded GPUs (CUDA, TensorRT), ideally on DRIVE Orin or Thor, under real\-time constraints. * \#AutonomousVehicles Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job\-related factors. jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist - Ads Marketplace
jobs.description: #### **\#TeamNextdoor** Nextdoor (NYSE: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at **nextdoor.com**. #### **Meet Your Future Neighbors** As a Data Scientist at Nextdoor, you will help design and oversee product experiments and own complex analyses to drive company and product strategy. We use a semi\-embedded team structure, in which a group of data team members works on a specific product or pillar, interfacing directly with product and engineering stakeholders. The Data Science group consists of people from a diverse set of backgrounds and perspectives, trained in fields as wide\-ranging as economics, physics, statistics, and operations research. We are an integral part of the product development organization and play an active and collaborative role in building and improving the product. At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI\-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we're looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI\-assisted outputs. We also offer a warm, inclusive work environment that embraces a hybrid employment model and provides flexibility for our valued employees. The hiring team will go over these expectations with you if you are being considered for a role near one of our offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, New York, and London. #### **The Impact You'll Make** We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist to lead data science for Ads Marketplace/Delivery. Delivery sits at the heart of the marketplace. It decides which ads are shown, to whom, at what price, and how pacing, budgets, and auction mechanics balance advertiser value, user experience, and platform revenue. As the go\-to expert on how our marketplace behaves and how to improve it, this person shapes the roadmap with Engineering, Product, and ML leadership and sets the bar for how delivery changes are designed, measured, and shipped. **Your responsibilities include:** * Serve as the technical lead for ads delivery data science, driving the roadmap across ads delivery areas (auction score development, budget pacing, bidding and optimization, etc.) * Set the standard for experimentation in a two\-sided marketplace, tackling interference, spillovers, and long\-term effects, and advancing methods and causal approaches where standard A/B tests fall short. * Partner with ML engineers on ranking, bid optimization, and pacing models by shaping objectives, offline evaluation, and the link between offline metrics and online outcomes. * Lead deep\-dive analyses that surface opportunities and diagnose delivery issues, such as supply and demand imbalances, auction dynamics, reserve and floor pricing, and advertiser spend patterns. * Influence product strategy by translating complex findings into clear recommendations for senior leaders and cross\-functional partners. * Mentor data scientists and raise the bar for analytical rigor across the ads org. #### **What You'll Bring To The Team** * Ph.D. or M.S. in Economics, Operations Research, Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative fields. * 10\+ years of relevant Data Science experience in Ads Marketplace or Monetization experience * Expert knowledge of SQL and Python programming, including common scientific computing packages and data science tools such as numpy, pandas, and scikit\-learn * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize, simplify, and explain complex jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: We're looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to serve as a principal reliability partner and technical authority across our infrastructure and platform teams, setting reliability standards and technical direction for the broader SRE practice. You'll operate across our hybrid infrastructure, on\-prem and cloud, and across both the application and infrastructure layers that keep our real\-time advertising platform running at scale, proactively surfacing systemic risks and driving meaningful architectural improvements while respecting each team's ownership of their own platforms. You come from a development background and bring deep experience running reliable, high\-throughput production systems at scale. Failure domains aren't just something you read about, they're something you think about constantly, and you know how to prevent them before they happen. You influence teams through technical credibility and clear communication, not authority, and the engineers you've mentored have gone on to become strong reliability practitioners. You treat every postmortem as a learning opportunity and every alert as a question waiting to be answered permanently. This role will be based in the **New York City** office. Our team follows a hybrid schedule working in\-office three days a week and remotely for the rest. **Each day can be different here at Nexxen, but some of the things you can expect to be doing daily are:** **What You'll Do** * Influence application and infrastructure teams across the engineering org on the reliability changes that matter most, translating postmortem findings, SLO burn rates, and architectural risk signals into concrete, prioritized engineering work that teams own and execute. * Mentor and develop SREs at every level, including senior engineers, providing structured code reviews, pairing on complex reliability investigations, and building the practice standards and career ladder that raise the reliability bar across the org. * Help drive Nexxen's AI strategy within the SRE space, exploring and championing AI\-powered tooling to strengthen proactive reliability practices and operational efficiency. * Drive latency and throughput improvements at both the code and infrastructure level, profiling hot paths, identifying inefficient patterns, and producing specific, actionable recommendations grounded in data. * Lead architectural reliability reviews and map failure domains across the platform, championing patterns such as circuit breakers, timeouts at every network boundary, queue\-based load levelling, and graceful degradation, so failure is contained, not cascading. * Design and validate reliability across our hybrid infrastructure, on\-prem data centers and AWS, spanning compute, storage, networking, and serverless technologies, balancing redundancy and headroom against infrastructure cost. * Drive reliability for our core data infrastructure, including high\-throughput streaming and messaging systems, distributed data stores, big\-data platforms, and enterprise storage systems, so these hold up under real\-time, high\-volume load. * Partner with teams on infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform) and platform maturity, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and GitOps workflows, and automate repetitive operational work across deployment pipelines, canary releases, and rollback procedures. * Define and maintain SLIs and SLOs, and strengthen observability across the stack using tools like Datadog, including alerting, dashboards, structured logging, and distributed tracing, so engineers have the signal they need to understand production state before, during, and after incidents. * Lead the incident postmortem process to drive systemic fixes, and champion proactive failure testing, fault and latency injection, chaos experiments, and game days that expose weaknesses before production does. **What You'll Bring** * 8\+ years of software development and site reliability or production engineering experience, including a track record of leading reliability initiatives across multiple teams and measurably improving reliability, availability, and performance of complex distributed systems at scale. * Proven ability to influence without authority, a history of convincing application and infrastructure teams to make difficult reliability\-driven changes through technical credibility, clear data, and collaborative problem\-solving rather than mandates. * Mentorship track record: you've actively coached SREs at every level, including seniors, run structured learning initiatives, and can point to engineers whose reliability skills grew materially under your guidance. * Strong understanding of observability practices, structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting, with hands\-on experience with Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent. * Code\-level performance expertise: you can identify the hot path and prescribe targeted fixes, whether that's asynchronous I/O, smarter caching, reduced all now when the fix belongs in the code versus the infrastructure. * Experience with AI\-assisted observability and agentic workflows (e.g., LLM\-based coding and ops copilots, AI\-driven runbooks) to accelerate triage and root\-cause analysis. * Deep hybrid cloud expertise, on\-prem infrastructure and AWS, including multi\-AZ and multi\-region resilience, auto scaling behavior under burst, and failover handling. * Hands\-on experience with distributed, high\-throughput data infrastructure, such as streaming and messaging systems, distributed NoSQL or in\-memory data stores, big\-data or analytics platforms, and enterprise\-grade storage systems. * A near\-obsessive interest in failure domains, you study how systems fail and maintain mental (or written) models of blast radius and cascade paths. * Proficiency with Linux internals, network diagnostics (tcpdump, netstat, curl, traceroute), and system\-level debugging under production conditions. * Solid SLO/SLI/error\-budget practice: you've defined them, defended them in engineering conversations, and used budget burn rates to drive prioritization decisions. * Proficiency with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform or similar) and container orchestration (Kubernetes), and a clear\-eyed understanding of how infrastructure changes introduce reliability risk. * Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, load balancing, CDN behavior, and how these layers contribute to reliability problems in distributed systems. * Experience with chaos engineering and failure injection: you've designed and run game days, not just read about them. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. In support of pay transparency and equity, the minimum and maximum full\-time annual base salary for this role is $175,000 \- $225,000 the time of posting, with the potential of an incentive or bonus. While this is our reasonable expectation this is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, actual compensation is influenced by a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, education, certifications, responsibility, and geographic location. Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location. We offer a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, 401(k), EAP, parental leave, unlimited vacation, and company\-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available will vary depending on the state, start date, and employment type. Our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any questions you may have. \#LI\-DN1 \#LI\-Hybrid At Nexxen, we value our differences, varied experiences, and collective contribution. We know that not everyone takes the same career path, so if you don’t match this job description perfectly, don’t worry! We would rather see your application than risk missing out on your potential to make an impact. *For information about how we handle your personal information please view our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice* **Important Notice from Nexxen: Your Safety Matters** At Nexxen, we care about the well\-being of our current and future employees. We are aware of the growing number of online scams and fraudulent job postings, and we urge all job seekers to remain vigilant. Please be advised that Nexxen will never request payment (whether in cash, cryptocurrency, or any other form) as a condition of employment, offer positions that require you to invest in vague or dubious financial schemes, or promote roles that resemble get\-rich\-quick opportunities. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Nexxen or encounter a questionable job posting associated with our name, please contact us at infosec@nexxen.com to verify its legitimacy. Your trust is important to us. Stay safe and informed. Nexxen Fraud Alert and Notice: Protect Yourself from Impersonation and Fraudulent Activity

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Why NinjaTech AI** We are building the unmetered intelligence workforce: autonomous AI agents that do real, end\-to\-end work for enterprises instead of just answering questions. Since founding in 2022 we have gone from research to agents running production workloads inside real companies, on secure, isolated infrastructure, backed by SRI International, DCVC, and Candou Ventures. This is a small, senior team moving at startup speed on one of the most consequential problems in technology, and the Applied AI Engineer sits at the sharpest edge of it: your work lands in front of real customers in weeks, not quarters, and directly shapes how the world's most demanding enterprises adopt agentic AI. If you want the shortest possible line between what you build and the outcomes it creates, this is a rare seat. **Why this role exists** When we close a large enterprise deal, the contract is the start of the hard part, not the end. The customer has bought an outcome, an "unmetered intelligence workforce" doing real work inside their business, and someone has to make that outcome real, fast, inside their systems, their security constraints, and their messy data. That someone is the Applied AI Engineer. We attach an Applied AI Engineer to every large enterprise account. They embed with the customer, build the first high\-value agentic workflows on our platform, and own technical success from kickoff through go\-live and expansion. The Applied AI Engineer is how a signed contract becomes a renewed and expanded one. **What you'll own** * **Land the deployment.** Embed with a newly\-closed enterprise customer, rapidly learn their operations and data, and stand up the first production agent workflows on NinjaTech in weeks, not quarters. * **Build custom, tailored solutions.** Wire our platform into the customer's real systems (their data sources, identity, ticketing, CRMs, internal APIs) and build the bespoke automations, prompts, tools, and guardrails that make agents useful for their jobs\-to\-be\-done. * **Be the technical face of NinjaTech in the room.** Run working sessions with everyone from the customer's frontline operators to their CISO and CTO. Translate their vision into an architecture, and translate our platform into their language. * **Drive adoption and expansion.** A deployment that isn't used doesn't renew. Instrument usage, hunt for the next high\-value workflow, and turn a beachhead into an org\-wide rollout. Your success metric is customer outcomes that drive net revenue retention. * **Clear enterprise gauntlets.** Own the technical side of security review, isolated\-VM/data\-residency requirements, SSO/SCIM, SOC 2 / DPA questionnaires,and procurement's technical due diligence. * **Close the loop to Product.** You see what breaks in the field first. Feed sharp, prioritized signal back to core engineering; occasionally upstream a fix or a reusable component so the next deployment is faster. **What we require** * **Engineering background.** You're a genuine builder. Proficient in Python and at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or Go; comfortable across data plumbing, APIs, and a bit of front\-end when a demo needs it. * **Genuine curiosity about agentic AI and LLM systems:** prompt/tool design, evals, orchestration, guardrails, and the failure modes of agents in production. You don't need to have built them at scale, but you should be hungry to. * **Data fluency.** You can wrangle messy, large\-scale, real\-world data and reason about storage, pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. * **Executive presence and operator empathy.** You can hold a credible technical conversation with a CTO and sit with a frontline user to understand their actual workflow. You listen before you build. * **Bias to ship.** You move with speed and precision, iterate with users, and are energized (not frustrated) by evolving objectives. * **Willingness to travel** up to \~25% to customer sites, and to be onsite in the Bay Area with the core team. **What we value (nice\-to\-haves)** * Experience integrating into regulated or security\-sensitive enterprise environments (isolated VMs, on\-prem/VPC, SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP\-adjacent). * Prior forward\-deployed / solutions\-engineering / delivery experience at an enterprise\-software or infra company. * A track record of turning a first deployment into a much larger footprint. **Compensation \& logistics** * Base range $80K to $120K depending on level and experience, plus meaningful equity and a delivery/expansion\-linked bonus. * Onsite in the Bay Area with the core team; \~25% travel to customer sites. * Full benefits (medical / dental / vision, etc.). **Equal opportunity** NinjaTech AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

jobs.description: **Description** Find YOUR fit at Ohio Machinery Co.! We do not provide employment sponsorship for this role.** **Summary:** The Data Engineer's role is to plan, design, develop, test, implement, and maintain efficient information systems with a primary focus on building scalable data pipelines, Lakehouse environments, semantic models, and governed datasets to support business intelligence and advanced analytics. This individual will apply proven communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills to help identify, plan, and implement integrations between disparate systems to maximize the benefit of business system investments. Frequent interaction is required with internal analysts, project leaders, as well as other internal and external stakeholders such as third\-party software vendors. **Essential Functions and Responsibilities:** * Microsoft Fabric / Azure + Build and maintain Fabric Lakehouses, Data Warehouses, and OneLake storage layers. + Develop Fabric Data Pipelines (Data Factory) for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and automation. + Create and optimize Spark notebooks for ETL/ELT workloads. + Implement medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) within Fabric. + Manage and monitor workloads using Fabric capacities, workspaces, and governance features. * Data Modeling \& BI + Build and maintain semantic models for reporting teams. + Work closely with reporting developers (Power BI) to ensure performant data models. + Optimize large\-scale datasets for consumption and self\-service analytics. * Data Engineering Core Skills + Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines. + Work with structured/unstructured data, Delta Lake, parquet, and data lake formats. + Implement best practices for data quality, lineage, monitoring, and observability. + Improve data performance through indexing, partitioning, caching, and optimization. * Collaboration + Work with business stakeholders to gather requirements. + Contribute to data governance and metadata management practices. + Ensure the integrity and security of enterprise data on host computers and databases, and during data transfers, in accordance with business needs and industry best practices regarding privacy, security, and compliance. + Conduct research on emerging products, services, protocols, and standards in support of systems software procurement and development efforts. + Develop, document, and maintain policies, procedures, and associated training plans for system administration and appropriate use. + Provide guidance and serve as an escalation to Help Desk. + Recommend, schedule, and perform software and related system improvement, upgrades, patches, reconfigurations, and/or purchases. **Minimum Skills and Qualifications:*** College degree or equivalent experience in jobs.description: **Date:** Nov 9, 2026 **Location:** Renton, WA, US, 98057 **Company:** PACCAR **Company Information** PACCAR is a Fortune 500 company established in 1905\. PACCAR Inc is recognized as a global leader in the commercial vehicle, financial, and customer service fields with internationally recognized brands such as Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF trucks. PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture and customer support of premium light\-, medium\- and heavy\-duty trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF nameplates and also provides customized financial services, information technology and truck parts related to its principal business. Whether you want to design the transportation technology of tomorrow, support the staff functions of a dynamic, international leader, or build our excellent products and services, you can develop the career you desire with PACCAR. Get started! **Position Summary** The Technical Fellow, Enterprise Data Architecture is PACCAR's highest level individual contributor within the data and analytics discipline. This role serves as the company's foremost technical authority on enterprise data strategy, architecture, governance, integration, and emerging data technologies. The Technical Fellow establishes long\-term architectural direction, influences enterprise technology investments, and leads the design of scalable data platforms that enable business transformation across PACCAR divisions and global operations. Operating with significant autonomy, the Technical Fellow provides technical leadership across multiple business units and disciplines, drives innovation through advanced analytics and AI readiness initiatives, and influences executive decision\-making through deep expertise and strategic vision. The role acts as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and is responsible for developing enterprise\-wide standards, frameworks, and architectural roadmaps that have long\-term business impact. **Essential Functions** Enterprise Data Strategy \& Architecture * Define and maintain PACCAR's enterprise data architecture vision, strategy, standards, and technology roadmap. * Establish architectural principles, governance frameworks, and technical standards for enterprise data management, analytics, AI, machine learning, and cloud platforms. * Lead the design of complex, scalable data ecosystems encompassing data warehousing, lakehouse architectures, real\-time integration, master data management, and business intelligence solutions. * Evaluate emerging technologies and provide strategic recommendations regarding future enterprise investments. Technical Leadership * Serve as the organization's foremost technical expert in data architecture and advanced analytics. * Provide technical direction and architectural oversight for enterprise\-wide initiatives spanning multiple business units and technology domains. * Lead resolution of the company's most complex architectural and data\-related challenges. * Guide senior technical professionals, architects, engineers, and technology leaders through mentoring, consultation, and technical reviews. * Establish best practices and influence technical decision\-making across global teams. Innovation \& Transformation * Drive enterprise modernization initiatives involving cloud platforms, data governance, artificial intelligence, predictive analytics, automation, and digital transformation. * Identify opportunities to leverage data as a strategic business asset and translate business needs into long\-term architectural solutions. * Champion AI readiness and advanced analytics capabilities while ensuring scalability, security, compliance, and data quality. * Lead proof\-of\-concept initiatives and emerging technology evaluations with enterprise\-wide implications. Governance \& Business Partnership * Partner with executive leadership to align technology strategy with business objectives. * Establish and maintain enterprise governance models for data quality, security, privacy, metadata management, and regulatory compliance. * Influence organizational priorities through thought leadership, technical expertise, and strategic consultation. * Represent PACCAR as a recognized subject matter expert with external partners, vendors, industry groups, and professional organizations Leadership Expectations This position functions as a senior technical leader and may not have direct supervisory responsibilities. Influence is achieved through technical expertise, strategic consultation, and organizational leadership rather than formal people management. The Technical Fellow is expected to: * Define enterprise technical direction. * Influence executive and senior leadership decision\-making. * Mentor senior architects and technical professionals. * Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning multiple business units. * Establish policies, standards, and practices affecting the enterprise. Scope \& Impact * Enterprise\-wide influence across multiple PACCAR divisions and functions. * Decisions have long\-term impact on technology strategy, investment priorities, risk management, innovation, and business capability development. * Frequently advises vice presidents, executive leadership, and senior technology leaders. * Recognized as the highest\-level subject matter expert within the discipline. * Creates new approaches, frameworks, and architectural standards that shape organizational direction. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or related field required. * 12\+ years of progressive experience in data architecture, enterprise systems, analytics, or related technology disciplines. * 5\+ years as principal architect, senior technical lead, or equivalent senior level with proven examples of success leading enterprise\-scale architecture programs and transformational initiatives * Recognized expertise in enterprise data platforms, cloud architecture, data governance, analytics, AI/ML, and systems integration. * Experience influencing executive stakeholders and driving organization\-wide technical strategy. * Executive communication and presentation skills with a proven ability to influence without formal authority through technical credibility and thought leadership. * Demonstrated ability to create new frameworks, methodologies, standards, and enterprise best practices. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree preferred. **Benefits** As a U.S. PACCAR employee, you receive a comprehensive benefits package including: * Fully funded pension plan plus 401(k) with up to 5% company match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) to invest in PACCAR stock * Minimum 10 paid vacation days, 12 paid holidays, and sick time * Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family * Flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings accounts (HSA) * Paid short\- and long\-term disability, life insurance, and accidental death and dismemberment coverage * Tuition reimbursement for continued learning * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) including wellness plans, estate planning, and financial counseling PACCAR is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veteran/Disability. At PACCAR, we value talent and promote growth and development. We carefully consider numerous compensation factors, including your education, training, or experience. Applicants and employees for this position will not be sponsored for work authorization, including, but not limited to H\-1B visas, now or in the future. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: **Pantograph** is building general purpose robots by training models on internet\-scale video. We believe the path to capable robots runs through general intelligence rather than narrow, robot\-specific skills. We believe there is an enormous amount of work worth doing in the physical world that would make life better for people. As AI models make it easier to build software around our needs, we believe robots can give people that same power to shape the physical world. Across research, hardware, and software, we believe in finding simple ideas that work, doing them extremely well, and scaling them up. We value clear thinking, careful execution, and systems we can understand, trust, and improve. We're looking for an experienced software engineer to design and build the internal infrastructure that powers our customer\-facing product. You'll work closely with our product, interface, and robot software teams to build shared APIs, services, and infrastructure for accounts, access, messaging, payments, and data hosting. This is an internal platform engineering role, rather than a forward\-deployed role building integrations or managing individual customer deployments. You'll own these systems: developing shared services, keeping databases and infrastructure reliable, and improving how we build, test, and deploy software. Your work will give our team a strong foundation for building and shipping the robot product as our customer base grows. A robotics background is not a requirement. The ideal fit is someone with strong backend and infrastructure experience, good product judgment, and the ability to provide technical guidance while staying hands\-on. **You might be a good fit if you:** * Have substantial experience building and operating production software * Design clear APIs and have good judgment about service architecture, databases, and infrastructure * Enjoy working with product and engineering teammates to turn open\-ended requirements into reliable systems * Are comfortable owning deployment, monitoring, debugging, and reliability * Are pragmatic and reach for the simplest thing that solves the problem * Enjoy finding the right abstraction for a given problem and building interfaces that make it easy for other systems to interact with your system * Communicate well and enjoy being someone teammates turn to for technical guidance * Use AI tools extremely effectively **Bonus if you've worked with:** * Accounts, authentication, permissions, or billing systems * CI/CD and tooling that helps engineering teams ship reliably * Data storage, hosting, and transfer * Application and infrastructure security * Connected devices or software that interacts with hardware We care much more about what you've built than credentials. We're a small, fast\-moving team working together in person in San Francisco. If this sounds exciting to you, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description: At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth. We’re looking for a Software Architect who wants to do more than design systems on a whiteboard. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys setting technical direction and writing the code that brings that direction to life. You’ll own the architecture of enterprise applications, including how services are designed, how data flows, how systems integrate, and how applications scale securely and reliably. You’ll also help shape how AI becomes part of our products, building solutions that combine traditional software architecture with LLM\-powered capabilities and intelligent agents. This role is ideal for an experienced architect, technical lead, or senior engineer who still loves to build and wants meaningful influence over both architecture and execution. ### **What You'll Do** ### **Design and Build** * Own application architecture across services, APIs, identity, data access, and integrations. * Write production code regularly across back\-end services, APIs, and front\-end applications. * Build new services and features from initial design through deployment and production support. * Design scalable, reliable, secure, and multi\-tenant applications. * Create prototypes and proofs of concept, then turn the strongest ideas into production\-ready solutions. * Help modernize legacy applications toward cloud\-native architectures while maintaining ongoing product delivery. ### **Build AI into the Product** * Develop AI\-powered capabilities using LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, and agents. * Design APIs and application capabilities that can be securely used by AI agents, including through protocols such as MCP. * Implement evaluation, guardrails, and cost monitoring to ensure AI features are reliable, safe, and sustainable in production. * Help determine where AI adds meaningful value and where traditional software solutions are the better approach. ### **Raise the Engineering Bar** * Review code, pair with engineers, and help solve complex technical problems. * Establish strong engineering practices around automated testing, observability, security, performance, and resilience. * Use modern AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and quality. * Create architecture decision records and reference implementations that engineering teams can put into practice. * Partner closely with Product, UX, QA, Security, and DevOps to turn business goals into scalable technical solutions. ### **What We're Looking For** * 8\+ years of software development experience, including 2\+ years in an architect, technical lead, or senior engineering role with ownership of system design. * Strong hands\-on development skills and recent experience contributing production code. * Experience designing and operating multi\-tenant SaaS or enterprise applications. * Experience building AI\-powered features using LLMs, ideally including RAG, agents, tool/function calling, or structured outputs. * Deep expertise in at least one modern development language such as C\#/.NET, Java, TypeScript, or Python, with working knowledge of another. * Experience with modern front\-end frameworks such as React or Angular.Strong knowledge of microservices, event\-driven architecture, domain\-driven design, and API design. * Experience with Azure or AWS, containers, Kubernetes, and/or serverless architectures. * Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data design, messaging platforms such as Kafka or Service Bus, and caching strategies. * Understanding of modern identity and application security, including OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, RBAC, OWASP practices, and secure handling of data used with AI models. * Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, automated testing, and performance optimization. ### **How You Work** You’re an architect who likes to stay close to the technology. You can move from an architecture discussion to a pull request, explain complex technical trade\-offs to both engineers and business partners, and help teams turn good ideas into working software. You’re also comfortable using AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools as part of your everyday engineering workflow, while knowing when AI is useful and when a simpler deterministic solution is the better choice. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with multi\-agent orchestration or AI evaluation pipelines. * Experience with fine\-tuning or open\-weight/smaller language models. * Experience modernizing legacy or acquired products into a more unified platform. * Experience working in PCI DSS, SOC 2, or GDPR environments. * Background in retail, payments, loyalty, or supply chain software. * Relevant certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, Azure AI Engineer, or AWS Solutions Architect. PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Join a team of proud, passionate, and caring people that together share their diverse talents and backgrounds to serve our members and grow the game of golf. Being at the PGA of America means you are supported, respected, and appreciated for your contributions.** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The Software Engineer V is a highly experienced technical leader responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and continuously improving software systems that create meaningful business outcomes for the PGA of America and its members. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong product judgment, ownership, and collaboration. The Software Engineer V partners closely with Product Managers, designers, business stakeholders, and other engineers to translate complex business challenges into simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions. **RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):** Partner directly with Product Managers and stakeholders to understand business needs, shape product requirements, and define effective technical approaches. Translate ambiguous or complex business problems into elegant, scalable, and maintainable software solutions. Lead the architecture and design of major software components, systems, and features. Facilitate and contribute to collaborative Architecture Decision Record reviews to establish clear, durable technical direction. Apply sound engineering practices, including test\-driven development, behavior\-driven development, code reviews, automated testing, observability, and continuous delivery. Build, deploy, monitor, maintain, and improve reliable web applications and services throughout the software development life cycle. Use modern AI\-assisted development tools and workflows to improve productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and delivery. Tools may include Cursor or comparable platforms. Identify and implement improvements to engineering tools, processes, systems, and workflows that increase delivery velocity and product quality. Proactively reduce technical debt and improve the maintainability, performance, security, and scalability of existing systems. Communicate work, decisions, risks, prototypes, and learnings transparently through tools such as GitHub, Slack, and team demonstrations. Manage project priorities, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables with a high degree of ownership and accountability. Seek and incorporate customer, member, business, and market insights to inform high\-value digital products and experiences. Mentor and develop engineers through technical guidance, knowledge sharing, design reviews, pairing, and constructive feedback. Contribute to a culture of innovation, inclusion, continuous improvement, and high performance. Help attract, develop, and retain a world\-class engineering team. **INCLUSION:** Employees are expected to contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and respecting others’ beliefs, backgrounds, identities, abilities, and individuality to help ensure a supportive and engaging experience for Association Members, partners, customers, and guests. PGA of America respects the uniqueness of each employee and offers everyone the means to find their place and thrive. **SHARED VALUES:** Embody the organization's shared values and help ensure the organization's values\-based culture thrives by proactively identifying and addressing any shared values, challenges and opportunities you are experiencing. **SUPERVISION:** No supervisory responsibilities. **FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY:** No financial responsibility. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** Bachelor’s Degree (B.A.) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. Ten or more years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and delivering production systems. Demonstrated experience leading the architecture, implementation, and delivery of complex software applications or services. Demonstrated experience with modern software development practices, including automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, observability, version control, and secure software development. Experience working in cross\-functional product teams and influencing technical direction without relying solely on formal authority. Strong experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, preferably in AWS environments using CloudFormation, CDK, or comparable technologies. **SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES:** **Job** **Knowledge/Technology:** Must have knowledge of and deep experience developing web applications and services using technologies such as Ruby on Rails, REST and/or GraphQL APIs, Next.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL; expert\-level understanding of web application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and relational databases; strong knowledge of system design, scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability; the ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and select appropriate solutions based on business needs, user impact, cost, risk, and long\-term sustainability; and proficiency with modern development, collaboration, and productivity tools, including GitHub, Slack, and related platforms. Working knowledge of Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Google Docs. Basic fluency in artificial intelligence (AI) tools and concepts. This includes using AI to enhance business operations and drive innovation, enabling us to better serve our Members and stakeholders. ***Ability to travel up to 5%.*** *This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position. PGA does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, veteran status, gender identity or expression, marital or familial status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.
