We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Data Engineer within PNC's Data and Automation organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA, Strongsville, OH, Dallas, TX, Denver, CO, Phoenix, AZ or Birmingham, AL. We are seeking a Data Engineer to help support large\-scale enterprise big data platforms. This team is responsible for building and evolving modern data solutions that enable analytics across the organization while partnering closely with business stakeholders. Ideal candidates thrive in problem\-solving environments, help shape analytical solutions, and contribute to the design of a next\-generation, cloud\-native data platform. Key Responsibilities: * Monitor, maintain, and improve the health and performance of the data platform * Ensure stability, reliability, and scalability of data systems * Implement best practices for platform operations and data engineering standards. Ensure understanding and adherence across technical and business customers * Perform frequent reviews of the data platform architecture and identify areas for automation, optimization, right\-sizing, and cost reduction to support health of the environment * Contribute to large\-scale transformation initiatives, including: * Driving user migration to a unified data platform * Modernizing legacy Hadoop\-based systems to cloud\-native architectures * Design and build scalable, modern data observability analytics to support site reliability * Develop ETL/ELT pipeline monitoring solutions to identify bottlenecks, failures or abnormal data processing metrics * Establish intelligent alerts to identify high utilization Spark and Trino jobs to ensure service ability for all users * Capture and report on compute usage across containers in Kubernetes, Docker, etc. to give visibility to job/query optimization needs * Develop dashboards and visualizations that provide real\-time visibility into enterprise data platform health, performance and availability * Partner with business stakeholders to translate analytical needs into technical solutions * Apply modern principles, methodologies and tools to advance business initiatives into actions through data and BI tools * Act as an internal consultant to internal customers on big data tools and capabilities * Enhance and optimize query performance and data structures to support analytical * Guide stakeholders in understanding how to leverage data for business insights * Design, implement and standardize the use of AI and Generative AI tools for automation of tasks, accelerate development and streamline platform efficiency and governance * Code generation for query and cost optimization to maximize platform resources * Use vector databases, embedding pipelines, feature stores Retrieval\-Augmented Generation workflows to engineer solutions * Maintain integrity of engineering code and data through automated code generation, profiling and data cleansing tools. * Define and implement internal process improvements through the development of detailed analytics that provide actionable insights into key business performance metrics Key Skills and Experience: * Strong proficiency in relevant programming languages such as Python, Spark, Scala * Strong background and practical experience in SQL development and enterprise database systems (Oracle, Teradata, etc.) * Experience with modern, cloud\-native and open\-source tools is highly valued: * Apache Iceberg * Apache Airflow * Trino * Strong experience in modern data engineering and big data ecosystems / frameworks * Hands\-on experience working in scalable data platforms and analytical solutions using data Lakehouse architecture * Knowledge and experience with machine learning concepts for automation development * Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. Azure , AWS ) and their data related services * Experience with dedicated data observability tools(Monte Carlo, Acceldata) or broad monitoring stacks (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus) a plus * Proven ability to go beyond data movement and contribute to solution design * Strong communication and presence — able to translate between technical and non\-technical audiences * Proven ability to bridge the gap between business and engineering teams * Collaborative mindset with experience working across cross\-functional teams * Strong problem\-solving and critical thinking skills PNC is an in\-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals. PNC  **Work Experience** ------------------- Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 3\+ years of relevant / direct industry experience. Certifications are often desired. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.**Education** ------------- Bachelors**Certifications** ------------------ No Required Certification(s)**Licenses** ------------ No Required License(s)**Language Assessments** ------------------------ No Required or Preferred Language Assessments**Pay Transparency** ==================== Base Salary: $86,250\.00 – $158,125\.00 Salaries may vary based on geographic location, market data and on individual skills, experience, and education. This role is incentive eligible with the payment based upon company, business and/or individual performance.**Application Window** ====================== Generally, this opening is expected to be posted for two business days from 11/09/2026, although it may be longer with business discretion.**Benefits** ============ PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company** PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. **Job Summary:** This job implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), follows internal conventions and procedures, makes technical decisions, collaborates with peers and project leads, and contributes to code and design reviews. **Job Description:** Job Duties: Expand automated functional and integration test coverage across microservice ecosystems; author and maintain test suites, achieving comprehensive validation of new features and minimizing regressions. Optimize CI/CD pipelines to improve build stability and reduce execution time; design, configure, and maintain continuous integration and deployment workflows to ensure reliable, repeatable builds and accelerate release cycles. Migrate legacy monolithic services to the newer microservices; analyze existing Credit \& Offers applications, define decomposition strategy, refactor APIs into new microservices, and coordinate cut\-over with cross\-functional teams. jobs.title: Generalist Software Engineer(s)
jobs.description: **About Pylon** America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand. We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API. Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury. Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it. Join us in building **America’s mortgage rails**. At Pylon, we’re a small team building a very ambitious product in the mortgage space. At this early stage, we’re looking for engineers who can see the opportunity of what we’re building towards and want to have a hand in building it. We're in search of people who find difficult problems invigorating and who fit well into a high\-performing team built on mutual respect and reliance. If you like pushing yourself to learn a massive amount while shipping code that has a huge impact on the end product, Pylon Engineering could be a great place for you. **About you** ------------- You: * **Have strong opinions that you’re willing to defend.** We have a culture of vigorous discussion and debate on technical decisions. We’ll push you to defend your choices, and we want you to push back. * **Don't settle.** Challenge yourself to frequently and consistently deliver exceptional code. If something could be better, take the initiative to improve it. * **Have great ideas, and lots of them.** You should see opportunities all around you to make the code, product and infrastructure better. We’ll give you an environment where you can act on those ideas. * **Are self\-motivated.** You can take a goal and drive towards it without needing extensive hand\-holding. The team is supportive and loves to share knowledge and advice, but there’s no time for micromanaging your work. * **Are comfortable with ambiguity.** There's a million ways to do things; you should feel at ease making a decision under uncertainty while balancing competing constraints. * **Are confident you can learn quickly.** Mortgage is complex, our platform is complex, good software engineering is complex. You’ve got to have an attitude that you can absorb it, get on top of it, and build something better than what came before. * **Love strong typing.** We're a team full of people who love Haskell and Rust (and Idris!) and take pride in pushing Typescript to its limits. **About the Team** ------------------ ### **What we’re not:** * Building a CRUD app: + We’re building a platform that’s only possible due to deep technology investments and thinking hard from first principles. Cargo\-culting what’s come before won’t be sufficient. + If you’re looking to do mostly plumbing / lego piece assembling, Pylon may be very frustrating for you * A ChatGPT wrapper: + Mortgage is a sprawling mess of problems, and there isn't one tool that solves every one of them. We use LLMs, but we've reached for tools in multiple disciplines like mixed\-integer linear optimization and programming language research. * An easy job: + We’re building a lot of things from the ground up for the first time. Working at Pylon is like a research project where you have to ship to intelligent, opinionated customers regularly. + It’s basically guaranteed you’ll be handed a task that is too difficult for you to do. You might fail sometimes. You might have no idea where to start. Our team leans heavily on each other, but there’s no getting around the difficulties. ### **What we are:** * A small team: + We don’t have an army of engineers. If you find something is broken, you are probably the best one to fix it + All the code we write has to punch above its weight in maintainability and toil reduction + If you have a good idea, you have much more ability to put it into action than at a large company + We need generalists: specialization is for big companies that already have everything figured out. If you’re smart, flexible and like getting into everything, we want you. * Working in a regulated space: + Mortgage is regulated both federally and at the state level. + We move fast, but breaking things isn’t an option. **About the Job** ----------------- ### **Basics** * Job title: Software Engineer * Stock options: own a piece of the company and we all win together * Health insurance, 401K, dental, etc. ### **Our technology stack:** We don’t require that you’ve worked with any of these technologies before, this is just our stack for your information: * Typescript front and backend * Web components * GraphQL * PostgreSQL * NestJS web framework * Nx build system * Sagittarius * AWS stack using CDK for declarative infrastructure + We currently use ECS rather than Kubernetes. If you have questions about this choice and want to know more, please apply! * General philosophy: monolith until it hurts. If we can do something without introducing a new service, we will **About Pylon** --------------- The $13 trillion mortgage industry at the core of the American economy runs on broken assembly lines with human\-powered workflows, stitched\-together software, and a series of capital markets intermediates. The costs to originate are at an all time high despite foundational shifts in technology. Pylon is rewiring mortgages from the ground up. We are building the only API\-first, programmatic infrastructure that fully automates credit, compliance, capital, and operations. For the first time, originators can build and scale mortgage businesses entirely through software, not people. Our team comes from Stripe, Better, and Affirm, and we are backed by Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, Peter Thiel, and the founders of Ramp, Mercury, Blend, and others.

jobs.title: Junior Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- San Francisco; Remote \- New York City; Remote \- Toronto; Remote \- Vancouver **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering Small businesses represent 99\.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi\-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow. Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy\-to\-use, AI\-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers. Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long. Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated \#1 in customer satisfaction on G2\. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top\-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big. **About the role** ================== We're looking for a Junior Fullstack Engineer who is building their foundation and wants to grow quickly alongside experienced teammates. You'll work in one of two engineering squads, Gateway or Connect, shipping real features across our React web app and Node backend that small businesses rely on every day. You'll have a dedicated mentor, well\-scoped work, and plenty of room to learn how a world\-class production SaaS platform is built, run, and scaled. **Gateway** owns the front door to Quo: how businesses sign up, choose a plan, pay, verify their business for compliance, and bring their existing phone numbers with them. You'll work on everything from the sign\-up, plan, and checkout experiences customers see to the systems behind them, like billing and subscriptions, pricing and trials, taxes, account and trust verification, and number porting. **Connect** makes Quo part of the rest of a small business's tech stack. You'll help build and maintain integrations with tools like HubSpot and Salesforce, including the in\-app experiences customers use to connect and manage them, and contribute to Quo's public API and webhooks, which let customers send messages, sync contacts, and log calls and messages in the other apps they use every day. **Some of the things you’ll do:** --------------------------------- * Spend most of your time writing, testing, and shipping code in TypeScript, across our React frontend and Node backend. * Build user\-facing features in our web app, working from designs in Figma and our shared component library. * Own well\-scoped tasks end to end: understand the customer problem behind a ticket, build and test the change, and confirm it works once it's live. * Investigate and fix bugs reported by customers and our support team. * Review your teammates' code and learn from their reviews of yours. * Write tests and documentation alongside your code, so the next person can pick up where you left off. * Use AI coding tools to move faster while maintaining personal growth. * Work closely with your mentor and squads, ask questions early, and grow toward owning larger pieces of work. **Technical stack and tools:** ------------------------------ * Our web app is built with React and TypeScript, using GraphQL and Relay for data fetching. * We build UI with Vite, Vanilla Extract, and React Aria, and develop components in Storybook. * We test with Vitest and React Testing Library. * Our backend is built on Node using TypeScript. * Our architecture is event\-driven microservices with RabbitMQ at the center, with a federated GraphQL layer. * We use a variety of databases for different purposes: Postgres, Elasticsearch, and Redis. * Observability and delivery tools. * Other tools: Claude Code and other AI coding tools, Linear, Notion, Slack, and Figma. **About you** ============= * You have at least 2 years of software engineering experience in formal, full\-time work environments * You've built web interfaces with React and TypeScript * You've written backend code, such as APIs or services, using Node and TypeScript * You enjoy working across the stack, from building interfaces people use to the APIs and data behind them. * You have a solid grasp of programming fundamentals, including HTML and CSS, data structures, APIs, databases, and writing tests, and you're eager to deepen them. * You display a strong sense of ownership of your work by monitoring performance, usage, and errors after it ships. * You're curious. You seek to understand the "why" behind things so you can better plan and build the "how." * You use AI tools in your work and think critically about what they produce. * You care about the people who use what you build. You practice empathy and thoughtfulness as you weigh trade\-offs. * You strive for code that's readable, testable, and maintainable, and you leave things better than you found them. **Nice to have:** * Experience with SQL databases such as Postgres. * Exposure to REST or GraphQL APIs, GraphQL clients like Relay or Apollo, or building against third\-party APIs. * Familiarity with web accessibility or component\-driven development. * Familiarity with message queues or event\-driven systems. * Interest in payments, billing, or SaaS integrations. **Compensation** ================ The annual base salary range for this position is as follows, plus equity and benefits: * SF Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Boston, New York, and Washington, DC Metro: $141,000 \- $166,000 USD * All other US Locations: $127,000 \- $150,000 USD * Canada: $130,000 \- $153,000 CAD The ranges displayed reflect the target for new hire salaries, and within each range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process. Salary is just one component of Quo’s total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy. **Who we are** ============== We're a remote\-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you. And remember, there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. integrated into everyday development workflows, supporting code development, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem\-solving. ### **Tasks** * Develop and maintain our iOS application, including implementing new business features and improving existing functionality. * Contribute to the redesign and modernization of the iOS product, including adaptive UI implementation across different screen sizes and device families. * Design and improve application architecture and platform\-level solutions within a multi\-module environment. * Integrate RESTful APIs, handle network requests, and implement WebSocket and other socket\-based connections. * Work with CoreData, multithreading, and asynchronous operations to ensure application performance and stability. * Maintain, refactor, and improve legacy code while ensuring compatibility with existing functionality. * Develop and maintain unit and UI tests to ensure application quality and reliability. * Troubleshoot and debug technical issues, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement appropriate solutions. * Participate in code reviews and collaborate with designers, product managers, QA Engineers, and other developers throughout the development lifecycle. * Actively use AI tools to improve development workflows, code quality, and engineering efficiency. ### **Requirements** * Deep knowledge of Swift and experience writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code. * Strong understanding of the iOS SDK, including UIKit, CoreData, and CoreAnimation. * Experience with Auto Layout and Xcode Interface Builder. * Experience integrating RESTful APIs, working with network requests, handling server responses, and processing JSON data. * Experience working with WebSocket and other socket protocols, including establishing and maintaining persistent connections with a server. * Experience maintaining, refactoring, and improving legacy code without disrupting existing functionality. * Experience writing unit and UI tests. Knowledge of testing tools and frameworks such as XCTest and Quick/Nimble. * Deep understanding of OOP principles and their practical application in iOS development. * Experience applying architectural and design patterns such as MVC, MVVM, VIPER, etc. * Experience working with modular architectures and multi\-module iOS projects. * Strong knowledge of reactive programming and practical experience with RxSwift. * Understanding of multithreading and asynchronous programming in iOS. * Experience working with third\-party libraries and dependencies. * Fluent in Russian and at least B1 level of English. ### **Nice to have** * Experience developing fintech or trading applications, or working on other high\-load products with a large user base. * Basic understanding of C\+\+ and experience integrating Swift with C\+\+ code. ### **We offer** * Full\-time remote work (service provider contract). * Competitive compensation (EUR). * 20 paid days off annually. * Corporate AI subscriptions (Claude, Gemini, GPT, etc.). * Access to a rewards marketplace offering products and language courses, redeemable using the company’s internal currency. * A strong team of engineers. * Positive and friendly atmosphere. * Opportunity to contribute creative ideas and directly influence the product’s architecture and technical direction. performance. + Define meaningful metrics, quality thresholds, test cases, and release criteria based on business requirements. + Perform detailed error analysis to identify where failures originate jobs.description: **Ref\#:** W181512 **Department:** Information Technology **City:** Nutley **State/Province:** New Jersey **Location:** United States **Pay Range:** $69,850 \- $125,525 annually; actual pay is dependent on experience and geographic location **Company Description**Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands. At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education \& Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration. **Position Overview****Who we are:** Ralph Lauren Corporation is a global leader in the design, marketing, and distribution of premium lifestyle products across apparel, home, accessories, and fragrances. Ralph Lauren is recognized globally for timeless style, premium experiences, and a distinctive brand portfolio serving customers across international markets. **Purpose \& Scope:** Ralph Lauren Consumer Technology is seeking a hands\-on Quality Engineer – Automation \& AI to develop reliable UI, API, integration, and end\-to\-end automation. The engineer will modernize reusable frameworks and utilities, contribute automated quality checks to CI/CD pipelines, and use approved AI\-assisted tools to improve testing efficiency and delivery feedback. The engineer will also create practical AI\-assisted accelerators for test design, code development, test data, failure analysis, and documentation, with all generated outputs reviewed for accuracy, maintainability, security, edge cases, and compliance. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities****Automation Development** * Develop and maintain reliable automated tests for web, API, integration, and end\-to\-end business flows. * Build and modernize maintainable automation frameworks using reusable components, libraries, and engineering standards.· * Optimize test execution, logging, reporting, troubleshooting, and maintainability across automation solutions. **AI\-Assisted Quality Engineering** * Build reusable AI\-assisted utilities that solve practical Quality Engineering challenges. * Use approved AI and LLM tools to accelerate test design, automation development, refactoring, and documentation * Apply AI to generate test data, analyze failures and logs, support defect triage, and improve test coverage. * Validate AI\-generated outputs for accuracy, edge cases, maintainability, security, and framework compliance. **CI/CD and Continuous Quality** * Integrate smoke, regression, API, and integration tests into CI/CD workflows using Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or comparable tools. * Implement automated quality gates and clear reporting to standards, solutions, examples, and reusable automation patterns. **Experience, Skills, and Knowledge** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, IT, related field or equivalent experience * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Quality Engineering, SDET, test automation, or software development. * Proficiency in Python, Java, or Typescript with frameworks Bitbucket, GitHub, or similar tools. * Hands\-on exposure to enterprise AI development tools and platforms such as Cursor, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable approved technologies. * Strong debugging, root\-cause analysis, communication, and collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Demonstrated experience in applying LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and agentic workflows to enhance test generation, failure analysis, test optimization, self\-healing automation, and ongoing maintenance. * Experience with prompt engineering, prompt regression testing, AI evaluation, and safety guardrails. * Experience building reusable automation utilities, internal engineering tools, or accelerators, including modernization or migration of automation frameworks. * responsibly, and implement prototypes, reusable accelerators, and production\-ready improvements. * Drive end\-to\-end ownership from requirements through implementation, adoption, and support while balancing speed, maintainability, security, and responsible AI validation. * Share reusable patterns and lessons learned to strengthen engineering capability across the QE team.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend, Comms Platform
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote (US) **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * Target Base Salary $172K – $280K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus The final compensation will depend on the location and level at which the candidate is hired. **About Ramp** ============== Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7\.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. **About the Role** ================== Every approval request, receipt reminder, payment alert, and card notification Ramp sends has to reach the right person, on the right channel, at the right time. When it does, finance teams close faster and employees spend less time chasing tasks. When it doesn't, a missed message can mean a stalled approval, a late payment, or a flood of notifications nobody asked for. Ramp's Communications Platform team builds the shared system that every product team uses to reach customers. It handles transactional messages across email, SMS, push, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp, including templating, delivery, retries, digesting, user preferences, and delivery monitoring. The team also supports the conversational experiences that let customers work with Ramp directly from the channels they already use. We're looking for a backend engineer to own a core part of that platform. You'll take responsibility for an area such as message delivery and channel integrations, communication preferences, or platform reliability and scale, set its technical direction within the team, and keep it correct and dependable as message volume and the number of teams building on it grow. You'll work closely with product, design, and engineering partners across Ramp to make communications faster, more reliable, and easier for every team to build on. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the design and evolution of a core part of Ramp's communications platform, from technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration * Build and extend integrations with messaging channels and delivery providers, including email, SMS, push, and workplace chat tools such as Slack and Microsoft Teams * Design delivery workflows that are idempotent, retry safely, and confirm successful delivery, so customers reliably get the messages they need without duplicate sends * Build communication preferences and controls that let users and administrators decide what they receive and where * Make the platform simple and safe for other Ramp engineers to build on, with clear abstractions, strong defaults, and good developer tooling * Improve the reliability, performance, and observability of the platform as message volume grows * Drive technical direction for your area and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship **What You'll Need** -------------------- * Experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows * A track record of owning a system or product area end to end and shaping its technical direction over time * Strong system design judgment, especially around reliability, idempotency, and correctness in high\-volume distributed systems * Product sense: you care about the experience of the people receiving each message, not just the ticket, and you balance speed with quality * Clear communication and a collaborative approach to technical decisions across product, design, and engineering **Nice to Haves** ----------------- * Experience building notification, messaging, or communications platforms * Experience integrating with messaging providers or channel APIs, such as Twilio, SendGrid, Slack, Microsoft Teams, or WhatsApp * Experience building internal platforms or shared services used by many engineering teams * Experience scaling high\-volume, event\-driven, or queue\-based systems **Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)** ---------------------------------------------------------------- * Flexible PTO * Centralized home\-office equipment ordering * Health and wellness stipend * Budget for intra\-office travel * Weekly coffee stipend **United States** ----------------- * 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents * One Medical annual membership * 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp * Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay * Pet insurance * In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more * Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed) **Canada** ---------- * Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life * Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage * Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime) * Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP \+ DPSP) * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay * Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health **United Kingdom** ------------------ * Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite * Virtual GP and at\-home care via eMed x Livi * Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay **Referral Instructions** ------------------------- If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf. **Other notices** ----------------- Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. *Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @**Ramp.com* *email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.*

Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village. **Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)** Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Financial Infrastructure
jobs.description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. **About the role:** Make Replit the single place where businesses can buy everything they need through their agents. As a Staff Software Engineer on Replit’s Money team, you’ll set technical direction and build the commerce platform that lets users discover, evaluate, purchase, and manage the products and services they need to build and run their businesses—without leaving Replit. Replit already enables businesses to accept payments through integrations such as Stripe. This role builds on that foundation to expand what businesses can buy and accomplish through Replit Agent. You’ll design commerce experiences that combine the simplicity consumers expect with the controls enterprises need, making agent\-assisted purchasing useful, trustworthy, and reliable. You’ll own architecture and lead cross\-team delivery across merchant and service\-provider integrations, agent tools, purchasing workflows, and the lifecycle after a transaction. The challenge goes beyond executing a payment: agents need to understand what a user wants, present clear choices and costs, act within delegated authority, and verify that the purchase delivered the intended outcome. You’ll stay hands\-on with design and code while aligning partners, mentoring engineers, and turning an ambitious product vision into incremental customer value. **You will:** * Set technical direction for Replit’s financial infrastructure, with an immediate focus on enterprise billing, spend controls, and financial correctness. * Build shared services for usage\-based billing, pricing, credits, subscriptions, and entitlements so product teams can launch without rebuilding billing. * Automate enterprise contract lifecycles—from onboarding through amendments and renewals—keeping commercial terms, provisioned credits, and invoices in sync. * Build timely budget enforcement, alerts, and overrides that give customers control over spend without disrupting their hosted apps. * Make AI usage understandable: attribute costs to the right customer, workspace, user, or agent, including delegated work without double\-counting. * Build reconciliation and audit trails that make balances and invoices explainable and help Finance catch discrepancies before customers do. * Simplify the billing stack through safe migrations that preserve balances, transaction history, and customer access. * Own production reliability through testing, observability, incident response, and safe recovery from duplicate events, delayed usage, and partial failures. * Stay hands\-on while leading cross\-team delivery, mentoring engineers, and partnering with Product, Finance, Sales, and Support. **Required skills and experience:** * A track record of Staff\-level technical ownership: setting architecture and delivering complex initiatives across teams. * Deep experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems. * Strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, databases, and event\-driven architecture. * Sound judgment around transactions, consistency, concurrency, idempotency, and failure recovery. * Experience evolving live systems and migrating data without compromising correctness or availability. * Product judgment that balances customer needs, delivery speed, and long\-term system quality. * Clear communication with technical and non\-technical partners, including translating business requirements into system behavior. * Hands\-on leadership through implementation, design reviews, mentoring, and production ownership. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with billing, payments, subscriptions, credits, entitlements, or other financial systems. * Experience with enterprise contracts, negotiated pricing, invoicing, or quote\-to\-cash automation. * Experience with high\-volume usage metering, pricing calculations, or low\-latency spend controls. * Experience building reconciliation, financial reporting, or auditable transaction histories with Finance and Accounting. * Experience integrating billing, payment, or CRM platforms, with judgment about what to build versus buy. ***Bonus Points*****:** * Experience with AI or cloud infrastructure billing, including variable costs and attribution across distributed workloads. * Experience building customer\-facing spend visibility, budgets, or internal tools that reduce manual billing work. * Experience with cloud marketplace billing, payment recovery, or fraud and dispute workflows. * Familiarity with agentic commerce or delegated spending. These are additional strengths, not requirements. **What we value**: * Customer outcomes: success means a business can get what it needs through its agent, with clear costs and a verified result—not merely a completed API call. * User control and trust: agents act within explicit authority, surface consequential choices, and make purchases and ongoing commitments understandable. * Consumer simplicity and enterprise readiness: straightforward experiences should coexist with the controls organizations need. * End\-to\-end ownership: we own the experience from intent through purchase, fulfillment, and ongoing management. * Pragmatic technical leadership: we build on what exists, deliver incremental value, and invest in correctness and extensibility where they matter. * Clear collaboration: we document decisions, surface risks early, and help other teams and partners succeed. **Full\-Time Employee Benefits Include:** Competitive Salary \& Equity 401(k) Program with a 4% match (*US Only*) Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance Short Term and Long Term Disability Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave Flexible Time Off (FTO) \+ Holidays Commuter Benefits (*In\-Office \& US Only*) Monthly Wellness Stipend Autonomous Work Environment In Office Set\-Up Reimbursement (*In\-Office Only*) Quarterly Team Gatherings In Office Amenities (*In\-Office Only*) **Want to learn more about what we are up to?** * Self\-driving Company * Replit Agent at Scale * AI Adoption * Build Open\-Source Apps **Interviewing \+ Culture at Replit** * Operating Principles * Reasons not to work at Replit To achieve our mission of making programming more accessible around the world, we need our team to be representative of the world. We welcome your unique perspective and experiences in shaping this product. We encourage people from all kinds of backgrounds to apply, including and especially candidates from underrepresented and non\-traditional backgrounds. Compensation Range: $290K \- $375K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer- Account Access & Controls
jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 49811 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. **WHY SAFETY?** At Roblox, we strive to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and the Safety organization’s mission is to become the leader in civil immersive online communities. We systematically detect, remove, and prevent problematic accounts, content and behavior, and we make Roblox accounts secure and free from compromise. We cover a broad area of the tech spectrum, including machine learning, classifiers for 3D models, experimentation, automation, detection workflows, and AI\-powered text filters. Aligned and partnering with product teams, we use this toolbelt to discover new opportunities, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build safety products, and measure the impact on our community of users and developers. In doing so, we keep Roblox safe, civil, and inclusive, and we foster positive relationships between people around the world. **WHY ACCESS \& CONTROLS?** Roblox operates globally across a huge number of jurisdictions, each with their own laws and regulations. Every user’s platform experience is tailored based on their age, location, parental consents, and more to ensure that Roblox is safe and compliant for them. The Access \& Controls pod owns the systems that make this possible. Our platforms allow internal teams to set feature access rules based on compliance requirements and let users customize their platform experience within those boundaries. Our services are some of the highest\-traffic systems at the company, sitting in the hot path of nearly every user action across billions of accounts and millions of requests per second. As international regulations evolve and new features are built, our systems are how Roblox enforces, manages, and gives visibility into consistent behavior across dozens of features. **You Will:** * Design, build, and operate high\-throughput, low\-latency services that shape what every Roblox user can see and do. The pod owns the full stack end\-to\-end, from gRPC services to caching, data pipelines, and client integrations. * Help set the technical direction for how feature access and user settings work across Roblox, evolving our systems as the platform and the regulatory landscape grow. * Partner directly with feature teams across Roblox to onboard them onto our platforms and turn evolving regulatory requirements into consistent product behavior. Past examples of this team’s contributions include: * + Policy Deployment: Access rules used to ship as dynamic configuration, with no visibility into what was running in production and no way to revert without a code change. The team replaced that with a purpose\-built deployment system with a custom UI, partial rollouts, shadow traffic, and one\-click rollback. Policy deployment went from a source of anxiety to a routine, low\-risk operation for the dozens of feature teams that depend on it daily. + Age\-Checked Comms: In late 2025, Roblox introduced platform\-wide Age Checks for all Communication features, including restrictions that only allow users to communicate with others in similar age ranges. Our access platform was the backbone of this rollout, giving every feature one centralized place to answer: Is this user Age Checked? Are they eligible to Age Check? Can these two users communicate? * Own the reliability, performance, and observability of systems that nearly every feature at Roblox depends on. * Mentor other engineers and add to the team’s culture of knowledge sharing, project retros, and bottoms\-up technical decision\-making. **You Have:** * 5\+ years of industry experience building and operating backend or distributed systems at scale. * Strong fundamentals in service design, caching, data modeling, and performance. You know how to build systems that stay fast and correct under millions of requests per second. * A track record of leading projects from design through launch, including projects that span multiple teams or customers. * Bonus: Experience with authorization or access control systems, policy engines, configuration or feature\-flag platforms, or regulatory compliance (e.g., age assurance, privacy, parental controls). * Educational Background: BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. **You Are:** * Someone Who Thrives in Ambiguity: You take full ownership of problems that don’t come with a clear spec. When requirements are shifting or incomplete, you define the problem, make the call, and drive it to an outcome. * Innovative: You spot friction in existing processes, look for simple abstractions that remove a whole class of work, and turn your ideas into prototypes that shape where the team goes next. * Reliability\-Focused: You understand what it means to own hot\-path infrastructure. You make changes safe through rollouts, validation, and fast rollback. * Collaborative: You enjoy working across teams and product areas, and you’re comfortable translating ambiguous policy or regulatory requirements into concrete technical designs. * Mission Oriented: You care about keeping Roblox safe and compliant for users of all ages around the world. jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About the team:** ------------------- The Application Security team believes software should be secure because of how it was built, not because someone checked it afterwards. We set the security standards that everything Rubrik builds has to meet, and we build the controls that make those standards the default. We cover any team that builds, generates, or assembles software or automation that runs against Rubrik or customer data. That includes Engineering product code, IT\-built tooling, data pipelines, low\-code automation, and anything produced by AI coding agents. Other teams handle triaging vulnerabilities and chasing remediation. Our measure of success is the risk we eliminate by design, not the number of vulnerabilities found later. **About the role:** ------------------- You will do hands\-on work across our four focus areas: Standards, Secure Architecture and Design, Preventative Controls, Adoption and Enablement. You will own defined pieces of this work, with guidance from senior engineers, and you will be measured on the outcomes below rather than on activity. The team is small, so you will also be expected to automate repetitive work, using AI tools where they help. You are not expected to know all of this on day one. We are looking for people who have started working in this space and want to learn and grow at speed. **What you'll do:** ------------------- * Build and maintain the preventative controls in development pipelines, including secrets prevention, dependency and artifact policy, and scan configuration as code. * With guidance from senior engineers, work with development teams to establish what needs to be scanned, ensure accurate scans policies and that the results can be trusted. * Help write security standards specific enough to test and build the automated checks that show whether teams conform to them. * Ensure agent\-generated code conforms to the highest security standards and controls through defining and implementing guardrails for AI coding agents. * Support design reviews and threat modeling for applications, build tooling and internal platforms. * Enable the team to scale at speed through automation of repetitive tasks, standards checks and review support. ### **What Success Looks Like:** By the end of your first year, we would expect: * The controls you built or maintain are enforced in the pipeline and reported by organization. * The teams you worked with have accurate scan configuration, comprehensive coverage that matches the standard, with no unknown gaps. * The standards you helped write have automated checks, so conformance is measured and not self\-attested. * Agent\-generated code is covered by the same standards and controls as other code. * The repetitive team work you automated no longer needs manual effort, and the team's time has moved to higher\-value work. **Experience you'll need:** --------------------------- * BS or MS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Can write and maintain tooling in Python and at least one of Go, TypeScript, or JavaScript. * Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Buildkite, Jenkins, Git workflows, and containers. * Basic grounding in application security: OWASP Top 10, threat modeling, secrets management, and software supply chain risk. * Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or Claude Code to build or automate real work, and the judgment to check the output before trusting it. * Clear writing and speaking, and a willingness to learn fast in an area that changes every few months. **Preferred qualifications:** ----------------------------- * You have built an automation or AI\-assisted workflow that replaced manual work and you can explain how you checked that its output was right. Claude skills, agents and MCP servers count. * You have set up or tested controls on an AI coding agent or assistant (permissions, sandboxing, hooks, tool restrictions), and you can describe the risk each one reduced, such as prompt injection, excessive agency, data exfiltration, or a malicious MCP server. * You have written evals, test cases, or review checks that caught bad LLM output before it was used. * You have put a security check into a CI/CD pipeline (secrets scanning, SAST, SCA, or dependency and artifact policy). * Working knowledge of AWS, GCP, or Azure. The minimum and maximum base salaries for this role are posted below; additionally, the role is eligible for bonus potential, equity and benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the role based on U.S. location. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US Pay Range $124,200—$186,200 USD **Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation** ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls. **Inclusion @ Rubrik** ---------------------- At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data. Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential. ### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:** * Our Company: We are committed to building a merit\-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here. * Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries. * Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities. **Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled** ------------------------------------------------ Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. jobs.description: As an S\&C Electric team member, you’ll work on projects that have real\-world impact. You’ll help transform the grid for resilient and reliable power worldwide. S\&C has more than a 100\-year history of innovation and has been 100% employee\-owned since 2012\. We continue this legacy as a trusted, forward\-thinking leader in the electrical industry. You will advance a safer, more reliable, and more resilient electrical grid. Our products help the grid adapt to severe weather and transition to clean energy. We’re big enough to be a respected industry leader but small enough for you to impact our company directly. Our commitment gives you opportunities to impact on and off the job positively. They focus on implementing software requirements, understanding core tools, and contributing to the microgrid control software suite and supporting projects, as needed. The role will also work closely with the cybersecurity, power systems control, and electrical studies teams while supporting specific projects. The Software Engineer I continuously learns and develops foundational problem\-solving skills and gains exposure to systems and industry\-standard practices. **Key Responsibilities:** * Program Development: Assists in writing and debugging software in accordance with defined specifications, following directions from senior engineers. Supports implementation of basic features, simple problem\-solving tasks, and unit test development. * Technology Advancement: Explores new technologies and articles to build a broad foundation understanding of the software engineering environment and industry trends. * Research \& Documentation: Reviews existing documentation to understand requirements, architecture, and workflows. Contributes to basic documentation updates, notes, and development records to support project traceability. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Works with senior engineers and project teams to clarify requirements and ensure alignment with project goals. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About SimpliSafe** We're a high\-tech home security company that's passionate about protecting the life you've built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we've created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you're building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don't just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here. We're embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state\-of\-the\-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done. **Why are we hiring?** Well, we're growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. The Device Connectivity team owns the cloud services that every SimpliSafe base station and camera connects to. We're modernizing those services, moving device messaging onto a new event\-streaming platform, and building the connectivity for our next generation of devices. All of this has to stay reliable through our busiest seasonal peaks. **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and operate the C\+\+ and Go services that provide secure, reliable connections between the cloud and SimpliSafe devices and route their messages to the rest of our platform * Contribute to the shared libraries our services are built on, including metrics, tracing, logging, authentication, and concurrency primitives * Lead engineering projects end to end, from design doc through staged rollout, zero\-downtime production cutover and decommissioning (for example EC2 to Kubernetes, OS upgrades, CI/CD platform changes) * Help move device messaging onto an event\-streaming platform, including a shared event format, schemas and code generation, and load testing * Build cloud\-side connectivity for next\-generation devices, including new device capabilities, device provisioning, and certificate management * Design for reliability at peak load: connection limits, load shedding, connection draining, graceful shutdown, pre\-scaling, and multi\-region architecture. * Own observability for the services you work on: distributed tracing, metrics, crash detection, and dashboards and alerts managed as code * Debug hard production problems across services and AWS infrastructure, lead root\-cause analyses, and see the follow\-up work through * Write design documents, review designs from other teams, and work with other engineering teams on features that span devices and the cloud * Keep services secure and current: certificates and CAs, least\-privilege IAM, network policy, fixing security scan findings, and regular releases and dependency updates **What You'll Bring** * 5\+ years of professional software development experience * Very comfortable with AWS (EKS, load balancers, Lambda, SQS, S3, IAM), ideally including IoT Core (MQTT, rules, device certificates), or a similar cloud provider * Experience managing infrastructure as code with Terraform or OpenTofu * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions * Experience debugging production systems with traces, metrics, and logs (for example OpenTelemetry and Prometheus\-style metrics), and leading root\-cause analyses * A track record of leading a migration or large project from design doc through production cutover, and of setting a direction other engineers can follow * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar **Nice to have** * Strong production experience in modern C\+\+ and/or Go, including async I/O and concurrency * Hands\-on experience running production services on Kubernetes. * Experience with event\-streaming platforms such as Kafka or Pulsar, and with schema formats such as Avro or JSON Schema * IoT or embedded\-adjacent experience, such as device provisioning, PKI for device fleets, or MQTT\-based device protocols * C\+\+ build and library ecosystem experience, such as CMake, Conan. * Experience with Redis in production * Experience building networked services that manage many long\-lived TCP/TLS connections, including mutual TLS, backpressure, TLS termination * Experience writing automated integration and end\-to\-end tests in Python **What Values You'll Share** * Customer Obsessed \- Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long\-term relationships with them. * Aim High \- Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar. * No Ego \- Maintaining a "no job too small" attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style. * One Team \- Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success. * Lift As We Climb \- Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed. * Lean \& Nimble \- Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment. **What We Offer** * A mission\- and values\-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive * A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families *(For more information on our total rewards please* *click here**)* * Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home. * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change. The target annual base pay range for this role is $117,300 \- $156,400\. This target annual base pay range represents our good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market\-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees' job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors. Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here. We're committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values. *We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact* *careers@simplisafe.com**.*

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Observability
jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. **Senior Product Manager: Extensible Compute** ============================================== **Location:** MPK or Bellevue \| **Workplace:** Hybrid At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don't just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset, rapidly testing emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager for our Extensible Compute team, which builds Snowpark Container Services (SPCS). SPCS is the compute platform that runs customer container workloads and Snowflake's own first\-party products, including Openflow, Notebooks, Streamlit, and AI agents. You will own the product for that platform: which compute we offer, how reliably and cheaply it runs, and how partner teams and customers get what they need without a one\-off every time. **AS A SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:** * Own the SPCS product roadmap and ship it. That includes the compute instance portfolio across AWS, Azure, and GCP (general\-purpose CPU, ARM, and GPU, including new Nvidia generations), and the storage and file system capabilities workloads depend on. * Turn requests from first\-party product partners into platform capabilities. When Openflow, Notebooks, Streamlit, or an agent team needs a new instance, a networking change, or multi\-cluster support, you decide what becomes a standard SPCS feature and what stays a one\-off. * Take features from early preview to general availability. You set the launch bar, hold a release when security, reliability, or unit economics are not ready, and work the path through PrPr and PuPr with engineering. Work credibly with senior engineers on architecture, performance, reliability, and cost. * Own platform health that customers feel: startup time, isolation, storage reliability, and the unit economics of running a workload on SPCS. You partner with Finance on pricing ($/GiB, instance pricing) when the model has to change. * Be the product point of contact for our infrastructure partners (AWS, Azure, GCP, Nvidia) on the SPCS compute roadmap, and for account teams qualifying strategic customers onto SPCS. * Use AI as part of how you work: customer and partner synthesis, specs, launch reviews, and the analysis behind a prioritization call. **OUR IDEAL SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER WILL HAVE:** * 5\+ years of product management experience, including several years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer\-facing product, or equivalent experience owning a technical product end to end. * Hands\-on depth in at least one of: cloud infrastructure, container or serverless platforms, developer runtimes, or distributed systems. You can hold a design review with senior engineers and leave with a decision. * A track record of taking a platform capability from 0 to 1 or from early adoption to scale, across engineering and at least one partner team (product, GTM, or a cloud/hardware partner). * Evidence you can say no. You have turned a pile of bespoke asks into a smaller set of reusable capabilities, and you can show what you cut and why. * Clear writing and crisp communication with engineering leads, partner PMs, finance, and account teams. You do not need a slide to make the point. * A Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience. **BONUS POINTS** * Direct experience with a container platform, Kubernetes\-based service, or serverless compute product that customers run production workloads on. * Experience qualifying or launching GPU or accelerated compute instances, or working a hardware/CSP roadmap (Nvidia, AWS, Azure, GCP). * Experience supporting data, AI, or developer workloads on a shared platform (orchestration, notebooks, apps, agents). * Familiarity with unit economics for compute or storage: instance pricing, $/GiB, or cost\-to\-serve for a multi\-tenant platform. **WHY JOIN OUR EXTENSIBLE COMPUTE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?** SPCS is the compute layer under a large and growing set of Snowflake workloads. A good call on an instance type, a filesystem, or a launch gate shows up in more than one product. You will work directly with the engineers who build it, the product partners who depend on it, and the customers bringing container workloads onto Snowflake. Customers want to run their own services, pipelines, and models inside Snowflake's governance boundary, and Snowflake's own products need the same platform to get faster, cheaper, and more capable. You will have a concrete surface to own, a roadmap you can ship against, and visibility into how this platform is used across the company. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: * The estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 \- $287,500\. * Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.
