jobs.description: At SolarWinds, we're a people\-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions. The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast\-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We're looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world\-class solutions in a fast\-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you're looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you've come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us! **Role overview** ----------------- SolarWinds Product and Engineering is building shared platform capabilities that help software teams use AI agents throughout the software development lifecycle. As a Software Engineer on the AI Development Platform team, you will build and improve the services, integrations, and developer workflows that make those capabilities useful, secure, and dependable. You will contribute production\-quality software for agent\-based development workflows, including agent harnesses, execution and orchestration, custom tool integrations, and the supporting evaluation, testing, and telemetry. You'll work with product and engineering partners to turn well\-defined needs into working features, use AI tools as part of your own development workflow, and learn the platform's production environment with support from senior engineers. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Design, implement, test, debug, and maintain small\-to\-medium platform features and services. * Build and improve agent\-based software development workflows that take work from specifications and context through agent\-assisted implementation, pull requests, review, and verification, including the harnesses, tools, and integrations that help agents plan and execute work, use engineering context, and produce reviewable results. * Contribute agent orchestration and execution capabilities, including reliable, isolated environments with appropriate access to repositories, tools, and dependencies. * Build and maintain custom MCP servers or similar integrations that connect agents to engineering systems such as source control, work tracking, documentation, CI/CD, and testing tools. * Build and maintain testing and evaluation approaches for agents and models, including repeatable test suites, evaluation datasets or scenarios, regression checks, and observability to verify outputs and improve reliability. * Contribute to platform capabilities for model and tool flexibility, usage attribution, budget visibility, and operational telemetry. * Apply secure engineering practices, including least\-privilege access, protection of secrets, useful auditability, and human review or approval where appropriate. * Participate in code reviews and design discussions. * Use AI development tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and code quality, while validating generated code and sharing useful practices with teammates. * Write and maintain clear technical documentation, tests, scripts, and developer\-facing guidance that make platform capabilities easier to adopt. **What you bring** ------------------ * Experience building and supporting software in a team environment, with sound skills in coding, debugging, testing, and version control. * Ability to implement medium\-complexity changes using established patterns, data structures, and engineering practices; willingness to ask for guidance when problems or risks exceed your experience. * Familiarity with Git\-based workflows, code review, automated testing, and iterative delivery. * Practical problem\-solving skills: you can clarify requirements, compare straightforward implementation options, and produce simple, effective solutions. * Interest in cloud services, developer platforms, automation, and improving the software development experience for other engineers. * Hands\-on experience building with AI agents or agentic workflows, or developing the harnesses and integrations that enable agents to perform useful work. You can explain how you tested agent behavior and handled failures or uncertain outputs. * Regular use of AI\-assisted development tools, with the judgment to review, test, and take responsibility for the results. * Clear communication and the ability to collaborate with engineers and partners across disciplines. **Helpful experience** ---------------------- * Working with containers, isolated or sandboxed workloads, event\-driven systems, or workflow orchestration. * Building agent or model evaluation systems, testing frameworks, evaluation datasets, test fixtures, guardrails, or observability to assess quality, consistency, and reliability across changes. * Working with LLM APIs, model gateways, usage telemetry, or cost controls. * Experience with observability, identity and access controls, or secure software delivery. At this level, you independently deliver scoped features and small\-to\-medium projects, while seeking senior\-engineer input on design tradeoffs, unfamiliar production systems, and higher\-risk changes. You contribute to team quality through testing, code review, documentation, and reliable follow\-through; you are developing deeper knowledge of the platform stack and its production environment. jobs.title: Automation & Controls Engineer, Data Center Facilities
jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. #### **AUTOMATION \& CONTROLS ENGINEER, DATA CENTER FACILITIES** As an Automation and Controls Engineer, you will design, program, commission, and own the controls for that plant. You will write robust control code, build operator interfaces people can trust, and take total ownership of live systems — tuning sequences, closing reliability gaps, and bringing new capacity online while the cluster is already in production. #### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design, develop, and manage facility automation projects from sequence of operations and control narrative through panel build, point\-to\-point checkout, commissioning, failover testing, and handoff to operations. * Architect, write, and debug PLC and controller code that is organized, structured, documented, maintainable, and reusable across chillers, pumps, cooling towers, coolant distribution units, air handlers, heat rejection, and related plant equipment. * Implement lead/lag, staging, rotation, free\-cooling, and liquid\-cooling control strategies that hold capacity, efficiency, and redundancy (N\+1 / 2N) as the cluster load changes. * Keep the plant safe and reliable with fail\-safe interlocks, emergency power off and transfer logic, and alarm philosophy that meets NEC, NFPA 70E, NFPA 75, and applicable life\-safety requirements. * Build clear HMI and control\-room graphics so operators can see plant state, acknowledge alarms, trend equipment health, and troubleshoot without calling an engineer first. * Integrate equipment controllers into the site BMS, EPMS, and historian so power, cooling, and environmental data are one operational picture. * Design control panels and electrical interfaces compliant with NEC, NFPA, and UL 508A, including motor and VFD interfaces, safety circuits, and network architecture. * Own the systems after go\-live: alarm rationalization, loop tuning, sequence changes, outage support, and continuous improvement of uptime and energy performance. * Build schedules and punch lists for controls scope and drive vendors, contractors, and internal teams to hit them during construction and live expansions. #### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, controls, mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline. * 1\+ years of experience in industrial controls, building or plant automation, data center facilities, or related programming (internship and extracurricular experience applies). #### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Energized by fast, iterative design, construction, and commissioning on a live critical facility. * Proven ability to turn a messy plant problem into a simple, reliable control solution. * Clear written and verbal communication, including control narratives, sequences of operations, and recommendations across mechanical, electrical, and operations teams. * Judgment to move quickly while protecting people and equipment around high voltage, stored energy, refrigerants, fuel systems, and high\-pressure hydronics. * Experience in data centers, power generation, district energy, industrial utilities, or other 24/7 process plants. * Experience in at least one of the disciplines below, with a real interest in learning the others. * Sizing and application of motors, VFDs, starters, valves, actuators, instrumentation, and circuit protection for pumps, fans, towers, and plant equipment. * Design of fail\-safe circuits using safety relays and safety controllers, including interlocks that must hold during a loss of power or a controls failure. * Hands\-on troubleshooting of industrial electrical systems with multimeters, oscilloscopes, and network diagnostics. * Reading and producing schematics, panel layouts, riser diagrams, and one\-line diagrams (EPLAN preferred). * Fieldbus and Ethernet plant networks: BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, Profinet, and OPC UA. * Designing, building, and commissioning control panels and electromechanical systems with arc\-flash, lockout/tagout, and construction\-power constraints in mind. * Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA 70E, UL 508A, and data center facility standards, with the ability to apply them to control design. * PLC programming in structured text and ladder, preferably Rockwell (Studio 5000\), Siemens TIA Portal, or Beckhoff TwinCAT. * HMI, BMS, and SCADA development — Ignition, Niagara, or an equivalent platform — focused on fast navigation, meaningful alarms, trends, and equipment health. * Industrial protocols used in critical facilities: BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, SNMP, EtherNet/IP, and Profinet. * Applying control software to mechanical and electrical assemblies: sensors, VFDs, valves, and pump or fan systems, including a disciplined checkout before a system is allowed to carry load. * Experience with EPMS, power metering, generator or ATS status, and historian or alarming tools used to operate a data center. #### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Ability to work long hours, nights, and weekends when commissioning, failover testing, or a live plant event requires it. * Willingness to work on site in the data center, including mechanical plants, electrical rooms, and the data halls, for checkout and troubleshooting. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: Lead Engineer, AI Infrastructure (C++, C)
jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. #### **LEAD ENGINEER, AI INFRASTRUCTURE (C\+\+, C)** The Grok training program is looking for a lead software engineer on the AI infrastructure team. You will lead the team that architects, implements, and maintains the software infrastructure responsible for training grok models on hundreds of thousands or millions of GPUs. The success of Grok depends on the quality of the software that you and your team produce, including reliability, fault tolerance, throughput, security, and developer experience. You are the engineer that other engineers count on; you are technical, you tackle every problem with enthusiasm; you remove hurdles. You are a self\-starter and a team player. We are seeking a talented lead software engineer to join us in making our vision a reality. #### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Develop reliable, performant, and maintainable software responsible for training Grok models in our world\-class compute clusters * Provide technical direction for future training architectures and hardware designs * Work closely with other model engineers, kernel engineers, network engineers, hardware design engineers, platform engineers, and site ops engineers * Develop prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints * Lead planning efforts for the team, working with key stakeholders in other teams and management to develop milestones and execute to them #### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or technical discipline * Hands\-on systems programming experience in C or C\+\+ #### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Developed, debugged, and and deployed software that has been used in real world applications/projects * 3\+ years of software engineering experience OR 1\+ years of C/C\+\+ experience at SpaceX * Solid fundamental knowledge of NVL72 GB300 racks, computer architecture, networking, math, and physics * Strong skills in modelling, debugging, performance optimization, and unit testing * Creative approach to problem solving, exceptional analytical skills and engineering fundamentals #### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** $220,000 \- $357,000 USD Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
jobs.description: Engineering Machine Learning Permanent New York or Boston The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most\-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business. The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi\-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify. What You'll Do * + Lead and grow a team of machine learning, backend, and data engineers, supporting their development and helping them deliver their best work.Shape the team's technical strategy and execution, ensuring engineering efforts align with listener needs and Spotify's broader business goals. + Guide the development of machine learning and recommendation systems that balance multiple objectives across personalized listening experiences. + Collaborate with Product and engineering partners to define priorities, align on outcomes, and translate complex challenges into clear plans. + Support the team in making thoughtful technical decisions across experimentation, scalability, system reliability, and model performance. + Create a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, where engineers feel empowered to experiment and learn. + Drive effective planning and delivery while balancing immediate priorities with long\-term technical health. + Foster an inclusive, supportive team environment through coaching, feedback, and thoughtful people leadership. Who You Are * + You have experience managing and developing engineering teams, with a track record of helping people grow and delivering impactful results. + You bring a strong technical background in machine learning, software engineering, or related areas, and can confidently guide technical conversations. + You understand the opportunities and challenges of developing and operating machine learning systems in production. + You have experience working with cross\-functional partners to define priorities, navigate trade\-offs, and deliver against shared goals. + You are comfortable leading teams through ambiguity and helping engineers make informed technical decisions. + You care about building inclusive, collaborative environments where people feel supported and empowered. + You communicate with clarity, lead with empathy, and know how to balance people, technology, and business needs Where You'll Be * + We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location. + This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration. Learn about life at Spotify The United States base range for this position is $227,495\- $262,928 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future. Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward\-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know \- we’re here to support you in any way we can. Our global benefits Extensive learning opportunities, through our dedicated team, GreenHouse. Flexible share incentives letting you choose how you share in our success. Global parental leave, six months off \- for all new parents. All The Feels, our employee assistance program and self\-care hub. Flexible public holidays, swap days off according to your values and beliefs.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Client Experience, Cost Journey
jobs.description: **Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.** ------------------------------------------------------------ Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage. Our AI\-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self\-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners. As an AI\-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission. Reporting to the Associate Director of Engineering for the Client Experience group, this Software Engineer will implement full\-stack experiences in our client\- and provider\-facing applications. Candidates must be based in the NYC area or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Occasional travel will be required for team on\-sites. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Write, review, and deliver production\-ready code with a focus on correctness, clarity, and maintainability. * Participate actively in code reviews—giving constructive feedback and leveraging review comments as a learning opportunity. * Use AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to explore implementation approaches, accelerate development, generate documentation, and augment code reviews—providing sufficient context to get high\-quality, system\-aware outputs, and always critically reviewing AI\-generated code before shipping. * Contribute to architectural discussions and tech debt prioritization within your team. * Proactively clarify requirements to remove ambiguity; identify and mitigate risks before they become blockers. * Deliver features independently on well\-scoped work; support larger multi\-person projects with consistent execution. * Collaborate with product managers and designers to break down complex requirements into manageable, shippable units. * Advocate for high engineering standards including test coverage, documentation, and observability. * Participate in an on\-call rotation to support system reliability and respond to production issues. * Identify and resolve root causes across code domains; add logging, alerting, and monitoring as a standard part of your work. * Work crossfunctionally with others teams within the organization to deliver full featured experiences. **What success looks like in this role** ---------------------------------------- * **Delivery \& Quality –** Deliver projects on time, within scope, and with high stakeholder satisfaction. Maintain high system uptime and low defect rates through strong testing and observability practices. * **Independent Execution –** Complete well\-scoped tasks independently, resolve issues proactively, and accurately track your own work. Estimates are improving in accuracy sprint over sprint. * **AI\-Augmented Engineering –** Regularly use AI to assist with features, debugging, documentation, and test creation—iterating on prompts to improve output quality, and always validating results against team standards. * **Collaboration –** Partner effectively with product, design, data, and engineering teammates, contributing meaningfully to team goals and alignment. * **Engineering Excellence –** Contribute to improved team velocity through planning, estimation, and delivery best practices. Continuously seek out new techniques—including AI capabilities—to improve engineering outcomes. * **Code Quality –** Write code that is tested, secure, and easy for others to understand and maintain. **AI Fluency Expectations** --------------------------- * Uses AI to explore multiple implementation approaches, ensuring consistency in decision making and sound tradeoffs on scope, cost and quality * Understands concepts of AI token efficiency, and works to minimize token use over time and choose less expensive models when possible * Creates thorough documentation and spikes utilizing AI extensively * Provides sufficient context to AI tools to get high\-quality, system\-aware outputs * Uses AI to augment code review, spotting potential bugs or improvements faster * Can actively apply their AI knowledge to  e, context, task, output format * Familiar with Spring Health's approved AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude) and what each is suited for * Understands what data can and cannot be fed into AI tools per Spring Health's data standards * Can evaluate AI\-generated code for functional correctness; knows output requires human review before merging **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * 3–5 years of professional software development experience * Proficiency with Ruby on Rails, React, and TypeScript * Experience building Fullstack applications * Actively uses AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to assist with features, debugging, and test creation—iterates on prompts to improve output quality and critically reviews all AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and standards compliance * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment * Experience working in cross\-functional Agile teams * Strong problem\-solving skills with a focus on clean, maintainable code and attention to detail * Embraces writing well\-designed tests that accompany all code * Bonus: Prior experience within a mental health or healthcare organization. **Note**: We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in\-depth information as you continue in the interview process. jobs.description: Vacancy details Argentina\|Chile\|Colombia\|Costa Rica…Argentina\|Chile\|Colombia\|Costa Rica … RemoteRemote Recruiter Olena Kokoieva Olena Kokoieva o.kokoieva@svitla.com **Role overview** ----------------- Svitla Systems Inc. is looking for a **Senior AWS Cloud and Platform Engineer** for a full\-time position (40 hours per week) on a short\-term basis (16 weeks) in LATAM. Our client is a food industry company located in Seattle, Washington, that runs its daily operations from its own on\-premises data center, which is its primary infrastructure. Its core systems run on VMware there, including Microsoft Dynamics GP on SQL Server and a warehouse management system. Orders also arrive through a third\-party ordering platform with no API, and retail partners trade through EDI. Staff work on virtual desktops and sign in through Okta. The company already runs its disaster recovery environment on AWS, keeps some services on Azure, and uses Microsoft 365\. You own the AWS platform the pod’s agents run on: accounts and environments, identity and access, infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, secrets, private links to the on\-premises data center, monitoring, audit logging, and cost. You build this foundation in the first workflow and reuse it for each one after, so every new workflow costs less to deliver. You will be one of three people who stay with the pod throughout. You will schedule your work, releases, and access requests with the Outcome Lead, Svitla’s delivery manager for the pod. The Forward Deployed Technical Lead owns the architecture, and specialists in agents and MCP, data, integration, and document AI join as each workflow needs them. You will also be the pod’s link to our client’s IT and security team, and you will get their sign\-off before anything reaches production. **Requirements** ---------------- * 5\+ years of hands\-on production experience with AWS. * Experience with AWS Organizations or Control Tower, service control policies, and IAM Identity Center. * Experience with IAM roles, permission boundaries, and short\-lived credentials for people, services, and agents. * Experience with VPC design with private subnets, endpoints, and PrivateLink, plus site\-to\-site VPN to on\-premises. * Experience with ECS on Fargate or EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, SQS, and EventBridge. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock: model access, guardrails, private endpoints, invocation logging, and quotas. * Experience with S3, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS Config, and Security Hub. * Experience with cost control using tagging, Cost Explorer, budgets, and anomaly alerts. * Experience with Terraform (preferred) or AWS CDK, including modules, remote state, and code review. * Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline), including automated tests, approvals, and rollback. * Experience with policy as code and security scanning in the pipeline (for example, OPA, Checkov, or tfsec). * Experience with Docker, Python, and Bash, plus PowerShell for the Windows side. * Experience running LLM applications or agents in production, not only prototypes. * Experience hosting MCP servers and tool APIs with authentication, rate limits, and a log of every call. * Experience with approval gates and rollback paths for agents that change records. * Experience tracing each agent step: errors, latency, tokens, and cost (for example, OpenTelemetry or Langfuse). * Experience with evaluation sets in the pipeline, with thresholds that can block a release. * Experience with isolated sandboxes for browser automation (for example, Playwright) against web applications with no API. * Experience with defenses against prompt injection and data leaks: scoped tools, egress controls, and output checks. * Experience integrating Okta with AWS IAM Identity Center through SAML, with SCIM provisioning. * Experience with Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID: groups, service accounts, and hybrid identity. * Experience providing read\-only access to SQL Server replicas and reporting databases without adding load to production. * Experience with SFTP file exchange with partners and vendors using key pairs and IP allow\-lists, never shared passwords. * Fluent English, with the ability to explain data flows and risks in plain language to a careful security team. * Ability to write runbooks that the client’s IT team can follow at 2 a.m., and architecture decision records. * Working from a time zone ahead of US Pacific Time, with at least 4 hours of overlap with Pacific business hours. * Availability for planned evening or weekend releases, and for travel to Seattle when the client asks. **Will be a plus** ------------------ * AWS Professional or Specialty certification (DevOps Engineer, Security, or Advanced Networking). * Experience with document AI on AWS, such as Amazon Textract or Bedrock Data Automation. * Working knowledge of Azure and Microsoft 365, which the client also uses. * Experience with Microsoft Dynamics GP or SQL Server data, and EDI file exchange (SPS Commerce, AS2, SFTP). * Experience in the food industry or other 24/7 operations. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Agree the access path and control baseline with the client’s IT and security team (Okta, virtual desktops, and AWS accounts), then build the environments, pipeline, and secrets management as code. * Build private, encrypted links from AWS to the on\-premises data center, so that agents reach data through read\-only replicas, the reporting database, and queues, never through production systems. * Connect Okta to AWS, give people and agents separate identities, enforce data access in the platform rather than in prompts, and keep every service and agent on least privilege. * Host agent services, MCP servers, Amazon Bedrock model access, and a document extraction service that keeps every document in the client’s accounts, with approval gates and rollback for agents that act. * Run browser automation for the ordering platform in an isolated sandbox, with synthetic checks and alerts. * Log every agent step to an audit trail, alert users and the pod when a check fails, and report AWS and model cost per workflow each month. * Deploy every change through the pipeline, never by hand in the console, with releases gated on each workflow’s test set and evaluation thresholds. * Prepare the runbook and the evidence pack that the client’s security team reviews before go\-live. * Support each workflow after go\-live until it runs without intervention. * Train the client’s IT team to run and extend the platform. **We offer** ------------ * US and EU projects based on advanced technologies. * Competitive compensation based on skills and experience. * Regular performance appraisals to support your growth. * Flexibility in workspace, either remote or our welcoming office. * Bonuses for article writing, public talks, other activities * Generous time off, including vacation, national holidays, sick leaves, and family days. * Personalized learning programs tailored to your interests and skill development. * Free tech webinars and meetups organized by Svitla. * Regular corporate online activities. * Awesome team and a friendly, supportive community! **Why join Svitla** ------------------- Svitla Systems is a global digital solutions company headquartered in the U.S., with operations across North America, Latin America, Europe, and Asia\-Pacific. Since 2003, we have served a wide range of clients, from innovative startups to Fortune 500 companies. Our success is built on strong partnerships. By integrating seamlessly with our clients' teams, we build lasting relationships that deliver measurable results. We are strong advocates of workplace flexibility, remote work culture, and an individual approach to professional and personal growth. Our global mission is to build a business that contributes to the well\-being of our partners, employees, and their families, strengthens our communities, and makes a lasting difference in the world. Together, we are coding a brighter tomorrow and living it. Join us! Vacancy details … … … … Recruiter Olena Kokoieva Olena Kokoieva o.kokoieva@svitla.com

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description: **About Telegent** ------------------ Want to use your mobile phone to set up call routing? Transfer a call to a colleague or an AI agent? Set up call filtering or a receptionist? All without an app, directly on the mobile network. ✅ Done. Now, want to do all of that without a SIM installed on a mobile device, or without a device at all? That's headless programmability: AI\-native workflows on a real mobile number. Come help us build the mobile network for all agents, and the safe tech it can power. **Culture \& pace** ------------------- We build fast, deliver fast, and ship fast, and what we ship is high\-quality code. You'll move faster than you ever imagined and feel truly accomplished doing it. This may be some of the most meaningful work of your career: building technology that doesn't exist anywhere else. Expect to contribute to patents and verifiable work, and to learn more here than anywhere you've been. **Who you are** --------------- You've written enough code and built enough systems at scale to show real mastery. You get the git versioning jokes and the Linux memes, and your servers hiccup in fear of Kai Lentit Seriously, though, you: * Know the end\-to\-end systems lifecycle and full\-stack development inside and out * Build apps and services on our established architecture and own your work end to end * Have mastery over agentic coding, including: * + Worktree management vs. multi\-agent workflows + Skills, hooks, and routines + Flexibility across clients: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, even custom harnesses like OpenClaw and Hermes + Token optimization, plan mode, and structured approaches like SDD, TDD, SpecKit, and role\-based development * Have deployed systems at scale with agentic coding, and know the difference between vibe coding and enterprise\-grade agentic coding * Geek out over paradigm\-shifting approaches, like TypeSafe's Jev decision model routing an agent's steps, but don't let shiny object syndrome get in the way of shipping You can't imagine coding by hand anymore. Your best friend might be an agent. We don't judge. You can't imagine a world without Wispr Flow, and you can't believe humans used to spend their time typing. **Level: Senior** **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Deliver the product roadmap.** Design, build and ship new capabilities across messaging (SMS, MMS and RCS), voice and carrier integrations as services on the new platform. * **Build on the target architecture.** Use the right store for each feature, follow the patterns and standards already set, and extend them where the roadmap needs it. * **Own features end to end.** From design through testing, release and monitoring in production, including the rollout and rollback plan. * **Keep services reliable at scale.** Watch performance and failure behaviour as partners and traffic grow, and fix what holds us back. * **Retire legacy workflows as you go.** When a feature moves to the new platform, switch off the legacy workflow it replaces, with no downtime. * **Keep the platform on track.** Work with engineering leadership on architecture decisions, raise risks early, and hold the standard: small, versioned, reversible changes behind PRs with CI. * **Grow together.** Collaborate closely with engineering, product and leadership in an AI\-native environment, learning from each other and raising the bar as a team. **The platform you will build on:** ----------------------------------- * **Relational database:** The transactional system of record, with real keys and integrity * **Wide\-column store:** High\-throughput message and call records (append\-heavy, the hot path) * **Event streaming:** The event and streaming backbone between producers and consumers * **Analytics store:** Analytics and reporting over message and call volume * **Ledger:** The accounting and usage ledger * **Cache:** Caching, hot lookups and rate limiting * **Object storage:** Large payloads, MMS media and archives **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * **Product and application engineering.** A track record of shipping customer\-facing services and APIs at scale, from design to production. * **Distributed systems and data.** Deep, hands\-on experience across transactional, wide\-column, streaming, analytical, ledger, cache and object stores, and the judgment to use each one well. * **Reliability at scale.** Replication, consistency, sharding, and read and write access patterns, with RPO and RTO in mind. * **Cloud and infrastructure.** Azure first, plus multi\-region and multi\-provider deployments. * **Languages.** Fluent in TypeScript for product, services and APIs, and Go for high\-throughput services, plus SQL. * **AI\-native.** You practice enterprise\-grade agentic coding, not vibe coding, and you move easily across coding clients and harnesses. You arrive with your own setup of agents, skills and automations, and ideas on how to make ours better. * **Ownership and judgment.** You take work from idea to production without hand\-offs, raise problems early, and help keep the team pointed in the right direction. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Telecom or messaging platforms: SMS, MMS, SIP or carrier integrations * CQRS and event\-driven designs in production * Billing or ledger systems, where every entry is append\-only and auditable * Building to SOC 2 controls from the first line of code * Rust or C/C\+\+ for performance\-critical paths in the ledger and data plane **How we work** --------------- * **Learn, assess, benchmark, prepare solutions.** Every responsibility runs this arc, done fast. Your first deliverable is your own assessment and 100\-day plan. * **AI\-first.** Design and implementation are agent\-driven across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and multi\-agent workflows, so one engineer moves at the pace of a team. * **End\-to\-end ownership.** Engineers take their work from design through deployment and production. * **Small, reversible changes.** Versioned, behind PRs with CI, with release tags and documentation that updates as the code does. * **Security from the start.** New systems are built to SOC 2 controls, with architecture decisions recorded as ADRs.

jobs.title: Deployed AI Strategist
jobs.description: **Job Description** As a **Deployed AI Strategist** , you will serve as the primary technical liaison between our product and end users. You will lead the hands\-on deployment of AI solutions directly within audit firms, embedding yourself in their workflows to ensure successful adoption. You are the trust\-layer: a credentialed professional who speaks the language of the customer, understands the regulatory environment, and guides practitioners through natural language workflow construction as a trusted advisor. You will partner closely with forward\-deployed engineers to translate client needs into technical requirements and rapidly iterate on solutions in the field. This role requires strong collaboration with internal teams (product management, engineering, sales, and customer success) to deliver customers a seamless experience with new\-to\-market AI solutions. **Key Responsibilities:** In the role of **Deployed AI Strategist** , you will: * Lead customer discovery to understand existing processes, identify automation opportunities, and assess use case feasibility * Guide customers through workflow construction using natural language prompting, building reusable skill templates and a prompt library scalable across service lines * Identify, document, and escalate edge cases, output quality issues, and domain\-specific gaps to product and engineering; participate in feature testing to close the feedback loop * Partner with sales during pre\-close engagements to provide technical credibility and workflow demonstrations * Track and report on value realization metrics for assigned accounts, including time saved, review cycles reduced, and engagement throughput Develop and deliver training resources to customers, enabling them to self\-serve on identified use cases * **Required Qualifications** You are a fit for the role of **Deployed AI Strategist** if you have: * An active CPA license or equivalent professional credential (required) * 3\-8 years of public accounting experience, ideally at a regional or national firm (Big 4 experience preferred) * Hands\-on experience in audit and assurance, or advisory/financial analysis * Deep familiarity with AI tools and comfort working in early\-stage, ambiguous environments Demonstrated ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical audiences * **Preferred Qualifications** * Strong organization and project management skills Willingness to travel for on\-site customer workshops * **Why Join Us?** This is a high\-impact customer\-facing role, giving you the opportunity to shape our AI deployment strategy. You’ll help build the foundational prompt library and domain knowledge base that shapes product direction from the ground up, while serving as the trusted liaison between an advanced AI product and real\-world tax and audit professionals. \#LI\-BS1 **What’s in it For You?** * **Hybrid Work Model:** We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. * **Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance. * **Career Development and Growth:** By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future. * **Industry Competitive Benefits:** We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. * **Culture:** Globally recognized, award\-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work\-life balance, and more. jobs.title: Senior Agent Designer
jobs.description: **Role** -------- You will be the first designer dedicated to Sidekick Labs. You will design how Sidekick (our AI agent) thinks, behaves, and acts, not just how it looks. That means the conversation, the moments where Sidekick hands over a real thing (a quote, an invoice, a post), how it shows its work, how it recovers when it gets something wrong, and how a Pro finds out what it can do. You'll write the prompts and the rubrics that define "good." Then you'll check the traces to see if we hit it. You'll report to the VP of Design and work closely with our Head of App Experience, Sidekick Labs engineers and product manager. **What you'll work on** * **One Sidekick, everywhere** \- Sidekick shows up across the app, the web dashboard, and partner surfaces. Today Sidekick is only available on our mobile app and is not available for all our products. You'll lead the audit and set the patterns to fix that. * **From chat to artifact** \- A pro says "okay, make it a quote." Sidekick keeps writing text. You'll design the handoff from conversation to real, editable work. * **Show your work** \- Pros trust what they can see. You'll design how Sidekick explains what it did and why, without burying a busy pro in detail. * **The wait** \- Complex requests take time. You'll design the waiting experience so Sidekick feels fast and in control, even when it's thinking. * **Discoverability** \- Our bet is that pros adopt features by talking to Sidekick, not by hunting through menus. You'll figure out how Sidekick teaches a pro what it can do, at the right moment. * **Agent behavior** \- Define tone, clarifying questions vs. just acting, error recovery, confirmation before anything goes out to a customer. You'll own these as design decisions and write them into prompts and system rules. * **Evals** \- You'll define what a good response looks like, write the rubrics, label real conversations, and work with engineering to turn that into automated checks. * **The cookbook** \- You'll turn what we learn into reusable agent design patterns other pods can pick up and use. Think design system, but for agent behavior. * **New conventions** \- Most of the patterns for agents don't exist yet. You'll invent new ones that feel obvious to a pro the first time they see them. * **Where Sidekick goes next** \- You'll help shape the Sidekick Labs roadmap with the PM and engineers. You'll bring a point of view on what we should build, not just how it should look. **What you bring** ------------------ * 6\+ years of product design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work. * 2\+ years designing LLM\-powered products that are live with real users. Agents, assistants, or copilots. Not just concepts. * You've written prompts and system instructions that shipped. You know how a small wording change moves behavior. * You're comfortable in the weeds. You can read a trace, spot where an agent went wrong, and say why. * You think in systems. You can design a pattern once and make it work across ten agents. * You write clearly and plainly. In an agent product, the copy is the product. * You've done research with people who aren't tech\-first, and you respect how they work. * You prototype in code. HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, or React Native, with help from AI tools like Claude Code. You use prototypes to test behavior against the real model, not just screens. * You stay close to the models. You know what the latest ones can and can't do, and you design for where they're going, not where they were six months ago. * Your craft is strong. Your UI is polished, clear, and builds trust. * You've owned complex products end to end in messy, undefined spaces, and shipped anyway. * You're happy in a small, fast team where the problem isn't fully defined yet. **About Sidekick Labs** ----------------------- Sidekick Labs is our AI agent team that is focused on making our agents trustworthy for the pros who use them, and for the teams who build them. We have three jobs: * **Build a platform other teams can build on.** Any pod at Topline Pro should be able to ship an agent without us holding their hand. * **Build a conversational experience Pros trust.** Every agent should feel like one Sidekick. Pros stay in control while Sidekick does the work. * **Build agents we're confident in.** Every agent completes real tasks correctly, and we can prove it. **About Topline Pro** ===================== We're building an AI\-powered Shopify for service businesses. We help service pros (e.g., roofers, landscapers, painters, cleaners) acquire direct business, fast. Up and running within minutes using Gen AI, our digital storefront products help pros get discovered, trusted, and booked repeatedly. Topline Pro was co\-founded by Nick Ornitz (CEO) and Shannon Kay (COO), with an excellent team of 120\+ rockstars and plans to expand further in 2026\. We serve thousands of local service businesses and were named one of the top 50 Tech Companies building for SMBs in 2023 and 2024\. We're YC\-backed and well\-funded, with several years of runway, and we've experienced rapid growth over the past year. We're in a phenomenal position to scale, with the financial foundation, product\-market fit, and momentum to go big. You'll be joining at an inflection point, where the groundwork is laid, and the path to massive impact is clear. We believe "great candidates" do not come about simply from a check mark next to past experience. We believe in hiring people, not just skills. Even if you do not check every box but find excitement at the prospect of working with us in this capacity, please apply. Topline Pro is committed to building an inclusive workplace and assembling a team from diverse backgrounds. We ensure that individuals with disabilities receive reasonable accommodation throughout the application and interview process. We strongly encourage applications from underrepresented candidates and those from nontraditional backgrounds.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI Agents)
jobs.description: Traba is building the AI operating system for the industrial supply chain \- the network of warehouses, manufacturers, logistics providers, and workers behind the physical goods people rely on every day. We started by tackling labor, supplying industrial businesses with consistent, reliable temporary workforces, and quickly became the fastest growing staffing company in America. Since then, we've expanded our suite of AI agents to help logistics providers, manufacturers, 3PLs, and other industrial businesses fully automate their manual workflows, derive insights from their data streams, and transform their decision intelligence. Our mission is to build a world where the global supply chain operates at peak efficiency. We’re proud to be backed by some of the world’s best investors, including Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst. **You'll build the AI agents themselves—the harnesses, evals, orchestration, and model strategy the rest of Traba's product runs on.** We're seeking an entrepreneurial Senior AI Agent Engineer to join as a founding member of the Agents team and build the next layer of Traba's product—an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. (Our Applied AI team puts these agents to work across the product; you own the agents and infrastructure they depend on.) You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agent harnesses on top of frontier models, and turn what you learn in the field into durable product. You will partner closely with our CTO, product, and our operators to take 0\-to\-1 ideas to scaled deployments. **About You** ------------- * **Builder with an AI operator's instinct.** You've shipped real product on top of LLMs—not just chat wrappers. You've designed agent harnesses, structured tools, written evals, and tuned prompts against production traces. You think in capability, reliability, and unit economics—not just whether the model says the right thing. * **Domain\-immersed.** You enjoy time with the people who do the work—learning an industry's vocabulary, edge cases, and operational tempo—and let that shape what you build. * **High\-agency in ambiguity.** Dropped into a fuzzy customer problem with a half\-formed hypothesis and a deadline, you scope, build, evaluate, and ship without waiting for a spec. * **Sweat both ends of the stack.** You move between prompt iteration, eval design, backend services, and customer\-facing UI in the same week, and you care about evals that catch regressions and traces that are easy to debug. **You Will** ------------ * Embed with customers and operators to understand how supply chains run today—then design and ship agents that take meaningful work off their plate. * Build production agent systems on frontier LLMs: tool use, sub\-agents, retrieval, structured outputs, MCP servers, and the orchestration that ties them together. * Own evaluation as a first\-class discipline—datasets from real traces, rubrics and graders, experiments, and improvements you can prove move the needle. * Architect the data, services, and APIs the agent layer depends on—integrating our internal systems with customers' WMS, TMS, and ERP environments. * Codify repeatable deployment patterns so each new customer rollout is faster than the last. **You Have** ------------ * 5\+ years of software engineering, with 1\+ year shipping LLM\- or agent\-based features into production. * Strong in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js, and comfortable designing APIs, distributed systems, and data models in PostgreSQL. * Hands\-on with the modern agent stack: production\-scale prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, orchestration patterns, and frontier model APIs. * A track record of building in fast, ambiguous environments—ideally at a vertical AI, AI\-agent, forward\-deployed, or data\-product company. * Excellent written and verbal communication—you can run a customer workshop in the morning and write a clean design doc in the afternoon. **Benefits** ------------ * Start\-up equity * Competitive Salary * 100% Paid health, dental \& vision coverage * Dinner Provided via DoorDash, free DashPass \& stocked kitchen for NY employees * Commuter benefit * Gympass Benefit * ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, HealthAdvocate, Teledoc Health **Salary Range Details** ------------------------ The compensation range for this position is set between $200,000 and $240,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. **Our Values** -------------- **Dream Big \-** We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life\-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long\-term value for short\-term results. **Olympian’s Work Ethic \-** Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field. **Growth Mindset \-** We confront the toughest challenges head\-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience. **Customer Obsession \-** We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high\-quality products and services that solve this massive and overlooked industries’ problems Job Applicant Privacy Notice Compensation Range: $200K \- $240K

jobs.title: Intermediate Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Family** IT Operations**About Us** At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests. Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there. **Who We Are** We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life. Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them. We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms. **What We Do** Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1\) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2\) Protection Solutions and Savings \& Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3\) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs. Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23\.9 million customers worldwide.\* For more information, visit transamerica.com. **Job Description Summary** The Intermediate Data Engineer is responsible for the development and support of systems, services, and applications required for the collection, storage, processing, and analysis of all forms of data to enable data\-driven decisions and outcomes across the enterprise.**Job Description** **Responsibilities** * Work collaboratively with other engineers, data scientists, analytics teams, and business product owners in an agile environment. * Build and support the operation of Cloud and On\-Premises enterprise data infrastructure and tools. * Design robust, reusable and scalable data driven solutions, and data pipeline frameworks to automate the ingestion, processing and delivery of structured and unstructured batch and real\-time streaming data. * Build data APIs and data delivery services to support critical operational processes, analytical models and machine learning applications. * Assist in selection and integration of data related tools, frameworks, and applications required to expand platform capabilities. * Understand and implement best practices in management of enterprise data, including master data, reference data, metadata, data quality and lineage. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, math, engineering, or relevant technical field * Two years of collective experience in the application of data engineering, data analytics, data warehousing, business intelligence, database administration and data integration concepts and methodologies * One year of experience developing and supporting modern data architectures * One year of experience developing and supporting large\-scale distributed applications * One year of experience with Linux operations and development, including basic commands and shell scripting * One year of experience with execution of DevOps methodologies and continuous integration/continuous delivery * Knowledge of SQL for data profiling, analysis and extraction * Results oriented with a strong customer focus * Ability to work within a team environment * Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines * Ability to learn and keep pace with the latest technology advances and quickly grasp new technologies to support the environment and contribute to project deliverables **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in a technical field (e.g. computer science, math, engineering) * Two years of experience developing, integrating REST APIs with backend data processing workflows using AWS Services * Experience with Snowflake cloud data platform, including data integration and ETL/ETL development * Understanding of b omes for clients, while keeping their information safe and secure. With more than 1,000 employees across the UK, US, Netherlands, Hungary, Spain, and Hong Kong, Enterprise Technology is a diverse, global team. Our experts work across areas such as application development, information security, infrastructure, data \& analytics, risk \& controls, program management, and architecture. We offer a wide range of career opportunities and are committed to supporting employee development. Curiosity is the quality we value most. Much of our work involves solving complex problems, applying knowledge in new ways, and continuously improving how we operate. As technology evolves rapidly, we look for inquisitive people who are confident challenging the status quo and helping us drive change. **What We Offer** For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well\-being of our employees. Compensation Benefits * Competitive Pay * Bonus for Eligible Employees Benefits Package * Pension Plan * 401k Match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Tuition Reimbursement * Disability Insurance * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Employee Discounts * Career Training \& Development Opportunities Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits * Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service. * Ten (10\) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays). * Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars * Parental Leave – fifteen (15\) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child. * Adoption Assistance * Employee Assistance Program * Back\-Up Care Program * PTO for Volunteer Hours * Employee Matching Gifts Program * Employee Resource Groups * Inclusion and Diversity Programs * Employee Recognition Program * Referral Bonus Programs **Inclusion \& Diversity** We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women. To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company\-sponsored, employee\-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all. **Giving Back** We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994\. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work. **Transamerica’s Parent Company** Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999\. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23\.9 million people across the globe.\* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: **Helping people live their best lives.** As a leading global investor and employer, the company seeks to have a positive impact by addressing critical environmental and societal issues, with a focus on climate change and inclusion and diversity. * As of December 31, 2023

If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level. **Job Description:** **Location**: Atlanta, Georgia, Dallas, TX, Mahwah, NJ flexible We are seeking a Lead Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for enterprise AI platforms that enable the development, deployment, and operation of intelligent applications, agents, and automation solutions. This role will be responsible for designing, building, and operating scalable platform capabilities on Red Hat OpenShift while ensuring reliability, security, performance, and compliance across the technology stack. infrastructure, security, architecture, and application teams to accelerate the adoption of enterprise AI capabilities. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise AI platform capabilities. * Provide technical leadership for OpenShift\-based platform environments supporting AI and intelligent automation workloads. * Define engineering standards, operational processes, and platform governance practices. * Build and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available platform services. * Develop automation for platform provisioning, deployment, upgrades, monitoring, and lifecycle management. * Establish observability, logging, monitoring, capacity planning, and performance management processes. * Partner with infrastructure, cybersecurity, architecture, and application teams to ensure alignment with enterprise technology standards. * Support development teams in onboarding, deployment, and operationalization of AI\-enabled solutions. * Drive platform reliability through proactive risk management, incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement. * Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend platform enhancements Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience. * 10\+ years of software engineering, platform engineering, cloud engineering, or Linux system administration experience. * 3\+ years of technical leadership or project management experience. * Strong hands\-on experience administering Red Hat OpenShift container platforms, including OpenShift 3\.x/4\.x, Kubernetes, Docker, RHEL/CoreOS, and containerized application platforms. * Experience with Istio Service Mesh, platform networking, container storage and enterprise platform operations. * Experience building, operating, and supporting large\-scale enterprise platforms with strong reliability, scalability, and operational practices. * Experience developing code, using source code repositories, and implementing DevOps engineering concepts. * Experience with automation and infrastructure\-as\-code practices using Ansible, Ansible Tower, shell scripting, and Jenkins Pipeline. * Experience with monitoring, observability, logging, and operational support using Prometheus, Dynatrace, and related platform monitoring tools. * Hands\-on experience with Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management. * Hands\-on GCP experience with Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Logging and Monitoring, Compute Engine, and networking. * Strong troubleshooting, communication, collaboration, and leadership skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation platforms. * Experience deploying and operating enterprise\-scale model serving agent\-based solutions. * Experience supporting GPU\-enabled workloads and high\-performance computing environments. * Experience with platform security, governance, compliance, and risk management. * Experience with DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, and platform engineering practices. * Experience integrating enterprise platforms with identity, data, and application ecosystems. Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short\-term and/or long\-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance. jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role and team** Engineering at Uber means building for real\-world impact under real\-world constraints. As a Software Engineer II on our Data and Storage teams, you will architect the foundational infrastructure that powers business decisions and core services for millions of users. Whether you are scaling distributed storage platforms or building high\-performance data pipelines, you will be solving complex challenges at the intersection of low latency, high correctness, and massive scale. The problems here are messy and the systems are global. You’ll need to make smart decisions with imperfect information, own your work end\-to\-end, and stay calm when high\-load systems are on the line. We are looking for engineers who think in systems, pride themselves on robust monitoring, and believe that the best solutions are built through candid feedback and cross\-functional collaboration. If you’re energized by challenges and motivated to move the real world \- this is where you’ll grow. **What you’ll do** * Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality code for features of moderate complexity and projects with multiple dependencies. * Build and scale foundational infrastructure and data pipelines, balancing technical debt and shifting priorities while keeping long\-term impact in mind. * Own the software lifecycle end\-to\-end, from drafting design docs to debugging production issues and managing incidents independently. * Collaborate across disciplines \- including Product, Data Science, and Ops \- to translate ambiguous requirements into simple, elegant system designs. * Champion engineering best practices by providing quality code reviews, creating comprehensive tests, and improving system performance. * Navigate internal complexity and stakeholder inquiries to unblock dependencies and ensure the reliability of our production environment. **Basic Qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend development, distributed systems, or data engineering. * Proficiency in one or more object\-oriented or functional programming languages (e.g., Go, Java, Python, or C\+\+). * Experience with data modeling, query optimization, and translating customer problems into system design. * Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * Experience writing tests to verify functionality and establishing monitoring systems to ensure code stability. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience identifying and reducing code\-level technical debt in high\-load distributed systems. * Background in mentoring new team members and contributing to engineering culture. * Proficiency with Big Data frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink) or real\-time data streaming (e.g., Kafka). * Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment on engineering trade\-offs for complex features. * Completing or recently completed a PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. **Preferred Qualifications** * Proven experience writing clean, maintainable, and high\-quality code in a production or collaborative research environment. * Deep technical expertise in one or more areas of computer science, such as distributed systems, algorithmic design, optimization, or large\-scale data processing. * Documented history of solving complex, unstructured problems through independent research or technical projects. * Experience designing and crafting scalable, reliable, and reusable software solutions that address complex architectural or algorithmic challenges. * Proven ability to thrive in a high\-ambiguity environment, demonstrating adaptability and a bias for action. * Strong systems\-thinking mindset, with the ability to balance long\-term technical health with short\-term business needs. * Excellent communication skills, with a track record of translating complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders. For New York City, NY\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. For Seattle, WA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. For Sunnyvale, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.
