jobs.title: Applied R&D Engineer
jobs.description: Build what's next in wood products. At Weyerhaeuser, we are a global leader in sustainable forestry, wood products, and timberland management. For more than a century, we have helped shape the built environment through innovative wood\-based solutions for residential, light commercial, and home improvement applications across North America and beyond. Our success is built on the talent, creativity, and dedication of our people. We foster an inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives, rewards results, and supports continuous learning and professional growth. We are committed to safety, integrity, sustainability, citizenship, and innovation. In return, we offer competitive compensation, exceptional benefits, and meaningful opportunities to develop your career while contributing to a renewable future. Join Our Applied R\&D Team! As an Applied R\&D Engineer, you will contribute to the development of innovative wood product solutions that are used in real buildings throughout North America. Working at the intersection of engineering, product development, manufacturing, and building science, you will help transform ideas into commercially viable products and applications. In this role, you will collaborate with engineers, scientists, and market analysts to solve complex building challenges. Your work will include product research and development, structural analysis, code evaluation and laboratory testing. We are seeking a curious and driven engineer who enjoys solving challenging technical problems, embraces innovation, and takes pride in delivering practical solutions that create value for customers. **Why Join Us?** • Develop product and building solutions that directly influence how structures are designed and built. • Work alongside a highly experienced and collaborative team of analysts, engineers and scientists. • Gain exposure across the complete product lifecycle, from concept development through manufacturing and market implementation. • Help advance innovation in a growing industry centered on sustainability and renewable materials. • Contribute to solutions that support a more resilient and sustainable built environment. Key Responsibilities • Promote and actively contribute to a strong safety\-first culture. • Develop innovative building and product solutions using structural analysis, engineering principles, and mechanical testing. • Apply building codes and design standards, including IBC, IRC, NDS, and ASCE standards, to support new product development and applications. • Develop and evaluate technical concepts for code compliance, manufacturing feasibility, and field application. • Plan, conduct, and oversee structural testing programs, including test design, execution, data analysis, and technical reporting. • Interpret technical data and translate findings into actionable product development recommendations. • Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to advance products from concept through commercialization. • Support code approvals, technical documentation, and engineering guidance for new products. **Qualifications** • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related field from an accredited institution. • Professional Engineer (PE) license. • Five or more years of engineering experience. • Strong knowledge of North American building codes, structural design principles, product applications, and engineering analysis. • Experience with wood design, engineered wood products, or building materials. • Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. • Ability to identify meaningful product development opportunities and translate them into practical solutions. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams. Join us and help create the next generation of wood products and building solutions. At Weyerhaeuser, your ideas, expertise, and innovation can make a lasting impact on the future of construction. **About Weyerhaeuser** We sustainably manage forests and manufacture products that make the world a better place. We’re serious about safety, driven to achieve excellence, and proud of what we do. With multiple business lines in locations across North America, we offer a range of exciting career opportunities for smart, talented people who are passionate about making a difference. We know you have a choice in your career. We want you to choose us. **What We Offer** **Compensation:** This role is eligible for our annual merit\-increase program, and we are targeting a salary range of $98,800\-$160,400 based on your level of skills, qualifications and experience. You will also be eligible for our Annual Incentive Program, which offers a cash bonus targeting 10\-15% of base pay. Potential plan funding may range from zero to two times that target. **Benefits:** When you join our team, you and your dependents will be offered coverage under our comprehensive employee benefits plan, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long\-term disability, and life insurance. We offer a pre\-tax Health Savings Account option which includes a company contribution. Other benefit options are also available such as voluntary Long\-Term Care and Employee Assistance Programs. We also support personal volunteerism, sponsor a host of diversity networks, promote mentoring, and provide training and development opportunities to help you chart your path to a fulfilling career. **Retirement:** Employees are able to enroll in our company’s 401k plan, which includes a paid company match in addition to our annual contribution equal to 5% of your base salary. **Paid Time Off or Vacation:** We provide eligible employees who are scheduled to work 25 hours or more per week with 3\-weeks of paid vacation to use during your first year of employment. In addition, after being employed for six months, eligible employees begin to accrue vacation for future use. We also recognize eleven paid holidays per year, providing a total of 88 holiday hours and paid parental leave for all full\-time employees. Weyerhaeuser is an equal opportunity employer. Inclusion is one of our five core values and we strive to maintain a culture where all our people feel a sense of belonging, opportunity and shared purpose. We are committed to recruiting a diverse workforce and supporting an equitable and inclusive environment that inspires people of all backgrounds to join, stay and thrive with our team. \#salary Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer, App Platform
jobs.description: **Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!** --------------------------------------------- Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops. As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact. We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce. **Role** -------- App Platform is Whatnot's client infrastructure team, building the consistent, reliable foundation that every product team builds on top of across iOS, Android, and web. Rather than owning a single feature surface, the team pushes technical boundaries so product pods can move fast without sacrificing quality — owning things like app stability, the Whatnot Design System, localization, core components, and the shared architecture that keeps our apps performant and consistent at scale. **What you'll do** * Design and maintain the app's core architecture and shared components: modularization, dependency management, navigation, and the patterns product teams build on * Build and harden the networking, real\-time and persistence layers behind live video, chat and bidding * Lead stability and performance work: crash and hang reduction, app launch time, memory, scroll and video performance * Partner closely with product teams as an internal consultant: shape scalable designs early, unblock them on hard technical problems, and write the docs and guidance that help them adopt platform work * Make sure our infrastructure lets product teams ship features fast and safely * Speed up the developer loop: build times, CI, test infrastructure, and release tooling * Build observability (crash reporting, performance monitoring, alerting) so we catch regressions before users do **We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in\-person time for planning, problem\-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of our New York, Seattle, San Francisco or Los Angeles hub.** **You** ------- People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they're building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 6\+ years of professional iOS engineering experience, including meaningful time on infrastructure, architecture, or platform work * Deep expertise in Swift and iOS fundamentals: the runtime, memory management, concurrency (Swift Concurrency and GCD), and the app lifecycle * A track record of measurably improving stability or performance, for example crash\-free rate, launch time or hang rate * Strong partnership skills: you treat product engineers as your customers, build trust across teams, and can turn their needs into platform priorities * Experience designing APIs and frameworks that other engineers use, with good judgment about abstraction, migration paths and adoption * Comfort with profiling and debugging tools such as Instruments, crash symbolication, and memory graphs * Bonus: + Real\-time or media experience: WebSockets, AVFoundation, live video + Experience with experimentation, feature\-flagging, or analytics infrastructure on the client + Experience scaling a large iOS codebase or team: modularization, build systems (Bazel, Tuist, SPM), or CI/CD + Experience with GraphQL clients, offline and caching strategies, or local persistence (Core Data, SQLite, GRDB) + Contributions to open\-source iOS libraries or tooling **Benefits** ------------ * Generous Holiday and Time off Policy * Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision * Work From Home Support + Home office setup allowance + Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet * Care benefits + Monthly allowance for wellness + Annual allowance towards Childcare + Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses * Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally * Monthly allowance to dogfood the app + All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!). * Parental Leave + 16 weeks of paid parental leave \+ one month gradual return to work \*company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence. **Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.** **EOE** ------- Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce. Compensation Range: $210K \- $230K

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, CX
jobs.description: **Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!** --------------------------------------------- Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops. As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact. We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce. **Role** -------- We’re looking for a Staff\+ Backend Engineer to help build the systems behind a world\-class Customer Experience platform at Whatnot. As Whatnot grows across buyers, sellers, markets, and support channels, our challenge is to resolve increasingly complex needs quickly and reliably—while protecting customer trust and making support scale with the business. Our work spans support intake and routing, buyer and seller support, Seller Provided Support (SPS), refunds and returns, CX Inbox and AI\-powered support. We’re building toward a more connected experience: capture context once, make it easy for the right system or person to resolve the issue, and ensure the outcome is completed and communicated across channels. You’ll help set the technical direction for the next generation of CX systems. That includes making AI\-assisted support safe and measurable; building configurable, observable, and testable automation; improving how support requests and conversations connect across surfaces; and strengthening the backend workflows that carry a case through decisions, refunds, returns, and follow\-up. You’ll work across CX, Product, Operations, AI, Payments, Logistics, Trust, and other engineering teams to turn ambiguous customer and business problems into durable systems. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You’ll lead architecture and delivery across multi\-team initiatives, make thoughtful tradeoffs between near\-term customer impact and long\-term platform health, and raise the quality and effectiveness of the broader engineering organization. This role is based near one of our hubs in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle. **You** ------- Curious about who thrives at Whatnot? We’ve found that low ego and a growth mindset, while leaning into action, details, and impact, go a long way here. As our next Staff\+ Backend Engineer, you bring 9\+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership on complex backend systems, and: * **Customer experience domain depth:** Meaningful experience building customer support, service, marketplace post\-purchase, or other operationally complex customer\-facing systems. You understand that CX is a system of experiences, policies, workflows, and operations—not just a ticketing tool—and can bring that context to technical decisions. * **Backend systems expertise:** A track record of designing, building, and operating reliable, high\-scale backend services and end\-to\-end product experiences. Experience with Python, Elixir, and/or Postgres is useful. * **Technical strategy and architecture:** Ability to identify the systems and foundational investments a product area needs next, set a clear technical direction, and evolve legacy systems without stopping product delivery. * **End\-to\-end ownership:** You lead initiatives from problem discovery and technical design through launch, measurement, reliability, and iteration. You make progress across organizational boundaries and surface risks and dependencies early. * **Product and operational judgment:** You translate customer needs and business goals into pragmatic technical solutions, balancing customer experience, support quality, cost, trust, and speed. * **Quality and reliability mindset:** You build for observable behavior, safe change, testing, recoverable workflows, and clear system ownership—especially when software takes actions on a customer’s behalf. * **Staff\-level leadership:** You raise the technical bar through design reviews, mentorship, and clear communication; create alignment without relying on authority; and help teams make sound decisions in ambiguity. * **Collaborative teammate:** You improve the team environment and foster an inclusive, supportive culture. **Benefits** ------------ * Generous Holiday and Time off Policy * Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision * Work From Home Support + Home office setup allowance + Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet * Care benefits + Monthly allowance for wellness + Annual allowance towards Childcare + Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses * Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally * Monthly allowance to dogfood the app + All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!). * Parental Leave + 16 weeks of paid parental leave \+ one month gradual return to work \*company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence. **Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. jobs.title: Software Engineer I (Backend, Growth)
jobs.description: At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. As a Software Engineer I, you will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of the services that power WHOOP’s core product experiences. You will work closely with experienced engineers, product managers, designers, and data scientists to build scalable, reliable systems that deliver meaningful insights to our members. This is a growth\-oriented role ideal for engineers who are excited to learn, ship high\-quality code, and make an impact in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Contribute to the development and maintenance of backend services and APIs that power WHOOP’s member\-facing features using technologies such as Java, Kafka, Postgres, and AWS. * Collaborate with cross\-functional partners across Product, Design, Data Science, and Engineering to translate requirements into well\-scoped technical solutions. * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code while participating in code reviews to continuously improve engineering quality and standards. * Support the operation and monitoring of production systems, helping to troubleshoot issues and ensure reliability, scalability, and performance. * Break down feature requirements into actionable tasks, identify risks early, and iterate quickly to deliver value to members. * Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing to support team velocity and long\-term maintainability. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Professional experience in backend software development (internship, co\-op, or academic project experience acceptable). * Experience building or interacting with RESTful APIs and relational databases (e.g., Postgres or similar SQL\-based systems). * Proficiency in an jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- The Staff Engineer performs professional engineering duties related to transportation system planning and maintenance under limited supervision from the County Engineer. **Examples of Duties** ---------------------- *The intent of this job description is to provide a representative summary of the primary duties and responsibilities performed by incumbents in this position. The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and may change with or without notice. Incumbents must be able to perform the essential function of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.* * Conducts engineering studies related to County transportation system planning, design, and maintenance * Develops overall design concepts and prepares details for transportation infrastructure, including roads, bridges, and drainage systems * Utilizes AutoCAD Civil 3D to develop plan and profile sheets, estimates, and detailed design documents * Prepares design specifications for transportation\-related projects * Performs engineering calculations to determine quantities, areas, and project costs * Conducts or oversees construction inspections, materials testing, construction staking, and surveying to ensure compliance with project specifications and contract requirements * Maintains accurate records and documentation, including field notes, daily logs, and project reports, in accordance with County, State, and Federal requirements * Manages a comprehensive inventory of County road surfacing types, bridges, and culverts; ensures timely reporting to the North Dakota Department of Transportation and other agencies * Maintains project files and provides project management for road and bridge improvement projects directly or through coordination with consulting engineers * Performs traffic analysis by deploying and retrieving radar traffic counters; interprets data to inform roadway planning and maintenance decisions * Assists with special assessment projects in accordance with the North Dakota Century Code * Reviews and coordinates engineering plans and plat submissions through the County Planning and Zoning Board and the Building Department * Maintains confidentiality of non\-public records and makes available all data and information deemed a public record by the North Dakota Century Code. **Typical Qualifications** -------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related field * Current registration as a Licensed Professional Engineer in the State of North Dakota or ability to obtain upon hire * Must possess a valid North Dakota Driver’s License or equivalent * Must pass a background check and pre\-employment drug and alcohol screening **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- * Work is performed in an office setting and an outdoor environment with exposure to extreme temperatures and inclement weather * Some work is performed on construction sites with exposure to uneven ground, loud noises, chemicals, and construction equipment * Must be able to lift/carry 50lbs **Compensation:** Starting salary ranges from $64\.00 to $70\.00/hour based on qualifications and experience. **Benefits:** Williams County offers a generous benefit package, including paid sick and vacation 12 paid holidays per year, fully paid health, dental and vision insurance for single, single plus dependent, or family contracts, term life insurance, long term disability insurance, fully funded retirement benefits through the North Dakota Public Employees Retirement System. To learn more about Williams County, please visit our website: https://www.williamsnd.com/departments/county\-information/ To learn more about living and working in Williams County, visit whereinwilliamscounty.com. *All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, drug screening, and reference review.* Williams County offers competitive pay, a great work environment and a generous benefit package to full time employees, including a fully\-paid health/dental/vision plan for the entire family. Williams County pays the full premium for family, single\-plus\-dependent or single coverage plan for each full\-time employee. Williams County provides a monthly allowance toward the purchase of a voluntary supplemental insurance policy for each full\-time employee. Coverage may include single, single\-plus\-dependent or family coverage on any voluntary supplemental insurance provided by the designated Williams County supplemental insurance provider. Williams County pays the premium for a $25,000 term life insurance policy and $25,000 accidental death and dismemberment policy for full\-time employees. Williams County pays the premium for a Long Term Disability Insurance plan for full\-time employees. Employees who are at least 18 years of age and are working in a qualified position an average of 20 hours per week for five or more months of the year are required to participate in the North Dakota Public Employees Retirement System (ND PERS) Retirement Plan. Membership will become effective immediately upon employment.

jobs.title: GRC Engineer
jobs.description: Opening Type: Business Professionals Department: Information Technology Employment Type: Full\-Time Location: Palo Alto 650 Page Mill Road Palo Alto CA 94304\-1050 US * 650\-493\-9300 Wilson Sonsini is the premier legal advisor to technology, life sciences, and other growth enterprises worldwide. We represent companies at every stage of development, from entrepreneurial start\-ups to multibillion\-dollar global corporations, as well as the venture firms, private equity firms, and investment banks that finance and advise them. The firm has approximately 1,100 attorneys in 17 offices: 13 in the U.S., two in China, and two in Europe. Our broad spectrum of practices and entrepreneurial spirit allow exceptional opportunities for professional achievement and career growth. The GRC Engineer a mid\-level position the works under the direction of the governance, risk and compliance leadership and reports to the Manager of IT Risk Operations. The position is technical and analytical in nature and requires a self\-directed professional who is committed to applying industry best practices in the areas of governance, risk, and compliance. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** ------------------------------------------ **Framework Alignment and Control Mapping** * Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of the client’s NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) program, including tracking progress against current and target profiles and supporting assessments against related standards (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, CIS Controls, SOC 2\). * Map the security controls in the current environment to NIST requirements (e.g., SP 800\-53\) and other applicable frameworks, perform gap analyses and self\-assessments, and identify gaps for remediation. * Support delivery of the client’s current security risk and compliance standards and maintain related documentation. **Risk Management and GRC Tooling** * Record and maintain security risks in the Risk Register, and coordinate with other teams as needed to obtain status and provide insights for remediation of risks. * Contribute to the ServiceNow implementation (e.g., requirements, testing, and workflow input). * Identify critical/high\-risk systems and processes and document the associated risk profiles. * Resolve tickets assigned to the governance, risk and compliance team and track them to closure. * Prepare and deliver periodic risk, compliance, and service\-level metrics and reports for the client’s program, tailored to leadership and stakeholder audiences. **Threat and Risk Analysis** * Gather and analyze data from various IT systems and security tooling (e.g., SIEM and log sources, unauthorized access attempts, phishing reports) that identify risk, and create reports that provide specific details. * Use threat, vulnerability, and endpoint/cloud security management systems and tools (e.g., SIEM, vulnerability scanners, Microsoft Defender) to identify critical/high\-risk systems, create threat analysis reports, initiate follow\-up action, and help reduce risk. * Partner with security operations and incident response teams to translate incident and vulnerability trends into risk register entries and remediation recommendations, and maintain related standard operating procedures. * Analyze policies, systems, hardware, software, cloud, and network infrastructure and recommend methods and strategies that reduce risk. **Awareness, Third\-Party Risk and Client Assurance** * Administer the cybersecurity awareness training program (e.g., assigning courses, tracking completion, and reporting results). * Conduct Third\-Party Risk Management analysis, including review of vendor security documentation and recording of results. * Complete security questionnaires and provide supporting documentation within agreed turnaround times. * Perform other related duties as assigned by the client’s governance, risk and compliance leadership. **Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:** -------------------------------------------------- * 3\+ years of experience in security risk, governance, and compliance (GRC). Security operations or incident response experience with demonstrated GRC exposure (e.g., control assessments, audits, compliance reporting) will be considered. * Working knowledge of the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST SP 800\-53, SP 800\-30, and SP 800\-39, with an understanding of the cybersecurity risk assessment process. * Working knowledge of IT fundamentals, including networking, identity and access management (e.g., Active Directory), and cloud security (e.g., Microsoft Azure). * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain risk to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong organizational, interpersonal, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure, work independently, and collaborate with diverse teams. * Sound judgment, high ethical standards, and the discretion to handle confidential client information. * Ability to respond promptly to unplanned requests within agreed service\-level expectations and to accurately estimate time and resources for projects. * Commitment to continuous learning of new technologies, frameworks, and skills. * Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in information security, information technology, risk management, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, certification, and experience. * Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., CompTIA Security\+, CISA, CRISC, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, Microsoft SC\-200 or AZ\-500\). **Preferred:** -------------- * Law firm experience, including responding to client security questionnaires and reviewing outside counsel guidelines. * Experience with a GRC platform (e.g., ServiceNow, RSA Archer) and with SIEM, vulnerability, or threat management tools (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk). * Scripting or automation experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, KQL) to streamline recurring GRC reporting and data\-gathering. * Working knowledge of Claude, Legora, BitSight, and/or Prompt Armor. The primary location for this job posting is in Palo Alto. The actual base pay offered will depend upon a variety of factors, including but not limited to the selected candidate’s qualifications, years of relevant experience, level of education, professional certifications and licenses, and work location. The anticipated pay range for this position is as follows: $116,875 – $158,125 per year. The compensation for this position may include a discretionary year\-end merit bonus based on performance. We offer a highly competitive salary and benefits package. Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE).

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** ***Due to the on\-site requirements of this role, preference will be given to candidates currently residing in Colorado. This position is not eligible for full\-time remote work. Relocation assistance is not provided.*** Ent Credit Union and Wings Credit Union joined forces in January 2026\. This merger means more opportunities, expanded resources, and a shared commitment to delivering exceptional member service. Together, we become more \- empowering members, communities, and teams through a bold, unified future. Both organizations bring a strong legacy of member satisfaction, operational excellence, financial stability, and community impact. Recognized locally and nationally as best\-in\-class financial institutions and employers of choice, each is known for its commitment to financial well\-being and philanthropic leadership. Join us during this transformative time and be part of shaping the future of banking! To learn more about the merger, click here. **Job Description** This role is responsible for identifying opportunities where artificial intelligence can improve decision making, streamline operations, enhance member experiences, and create measurable business value. It combines business curiosity, experimentation, technical problem solving, and solution development to uncover high value opportunities and transform them into practical, governed AI\-enabled solutions. Rather than simply implementing technology, the AI solutions engineer seeks to understand how work gets done today, challenges existing assumptions, and helps business teams discover new and better ways of operating. The successful candidate is comfortable working across business and technical teams, translating operational challenges into innovative solutions while balancing governance, risk management, and long term sustainability. This position owns the full solution lifecycle, from opportunity discovery and requirement definition through solution design, development, testing, deployment, adoption and continuous improvement. Success in this role is measured not by the number of solutions delivered, but by the business outcomes achieved, the problems solved, and the value created for members, employees, and the organization. **Essential Functions** * Opportunity Discovery \& Experimentation: + Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand workflows, decision processes, operational challenges, and opportunities for improvement. + Identify opportunities where AI can create meaningful business value through increased effectiveness, efficiency, consistency, or member experience. + Form hypotheses, develop rapid prototypes, and conduct experiments to evaluate potential solutions before larger investments are made. + Challenge existing assumptions and recommend alternative approaches when traditional methods no longer represent the best solution. + Employ innovative and evidence\-based approaches to solving business problems + Develop business cases and value assessments that support prioritization and investment decisions. * AI Solution Design \& Development: + Design, build, test, and implement AI\-enabled solutions that improve business outcomes and operational effectiveness. + Develop prototypes, proofs of concept, and production ready solutions using modern AI technologies including generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning, and workflow orchestration platforms. + Evaluate multiple solution approaches and select the most appropriate technology, methodology, and implementation strategy. + Leverage a broad range of AI tools, platforms and techniques to rapidly iterate and deliver value. + Collaborate with business stakeholders throughout development to validate assumptions and refine solutions. * Business Engagement \& Transformation: + Translate business challenges into structured business and technical requirements. + Facilitate discovery sessions to understand current state processes and envision future state operating models. + Help business teams rethink traditional workflows and identify opportunities to create AI\-enabled or AI\-native processes. + Communicate technical concepts in a clear and business friendly manner. + Manage stakeholder expectations regarding scope, timelines, risk, and anticipated benefits. + Build strong partnerships across business and technical teams to drive adoption and organizational change. * Governance, Risk \& Responsible AI: + Ensure all AI solutions comply with governance, security, privacy, risk management, and regulatory requirements. + Maintain documentation that supports auditability, transparency, explainability, and long\-term sustainability. + Participate in reviews with Risk, Compliance, Information Security, Legal, and Internal Audit partners. + Ensure solutions follow approved change management, model governance, and control frameworks. + Support Responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, explainability, accou ate reusable assets, frameworks, implementation patterns, and best practices. + Share lessons learned and successful approaches across teams. + Actively explore emerging AI technologies, techniques, and business applications. + Serve as a champion for responsible experimentation, innovation, and continuous learning. * Bank Secrecy Act: Remains cognizant of and adheres to Wings policies and procedures, and regulations pertaining to the Bank Secrecy Act. **Qualifications** **Minimum Formal Qualifications for this Position:** * Master's Degree in a scientific/engineering discipline such as computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, artificial intelligence, physics, operations research or a related field, *required* + *Equivalent combinations of education, technical training, and demonstrated experience delivering analytical or technology enabled solutions may be considered in lieu of degree requirements* * 3\+ years or experiencing solving business problems through technology, analytics, process improvement, operations, software development, consulting, or related disciplines, *required* * Experience working with AI, automation, or technology\-enabled business solutions, *required* * Experience within financial services, credit unions, banking, lending, risk management, compliance, operations or similar regulated industries, *preferred* **Technical or Specialized Knowledge/Skills:** * Strong business analysis, problem solving and critical thinking abilities. * Ability to understand complex business processes and identify opportunities for improvement. * Demonstrated ability to translate business challenges into practical and scalable solutions. * Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to work effectively across business and technical teams. * Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. * Proven record of self\-directed learning, experimentation, and application of emerging technologies. * Strong systems thinking mindset with the ability to connect business strategy, process design, data, and technology. * Ability to evaluate multiple solution paths and determine the most effective approach rather than defaulting to a specific tool or technology. * Intellectual curiosity and a passion for understanding how businesses operate and how they can improve. * Strong governance, risk, and control awareness. * Experience using a variety of AI platforms and tools with a commitment to continuous learning. * Exposure to data analytics technologies including SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, Excel or similar tools preferred. * Experience with Microsoft Azure AI, Microsoft CoPilot, OpenAI, Anthropic technologies, automation platforms, APIs, workflow orchestration tools, or cloud based services *preferred.* * Familiarity with software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile, or product delivery methodologies *preferred*. * Understanding of governance, audit, compliance, regulatory, or operational risk frameworks *preferred*. **Additional Information** **PAY RANGE:** $108,000 to $126,000 annually (I16\) plus a 15% annual target bonus *Final compensation for this position will be determined by various factors such as relevant work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, certifications, location and internal pay equity.* **BENEFITS:** * Generous 401(k) match * 401k Discretionary Profit Sharing * Health Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Life Insurance * Short Term and Long Term Disability * Health Savings Account with company contribution * Employee Assistance Program * Paid Vacation, Sick, Floating Holidays and Volunteer Time Off * Paid Holidays * Tuition Reimbursement * Paid Parental Leave **We anticipate this position to close on 11/12/2026\. Please submit your application at your earliest convenience to be considered.** Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities.

We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. When Workday launches new AI agents and products, early deployments surface complex real\-world challenges—from unstructured tenant data and intricate configurations to edge\-case enterprise workflows. FDE pods deploy directly into active customer engagements to resolve technical friction, debug complex setups, and build lightweight integrations. Crucially, FDEs serve as the primary feedback engine for Product and Engineering: field insights, recurring customer friction, and configuration patterns are converted directly into scalable, out\-of\-the\-box product capabilities. It's a team where deep technical skill meets real customer impact, every day. **About the Role** As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll bridge hands\-on software development with high\-impact customer technical strategy — taking on the most complex, ambiguous engagements where no existing playbook applies. You will partner with enterprise customers, often at the executive level, to architect, deploy, debug, and optimize Workday's AI agents and developer platform solutions inside live customer environments. You'll work across the full deployment lifecycle alongside AI Deployment Architects, Product Managers, and Workday Services leads. Beyond delivering for individual customers, you'll help set the technical direction for the FDE practice itself: turning field\-tested solutions into scalable product capabilities and mentoring other engineers along the way. **What you'll do:** * **Technical Deployment \& Engineering:** Architect, deploy, configure, and debug AI agents and integrations inside the most complex live enterprise tenant environments, frequently in situations with no established precedent. * **Customer Discovery \& Solution Architecture:** Lead technical discovery sessions with senior leaders at customer organizations, translating ambiguous business requirements into robust product configurations, POCs, and integration specs. * **Product Feedback \& Influence:** Synthesize field telemetry, edge\-case engagements and lead the work of turning custom fixes into standardized, automated, out\-of\-the\-box product capabilities. * **Cross\-Functional \& Executive Alignment:** Act as a trusted technical advisor to Workday Services leads, AI Deployment Architects, Account Teams, and customer executives, keeping every engagement focused on core product strength. * **Engagement Leadership \& Mentorship:** Own the most strategically important or technically complex engagements end\-to\-end — from kickoff through graduation — within standard 6\-month deployment cycles, while coaching other FDEs on technical approach and customer engagement. **About You** **Basic Qualifications** * **Experience:** 10\+ years of experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Software Development, including experience leading complex, high\-stakes enterprise technical engagements. * **Technical Execution:** Hands\-on coding and debugging skills (for example, Python, Java, or similar), with deep knowledge of REST APIs, object\-oriented design, system architecture, and integration patterns. * **Workday Knowledge:** Working knowledge of Workday, including business processes, security and permissions, tenant configuration, integrations, and how customers implement and govern Workday, so you can read a customer's tenant and understand how agentic features and agents will  mate who mentors other engineers and helps multi\-disciplinary account and delivery pods work well together. **Preferred Qualifications** Applied experience with LLM\-powered or agentic AI systems — e.g., prompt/context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, evaluations, or agent orchestration frameworks — and a working understanding of how model behavior shows up jobs.title: AI & Process Automation Specialist
jobs.description: **Yogurtland** **Hiring: AI \& Process Automation Specialist** Location: Farmers Branch, TX (Hybrid) Shift: Monday–Friday (Overtime as Needed) Pay: $75,000–$85,000/year \*Depending on Experience. **POSITION SUMMARY** We are seeking an AI \& Process Automation Specialist to drive efficiency and innovation across our operations. In this role, you will implement cutting\-edge AI solutions (including Large Language Models and other automation tools) to streamline business processes and boost company efficiency. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify improvement opportunities and lead AI\-driven initiatives that modernize how we work. This position is hybrid, based in Farmers Branch, TX, with 4 days on\-site and 1 day remote each week. If you’re excited about leveraging AI to solve problems and improve systems in a supportive, values\-driven team, we’d love to hear from you. **Web Development:** Hands\-on experience building and deploying modern web applications using Next.js (React framework), TypeScript/JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS, with deployment via Vercel. Familiarity with REST/GraphQL API integration and responsive design. **Database \& Cloud:** Experience with Azure SQL Database (or similar cloud\-based relational databases): schema design, query optimization using T\-SQL, and managing connections via tools like Azure Data Studio or SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS). General familiarity with the Microsoft Azure ecosystem (e.g., Azure App Service, Azure Functions) is a plus. **Data Engineering:** Experience designing and maintaining data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows using tools such as Azure Data Factory, Python (pandas, SQLAlchemy), or dbt. Ability to structure, clean, and move data reliably between systems (Azure SQL, POS/ERP platforms, and dashboards) using version control (Git/GitHub) to support the AI and automation initiatives described above. **REQUIREMENTS \& QUALIFICATIONS (LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS)** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field requirement. * **Experience:** 2\-5 years of hands\-on experience in AI automation, process automation, or data\-driven operations. Early career professionals with relevant project experience (including vibe coding projects) are welcome. * **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills:** Ability to analyze complex datasets and processes to find inefficiencies and recommend improvements. Comfort working with ambiguous or high\-level requirements and rapidly iterating solutions is a strong plus. * **Collaboration \& Communication Skills:** Excellent teamwork and communication abilities. Proven capacity to coordinate projects, work cross\-functionally, and drive initiatives to completion. Ability to effectively articulate high\-level “vibes” or conceptual requirements to both technical teams and AI coding tools is highly desirable. * **Project Management (Preferred but not required):** Experience managing projects (e.g., scoping requirements, assigning tasks, meeting deadlines) is a plus. **Technical Proficiency:** * **AI/Automation:** Experience with AI tools and frameworks (e.g. chatbots, robotic process automation, machine learning models). Strong preference for candidates experienced in AI\-augmented development workflows. * **Programming \& Scripting:** Proficiency in Python or similar languages to build and maintain automation scripts or workflows. Experience with vibe coding practices is highly valued. * **Vibe Coding \& AI\-Assisted Development (Highly Valued):** Demonstrated experience with vibe coding using modern AI coding agents and tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Replit Agent, or similar). This includes using natural\-language prompting to describe desired functionality (“the vibe”), rapidly generating and iterating on code, reviewing and refining AI\-generated output, and accelerating automation development. * **Automation Platforms:** Familiarity with Microsoft Power Automate or similar workflow tools. * **Data Management (Preferred but Not Required):** Exposure to managing and manipulating data in SQL databases, creating dashboards in Power BI, and optimizing data pipelines. **OFFERED** * **Benefits Package:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings plan; paid time off. * **Professional Growth:** Training, mentorship, and opportunities to work on cross\-department projects. * **Collaborative Culture:** A supportive environment that values innovation, teamwork, and diverse perspectives. * **Employee Perks:** Product discounts, access to exclusive events, and additional incentives. **Work Location:** Hybrid remote in Farmers Branch, TX Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $82,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Farmers Branch, TX

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, 3D Simulation
jobs.description: The 3D Simulation group at Zoox is looking for machine learning engineers to bring the latest research in 3D vision to accelerate autonomy by blurring the line between simulation and reality. Our ML group is working on generating rich and diverse 3D environments, humans, and environmental conditions using reconstruction and generative models. You will have access to the best sensor data in the world and an incredible infrastructure for testing and validation to bring new algorithms into our robotics stack. ### **In this role, you will:** * Research, implement, and optimize state of the art machine learning approaches to improve 3D simulation variation and fidelity * Collaborate with ML Researchers, Technical Artists and Simulation engineers to bring new ML techniques to our production simulator * Train 4D generative and world models for simulating rare scenarios * Build scalable, useable cloud pipelines for machine learning solutions in 3D simulation * Improve rendering and tooling for generating realistic data at scale ### **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience with Python/C\+\+ programming and algorithm design * Experience building and extending radiance field ML models * Experience with generative models for 3D or video content * Publications or production experience in human\-centric 3D vision, 3D reconstruction, or style transfer * Strong mathematical skills and understanding of probabilistic techniques ### **Bonus Qualifications** * Experience automating 3D content pipelines using applications like Houdini, Maya, or Blender * Experience in distributed systems and cloud computing platforms * Experience in generative camera, lidar, radar, or LWIR **Base Salary Range** There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.**About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team. Follow us on LinkedIn **Accommodations** If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter. ***A Final Note:****You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Senior Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** A global lead company applies AI to its own operations first. You will set the technical direction for a model platform used across sales, support, finance and engineering, with direct, measurable cost and quality impact. is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. IT AI/ML Engineering team is hiring a Senior Staff AI Engineer to serve as technical lead for two engineering groups: one that runs our shared AI platform, and one that delivers AI solutions and support to teams across the company. You will set technical direction, keep delivery on track, and work day to day with engineers and contractors in the US and India. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will own the architecture and roadmap for platform services such as model gateways and cost controls, AI observability and evaluation, and shared memory and context, along with the AI\-powered applications, enterprise AI tool administration and support processes built on top. Deep expertise in model inference or training is not required. **What You'll Do** * Lead the AI platform group. Own architecture, roadmap and delivery for shared services: LLM gateways and model routing, AI cost optimization, observability and evaluation, an internal catalog of agents and skills, and long\-term memory and context for AI applications. * Lead the AI solutions and support group. Own delivery and quality for AI\-powered help and search experiences, the rollout and administration of enterprise AI platforms, and the L2 support model, including triage, escalation, runbooks and training workshops. * Anchor a distributed team. Work with engineers and contractors across the US and India, bridge time zones, run planning and reviews, and make sure context and decisions flow in both directions. * Plan and prioritize. Turn business requests into a clear priority order, balance capacity across the team, flag risks early, and report status to engineering leadership and stakeholders. * Stay hands\-on. Design and review APIs, services, front\-end and back\-end code, and CI/CD pipelines; unblock engineers; set standards for code quality, testing and documentation. * Set the quality bar for AI solutions. Define release gates, regression checks and cost and latency targets using evaluation and observability tooling, and partner with the team that owns models and agents on model selection and tuning. * Run operations well. Reduce repeat support tickets through automation and better documentation, lead incident response and postmortems, and track platform cost, usage and reliability. * Partner across the company. Work with business owners in sales, support, finance andengineering, and with Security, Privacy and Legal on data handling, access controls and approvals. * Grow the team. Mentor engineers, help hire, manage contractor performance, and share best practices through documentation and workshops.What You Bring **Minimum Qualifications** 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years building production applications with LLMs or other ML services; Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience). 3\+ years as a technical lead or equivalent, leading engineers on shared deliverables, ideally across time zones and with contractors. Strong full\-stack skills: Python and TypeScript/Node.js (or Java/Go), a modern front\-end framework such as React, and solid API design. Practical experience with LLM applications: prompt and tool design, retrieval\-augmented generation, agents and function calling or MCP , and gateways or routing layers. Experience with evaluation and observability for AI systems: test sets, regression suites, LLM\-as\-judge, tracing, and cost and latency tracking. Cloud and DevOps skills: AWS (or GCP/Azure), Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD, with monitoring, canary and rollback practice. Experience running or supporting a production service, including on\-call, incident response, runbooks and L2 escalation. Clear written and verbal communication, with a record of managing priorities and expectations with leaders and business partners. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience administering enterprise AI platforms and vendor accounts (such as Claude, OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock or Vertex), including usage controls and cost governance. Experience with vector and graph databases, and with agent memory and context management. Experience building search or help experiences, Slack bots and web widgets integrated with AI services. Familiarity with model inference, fine\-tuning and open\-weight models; helpful but not required. Experience running enablement: workshops, documentation and internal training for AI tools. Experience in regulated environments such as FedRAMP. **Team, Location and Compensation** Team. You will join IT AI/ML Engineering team and lead two of its groups, working closely with the group that builds agents and models. Day to day you will use Python, TypeScript, AWS, Kubernetes, LLM gateways and evaluation tooling. Location. Hybrid, three days per week in San Jose, CA or Bellevue, WA; remote within the US considered for exceptional candidates. Pay: $207,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Retirement plan Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Jose, CA 95139

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Data Transformation Platform
jobs.description: dv01, a Fitch Solutions company, is lifting the curtain on the largest financial market in the world: structured finance. The $16\+ trillion market is the backbone of everyday activities that empower financial freedom, from consolidating credit card debt and refinancing student loans, to buying a home and starting a small business. dv01's data analytics platform brings unparalleled transparency into investment performance and risk for lenders and Wall Street investors in structured products. As a data\-first company, we wrangle critical loan data and build modern analytical tools that enable strategic decision\-making for responsible lending. In a nutshell, we're helping prevent a repeat of the 2008 global financial crisis by offering the data and tools required to make smarter, data\-driven decisions resulting in a safer world for all of us. More than 400 of the largest financial institutions use dv01 for our coverage of over 75 million loans spanning mortgages, personal loans, auto, buy\-now\-pay\-later programs, small business, and student loans. dv01 continues to expand coverage of new markets, adding loans monthly, and developing new technologies for the structured products universe. A Senior Data Engineer on the Data Transformation Platform team builds and maintains the data pipelines that turn billions of dollars of loan and bond data into the datasets behind the dv01 platform. The team owns the building blocks for the organization's data management needs and the architecture that keeps our data the single source of truth for the securitization markets we cover. This is a hands\-on senior role on a small, highly collaborative team, where your decisions shape how our users see risk and performance and your contributions have a visible and lasting effect on the business. **You will:** * Design, build and maintain production data pipelines in Python, SQL and dbt on Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc) and Databricks * Own the architecture and data modeling of pipelines and schemas that scale * Profile and optimize large data jobs for performance and cost * Deliver roadmap projects end to end, from building new pipelines and migrating legacy ones to modernizing the platform they run on * Keep production healthy: monitor and troubleshoot pipeline jobs, take part in the on\-duty rotation, and fix root causes * Review code, mentor engineers and analysts, and improve the team's tooling, including AI\-assisted development with tools such as Claude Code * Work with analysts, product and other engineering teams to turn data requirements into correct, maintainable transformations **You are:** * An experienced data engineer, with 7\+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines and platforms on a major cloud provider, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP) * A rigorous data modeler who designs data pipelines and schemas that other engineers can maintain and extend * Fluent in Python and SQL, with hands\-on experience in dbt and Spark; Scala or Java is a plus * Proven at making large data jobs faster and cheaper * Comfortable managing deployment and orchestration for complex production pipelines * Hands\-on with Databricks for pipelines and analytics, including workspace administration. * Self\-directed and capable of making a large impact with a small team. You are able to both work independently and collaborate deeply as needed, you proactively explore and evaluate new technologies. * Curious about structured finance; financial knowledge is preferred but not required and can be learned on the job **BENEFITS \& PERKS:** * **Paid Time Off.** Vacation days, personal holidays and paid sick days on top of company holidays, so you can unplug and rejuvenate. * **401(k) with Company Match.** Build long\-term savings with a company match on your contributions. * **Health Care.** A comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance package for you and your family. * **Parental Leave and Family Support.** 10 weeks of paid leave for all parents and 16 weeks for birthing parents, at 100% of salary. Fertility support up to a $25,000 lifetime maximum and backup childcare through Bright Horizons. * **Learning \& Development.** Support for professional qualifications and external study programs, including certifications, courses, master's programs and MBAs, plus the Fitch Management Academy, MentorPoint mentorship, and Hearst Academy technical training. * **Wellbeing.** Wellhub gym and wellness memberships, free mental health support through Spring Health, and a confidential Employee Assistance Program. * **Everyday Support.** A $250 annual home office allowance, pre\-tax commuter benefits, and an employee referral program paying $2,500 to $10,000\. * **Community and Purpose.** Six active employee resource groups, 1:1 donation matching and paid volunteer hours, and company\-funded service trips to build schools abroad. In good faith our salary range for this role is $160,000 \- $175,000 but are not tied to it. jobs.title: Mobile Application Developer
jobs.description: At i3 Product Development, we are a place for people who love to build, learn, and stay curious, especially when the problems are complex. As part of Helios Technologies, i3 develops products for diverse customers and end markets, including established OEM brands in outdoor recreation, off\-road, health and wellness, and beyond. From mobile applications and connected devices to cloud\-based solutions, our work offers variety and opportunities to tackle interesting technical challenges. **About the Role** We're looking for a mobile developer who enjoys creative problem\-solving, building intuitive applications, and working at the intersection of software, hardware, and user experience. You will contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from understanding product requirements and shaping application features to designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting mobile solutions. Working closely with our software, firmware, and design teams, you'll help create reliable, easy\-to\-use applications that connect people with the products around them. You'll have opportunities to contribute ideas, influence technical decisions, and grow alongside an experienced engineering team that values individual expertise and collaboration. **What You Will Do** * Design, develop, test, and maintain mobile applications for iOS, Android, or cross\-platform environments. * Collaborate with product stakeholders, UX designers, and engineers to translate product requirements into intuitive, reliable mobile experiences. * Develop mobile applications that integrate with connected products, cloud services, APIs, and embedded systems. * Participate in software architecture and technical design discussions, considering application performance, usability, scalability, and long\-term maintainability. * Integrate mobile applications with RESTful APIs, web services, and backend systems. * Troubleshoot and resolve software issues throughout development, deployment, and ongoing product support. * Contribute to application deployment, maintenance, and updates through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. * Work within Agile development teams, contributing to planning, estimation, code reviews, and iterative development. * Apply sound engineering practices, including source control, automated testing, continuous integration, and documentation. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * 3\+ years of professional mobile app development experience. * Strong understanding of software development fundamentals and maintainable coding practices. * Experience developing native or cross\-platform mobile applications for iOS or Android. * Professional experience with relevant mobile development languages or frameworks, such as Swift, Kotlin, Flutter, React Native, or .NET MAUI. * Experience developing applications that integrate with RESTful APIs and web services. * Experience with mobile application development tools, debugging techniques, and testing practices. * Experience using source control tools such as Git and working within Agile development teams. * Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving, and technical communication skills. * Ability to collaborate effectively, manage priorities, and balance technical details with broader product goals. **Benefits** * Health insurance with a $0 deductible and premiums as low as $9\.00 * Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA * 401(k) with 6% match * Employee Stock Purchase Program * Company paid disability and life insurance * Paid time off \& 10 paid holidays

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000\+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership\-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition. Our team is growing and we are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our Professional Services team! In this role, you will own the full arc of our most strategic services engagements, from the first conversation about what AI could do for a customer's business, through the delivery that builds it, to the value they realize from it. You will scope and price the services that move an enterprise from AI ambition to AI running in production, support the sale of that work alongside the Account Owner, and orchestrate the consultants and engineers who deliver it. You will stay with the engagement well past the build, accountable for turning what the customer bought into AI that is genuinely doing their work. Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our **Denver** office. **About The Role** * Lead discovery with executives and process owners, then build the deployment strategy with them: which departments, workflows, and use cases move to intelligent, agent\-driven execution on the monday AI work platform. * Translate that strategy into a scoped and priced services engagement, owning packaging, effort and unit estimation, and the proposals and statements of work that carry it. * Support the sale of services alongside the Account Owner, articulating the path from a customer's current state to AI in production for stakeholders from technical staff to executive sponsors. * Define the work clearly enough for someone else to build it, capturing the outcome, the estimate, and the shape of the solution, then bring in the forward deployed consultants and engineers who execute it. * Own timeline, budget, quality, risk, and commercial administration across your engagements, running one\-time projects directly, overseeing execution on ongoing ones, and directing the resources assigned to you. * Define the work plan with customers on ongoing engagements, deciding together which AI use cases to build next and in what sequence. * Own AI value realization inside your engagements, tracking consumption against the plan agreed at sale and diagnosing where adoption gaps or unbuilt workflows hold it back. * Identify and/or support the next outcome opportunity within your accounts, and drive the additional services needed to deliver it — expanding the engagement as new use cases and workflows are identified. * Communicate status, risk, and progress to stakeholders at every level, manage escalations to resolution, and surface account risk and expansion signals to the Account Owner. * Feed the practice from the field, contributing the patterns, estimation inputs, and playbooks that make each AI deployment faster than the last. **Requirements** * Minimum 5 years of professional services experience in delivery management, engagement management, or technical program management, with significant time in front of enterprise customers delivering successful strategic outcomes * Experience in B2B SaaS scoping and delivering software implementation, transformation, or managed services engagements in complex enterprise environments, working in industry standard work management, project management, or CRM platforms. * Hands\-on experience with Generative and Agentic AI tools, and a strong understanding of how AI changes the way work gets done. * Commercial acumen sufficient to scope, price, and support the sale of services rather than simply deliver them, including effort estimation and statement of work authorship. * Experience with consumption\-based or usage\-based commercial models, and with holding a customer to the value they set out to achieve, is a strong plus. * A track record of leading technical and non\-technical delivery teams through influence, keeping the team aligned to a common goal. * Technical fluency sufficient to be credible in an architecture conversation and to recognize when an engagement needs deeper expertise: how enterprise systems exchange data, and when a goal calls for software to be built rather than configured. * Strong customer\-facing and presentation skills, able to establish credibility with executives, articulate technical topics to a non\-technical audience, and frame business outcomes for a technical one. * Detail\-oriented with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies. * Superb written and verbal communication skills, with a positive attitude, empathy, and the ability to take initiative and adapt. * Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time. * BA or BS degree preferred. **What** **monday.com** **can offer you:** * Join a customer\-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate \- not just things we put on a wall * Work on a multi\-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide * Competitive salary, benefits, bonus potential, and equity eligibility for many roles — we believe people should share in our success * Grow fast through a dedicated L\&D team, AI workshops, bootcamps, and internal hackathons \- the industry moves quick and so do we * A collaborative, global culture backed by Employee Resource Groups and workplace teams across New York, Tel Aviv, London, Munich, Warsaw, Tokyo, Sydney, and more *Visa sponsorship for this role is currently not available.* *monday.com* *is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.* *For Denver\-based hires only:* The estimated annual base salary range for this role is *$120,000 \- $160,000\. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including education, training, experience, business needs, and work location. In addition to base salary, employees are eligible for either an annual discretionary bonus or a role\-based, sales incentive plan. Certain roles may also include equity in the form of RSUs. Full compensation details, including any applicable bonus or incentive plan, will be provided in the hiring process.* *monday.com* *offers a competitive benefits package, including comprehensive medical/dental/vision insurance, generous paid time off (vacation, holidays, personal leave and sick leave), fully paid parental leave, automatic 401(k) contributions, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount (ESPP), and more. Full benefits details are available upon request. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis with no set deadline.* Compensation Range: $120K \- $160K
